jobs.description:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Campus Manager is a key partner responsible for operational excellence and organizational health through business PXT leadership across their campus. Leading a team of HR Partners and HR Business Partners, you will partner with site, business, and HR Leaders to strengthen culture and deliver business results. You translate PXT priorities into clear, actionable campus-level strategy, driving operational excellence, improving employee experience, and building scalable PXT practices that support performance and long-term growth. Success in this role depends on prioritization, sound judgment, and leading through others to drive measurable improvements in attrition, attendance, engagement, and leadership effectiveness across multiple sites. You will be expected to travel and work onsite at an Amazon facility’s, ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.

Key job responsibilities
PXT Operational Excellence
Ensure PXT teams across your campus execute with discipline, consistency, and alignment to Amazon standards. Use inspections and data to identify defects, validate process integrity, and reinforce accountability. Own end-to-end operational excellence through rigorous process execution, structured inspection routines, and effective use of tools and data. Ensure consistent documentation standards and timely issue resolution while escalating systemic concerns appropriately. Surface recurring system gaps and usability challenges to central teams, influencing scalable improvements. Promote continuous improvement through standardization and simplification.

Employee Experience & Culture
Drive engagement and retention by ensuring site leaders implement feedback mechanisms including Voice of the Associate boards, roundtables, and GEMBA walks. Deliver meaningful recognition programs with budget oversight and execution accountability. Champion safety standards through partnership with site leaders, ensuring consistent execution of safety programs and maintenance of workplace conditions. Maintain building standards through regular inspections and routines. Support community engagement initiatives that strengthen local impact. Monitor employee sentiment through regular floor presence, data analysis, and feedback mechanisms, holding leaders accountable for delivering positive experiences and implementing targeted action plans to strengthen culture.

PXT Leadership
Provide oversight on investigations, corrective actions, and employee relations matters, serving as final decision-maker on high-risk decisions including terminations. Manage escalations as primary escalation point for complex issues, partnering with Regional PXT, Legal, and ER teams. Mitigate compliance risks by establishing early warning systems and making high-judgment decisions that balance policy intent with business needs. Partner with country-level Governance teams and Works Council representatives to ensure effective consultation processes on site-level matters, maintaining constructive labor relations and compliance with co-determination requirements. Lead regional change initiatives through effective stakeholder management, removing adoption barriers and modelling positive behaviours. Foster collaboration between site and central PXT teams, maintaining strong partnerships across functions. Drive adoption and optimization of HR technology solutions to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and employee experience, developing digital fluency and leveraging analytics for decision-making.

Ops Talent Planning & Org Health
Support long-term business success through leadership development programs and coaching for operations leaders at all levels. Drive workforce and succession planning to ensure pipeline readiness for critical roles. Detect succession risks and implement mitigation strategies. Manage underperformance effectively, coaching leaders to address performance gaps and build high-performing teams.

PXT Leadership & Org Health
Build a high-performing PXT organization by investing in team development and professional growth. Manage PXT succession planning and promotion decisions, identifying high-potential talent. Create leadership exposure opportunities for team members. Assess team health through engagement metrics and feedback. Manage PXT headcount and resource allocation to ensure appropriate coverage and capability. Translate Amazon priorities into regional execution plans, ensuring alignment between campus operations and organizational strategy.

A day in the life
Your day blends business partnering and leadership with operational execution across multiple sites. You'll partner with Site, Business site and HR Leaders on complex organizational challenges while coaching your team of HR Partners and HR Business Partners to elevate their strategic impact. You'll conduct site walks to assess building standards and safety compliance, facilitate employee feedback sessions, and review operational metrics to identify trends. You'll make high-judgment decisions on investigations and corrective actions, manage escalations, and drive change initiatives at scale. Through data analysis and inspection routines, you'll identify systemic issues and influence central teams on scalable improvements. Success comes from your ability to lead through others, balance competing priorities, and drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance across your campus.

jobs.title: Integration & Deployment Supply Chain Manager, One MHS
jobs.description:
OMHS Integration & Delivery is building the team that installs and commissions Amazon's next-generation material handling systems. We are looking for a supply chain manager to own end-to-end material operations across our full portfolio of concurrent installation programs.

If you have spent your career coordinating material flow for large-scale industrial projects, you know that a missing a component can shut down an entire project. This role puts that supply chain discipline at the front of the deployment lifecycle. You will build and maintain the material planning frameworks that align procurement timelines, sequencing center operations, vendor deliveries, and site staging requirements with installation sequencing, ensuring the right materials arrive at the right site at the right time.

You will own material operations end-to-end: forecasting demand from design packages, managing inventory visibility across the network, coordinating delivery to field sites, and designing the technology ecosystem that ties it together. The position will drive improvements through inventory analytics, automation, and emerging AI-enabled tools to improve demand accuracy, reduce material-driven schedule risk, and enable deployment scalability across a growing portfolio of concurrent projects.

Key job responsibilities
Develop the end-to-end material sequencing strategy, including demand forecasting, kitting priority logic, phased delivery cadence, and staging workflows aligned to BOM requirements and installation schedules across the site portfolio.
Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Logistics teams to align vendor lead times, transportation plans, and delivery schedules with project milestones; identify and mitigate risks related to material availability, vendor performance, or shipping delays.
Own inventory visibility across sequencing centers and field sites through WMS platforms, maintaining real-time awareness of stock levels, material movement, and staging readiness.
Evaluate and implement inventory management and enterprise planning systems; own business requirements, operational workflow design, and user onboarding, partnering with IT on configuration and integration.
Design the material operations technology stack, including asset tracking (RFID/BLE), automated material delivery from staging to installation locations, and interoperability between inventory, tracking, and planning systems.
Manage material flow from sequencing centers to field sites, coordinating kitting, delivery frequency, transportation mode, and staging logistics aligned to crew deployment schedules.
Develop inventory standard work including receiving protocols, cycle counts, and material accountability frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement through analytics, AI-enabled forecasting, planning dashboards, and post-deployment material reviews.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of supply chain management, planning, strategic sourcing, commodity management or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- 5+ years of experience with inventory management systems (WMS, ERP, or equivalent)
Preferred qualifications:

- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools

- Experience in construction, industrial installation, or large-scale equipment deployment environments
- Experience implementing warehouse automation technologies (autonomous mobile robots, automated storage/retrieval, conveyor integration)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is looking for a motivated Supply Chain Intern to join our team in Singapore. In this role, you will drive documentation standardization, create internal enablement resources, build operational playbooks, and explore agentic AI solutions - all within a global supply chain that powers AWS's infrastructure worldwide. You will be able to leverage Amazon's suite of AI tools, Amazon Quick, and its underlying models to optimize your workflow and productivity while continuing to grow and develop your acumen in AI.

Key job responsibilities
Site Management Framework & Governance: Conduct site visits across APAC warehouses to understand operations firsthand, followed by a gap assessment of existing SOPs, governance, and reporting. Develop a standardized Site Management Framework covering vendor governance, SLA management, performance scorecards, RCCA processes, and escalation matrices. Establish a sustainable review cadence with clear ownership to ensure the framework remains current beyond tenure.

SOP Development & Process Documentation: Author Standard Operating Procedures for key warehouse operational areas including receiving, outbound, inventory management, and exception handling. Develop standardized work instructions and process flows that enable consistent execution across sites and accelerate onboarding of new team members and WSP staff. Ensure all documentation is repeatable, clear, and audit-ready.

Data, Analytics & Automation: Identify opportunities to automate recurring operational workflows using AI agent tooling and Python, such as daily metrics consolidation, exception alerting, SLA tracking, and vendor performance reporting. Build automated workflows and document them as replicable playbooks for adoption across the APAC network.

No two days look the same, but every day has a rhythm. jobs.description:
OMHS Integration & Delivery is building the team that installs and commissions Amazon's next-generation material handling systems. We are looking for a supply chain manager to own end-to-end material operations across our full portfolio of concurrent installation programs.

If you have spent your career coordinating material flow for large-scale industrial projects, you know that a missing a component can shut down an entire project. This role puts that supply chain discipline at the front of the deployment lifecycle. You will build and maintain the material planning frameworks that align procurement timelines, sequencing center operations, vendor deliveries, and site staging requirements with installation sequencing, ensuring the right materials arrive at the right site at the right time.

You will own material operations end-to-end: forecasting demand from design packages, managing inventory visibility across the network, coordinating delivery to field sites, and designing the technology ecosystem that ties it together. The position will drive improvements through inventory analytics, automation, and emerging AI-enabled tools to improve demand accuracy, reduce material-driven schedule risk, and enable deployment scalability across a growing portfolio of concurrent projects.

Key job responsibilities
Develop the end-to-end material sequencing strategy, including demand forecasting, kitting priority logic, phased delivery cadence, and staging workflows aligned to BOM requirements and installation schedules across the site portfolio.
Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Logistics teams to align vendor lead times, transportation plans, and delivery schedules with project milestones; identify and mitigate risks related to material availability, vendor performance, or shipping delays.
Own inventory visibility across sequencing centers and field sites through WMS platforms, maintaining real-time awareness of stock levels, material movement, and staging readiness.
Evaluate and implement inventory management and enterprise planning systems; own business requirements, operational workflow design, and user onboarding, partnering with IT on configuration and integration.
Design the material operations technology stack, including asset tracking (RFID/BLE), automated material delivery from staging to installation locations, and interoperability between inventory, tracking, and planning systems.
Manage material flow from sequencing centers to field sites, coordinating kitting, delivery frequency, transportation mode, and staging logistics aligned to crew deployment schedules.
Develop inventory standard work including receiving protocols, cycle counts, and material accountability frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement through analytics, AI-enabled forecasting, planning dashboards, and post-deployment material reviews.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of supply chain management, planning, strategic sourcing, commodity management or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- 5+ years of experience with inventory management systems (WMS, ERP, or equivalent)
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience in business analytics and reporting or demand forecasting
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Experience in construction, industrial installation, or large-scale equipment deployment environments
- Experience implementing warehouse automation technologies (autonomous mobile robots, automated storage/retrieval, conveyor integration)

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Business Development Specialist HPC, US Federal & Public Sector, WWSO HPC Team
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of a team redefining the IT industry for the Federal and Public Sector market? The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) within AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Business Development Manager to develop and lead go-to-market strategies for HPC and Accelerated Compute solutions serving Defense, Intelligence Community, and civilian federal agencies.
In this role, you will own the end-to-end GTM strategy for HPC in the US Federal market, with particular emphasis on AWS Government Regions (GovCloud, Secret Region, Top Secret Region). You will identify and develop business strategies that address critical HPC requirements for customers operating in classified and regulated environments, while building and executing campaigns that drive out-year growth across the federal HPC portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing partnership and deal strategies, managing strategic customer relationships at senior and executive levels, and driving top-line revenue growth for the federal HPC business. Success requires the ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges while working effectively with cross-functional teams to drive performance goals. You must be able to craft compelling value propositions, develop business case and financial proposals, and influence technical decisions at the highest levels of federal agencies.

As an HPC Specialist within WWSO, you will have direct influence on AWS product roadmaps — bringing federal customer insights back to EC2, Batch, and other HPC service teams. Your work will define how Public Sector, Defense and Intelligence agencies modernize from legacy on-premises HPC clusters to cloud-native, mission-ready infrastructure at the convergence of silicon, AI/ML, and advanced computing.

The ideal candidate will possess deep understanding of cloud computing and HPC architectures and operations (on-premises and/or cloud); demonstrated experience executing HPC GTM in the US federal market; and proven success influencing product management and introducing new products into federal and regulated markets.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and execute end-to-end GTM strategy for HPC in the US Public Sector, Govt. and Federal market, developing and executing comprehensive strategies that drive adoption across Defense, Intelligence Community, and civilian agencies.
- Work with cross-functional teams (sales, solutions architecture, product engineering, partners, marketing) to validate customer requirements, perform proofs of concept, and define pathways to production adoption
- Identify specific customer segments and partners to approach with targeted value propositions, build and qualify pipeline and support engagement through the entire business development cycle
- Develop business cases to support product feature requests for segment specific HPC use cases and workload classes, ensuring government-specific requirements are prioritized in AWS product roadmaps
- Define, develop, and manage HPC-focused AWS programs and initiatives tailored to US Federal, Public Sector and regulated industry customers, including workshops, immersion days, migration frameworks, and reference architectures.
- Collect, create, and manage sales and marketing collateral to facilitate the business development process, including whitepapers, solution briefs, customer success stories, and executive presentations
- Monitor customer onboarding and adoption; develop approaches to increase adoption rates, revenue growth, and workload retention for HPC workloads in AWS
- Execute on revenue, and non-revenue KPIs, delivering regular business reviews to senior leadership

About the team
This position is part of the WWSO HPC Specialist team, driving market adoption for AWS's HPC Cloud and services, and emerging AI/ML accelerated compute capabilities — through data-driven analytics, financial metrics, and strategic GTM programs. We create sales plays, build partner ecosystems, and develop programs that drive measurable results. We work closely with Public Sector and Federal Sector customers, DIBs/ federal systems integrators, HPC ISV partners to build an ecosystem supporting AWS success. We operate with a startup mentality within the world's leading cloud provider, combining entrepreneurial ownership with the resources and scale of AWS.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Bachelor's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology or equivalent
- 5+ years of working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute and High Performance Compute.
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret or above
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology or equivalent
- Proven track record influencing product management teams and successfully introducing new products into federal and regulated markets.
- Strong technical competency in cloud computing, web services, enterprise software, and HPC architectures, and GPU-accelerated computing
- Experience with compliance/security regimes germane to Defense and National Security (DoD SRG, ICD 503, NIST SP 800-53/171, CMMC, ITAR, DFARS, FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/5/6, FIPS 140-2/3)
- Experience with federal systems, HPC partner ecosystem and ISVs

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success, Selection & Brand Success, ESM
jobs.description:
Amazon Global Selling is a key initiative to achieve our vision to offer customers Earth's largest selection. We provide businesses the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform worldwide. Each year, tens of thousands of businesses join our Marketplace in 10 countries, adding millions of new products.
Amazon's Asia Global Selling organization is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Customer Success to lead and scale our Strategic Account Management operations. This senior leader will own the end-to-end strategy for driving seller selection growth, selection success, promotion effectiveness, and brand success, while leading seller engagement, campaign optimization, seller profiling, and talent development across the organization. Reporting to senior leadership, s/he will be responsible for building high-performing teams, setting the strategic direction for seller success programs, and driving measurable business outcomes at scale.
The ideal candidate is a seasoned people leader with a strong track record of managing and developing teams, driving cross-functional programs, and delivering results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. S/he combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, leverages data to inform decisions, and has the ability to influence senior stakeholders across the organization. Experience in marketplace/e-commerce, seller/partner ecosystem management, or customer success at scale is highly preferred.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Team Management
• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of program managers and customer success professionals; set clear goals and drive a high-performance culture
• Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for seller engagement and success programs, aligning with Asia Global Selling business priorities
• Build organizational capability and talent bench strength through structured hiring, onboarding, and learning & development programs
Seller Engagement & Campaign Management
• Own the planning, execution, and optimization of seller engagement campaigns and strategic marketing events end-to-end
• Establish scalable frameworks for campaign creation, measurement, and continuous improvement; present campaign results and strategic recommendations to senior leadership
• Drive innovation in how we engage, retain, and grow strategic sellers across the Asia region
• Define and execute strategies to accelerate seller selection growth, improve selection success rates, optimize promotion effectiveness, and strengthen brand success metrics
Seller Profiling & Operational Excellence
• Own the seller profiling workstream across the organization — define mechanisms, develop tools, and drive adoption of data-driven seller insights
• Establish and optimize operational processes, workflows, and tooling to improve team efficiency and seller outcomes
• Build and leverage dashboards and data infrastructure to identify opportunities, track performance, and inform strategic decisions
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
• Partner with Account Management, Product, Marketing, and Business Intelligence teams to align on priorities and translate ambiguous requirements into executable plans
• Serve as the key point of contact for customer success initiatives with senior leadership, ensuring alignment and visibility across the organization
• Drive cross-team mechanisms for knowledge sharing, best practice dissemination, and holistic seller learning synthesis
Talent Development
• Own the Strategic Account Manager training strategy — design learning modules, coordinate training sessions, and measure effectiveness
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational rigor within the team
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 8+ years of experience in program/project management, customer success, account management, or related fields
- 5+ years of people management experience, including managing managers or cross-functional teams
- Proven track record of driving business results through strategic planning and operational execution
- Experience working with data analytics and business intelligence tools to drive decision-making
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree (MBA or relevant advanced degree)
- Experience in e-commerce, marketplace, or seller/partner ecosystem management
- Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
- Experience managing large-scale seller/customer engagement programs across multiple geographies
- Track record of building teams and organizational capabilities from the ground up
- Proficiency in SQL, Excel, or BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau)

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Mgr. - Supply Chain, Strategic Vendor Acceleration (SVA)
jobs.description:
Want to drive worldwide growth and reduce Cost to Serve for Amazon, working with some of Amazon's top global vendors? We have an exciting opportunity for you. The Strategic Vendor Acceleration (SVA) team was created to accelerate the growth and profitability of strategic vendors across Amazon Worldwide (WW) Stores. Our team creates solutions to drive better customer and vendor experience and enable improved selection and value propositions worldwide.
Amazon is looking for an analytical, results-oriented, self-directed, and customer-focused candidate to join the Strategic Vendor Acceleration team as a Sr. Business Development Manager – Supply Chain. We are seeking a customer-obsessed individual with vendor management skills to build collaborative relationships with both vendors and vendor management teams across WW Amazon Stores (US, Canada, Europe, Japan, MENA (Middle East and North Africa), Mexico, Brazil and India websites). This is a highly visible role, working with vendor executives and Amazon teams across multiple WW stores, and your work will directly impact how we evolve and grow Amazon’s global business.

Key job responsibilities
•Work with internal and external business teams to develop solutions that optimize the inbound supply chain network by improving cost structure, service levels, vendor lead times, and quality of the program.
•Design solutions, develop business cases, and manage projects from design to production.
•Collaborate with internal teams and suppliers to identify best-in-class inbound supply chain networks.
•Map physical and data flows and develop and deliver a roadmap of initiatives to achieve the ideal state in existing and new stores, including vendor education.
•Prioritize and deliver initiatives that reduce lead times and costs across the end-to-end supply chain with global vendor partners.
•Identify areas for improvement, select the best supply chain programs, and develop metrics to monitor inbound supply chain performance.
•Plan and execute vendor Gembas (Japanese improvement methodology where you go and see where the work is done) to drive the right supply chain program adoption and reduce mutual cost to serve with vendors globally.
•Create models and tools for profitability analysis to measure and improve cost structure by product group and program.
•Lead focused and strategically critical projects across WW Stores as required to support Global Supply Chain Operations.
•Diagnose Amazon processes, recognize supplier needs, identify improvement opportunities, prescribe improvement strategies, and guide improvement efforts.
•Motivate and influence cross-functional teams to meet challenging deadlines in a high-growth, deadline-driven environment while achieving impeccable quality.
•Deliver results aligned with Amazon priorities including working backwards from customer needs, thinking beyond constraints, fact based decision making, and ability to earn trust with stakeholders.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional or military experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience understanding product and technical requirements and interfacing with Product/Technology teams
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification

jobs.title: Sr BIE Manager, Supply Chain, Supply Chain, Mexico
jobs.description:
Lead the data and business insights team along with the AI strategy for Mexico's Supply Chain organization, owning a portfolio of BI and data products that power decisions across 10 functional areas, from network topology and capacity planning to last mile operations and cross-LATAM AI enablement.

As a Sr. Manager of Business Intelligence Engineering, your first role is to lead a group of 11 Business Intelligence Engineers: teach, coach, and develop them as your first priority. You will build a high-performing team that is stronger because of your presence but does not require your presence to be successful. You will attract and retain top BI talent, decide staffing and skill mix, drive growth into higher-technical-complexity work, and keep the team motivated through recognition, codified onboarding, and work-life harmony across a distributed team.

After that, you will own the AI strategy and data systems for the organization, leading the data infrastructure, pipelines, and reporting that power a portfolio of BI and data products across Mexico's Supply Chain. You will increase data availability and efficiency, improve data confidence and reliability, and scale existing systems into AI-ready platforms while building net-new infrastructure to support the needs of a rapidly evolving Supply Chain business. You will own end-to-end analytical solutions that are highly available, scalable, stable, secure, and cost-effective.

This is a unique opportunity to build the AI-ready data foundation for one of Amazon's fastest-growing markets, lead a team of 11 Business Intelligence Engineers, and define how GenAI and ML transform supply chain decision-making at scale.
MX Supply Chain Business Intelligence & AI owns the data, insights, and analytics that power how Amazon's Mexico Supply Chain organization understands its business, measures its customer experience, and makes decisions. The team serves 10 functional areas including Topology, S&OP, Network Planning, Middle Mile, Last Mile (OTR/UTR), Sort Centers, External Fulfillment, and FC Operations, with growing cross-LATAM collaboration with Brazil. The data that powers our decisions, from network capacity and speed to compliance, cost, and operational performance, must be available, efficient, and trusted.

Our team of Business Intelligence Engineers works together to deliver the data infrastructure, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting that underpin MX Supply Chain's most critical business metrics. We are at an inflection point: as we embed GenAI across the portfolio and scale an AI-ready data lakehouse (Apache Iceberg on serverless AWS) across LATAM, the decisions our stakeholders make depend on data they can trust, access quickly, and act on confidently.

Key job responsibilities
Drive team growth through mentoring, coaching, career development, BIE tech assessments, and lateral moves into roles of higher technical complexity

Own the AI-ready data foundation that powers MX Supply Chain's GenAI/ML initiatives, including the data lakehouse platform and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose trusted, governed datasets to agentic and self-service AI workflows

Delivery of robust, scalable data solutions supporting MX Supply Chain's data infrastructure across all functional areas, mile types, and geos

Leadership in data governance, single-source-of-truth definitions, quality standards, metric accountability, and SLA enforcement across the MX Supply Chain data ecosystem

Collaborate with central teams to deploy AI solutions and align strategies and resources, negotiating coexistence and shared metric definitions while preserving local execution speed

Own technical delivery and team leadership for development and maintenance of scalable ETL/big-data pipelines, medallion-architecture data lakes, semantic layers, and dashboard data models

Collaborate with Product Management, BI teams, and stakeholders to prioritize work aligned with MX Supply Chain business goals

Establish best practices for data engineering, including code reviews, testing, monitoring, naming conventions, alarms, and documentation

Reduce time-to-insight for product, leadership, and partner teams by increasing data availability and efficiency

About the team
The team is responsible for the development of business-critical BI and analytics solutions: datasets, real-time capacity and speed analytics, ML-based planning models, network speed analytics, automated compliance platforms, and an AI-ready data lakehouse serving as the LATAM data platform built on Apache Iceberg with Infrastructure as Code.

The incumbent sets the organization's BI architecture where the strategy is not yet defined, operating with complete independence in ambiguous problem spaces to determine not only how to build, but which business questions the organization should be asking of its data.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
- 6+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience using Python or R for data analysis or statistical tools such as SAS
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with AWS products and services
- Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in computer architecture
- 5+ years of SQL experience
- 5+ Experience in ETL management/data pipeline
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior management
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- 7+ years of developing automated reporting experience
- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst, CFX - Brazil
jobs.description:
The LATAM CFX team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Business Intelligence Analyst (BA) to help us build an exceptional Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) in the complex and exciting Concessions (NCRC) and Returns Experience (RCX) space to support LATAM fast-paced growth.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BA) in this team, you will be responsible for driving and building data & analytics solutions to identify, prevent, anticipate, solve for customer pain points, network defects, abuse behaviors, policy and catalog gaps, and opportunities throughout the purchase and post-purchase journey in MX and BR.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BA), you'll be at the heart of Amazon's data-driven culture, building programmatic and analytics solutions that power intelligent business decisions and solve opportunities about concessions, returns experience & policies, operating procedures, network and product/program's logic. Your insights will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

You will partner closely with MX/BR NCRC & Returns PMs, BIE Leads and Engineers, Operations Managers, and IES BIE/Applied Scientists to solve business problems and should be skilled at translating complex or ambiguous problem statements into analytic requirements.

Additionally, you will act in an analytic consultative capacity and can both articulate the “so-what” of your analytic results and model potential/real outcomes of proposed solutions to senior leadership.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business and make data-driven conclusions and programmatic solutions with direct impact in Amazon's profitability. They will be comfortable with ambiguity and learning new analytical skills, while working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Insights and Solutions
- You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping journey.
- Spearhead business intelligence & data analytics initiatives that directly impact Amazon's profitability.
- You develop advanced analytical tools and models to uncover hidden business opportunities.
- Present compelling insights, business models, programs, workflows, policies recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decisions.

Innovate with Advanced Analytics
- Harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI to generate business impact
- Lead data-driven discussions with Product and Operations teams to accelerate growth and solve for leakages
- Pioneer new methodologies in returns experience, abuse and defect analytics, setting industry standards
- Create intuitive and automated analytical tools that transform complex data into clear, actionable insights
- Continuously innovate and simplify tools and processes, maximizing impact

jobs.title: Manager, Business Intelligence, Fraud Investigations, Recovery & Enforcement (FIRE)
jobs.description:
Are you a data leader who wants to reinvent business intelligence around AI, and put that reinvention to work protecting Amazon from fraud and financial loss? Do you want to lead a team that is moving beyond static dashboards to production-grade AI agents that investigate, detect, and act autonomously?

The Fraud Investigations, Recovery and Enforcement (FIRE) team is looking for a Manager, Business Intelligence to lead a team of Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineering that owns fraud prevention, detection, and investigation analytics for FinOps. This is not a traditional reporting role. We are transforming BI from a passive, dashboard-centric function into an AI-powered fraud analytics engine, embedding AI in every layer of the stack, and shifting our stakeholders from reading static reports to interacting with active, conversational, and autonomous workflows that surface risk, explain it, and act on it.

You will set the technical and analytical direction for a team that has already delivered multi-agent investigation platforms, agents that cut per-query handling time by roughly 70%, and a billion-row entity layer that serves as a single source of truth across FIRE's fraud programs. Your mandate is to push this further: make AI the default in reporting, detection, and investigation; convert manual, human-in-the-loop analysis into agentic and self-service workflows; and keep the underlying data platform robust and scalable enough to deploy AI models with confidence.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will coach BIEs and DE toward high-judgment ownership, partner deeply with Data Science, FinTech, and FinAuto, and work directly with FIRE Investigators and Program Managers to translate ambiguous fraud problems into agentic, measurable solutions. The position is based in Hyderabad and reports to FIRE leadership. The ideal candidate is a Think Big, invent-and-simplify leader who is energized by building AI at the frontier of fraud analytics and by growing engineers who operate above their level.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, hire, develop, and retain a team of 4 Business Intelligence Engineers and 1 Data Engineer; set a high bar, create structured growth paths, and grow engineers who consistently operate above level.
- Own the BI strategy and roadmap for FinOps fraud prevention, detection, and investigation, spanning reporting, analytics, detection models, data platform, and automation.
- Embed AI in every layer of business intelligence, from data ingestion and entity resolution to detection, investigation, and reporting, and set the standard for how the team designs, evaluates, and productionizes AI/LLM solutions.
- Drive the shift from passive, static dashboards to active, conversational, and autonomous workflows, including agentic investigation tools, conversational and self-service data access, and autonomous detection and dispositioning that reduce human effort and time-to-action.
- Partner with FIRE Investigators and Program Managers to translate fraud and investigation problems into agent architectures and analytical solutions, securing stakeholder alignment across fraud program leadership.
- Own and evolve FIRE's fraud data platform (for example, entity and risk-intelligence layers) so it is robust, scalable, and reliable enough to serve production AI models and self-service prototyping at billion-row scale.
- Partner with Data Science, FinTech, and FinAuto to establish and streamline the prototype-to-production lifecycle, reduce deployment overhead, and enable direct collaboration across environments.
- Define and own the metrics and savings methodology that quantify fraud rates, exposure, loss, recovery, and detection coverage, and automate P0, WBR, and MBR reporting via agents.
- Establish and enforce best practices in data integrity, model and change management, code quality, testing, and documentation across the team.
- Prioritize competing requests across fraud programs and investigations, balancing urgent operational needs with durable platform and AI investments.
- Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, insights, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership, across regions.

A day in the life
You start by reviewing the health of the fraud data platform and the agents running in production, checking that overnight incremental refreshes landed and that the investigation and reporting agents are performing within expectations. You meet 1:1 with a BIE architecting a new detection agent, coaching them on the agent design, evaluation strategy, and how to secure alignment from Retail Fraud leadership. You then work with a Program Manager and a Data Scientist to scope a conversational, self-service workflow that lets investigators query case data in natural language instead of waiting on a dashboard. In the afternoon, you review a Data Engineer's entity-layer pipeline design to ensure it scales for the next set of fraud entities, align with FinAuto and FinTech on the prototype-to-production path, and present detection-coverage and savings-methodology findings to senior stakeholders. Throughout, you balance shipping today's automation against the platform and AI investments that make FIRE's analytics increasingly autonomous.
Basic qualifications:
- 7+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
- 5+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with ETL
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with R, Python, Weka, SAS, Matlab or other statistical/machine learning software
Preferred qualifications:
- 4+ years of working with very large data warehousing environment experience
- 10+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
- Experience across the domain of risk management & fraud
- Experience with various statistical techniques (regression analysis, coefficient correlation)
- Experience with Generative AI architecture patterns, including multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and fine-tuning, and building agentic, conversational, or autonomous workflows.

jobs.description:
Amazon’s Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international grocery and highly perishable supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders, to Retail teams and everything in between. You’ll help us optimize our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities
- Define our Demand Planning strategy in 5 European countries (UK, IT, ES, DE, FR), across our Fresh Online, Same Day and Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) Grocery banners.
- Analyse and interpret data to deeply understand regional customer demand patterns and improve demand planning accuracy, helping the business drive efficiency across our end-to-end supply chain (from Inbound to Customer Outbound).
- Partner with ground Operations, Last Mile Delivery and Business teams, incorporating their inputs into our forecasting routine.
- Align complex Demand Planning strategies with Snr Leadership and financial partners.

Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to shape demand planning strategies for our ever growing groceries business.

As a Supply Chain Manager leading our S&OP vertical, you’ll need to help with both tactical and strategic work. No two days will be the same. You might spend Monday modelling demand scenarios for a new Amazon Sub-Same-Day site launch, and Tuesday partnering with Last Mile Ops to resolve a resource capacity gap impacting our customer delivery speeds, across five International regions. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

This role will be carried out from our corporate location in London (LHR16 UK).

The INT Supply Chain (Grocery) Execution team breathes life into our newest ideas and incubates them until they grow into sophisticated businesses. We’ve got the energy of an exciting start-up, as our team works on Amazon’s next big project, under the umbrella of one of the world’s biggest companies.

We work behind the scenes to support new areas of the business - like Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) stores and our online Same Day perishables service. There are lots of opportunities for every skill set, from operations to supply chain to data management.

SC Execution's goal is to help develop new capabilities within Amazon on behalf of our customers. This entrepreneurial team has a deep understanding of the needs of our customers, employees and partners and helps to develop Amazon businesses of all sizes.

We grow new opportunities that will help Amazon diversify even more, taking them from concepts to mature operations that operate as standalone businesses. This dynamic environment supports our people’s growth and development.

We use automated alarms for real-time pipeline monitoring and AI-powered agents to self-heal failures and triage tasks, minimizing manual intervention at this scale.

These SOPs help all PMs, Sales, and Finance stakeholders deep-dive with governed data, technical depth, and the right queries — enabling reproducibility and easy follow-ups across the organization.
Everything we build is designed to be sustainable, reproducible, and available on demand — so any team member can pick up, extend, or re-run work without starting from scratch.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager (S&OP), INT Supply Chain Grocery Execution
jobs.description:
Amazon’s Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international grocery and highly perishable supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders, to Retail teams and everything in between. You’ll help us optimize our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities
- Define our Demand Planning strategy in 5 European countries (UK, IT, ES, DE, FR), across our Fresh Online and Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) Grocery banners.
- Analyse and interpret data to deeply understand regional customer demand patterns and improve demand planning accuracy, helping the business drive efficiency across our end-to-end supply chain (from Inbound to Customer Outbound).
- Partner with ground Operations, Last Mile Delivery and Business teams, incorporating their inputs into our forecasting routine.
- Align complex Demand Planning strategies with Snr Leadership and financial partners.

A day in the life
Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to shape demand planning strategies for our ever growing groceries business.

As a Supply Chain Manager leading our S&OP vertical, you’ll need to help with both tactical and strategic work. No two days will be the same. You might spend Monday modelling demand scenarios for a new Amazon Fresh dark store launch, and Tuesday partnering with Last Mile Ops to resolve a resource capacity gap impacting our customer delivery speeds, across three International regions. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

This role will be carried out from our corporate location in London (LHR16 UK).

About the team
The INT Supply Chain Grocery Execution team breathes life into our newest ideas and incubates them until they grow into sophisticated businesses. We’ve got the energy of an exciting start-up, as our team works on Amazon’s next big project, under the umbrella of one of the world’s biggest companies.

We work behind the scenes to support new areas of the business - like Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) stores and our online grocery service. There are lots of opportunities for every skill set, from operations to supply chain to data management.

SC Execution's goal is to help develop new capabilities within Amazon on behalf of our customers. This entrepreneurial team has a deep understanding of the needs of our customers, employees and partners and helps to develop Amazon businesses of all sizes.

We grow new opportunities that will help Amazon diversify even more, taking them from concepts to mature operations that operate as standalone businesses. This dynamic environment supports our people’s growth and development.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst, AMZL PSX
jobs.description:
Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join the Pricing & Payments team within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization, as part of the Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. This role owns the design, development, and maintenance of data intelligence solutions, automated mechanisms, and analytical frameworks that ensure pricing accuracy, payment reliability, and financial health across all delivery partner programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large).

As an Individual Contributor, you will be the data and automation backbone of the Payments & Pricing function — building pipelines, dashboards, reconciliation mechanisms, and self-service tools that eliminate manual processes, reduce payment errors, and provide real-time visibility into financial operations. You will partner closely with Payments Specialists, Pricing Specialists, Finance, and Operations to turn complex data into actionable intelligence.

This role reports directly to the Pricing & Payments Manager and works cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Technology, and partner-facing teams.

This position is based out of an AMZL office.

If you are passionate about building intelligent data solutions, automating complex processes, and driving financial precision through analytics, come join our team.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and ETL processes that support payment reconciliation, pricing validation, and financial reporting across all partner programs

Develop and maintain SQL-based queries, views, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational and financial datasets

Build and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms (QuickSight, Tableau, or equivalent) providing real-time visibility into payment status, pricing accuracy, disputes, and financial KPIs

Create automated reconciliation mechanisms that identify payment discrepancies, pricing errors, and anomalies before they impact partners — reducing manual intervention and improving trust

Develop self-service analytical tools that enable the Payments and Pricing team to access insights without requiring ad-hoc requests

Automate recurring reports and manual processes, driving efficiency gains across the Payments & Pricing function

Conduct deep-dive analyses on payment cycles, dispute patterns, incentive effectiveness, and pricing model performance to support data-driven decision-making

Build alerting and exception-handling mechanisms that proactively flag issues (e.g., payment delays, pricing inconsistencies, unusual dispute volumes)

Partner with Technology and Engineering teams to define data requirements, validate data sources, and ensure data quality and integrity

Support the development of pricing models and incentive simulations by providing historical data analysis, scenario modeling, and impact projections

Document all data solutions, pipelines, and mechanisms with clear technical specifications and operational runbooks

Present analytical findings and automation proposals to stakeholders, translating technical solutions into business value

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking the automated health monitors you built for the payment pipeline. An alert fires — a batch of AMPL partner payments shows a 3% discrepancy against expected values. You dive into the SQL query that powers the reconciliation engine, identify a data source lag from a route restructuring, and push a fix before the payment cycle closes.

Mid-morning, you join a sync with the Payments Specialists to review a new automated dispute detection mechanism you're piloting. The early results are promising: 40% of disputes that previously required manual review are now auto-classified and routed, saving 15+ hours per week.

Before lunch, you finalize a new QuickSight dashboard for the Pricing team — it visualizes incentive effectiveness across partner segments, showing which incentive structures drive the best delivery performance per Real invested. You walk the Pricing Specialist through the self-service filters and drill-down capabilities.

After lunch, you deep-dive into a request from the Ops Excellence Manager: they need historical payment data cross-referenced with partner Scorecard performance to validate a hypothesis about payment timeliness and delivery quality correlation. You build the query, visualize the results, and share a brief with your findings.

Late afternoon, you work on your current sprint priority: automating the monthly partner payment summary that currently takes 8 hours of manual work. You're building a Python script that pulls from three data sources, reconciles automatically, and generates the formatted output — target: zero manual hours by next month.

You close the day documenting the new pipeline you deployed this week and updating the team's automation roadmap with next quarter's priorities.

About the team
The Business Intelligence Analyst sits within the Pricing & Payments team, part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. The Pricing & Payments function owns one of PSX's core pillars: "Pricing accuracy, incentive effectiveness, and payment reliability: ensuring financial health and trust across all delivery channels."

The team manages pricing models, payment cycles, incentive structures, and dispute resolution for +30 logistics partners across Brazil. The BI Analyst is the technical engine of this function — building the data infrastructure, automations, and intelligence that enable the team to operate at scale with precision and speed.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Transportation, Mathematics, Economics, Physics or another technical field
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience building data pipelines or automated ETL processes
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
- Experience in translating business needs into detailed feature requirements
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in SQL Server/MySQL
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
Preferred qualifications:
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with financial services, payments or e-commerce
- Experience with creating automated alarms, reports and KPI metrics for plant management
- Knowledge of finance, accounting, business or related field focused on analytics
- Experience working with Git or an equivalent distributed version control system
- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
- Experience automating routine tasks
- Knowledge of data structures, data modeling, and database schema
- Master's degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or related science field, or Master's degree and 2+ years of data scientist experience
- Experience in Amazon Redshift and other AWS technologies

Business intelligence engineers use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic Account Services
jobs.description:
The Strategic Account Services (SAS) organization is seeking Customer Success Managers to shape the future of the program and drive business growth for some of the most influential Sellers and Brands on the Amazon Store. CSMs ensure program satisfaction by delivering an optimal level of service through strategic insights and relentlessly high operational standards.

In this role, you will own building and executing strategic joint business plans with your Sellers, collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, traffic and conversion drivers, and operational improvement opportunities. You will also develop and manage a pipeline mix of both high-value and transactional accounts while executing sales and account management strategies to deliver results that exceed output goals. This includes identifying and building relationships with key influencers and decision-makers within the senior management and executive teams of prospective and existing accounts, along with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams, to create and present compelling Amazon solutions that meet and exceed customer requirements.

The ideal candidate should possess client management skills with the keen ability to work backwards with Sellers to identify and prioritize the right inputs and outputs to deliver value and growth. They will be able to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced work environment and actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives to multiply impact beyond their portfolios. Above all, they should demonstrate ownership and the ability to embrace and navigate ambiguity and complexity. They are agile, inventive, and an advocate for their Sellers' experience on the Amazon Store.

Key job responsibilities
Customer Success Managers are responsible for driving Seller business growth by providing customized insights and recommendations, educating on relevant tools, products, and services, and delivering a positive experience with the program. This includes analyzing data and trends to maximize long-term potential for an assigned portfolio of Sellers, leading business strategy development and long-term account planning, and acting as a strategic and consultative partner who proactively identifies new opportunities and presents compelling value propositions. CSMs manage and deliver against complex account goals — often where strategy is not yet defined — making tradeoffs between short-term customer needs and longer-term strategic investment while implementing and tracking metrics to uncover hidden areas of opportunity.

CSMs also serve as trusted advisors and business advocates for their Sellers, delivering timely operational support within specified SLAs and coordinating cross-functionally to resolve issues quickly and with high quality. They play a "consultant" role with oversight of key strategic activities, escalating and clearing blockers across multiple organizations while advocating as the Voice of the Customer internally. On the process excellence side, CSMs act as thought leaders in defining success criteria, improve team efficiency by optimizing processes and delivering critical solutions, and identify feature enhancements and new products based on customer feedback, data analysis, and competitive gaps. They own project status communication and aggregate themes to address root-cause opportunities with owning teams.

A day in the life
Customer Success Managers balance their day across three core activities:
● Outbound prospecting: Conducting calls and email outreach to prospective Sellers to identify growth and optimization opportunities
● Active account management: Communicating with engaged Sellers to execute against joint business plans, review performance metrics, educate on new tools and programs, and drive progress on strategic initiatives
● Internal deep dives: Collaborating cross-functionally to resolve Seller friction points, clear blockers, analyze data trends, and advocate for Seller needs with internal partner teams
CSMs work autonomously while earning the trust of their peers and Sellers. They are highly motivated, results-driven, and operate with a consultative mindset — whether managing long-term strategic accounts or time-bound engagements focused on specific optimization goals like FBA supply chain improvement.

About the team
CSMs in Strategic Account Services operate within category-specific portfolios (e.g., Health & Personal Care), managing high-value, long-term Seller relationships with a focus on strategic growth, program satisfaction, and driving business results for some of Amazon's most influential Brands and Sellers. The team's mission is driving Seller success on the Amazon Store through data-driven insights, consultative partnership, and relentless operational excellence.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience analysing market opportunities, engaging and negotiating with customers, and defining new areas of innovation
- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- Experience using analysis, reporting, modeling, and forecasting to gather data for the purpose of making business decisions
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience building customer relationships, identifying business opportunities for clients and increasing adoption and utilization of company products

jobs.title: Cloud Intelligence Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Join a team of cloud experts focused on uncovering and articulating advantages for AWS Customers!

The AWS Cloud Intelligence team is a specialty services organization that provides cloud compete expertise globally. We are subject matter experts (SMEs) covering top and emerging competitors, key domains, and industry segments. Cloud Intelligence enables field teams to help their customers quickly by removing both business and technical blockers in the sales cycle. We advise account teams and their customers through at scale content, gather and analyze insights surrounding comparable cloud providers, and highlight product and position gaps that our customers are experiencing to continuously improve AWS’ overall value proposition. In addition to on-demand self-service resources, the CI team provides targeted support for specific competitive opportunities through one-to-one customer engagements. This team hires SAs and BDMs who are SMEs in one or more public clouds to advise AWS field teams on the best strategies to develop compelling business cases to support customers co-existing and partnering with competing public cloud services.

As a Cloud Intelligence Field BDM, you will be a strategic partner to the AWS field sales team. You will help customers understand why AWS is the best cloud partner for their business. You will coach sales teams on how to amplify AWS strengths and create differentiation strategies. As a strategic partner to sales and external customers, you will identify emerging signals and best practices, to serve the broader organization. This position blends business and technology skillsets. Cloud Intelligence Field BDMs drive complex engagements and interact with executive audiences. They also have technical competence that enables them to analyze AWS and other cloud providers. Candidates must have the capability to craft and convey compelling value propositions, and to communicate concepts and stories effectively.

We are looking for experience in one or more of the following: market or competitive intelligence, sales, business value engineering, sales enablement, sales coaching, and customer-facing technology sales experience. The ability to successfully differentiate cloud services in competitive market segments is key.

• Develop scalable competitive strategies to enable winning key strategic deals.
• Support, coach, and develop large deal closing capability.
• Be the go-to resource for an AWS field sales segment and sales leadership for AWS differentiation.
• Leverage excellent communication skills to articulate the business value of AWS value propositions, working backwards from our customers strategic objectives.

jobs.title: Principal, Human Resources Specialist, ADC Talent
jobs.description:
There has never been a more exciting time to be at AWS. Our business is evolving rapidly, the regulatory landscape is shifting under our feet, and the opportunities to deliver value are endless! We are looking for a Principal, Human Resources Specialist to own and drive strategic employee initiatives for a business segment that delivers essential services to AWS national security customers. In this role, you will partner with a global network of cross-functional teams to design and deliver solutions across compensation strategy, employee engagement, workforce planning, career growth, and culture. You will analyze complex data sets and connect what the data tells you to real business priorities. This is a hands-on, high-judgment role where you will build new approaches from scratch, influence the design of long-term tooling, and collaborate with partners across Human Resources, personnel security, and legal to attract and retain a niche talent segment doing meaningful work.

Note: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision and strategy for employee engagement, career growth, and compensation programs (including bonus design) for a growing matrixed AWS business segment, defining the approach where one may not yet exist.
- Analyze complex and sometimes incomplete workforce data to identify trends, inform business priorities, and deliver actionable recommendations to senior leadership through clear written narratives and presentations.
- Design and deliver engagement strategies that build culture across functionally isolated teams, and lead initiatives that enable leadership cohesion in a matrixed global environment.
- Partner with Human Resources Business Partners, compensation, talent acquisition, workforce planning, personnel security, and legal teams to create compliant, scalable mechanisms that attract and retain specialized talent.
- Leverage AI and available tooling to deliver results quickly while collaborating with Technical Program Management and Business Intelligence partners to shape bespoke tools for long-term support.

A day in the life
You might start your morning digging into workforce data to refine a compensation proposal, then jump into a working session with your Business Intelligence Engineer to scope requirements for a new reporting tool. After lunch, you connect with leaders across multiple regions to align on an engagement strategy for teams that operate in isolated environments. Later, you draft a narrative for a senior leadership review, translating what the numbers are telling you into a clear recommendation. In between, you are fielding questions from HR Business Partners, troubleshooting an emerging customer requirement, and sketching out a plan for a culture initiative that has never been done before.

About the team
We are not a typical Human Resources team. We provide both line support through embedded HR Business Partners and program design through embedded specialists, and we also own tooling development and bonus administration. jobs.title: Sr. Risk Manager, Sales Abuse, Sales Abuse Prevention
jobs.description:
The Catalog Integrity team is tasked with identifying and preventing abuse that impacts product authenticity, accuracy, and trust for our customers and brand owners worldwide. Our growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, a tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.

The Catalog Abuse Prevention team designs and implements policies, tools, and technology innovations to protect the integrity of Amazon's product catalog. We are looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Risk Manager with a background in risk management, digital fraud, compliance, or cyber investigations who also has advanced data analysis skills (SQL, Data Science) to manage critical and high-impact projects.

The Senior Risk Manager role for Catalog Abuse is responsible for discovery and risk mining of new and emerging abuse patterns within Amazon's product catalog ecosystem. As the Senior Risk Manager over this space, you'll partner with our team of engineers, applied scientists, data scientists, and business intelligence engineers to mitigate risks and vulnerabilities across our catalog experiences. You will lead the identification and analysis of emerging abuse patterns, manage executive escalations, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. You will be responsible for data mining for emerging abuse patterns in our catalog's extensive datasets and should have advanced data analysis skills (SQL). Your role will ultimately help us ensure that customers have access to accurate and authentic product information, and that brand owners and selling partners using Amazon can trust the integrity of our catalog.

Successful candidates will have a keen ability to distill insights from data analysis and internal escalations, and form comprehensive mitigation strategies to address identified risks. They will be able to translate these insights into effective prevention mechanisms and improve catalog quality outcomes. They will thrive in an environment with lots of opportunity to invent new approaches, while moving fast and learning from prior investigations. They should be comfortable working in a collaborative, creative, analytical, and fast-paced environment and interacting with senior leaders, technical software development teams, legal and compliance teams, and business intelligence teams.

• Develop and implement comprehensive risk mitigation strategies, partnering with engineering, science, and product teams to build technical solutions

• Manage regulatory compliance documentation and Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) reporting requirements

• Leverage AI to scale detection and enforcement

• Design and implement process improvements for abuse detection and mitigation, including creation of metrics and dashboards to track program effectiveness

• Create deep-dive analyses and executive-level documentation summarizing findings and recommendations

• Identify policy gaps and propose solutions to address emerging abuse patterns

• Build and maintain strong partnerships with key stakeholders across the organization

• Monitor and analyze emerging trends in e-commerce that could impact catalog integrity

A day in the life
This role partners with Product, Engineering, Science, and BI teams to investigate and mitigate catalog abuse. You'll analyze data to identify emerging abuse patterns, manage executive escalations, and coordinate global responses. Daily activities include SQL analysis, reviewing abuse reports, stakeholder meetings, and preparing executive communications.

Key stakeholders include Catalog Integrity Tech, Brand Registry, Retail/Category teams, ASCS and Legal/Compliance. Customers are both internal (Amazon business teams) and external (brands, sellers, and end customers), and you'll focus on preventing abuse that compromises catalog integrity, such as inconsistent variation , review aggregation, miscategorization, inappropriate claims, and other forms of listing data manipulation.

The Catalog Abuse team safeguards the integrity of Amazon's product catalog, ensuring customers can make informed purchasing decisions based on accurate product information. Our mission is to detect, prevent, and mitigate abuse that compromises catalog quality and trust. We're a data-driven team that combines technical expertise with investigative skills to protect millions of product listings globally.

Our culture emphasizes innovation, collaboration, and rapid problem-solving. Team members are empowered to experiment with new approaches while working closely with tech and business partners to build scalable solutions that maintain catalog trust.
