jobs.title: Business Intelligence Specialist, AMZL PSX
jobs.description:
Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join the Pricing & Payments team within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization, as part of the Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. This role owns the design, development, and maintenance of data intelligence solutions, automated mechanisms, and analytical frameworks that ensure pricing accuracy, payment reliability, and financial health across all delivery partner programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large).

As an Individual Contributor, you will be the data and automation backbone of the Payments & Pricing function — building pipelines, dashboards, reconciliation mechanisms, and self-service tools that eliminate manual processes, reduce payment errors, and provide real-time visibility into financial operations. You will partner closely with Payments Specialists, Pricing Specialists, Finance, and Operations to turn complex data into actionable intelligence.

This role reports directly to the Pricing & Payments Manager and works cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Technology, and partner-facing teams.

This position is based out of an AMZL office.

If you are passionate about building intelligent data solutions, automating complex processes, and driving financial precision through analytics, come join our team.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and ETL processes that support payment reconciliation, pricing validation, and financial reporting across all partner programs

Develop and maintain SQL-based queries, views, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational and financial datasets

Build and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms (QuickSight, Tableau, or equivalent) providing real-time visibility into payment status, pricing accuracy, disputes, and financial KPIs

Create automated reconciliation mechanisms that identify payment discrepancies, pricing errors, and anomalies before they impact partners — reducing manual intervention and improving trust

Develop self-service analytical tools that enable the Payments and Pricing team to access insights without requiring ad-hoc requests

Automate recurring reports and manual processes, driving efficiency gains across the Payments & Pricing function

Conduct deep-dive analyses on payment cycles, dispute patterns, incentive effectiveness, and pricing model performance to support data-driven decision-making

Build alerting and exception-handling mechanisms that proactively flag issues (e.g., payment delays, pricing inconsistencies, unusual dispute volumes)

Partner with Technology and Engineering teams to define data requirements, validate data sources, and ensure data quality and integrity

Support the development of pricing models and incentive simulations by providing historical data analysis, scenario modeling, and impact projections

Document all data solutions, pipelines, and mechanisms with clear technical specifications and operational runbooks

Present analytical findings and automation proposals to stakeholders, translating technical solutions into business value

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking the automated health monitors you built for the payment pipeline. An alert fires — a batch of AMPL partner payments shows a 3% discrepancy against expected values. You dive into the SQL query that powers the reconciliation engine, identify a data source lag from a route restructuring, and push a fix before the payment cycle closes.

Mid-morning, you join a sync with the Payments Specialists to review a new automated dispute detection mechanism you're piloting. The early results are promising: 40% of disputes that previously required manual review are now auto-classified and routed, saving 15+ hours per week.

Before lunch, you finalize a new QuickSight dashboard for the Pricing team — it visualizes incentive effectiveness across partner segments, showing which incentive structures drive the best delivery performance per Real invested. You walk the Pricing Specialist through the self-service filters and drill-down capabilities.

After lunch, you deep-dive into a request from the Ops Excellence Manager: they need historical payment data cross-referenced with partner Scorecard performance to validate a hypothesis about payment timeliness and delivery quality correlation. You build the query, visualize the results, and share a brief with your findings.

Late afternoon, you work on your current sprint priority: automating the monthly partner payment summary that currently takes 8 hours of manual work. You're building a Python script that pulls from three data sources, reconciles automatically, and generates the formatted output — target: zero manual hours by next month.

You close the day documenting the new pipeline you deployed this week and updating the team's automation roadmap with next quarter's priorities.

About the team
The Business Intelligence Analyst sits within the Pricing & Payments team, part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. The Pricing & Payments function owns one of PSX's core pillars: "Pricing accuracy, incentive effectiveness, and payment reliability: ensuring financial health and trust across all delivery channels."

The team manages pricing models, payment cycles, incentive structures, and dispute resolution for +30 logistics partners across Brazil. The BI Analyst is the technical engine of this function — building the data infrastructure, automations, and intelligence that enable the team to operate at scale with precision and speed.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience building data pipelines or automated ETL processes
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
- Experience translating customer needs into business requirements
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in SQL Server/MySQL
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in Amazon Redshift and other AWS technologies
- Experience with financial services, payments or e-commerce
- Experience with creating automated alarms, reports and KPI metrics for plant management
- Knowledge of finance, accounting, business or related field focused on analytics
- Experience working with Git or an equivalent distributed version control system
- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
- Experience automating routine tasks
- Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
- Master's degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or related science field, or Master's degree or equivalent and 2+ years of data scientist experience

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success & Sales Operations, Brand Protection
jobs.description:
Transparency represents an incredible opportunity to raise retail industry standards around authenticity, product transparency, and supply chain tracking. Transparency is a strategic new software-as-a-service launched by Amazon for the global consumer goods industry. We are focused on building a global service which allows consumer brands and consumers to trace the origin of items throughout the supply chain ensuring only authentic items enter the supply chain. The Transparency service is focused on preventing the receipt and sale of counterfeit goods both online and offline. Our customers include individual consumer brands who sell both on and off of Amazon direct and through a network of direct and third-party sellers.

We are seeking a talented, driven, and proven CSM and Operations leader to grow the Transparency business in China. The Manager, Customer Success and Sales Operation will lead a high-impact team and serve as a key member of the CN Transparency leadership group. You will identify and address key brand and selling partner experience issues to improve program adoption and retention, as well as identifying new opportunities (e.g., large/famous brands, new industries, new regions) for Transparency business expansion. He/she would work closely with senior leadership team, marketing team, sales team, account management team, support team, product team and other stakeholders in China and Worldwide.

The candidate will need to possess excellent customer success management, program development and management skills, dynamically prioritize and manage resources. She/he will be extremely customer obsessed, strong at performing deep dives to derive analytical insights on seller behaviors, thus improving seller engagement resulting in seller success on Amazon platform. The ideal candidate should be able to work in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment; has strong analytical skills, program management skills, people management skills, communication skills, and innovative. If you are passionate about working in a fast-paced innovative environment, willing to take challenges, make history and have fun with us, please apply for the position now!

Key job responsibilities
Customer Success Strategy & Program Ownership
• Set the strategic direction for the CN Transparency CSM function — defining program goals, success metrics, and long-term roadmap priorities across brand experience, adoption, and retention
• Lead and develop the CSM team (up to 3 CSMs), providing coaching, performance guidance, and career development support, enabling team members to independently own brand strategy and VoB programs
• Synthesize brand insights at scale — consolidate findings from VoB programs (brand interviews, surveys, walk-the-store sessions) led by CSMs, and translate them into strategic recommendations for Product, PMO, and senior leadership
• Represent CN Transparency in senior leadership reviews, annual planning cycles, and cross-regional forums, own CN perspective in global product and business discussions
• Identify systemic brand experience gaps that cannot be resolved at the individual CSM level, and build centralized, scalable solutions to address them
Central Operations Management
• Own the central sales operation’s function — including goal planning, seller/brand assignment, performance reporting, forecasting, and business planning cycles for a team of up to 5 (3 CSMs + 2 Sales Ops)
• Build and optimize operational infrastructure — develop SOPs, scalable workflows, and productivity tools that enable CSMs and Account Managers to operate efficiently and consistently
• Drive cross-functional alignment — partner with BD, Product, Tech, and global Transparency teams to translate strategy into execution and ensure regional priorities are reflected in global roadmaps
• Deploy and iterate on AI/automation tools to improve lead prioritization, brand engagement efficiency, and team productivity
• Establish mechanisms for knowledge sharing and best practice adoption across regional teams, contributing to global program consistency

About the team
The CN Transparency CSM and Sales Operation Team delivers scalable solutions to optimize brand experience and operational efficiency. We empower regional business teams through program operations, business intelligence, and sales operations excellence — acting as the connective tissue between local execution and global strategy.

- Experience building and effectively executing a strategy from the ground up, including designing roadmaps to drive incremental progress towards long-term vision and goals
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in SQL Server/MySQL
- Experience identifying and improving business processes
- Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 10+ years of experience in customer success, program/project management, business development, or operations — ideally in a tech, e-commerce, or SaaS environment

- Experience using sales tools including Salesforce, and BI tools including QuickSight and PowerBI

jobs.title: Procurement Category Manager - Energy & Water Infrastructure, Data Center Services Procurement (DCSP)
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. We are seeking a Procurement professional to support the APAC data center operations space.

As a Procurement Category Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for the Energy and Water Infrastructure categories and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:
• Manage the Energy and Water Infrastructure categories within the CAPEX domain
• Ensure on-time execution of RFPs/tenders across multiple countries from supplier on-boarding, RFx initiation, pre-tender briefings, post-tender interviews and clarifications, proposal evaluations, negotiations, supplier selection till contract award
• Achieve cost savings through bidding, negotiations and strategic initiatives
• Understand customer requirements and analyze category data to establish and implement robust regional procurement category strategies that deliver value to the business
• Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns across categories and regions to influence customers’ priorities
• Provide in-depth knowledge about the supply market and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically, to the business.
• Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost
• Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance
• Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships
• Innovate within the procurement space, automating and improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle
• Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as management of contracts post-execution
• Some travel is required (<30%)

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Experience driving process excellence and productivity improvement initiatives, including Kaizen methodologies

jobs.title: General Marketing Manager Intern- 2027
jobs.description:
IMPORTANT:
This role is open to students graduating in 2028 and seeking an internship starting between January and July 2027.

Job Summary

There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment
designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support marketing initiatives, demonstrating project management skills in a competitive and dynamic business climate.

Assist with implementing the global brand strategy, adapting it to the local market to ensure relevance and impact.

Support the creation of effective content and marketing assets to engage customers and prospects.

Help run marketing campaigns and other growth initiatives, tracking performance and contributing to optimisation efforts.

Support the team in recommending and executing network improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness.

Contribute innovative, long-term solutions that benefit the entire team and drive lasting impact.

A day in the life
Every day is different as a General Marketing Manager Intern. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams on real marketing initiatives that help grow Amazon's brand and customer engagement. You might spend your morning adapting a global brand campaign for the local market and creating compelling content, then spend your afternoon analysing campaign performance data to recommend optimisations for an ongoing growth initiative. You will partner with experienced marketers, support the execution of network improvements, and bring fresh ideas to the table.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which initiative you are supporting, part of your role will involve understanding what resonates with customers and prospects. You'll contribute to brand strategy, help run marketing campaigns, and propose innovative solutions that benefit the wider team — building your skills in brand management, content creation, and strategic marketing in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
- Currently in your penultimate year (graduating in 2028) in a Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Marketing, Communications or similar discipline
Preferred qualifications:
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Understanding of digital marketing channels (such as email, digital display, SEO, PPC.) and tools (including email, web analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms)
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager – Customer Lifecycle, Amazon Music
jobs.description:
Role Scope

This is a marketing role responsible for defining and executing Amazon Music India’s customer lifecycle strategy across multi-channels, including but not limited to owned and operated.

The role operates across Amazon Music’s three customer tiers - Free, Prime Music, and Amazon Music Unlimited (AMU), and uses channel interventions to drive acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation, churn management, and migration across tiers.

Role Complexity and Seniority

Single independent leader who will own both strategy and execution across multiple channels, lifecycle stages, customer propositions, and subscription tiers.

The role therefore requires the ability to:

Independently define strategies in areas where established playbooks may not exist.

Manage multiple interconnected channels and programs simultaneously.

Move fluidly between long-term strategic planning and hands-on execution.

Translate product features and benefits into effective channel-led customer interventions.

Make informed trade-offs across Free, Prime Music, and AMU priorities.

Influence senior stakeholders and global partner teams without direct authority.

Build scalable mechanisms, automation, and operating models rather than relying on one-off campaign execution.

Deliver measurable impact across acquisition, engagement, retention, reactivation, churn management, and tier migration.

The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in customer lifecycle marketing, CRM, owned-channel strategy, digital merchandising, experimentation, and cross-functional leadership, with demonstrated success managing complex, multi-product or multi-tier consumer businesses.

Key job responsibilities
Key responsibilities include:

Define and execute the customer lifecycle strategy across email, push notifications, WhatsApp, Browse Home, retail merchandising, and landing pages, and beyond.

Develop differentiated lifecycle journeys for Free, Prime Music, and AMU customers, reflecting the distinct customer proposition, business objective, and maturity of each tier.

Determine how new and existing product features, content, and benefits can be effectively marketed through owned channels to drive acquisition, engagement, retention, reactivation, and tier migration.

Own audience segmentation, targeting, personalization, experimentation, automation, and performance optimization across email, push notifications, browse home, and WhatsApp.

Define and execute the Browse Home strategy, using the app homepage to improve content and feature discovery, product education, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Own the retail merchandising strategy and execution across relevant Amazon surfaces, identifying placements and customer moments that can drive acquisition, engagement, reactivation, and cross-tier conversion.

Define the lifecycle strategy, customer journey, messaging architecture, and content requirements for landing pages supporting product launches, campaigns, and customer communication.

Build integrated go-to-market plans across owned channels for new product features, benefit changes, tier launches, tentpole events, and other priority business initiatives.

Establish channel goals, measurement frameworks, experimentation roadmaps, and operating mechanisms to evaluate lifecycle performance and identify new growth opportunities.

Serve as the single point of ownership for India’s owned-channel and customer lifecycle agenda, balancing channel priorities and customer needs across Free, Prime Music, and AMU.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience in segmentation and developing customer profiles
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in a marketing focused role including customer lifecycle marketing, segmentation reporting, customer funnel analysis, and top-line sales performance

The role will partner with product, field, brand, digital, partner marketing teams and agencies to define and execute a global demand, content and campaign strategy that drives acquisition and engagement. You will develop targeted marketing programs aligned with business priorities that engage and nurture prospects throughout the buyer's journey, measuring and optimizing performance against goals and ultimately driving conversion and revenue growth.

You will work closely with partners and our Geo based partner teams to help execute these programs regionally and be an expert resource on marketing processes and guidelines for partners.

This role requires a proven leader with the demonstrated ability to think strategically to build and convey compelling value propositions and content with technology partners. The ideal candidate will have creative ideas, extensive analytic and data-driven customer demand generation experience and a proven track record of driving successful demand generation programs. You should be detail-oriented and organized, capable of handling multiple projects at once, and comfortable dealing with ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities. At AWS we prize innovation, agility and a builder mentality. This is an individual contributor role that is both strategic and tactical where you will ideate, build, execute, measure, and optimize programs that deliver value to customers and partners as both the musician and the composer.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an incredibly fast-growing business where you will work with some of the leading technology providers. AWS gives customers secure, scalable, global cloud infrastructure while paying only for what they use.

Scaling through partners is a key part of how we help customers move to cloud services that power strategic workloads. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, a history of success creating high-impact partner marketing programs, experience with large, ISV partners, and love helping partners reach their full potential, this position might be just for you.

Key job responsibilities
Own the WW AI partner program strategy, setting annual priorities and program streams aligned to AWS Growth Initiatives, OP2 goals and the AI Competency roadmap.

Plan, govern and deploy a multi-million dollar WWSO co-investment budget, including business cases, PO management and year-end spend discipline.

jobs.title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, AI , NAMER Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
AWS is looking for a Sr. Partner Marketing Manager to own the North America marketing relationship with our most strategic AI Labs and frontier model provider and AI ISV partners. You will be the connective tissue between AWS's AI product and service teams and partners such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Space X, Cohere - translating technology roadmaps into joint go-to-market programs that accelerate customer adoption and drive measurable pipeline in North America.

This role sits within the North America Partner Marketing team, part of the AWS Global Partner Marketing organization working closely with the Data & AI Partner GTM team, Global AI & SUP Partner Marketing. The partners you work with are not traditional ISVs - they are category-defining companies at the frontier of foundation model research whose models power workloads across Amazon Bedrock and the broader AWS AI stack. Your job is to build the marketing engine that takes global AI marketing strategy and helps these partners succeed on AWS in NAMER while helping AWS customers access their capabilities through joint messaging, campaigns, launches, and programs.

You will develop joint marketing plans (JMPs), orchestrate cross-functional activation across AWS field sales, product marketing, and partner development, and own pipeline and attribution metrics for your assigned partner portfolio in region. The right candidate combines deep marketing craft with enough AI/ML literacy to hold their own in technical product conversations, and enough commercial instinct to prioritize programs by revenue impact. This portfolio will evolve as the frontier AI landscape shifts - we need someone comfortable building structure in ambiguity while staying close to where the technology and customer demand is heading.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute North America joint marketing plans (JMPs) for assigned frontier model provider partners, aligned to AWS AI service priorities and customer adoption goals.
- Define Industry marketing plans together with AI partners joint positioning that differentiates the partner's offering on AWS for priority industries.
- Design, launch, and optimize multi-channel industry tailored campaigns (digital, events, content, ABM) that drive joint pipeline for both AWS and the partner.
- Own Marketing Development Fund (MDF) planning and execution for your partner portfolio in close partnership with Global AI & SUP Partner Marketing team.
- Coordinate partner presence at AWS flagship events (re:Invent, Summits, Builder Days) and partner-hosted events, advising on messaging, audience targeting, and customer engagement tactics through "precision programs"
- Create partner activation playbooks and enablement assets (messaging guides, battle cards, solution briefs) that equip AWS field teams and partner sellers.
- Serve as the primary marketing point-of-contact for assigned partners, building trusted relationships at senior marketing and executive levels within partner organizations.
- Align closely with Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Solutions Architects, AWS Product Marketing, and Service GTM teams to ensure marketing programs reinforce co-sell plays and technical readiness in North America
- Collaborate with global partner marketing teams to scale worldwide programs into local / North America execution while maintaining message consistency.
- Set clear KPIs - partner-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced revenue, MDF ROI, activation milestones - and report progress to leadership.
- Track and report on pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, MDF utilization, and co-sell revenue; use data to continuously optimize partner marketing performance.
- Prepare monthly business reviews (MBRs) and quarterly partner scorecards for leadership review.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing AI Partner originated performance data for your partner portfolio, then jump into a strategy session with a partner's marketing team to align industry messaging ahead of a model launch on Bedrock. Later, you could be working with AWS ABM teams on an account-based play targeting enterprise customers evaluating foundation model providers or AI ISVs. You might wrap up by joining a cross-functional planning call for re:Invent partner activations - ensuring your partners have the right presence, the right story, and the right audience. No two days look the same, but every day centers on connecting partners with customers through compelling marketing that drives measurable business outcomes.

About the team
The NAMER Partner Marketing team is within AWS global Partner Marketing. We are the marketing engine for AWS's most strategic AI relationships - spanning frontier model providers, AI software companies, building on AWS AI services.

Our team works at the intersection of partner innovation and AWS's most rapidly evolving service areas: AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, AWS SageMaker, Kiro and the broader generative AI stack. We work with category-defining companies - from the largest AI labs in the world to ISVs - building joint go-to-market programs that drive customer adoption and revenue.

We value marketers who combine strategic thinking with execution intensity, can navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving domain, and measure their success by the pipeline they create rather than the programs they run. This is a builder role in a builder team - you will be creating motions that do not yet exist.

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

- Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
- Experience with Salesforce and Tableau

jobs.title: General Marketing Manager Intern- 2027
jobs.description:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment
designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support marketing initiatives, demonstrating project management skills in a competitive and dynamic business climate.

Assist with implementing the global brand strategy, adapting it to the local market to ensure relevance and impact.

Support the creation of effective content and marketing assets to engage customers and prospects.

Help run marketing campaigns and other growth initiatives, tracking performance and contributing to optimisation efforts.

Support the team in recommending and executing network improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness.

Contribute innovative, long-term solutions that benefit the entire team and drive lasting impact.

A day in the life
Every day is different as a General Marketing Manager Intern. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams on real marketing initiatives that help grow Amazon's brand and customer engagement. You might spend your morning adapting a global brand campaign for the local market and creating compelling content, then spend your afternoon analysing campaign performance data to recommend optimisations for an ongoing growth initiative. You will partner with experienced marketers, support the execution of network improvements, and bring fresh ideas to the table.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which initiative you are supporting, part of your role will involve understanding what resonates with customers and prospects. You'll contribute to brand strategy, help run marketing campaigns, and propose innovative solutions that benefit the wider team — building your skills in brand management, content creation, and strategic marketing in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Internship Start Dates across the year:

We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.
Basic qualifications:
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, or a related fields
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
- Work 40 hours/week minimum and commit to 6 month internship
Preferred qualifications:

jobs.description:
This highly visible role will help drive AWS's global go-to-market strategy for Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), developing holistic strategies that build awareness, generate demand, and grow revenue across the full ISV flywheel: selling to, with, and through our software partners. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of B2B marketing strategy paired with hands-on experience in integrated marketing and digital demand generation. You'll be the subject matter expert on how we market-to ISVs, translating market and customer data into strategy into repeatable marketing motions across sales segments and geographies.

You will partner with product, field, brand, and digital teams, and work closely with our Integrated Demand Plan (IDP) teams, Product Marketing, and our Geo-based partner marketing teams to define and execute a global demand, content, and campaign strategy that drives acquisition and engagement. You'll identify key themes relevant across our ISV customer base and develop targeted marketing motions aligned with business priorities that engage prospects throughout the buyer's journey to drive conversion and revenue growth. You will help our Geo-based teams activate these programs regionally and serve as an expert resource on the marketing motions, processes, and guidelines that bring ISV solutions to market.

This role requires a proven leader who can think strategically and build compelling value propositions and content for cloud and AI software solutions. You will turn our ISV go-to-market strategy into action, identifying the customer use cases, buyer personas, and industry priorities that shape joint value propositions for building on AWS. With agentic AI reshaping how software is built, bought, and adopted, you'll help position AWS as the platform of choice for ISVs delivering the next generation of AI-powered solutions.

The ideal candidate has creative ideas, extensive analytic and data-driven demand generation experience, and a proven track record of running successful demand generation programs. The ability to communicate effectively across both technical and non-technical audiences is critical. You're detail-oriented and organized, comfortable handling multiple projects at once, and at ease with ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities. A solid understanding of the cloud landscape and the software provider ecosystem is essential.

At AWS we prize innovation, agility, and a builder mentality. The organization is purposefully flat to enable fast decision-making, and we're empowered to resolve issues, deliver new ideas, and optimize existing ones in service of our customers. This is an individual contributor role that is both strategic and tactical: you'll ideate, build, execute, measure, and optimize programs that deliver value to customers and partners as both the musician and the composer.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an incredibly fast-growing business at the center of how AWS scales with the software ecosystem. AWS gives customers secure, scalable, global cloud infrastructure while they pay only for what they use, and ISVs are central to how we help customers adopt the cloud services that power strategic workloads. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, a history of creating high-impact marketing programs, experience marketing technology or software solutions, and a love for turning strategy into demand that scales, this role might be just for you.

jobs.title: General Marketing Manager Intern- 2027
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Il existe un univers d'opportunités chez Amazon.
Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle s'accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi de manières que vous n'auriez jamais imaginées. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonner la manière dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se connectent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact. Vous travaillerez avec des outils de classe mondiale, des plateformes internationales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez rapidement, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent. Avec des opportunités infinies à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez vite, appliquerez vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences dont vous ignoriez l'existence. C'est un environnement conçu pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact de leur travail dans le monde. Prêt(e) à commencer votre aventure ?

Qu'est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

Un stage chez Amazon signifie de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous construirez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui souhaitent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact qui va bien au-delà du campus.

There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment
designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

Collaborer avec des équipes transversales pour soutenir les initiatives marketing, en démontrant des compétences en gestion de projet dans un environnement commercial compétitif et dynamique.
Participer à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de marque mondiale, en l'adaptant au marché local pour garantir sa pertinence et son impact.
Soutenir la création de contenus et de supports marketing efficaces pour engager les clients et les prospects.
Contribuer à la gestion de campagnes marketing et d'autres initiatives de croissance, en suivant les performances et en participant aux efforts d'optimisation.
Accompagner l'équipe dans la recommandation et l'exécution d'améliorations du réseau pour renforcer l'efficacité marketing.
Proposer des solutions innovantes et durables qui profitent à l'ensemble de l'équipe et génèrent un impact durable.

Qualifications de base

Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur
Être titulaire ou en cours d'obtention d'une licence (ou diplôme supérieur) en Marketing, Communication ou dans un domaine connexe
Travailler au minimum 35 heures par semaine et s'engager pour un stage de 6 mois maximum
Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel, incluant : tableaux croisés dynamiques, macros, index/equiv, recherchev, VBA, liaisons de données, etc.

Qualifications souhaitées

Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'identifier des améliorations de processus et des solutions innovantes
Compréhension des canaux de marketing digital (tels que l'e-mail, l'affichage numérique, le SEO, le PPC) et des outils associés (incluant l'e-mail, l'analyse web, le CRM et les plateformes d'automatisation marketing)
Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les autres
Curiosité démontrée, proactivité et volonté de relever des défis dans un environnement ambigu et en constante évolution

Key Job Responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support marketing initiatives, demonstrating project management skills in a competitive and dynamic business climate.

Assist with implementing the global brand strategy, adapting it to the local market to ensure relevance and impact.

Support the creation of effective content and marketing assets to engage customers and prospects.

Help run marketing campaigns and other growth initiatives, tracking performance and contributing to optimisation efforts.

Support the team in recommending and executing network improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness.

Contribute innovative, long-term solutions that benefit the entire team and drive lasting impact.

A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque jour est différent en tant que stagiaire en Marketing Général. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes transversales sur de véritables initiatives marketing qui contribuent à développer la marque Amazon et l'engagement client. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à adapter une campagne de marque mondiale au marché local et à créer du contenu percutant, puis consacrer votre après-midi à analyser les données de performance des campagnes afin de recommander des optimisations pour une initiative de croissance en cours. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de marketeurs expérimentés, soutiendrez l'exécution d'améliorations du réseau et apporterez des idées nouvelles.

Amazon est une entreprise obsédée par le client, donc quelle que soit l'initiative que vous soutenez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à comprendre ce qui résonne auprès des clients et des prospects. Vous contribuerez à la stratégie de marque, participerez à la gestion de campagnes marketing et proposerez des solutions innovantes qui profitent à l'ensemble de l'équipe — en développant vos compétences en gestion de marque, création de contenu et marketing stratégique dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.

Every day is different as a General Marketing Manager Intern. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams on real marketing initiatives that help grow Amazon's brand and customer engagement. You might spend your morning adapting a global brand campaign for the local market and creating compelling content, then spend your afternoon analysing campaign performance data to recommend optimisations for an ongoing growth initiative. You will partner with experienced marketers, support the execution of network improvements, and bring fresh ideas to the table.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which initiative you are supporting, part of your role will involve understanding what resonates with customers and prospects. You'll contribute to brand strategy, help run marketing campaigns, and propose innovative solutions that benefit the wider team — building your skills in brand management, content creation, and strategic marketing in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the team
À propos de l'équipe

Communauté des stagiaires : En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d'une communauté dynamique et solidaire qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, en réseautant et en participant à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des domaines tels que le développement durable pour explorer vos centres d'intérêt variés.

Accompagnement : Le programme de stage offre un système de soutien solide, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu'une équipe de programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela garantit que vous disposez de l'accompagnement et de l'assistance nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions de formation : Des sessions de formation exclusives renforceront davantage vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d'apprentissage de pointe d'Amazon et à l'expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Opportunités : À l'issue de votre stage, si celui-ci est réussi, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours chez Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'un salaire mensuel compétitif, d'une aide à la relocalisation et d'un accès à une gamme d'avantages sociaux.

Dates de début de stage tout au long de l'année : Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour commencer à tout moment de janvier à septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d'intégration pour les nouvelles recrues.

Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:

jobs.title: Launch MBA Program Intern
jobs.description:
Launch – Amazon’s corporate MBA program for Europe
Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. Launch MBA internships provide a route into our full-time Launch MBA Program, location flexibility is encouraged throughout the Launch Program journey. Fluency in English is essential for all roles and local language skills are highly desirable for some internships, but are not essential for every role.
At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for an internship is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better. Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...
• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy’s 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world
Important Notes
• You will have the opportunity to specify business area and job location preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities
Launch - Amazon’s corporate MBA program for Europe, offers an eight- to ten-week internship, providing you with deep exposure to one of our diverse European business areas. As a Launch Intern, you will partner with key business groups and cross-functional teams to analyse unique business ideas, make data driven decisions, and provide input to drive meaningful change. You will have exposure to senior level management and the opportunity to apply general business and functional skills to support successful development and execution of strategy. Interns will be allocated either a project, where you will act as an in-house consultant on a piece of work with tangible business impact, or a functional role, where you will experience the day-to-day life of a full-time Launch MBA at Amazon.
Should you be successful in your internship, you will be considered for a place on our full-time launch program. Launch recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity, to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon’s peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experience that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon’s extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life
Opportunities within different business areas (for both internship and full-time roles) vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.
If you join Amazon in a full-time role after your internship, example job functions include:
• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit’s customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.
Basic qualifications:
• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2026 and September 30, 2027
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program
• Must be able to commit for an internship lasting eight to 10 weeks between June and August 2024 (exact dates tbc)
Preferred qualifications:
• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master’s degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, New Seller Recruitment Marketing
jobs.description:
New Seller Recruitment Marketing is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Marketing Manager to join our team. In this role, you will grow awareness and adoption of strategic recruitment initiatives that accelerate brand discoverability and growth in our stores. This role manages the full marketing execution across strategic recruitment programs, including developing go-to-market and program adoption strategies, partnering with product and business teams to shape features that improve brand CX, and managing marketing campaigns to increase brand participation. You will own team KPIs for campaign engagement, developing strategies to drive results over both the short and long term. This includes managing content development and delivery, monitoring program adoption and service delivery across our brand base, and managing shared goals with partner teams to drive campaign creation and success at scale.

An ideal candidate is someone who is obsessed with improving our new seller experience and driving seller success in their first year on Amazon. You have a passion for testing to develop an impactful program — from creating the testing plan, to communicating results upward, to using data to inform future business decisions. You are highly organized, enjoy diving deep into brand and customer behavior, and have the creativity to challenge our status quo with fresh approaches to brand engagement and program design.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop marketing strategy end to end - from curation to design and execution - and drive innovations within existing processes.
- Lead the development of fully integrated campaigns, leading and driving collaboration with a sizable team of cross-functional partners, inclusive of business, onsite, project management, paid media, creative, PR, and beyond.
- Manage content development and delivery.
- Analyze results of testing, communicate learnings upward and across partner teams, and use the data to drive future tests.
- Partner with technical and business teams to drive system improvements and automation within self-service seller solutions.
- Own multiple team KPIs for campaign engagement, developing strategy to drive results over short and long-term.
- Manage shared goals with partner teams to drive campaign creation and success at scale.
- Manage the full lifecycle of product marketing initiatives including defining the strategy and measurement.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members thrive in their career. We have a broad mix of experience and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We strive for an open environment to expand on your strengths while isolating growth opportunities in order to drive longer term career success.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing detailed go to market plans
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting

This is an execution-oriented, partner-facing, and data-driven growth role focused on driving customer acquisition, retention, and engagement through partner-led initiatives. The role involves managing day-to-day relationships with assigned partners, delivering measurable performance through integrated go-to-market (GTM) campaigns, data-led insights, and scalable marketing programs.

You will work closely with Business Development, Central Marketing and Partner Growth, Product, Lifecycle Management, and Finance teams to execute impactful campaigns that strengthen partner engagement and grow Amazon's customer base.

The ideal candidate is a motivated, detail-oriented marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments, can translate data into actionable insights, and is eager to develop expertise in strategic partnerships and growth marketing.

We're seeking a results-oriented, customer-obsessed professional with solid analytical skills, a bias for action, and enthusiasm for building high-impact marketing programs that drive measurable growth.

• Own partner marketing plans and campaigns: Build and manage campaign plans for assigned partners, aligning objectives, audiences, channels, milestones, and deliverables. Coordinate execution from brief and readiness through launch, optimization, and post-campaign review..

We operate across two major merchant verticals: Online Merchants (serving 120MM+ customers on platforms like Zomato, Swiggy, Zepto, Blinkit, IRCTC, BookMyShow) and Offline Merchants (enabling Amazon Pay QR-based payments at organized national and regional retail chains across HCTP and non-HCTP categories.

We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to lead merchant marketing across both Online and Offline channels, driving customer awareness, adoption, and transaction share for the full suite of Amazon Pay Products, including Amazon Pay Balance (APB), Amazon Pay Later (APL), Amazon Pay UPI, and Smart Wallet.
As a Senior Marketing Manager for Merchant Marketing, you will own the end-to-end marketing strategy to grow Amazon Pay's presence and preference across India's online and offline commerce ecosystem. This is a full-stack marketing role spanning customer awareness campaigns, merchant co-marketing partnerships, rewards and offers strategy, and data-driven growth programs.

On the Online Merchants side, you will work with merchants to drive upper-funnel awareness, design and execute HVE (High Visibility Event) partnerships (e.g., merchant sale events, co-branded campaigns), and drive preferential visibility for Amazon Pay instruments on merchant checkout pages. You will be STL for marketing funnel metrics (awareness to consideration to conversion).

On the Offline Merchants side, you will partner with national and regional brands and retailers to drive in-store customer adoption of Scan & Pay via Amazon Pay. This includes designing multi-pronged campaigns targeting customers (rewards, cashback), cashiers (incentive programs), and merchants (in-store merchandising and co-branding), as well as executing 360-degree campaigns with marquee partners. You will create BTL, in-store, and digital activations that drive measurable incrementality in transaction share.

At Amazon Ads, we're not just selling advertising — we're crafting full-funnel growth strategies that empower brands to reach their full potential. We believe that breakthrough advertising happens when deep understanding meets innovative technology. Our team is dedicated to developing innovative marketing solutions, providing actionable insights and opportunities for advertisers, and partnering with agencies and tech innovators to drive mutually beneficial growth.

To accelerate the next phase of Amazon Ads development, we're committed to deepening the scale and ambition of our partnerships across a diverse landscape of agencies and tech innovators. Amazon Ads Partners play a crucial role in this landscape, helping brands achieve and exceed their desired outcomes through tech innovation and expert managed services. Our team builds partnerships across the advertising landscape to drive innovation and growth for all brands, including those that do not sell on Amazon.com.

At the heart of this initiative is the Amazon Ads Partner Growth Marketing Team. We enhance partner expertise, capabilities, and visibility through bespoke marketing programs that foster growth for advertisers, partners, and Amazon Ads. To further our mission, we're seeking a Sr. Partner Marketing Manager to design and build a Scaled Partner Success Stories program — creating the strategic framework that showcases partner excellence and delivers the proof points partners need to grow their businesses.

This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, partner marketing, and program design. You will build the operating model and multi-format storytelling infrastructure that positions partners as industry innovators and creative leaders — giving them credible, visible proof that helps them win new business, retain clients, differentiate from competitors, and demonstrate the value of their Amazon Ads investment. You'll design a program that sources compelling partner outcomes, produces stories in the formats partners actually use (e.g., co-branded case studies, video testimonials, event-ready spotlights, pitch-ready assets), and measures impact through partner business growth.

The ideal candidate is a program builder with a proven track record in content strategy, partner marketing, and scalable production systems. You combine deep understanding of partner needs with the ability to design storytelling programs that drive measurable business outcomes — partner acquisition, client retention, competitive differentiation, and advertiser growth. You should thrive in ambiguous environments where the operating model doesn't yet exist, bringing both the strategic vision to define the program and the operational rigor to build it. Above all, you should be passionate about elevating partner voices and creating proof points that strengthen partnerships and accelerate mutual growth.

Key job responsibilities
● Build the Partner Success Stories program — design the operating model, intake process, prioritization criteria, and distribution strategy across 10 partner segments
● Position partners as heroes of their own success — create storytelling that showcases partner innovation, expertise, and client impact in formats they can use to win business and retain clients
● Develop multi-format storytelling infrastructure — deliver co-branded case studies, video testimonials, event spotlights, social proof, and executive-level proof points from a single production pipeline
● Serve distinct segment needs — design differentiated approaches recognizing that a managed tech partner, an indie agency, and a Big 5 holding company each need different formats, channels, and proof points
● Connect stories to business outcomes — measure how stories drive partner acquisition, client retention, competitive differentiation, and advertiser growth
● Integrate across the team — align with Segment Managers, Co-Marketing, GTM and VOP, PMM, Partner Communications, Partner Awards, and Sales to ensure stories are demand-driven and strategically deployed
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience in online advertising, marketing, sales or digital media
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in a business-to-business (B2B) environment, high-tech products/services
- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners

jobs.title: Account-Based Marketing Manager , NAMER Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a results-driven Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to design and execute high-impact ABM programs for enterprise customers. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive measurable business outcomes through targeted marketing initiatives.

The Account-Based Marketing Manager will own the ABM strategy and end-to-end execution of territory ABM programs, working backwards from customer needs to create data-driven, multi-channel campaigns that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. This role requires strategic marketing expertise, strong project management skills, analytical capabilities, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

We are looking for a marketer who is intellectually curious, analytically grounded and creatively agile; someone who can navigate ambiguity, challenge conventional approaches, and build scalable solutions while maintaining the personalization required for strategic account outreach.

Key job responsibilities
* Develop account-based marketing strategies for priority enterprise customers, translating business objectives, customer insights, account priorities, and market dynamics into actionable 1:1 and 1:few marketing plans.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to Sales, working closely with account teams and Sales leaders to understand customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and determine where marketing can have the greatest impact.
* Build integrated customer engagement initiatives that connect account insights, messaging, content, executive engagement, digital marketing, events, and other channels into cohesive customer experiences.
* Bring creative agility to account challenges, identifying new approaches and developing differentiated programs that engage key decision makers, buying groups, and influencers.
* Own programs from strategy through execution, establishing objectives, developing plans, coordinating cross-functional resources, managing budgets and timelines, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
* Develop account-specific content and messaging that translates account insights, business priorities and AWS capabilities into relevant narratives and assets that engage key decision makers and buying groups.
* Use data and customer intelligence to inform strategy, leveraging engagement data, buying signals, account insights, and market trends to identify opportunities and continuously optimize programs.
* Partner across AWS marketing organizations, including Global CoE, Industry, Partner, Digital, Events, and other teams, to orchestrate AWS capabilities around strategic customer opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to collaborate with AWS partners where joint engagement can strengthen customer value propositions, deepen relationships, or accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Measure business impact, establishing account-level objectives and evaluating engagement, account progression, opportunity acceleration, pipeline influence, revenue contribution, and program ROI.
* Build for scale, identifying successful approaches, codifying best practices, and creating repeatable frameworks that can be adopted across accounts and regions.
* Contribute to the evolution of ABM at AWS, sharing insights, experimentation, and best practices with the broader global ABM community.

A day in the life
The Account-Based Marketing Manager role sits within the NAMER Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing organization and is responsible for accelerating adoption, growth and revenue across our largest and and fastest growing enterprise customers. The ABM Marketer
will develop a deep understanding of the accounts within their portfolio and use those insights to develop and execute account-specific marketing strategies that advance account and business goals. This marketer will partner closely with Sales and Business Development teams to identify opportunities and lead the end to end execution of targeted marketing programs, which may include integrated campaigns, executive engagements, events and other account-specific activations. The ABM Manager will measure performance, optimize strategies based on results and provide regular reporting and insights to key stakeholders and business partners.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
