- Strong written and verbal communications skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and clearly articulate program plans, recommendations and results.
- 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, including experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies for enterpise customers or complex B2B audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into marketing strategies and programs
- Experience building and executing cross-functional marketing initiatives from strategy and concept through execution, measurement and optimization.
- Strong track record of partnering with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders to design programs and influence business outcomes.
- Experience using data and analytics to inform marketing strategy, prioritize investments and measure performance
- Strong written and verbal communications skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and clearly articulate program plans, recommendations and results.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience marketing technology, cloud, SaaS or other complex B2B solutions.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Prime Video US Streaming
jobs.description:
Own the Game-Day Experience for Prime Video's Biggest Live Sports! Prime Video (PV) is transforming how fans experience live sports—from Thursday Night Football to NBA games to NASCAR races. As a Marketing Manager on our US Streaming team, you'll be at the center of the action, orchestrating the in-app and out-of-app marketing that brings millions of sports fans to our platform every week.

Your Arena: You'll own the Storefront and Fire TV marketing execution for Prime Video's expansive live sports catalog—NBA, Thursday Night Football, NASCAR, and more. This is high-stakes, real-time marketing where every second counts. You'll launch time-sensitive campaigns, troubleshoot live during games, and optimize performance on the fly to ensure fans never miss a moment.

The Play:

- Plan and execute rapid-fire merchandising campaigns for live sporting events across Prime Video's platform
- Partner with Live Events Marketing, Creative, Product, and cross-functional teams to deliver seamless game-day experiences
- QA, monitor, and optimize in real-time—because when the game is live, there's no room for error
- Drive fan engagement through strategic in-app placements and Fire TV promotions
- Be the champion for Prime Video's sports merchandising strategy

What You Bring: A passion for sports, an eye for detail, and the ability to thrive under pressure. You'll work in a fast-paced environment where deadlines are non-negotiable and every campaign directly impacts how millions of fans experience their favorite sports.

If you live for the intensity of game day and want to shape how the world watches live sports, this is your shot.

This role operates on a shift-based schedule to support live events coverage. Candidates must be available to work assigned shifts that include weekends and select holidays during peak sports seasons (e.g. playoffs, championships, tournament finals, etc.). Schedule flexibility is required to accommodate live game coverage needs and shift rotations.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Campaign Operations & Planning
- Autonomously develop and manage the seasonal merchandising calendar for live sports assigned properties, anticipating operational complexity across concurrent events
- Lead high-stakes campaign execution during peak sports periods (playoffs, championships, season openers), making real-time prioritization decisions without oversight
- Design and execute A/B tests for carousel positioning, creative assets, and messaging frameworks in alignment with stakeholder teams
- Self-sufficiently schedule, publish, and QA Prime Video live sports content across PV Storefront, X-Site, and Fire TV
- Execute merchandising requests from Marketing Managers, CAMs, and Content Operations teams, proactively identifying gaps, risks, and dependencies with limited direction

Real-Time Operations & SME-Level Troubleshooting
- Establish and maintain QA standards for all live event placements, applying SME-level knowledge to catch issues
- Own the live monitoring framework during game broadcasts, driving rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of technical issues or customer-facing errors in real-time
- Verify compliance with league brand guidelines, broadcast rights requirements, and partner agreements
- Build and maintain reporting mechanisms to track execution quality, issue trends, and resolution metrics - Use AI-assisted anomaly detection and automated QA workflows to catch defects at scale during high-volume sports weekends

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Coordination
- Partner and serve as the operational point of contact for Marketing, CAMs, Content Operations (PVCO), providing clear status communication and managing expectations on execution timelines
- Independently evaluate and prioritize competing merchandising demands across multiple stakeholder teams, making real-time business impact assessments to determine execution sequencing — including decisions to defer, decline, or escalate requests based on customer-facing risk and strategic priority
- Escalate blockers with context and recommended solutions, not just flagging problems, but proposing paths forward

Process Innovation & AI-Driven Efficiency
- Document workflows, create and maintain SOPs, and build knowledge base articles that enable team scalability
- Provide structured feedback on tooling gaps and process inefficiencies, partnering with leadership to build the case for system improvements
- Leverage existing AI tools to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort, applying SME judgment to validate outputs for brand and compliance standards e.g., generative AI for campaign setup, automated QA workflows)
Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working with a major brand or entertainment company in project/production management
- Experience in e-commerce, start ups, advertising, commercial
- Experience using data visualization tools

jobs.title: Account-Based Marketing Manager, ISV Marketing, EMEA, EMEA ISV Marketing & Partner Workloads
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a results-driven Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to join the EMEA ISV & Workloads Partner Marketing team. Based in Tel Aviv, Israel, this role will design and execute high-impact ABM programmes for ISV customers and technology partners across the EMEA region. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive measurable business outcomes through targeted marketing initiatives that accelerate cloud adoption, workload migration, and partner growth.

The ABM Manager will own the end-to-end execution of ABM programmes within assigned thematic clusters, working backwards from customer needs to create data-driven, multi-channel campaigns, events, and executive programmes that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. You will be part of a distributed EMEA team and collaborate closely with sales, partner development, and marketing peers across the region.

Key job responsibilities
Account-Based Marketing (Cloud Adoption & Workload Growth):

Design and execute 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns for a portfolio of EMEA ISV accounts, translating AWS cloud, AI/ML, and GenAI capabilities into business-relevant value propositions
Analyse customer data, buying signals, and market trends to optimise campaign strategy
Deliver multi-channel programmes (events, digital, direct) that drive cloud adoption and workload migration
Track programme performance — pipeline influenced, engagement scores, and ROI — and continuously optimise
Partner Growth & Co-Marketing:

Develop joint marketing plans with key ISV ABM accounts and manage Marketing Development Funds for integrated go-to-market activations across EMEA
Support ISV partners through marketing enablement, content creation, and joint customer engagement
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence:

Build strong relationships with EMEA sales teams, solutions architects, and partner development managers
Align ABM programmes with broader EMEA field marketing efforts
Drive operational excellence through standardised processes and documentation
Collaborate with global ABM and EMEA ISV cluster peers to share learnings and scale best practices
Represent AWS at industry events and partner forums across EMEA

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing engagement dashboards and campaign metrics for your assigned cluster accounts across EMEA. Mornings might include strategy sessions with sales leaders across multiple countries, aligning on pipeline targets. After lunch, you could be finalising logistics for an executive roundtable bringing together ISV CxOs to discuss GenAI adoption on AWS. Later, you might develop a joint go-to-market campaign with an ISV partner, creating content that showcases how their AWS-built solution solves real customer challenges. You'll regularly collaborate with EMEA ABM cluster peers to share playbooks and scale what works.

About the team
The EMEA ISV & Workloads Partner Marketing team drives demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and revenue growth through strategic marketing programmes developed for and with AWS technology partners (ISVs) across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. We work the intersection of customer and partner marketing — helping ISV customers accelerate their own cloud journey on AWS while simultaneously enabling them to build and sell solutions that serve end customers.
Our ABM programme uses thematic cluster model to deliver highly personalised, account-specific marketing across EMEA's most strategic ISV accounts. The team is distributed across multiple EMEA locations and works as one integrated unit.
Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
- Experience producing marketing promotional material for Owned & Operated channels
- Experience in brand identity and voice development
- Experience creating brand marketing content
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- MBA, or 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Read, write and speak in English (native), Hebrew, plus one incremental European language
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs
- Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation

jobs.title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, Global ISV Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
This highly visible role will work across AWS Software & Technology partners globally to develop and implement strategic plans that include building awareness, generating demand and driving pipeline and revenue. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B marketing strategies, coupled with hands-on experience in integrated marketing, digital demand generation, and partner or alliance marketing. You will be the subject matter expert for marketing partner solutions with and through partners across sales segments and geographies.
The role will partner with product, field, brand, digital, partner marketing teams and agencies to define and execute a global demand, content and campaign strategy that drives acquisition and engagement. You will develop targeted marketing programs aligned with business priorities that engage and nurture prospects throughout the buyer's journey, measuring and optimizing performance against goals and ultimately driving conversion and revenue growth. You will work closely with partners and our Geo based partner teams to help execute these programs regionally and be an expert resource on marketing processes and guidelines for partners.
This role requires a proven leader with the demonstrated ability to think strategically to build and convey compelling value propositions and content with technology partners. Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We are looking for a talented Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead Programmatic media channels for our EMEA B2C business. This role is responsible for developing and executing the programmatic media strategy across Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs), managing agency partnerships, and optimizing campaign performance to maximize subscriber acquisition at efficient CPA/ROAS targets across all EMEA markets.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven, customer-obsessed self-starter with deep expertise in programmatic media buying, DSP platform management (Amazon DSP, DV360), and performance optimization. You will own the end-to-end programmatic channel, from strategy and planning through execution and measurement — driving website traffic, maximizing gross adds, and improving the customer experience. You will work with agency partners and cross-functional teams to build scalable programmatic campaigns, develop robust measurement frameworks (MMM/MTA), and champion automation and testing to continuously improve performance.

In this role, you will collaborate with a range of technical and non-technical teams to assess media capabilities, own the experimentation strategy, and undertake detailed performance analysis. The scope of this role focuses on delivering against key business goals (Gross Ads, CPA/ROAS efficiency), while also innovating and finding efficiencies through the development and management of a multi-year programmatic strategy and roadmap.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.”

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the strategy, design, and execution of programmatic media campaigns across DSPs (Amazon DSP, DV360) for Amazon Leo’s B2C business across all EMEA markets, optimizing for Gross Ads, CPA/ROAS targets.
• Own the end-to-end relationships with internal ADSP teams and agencies for the programmatic channel including briefing, campaign planning, execution oversight, performance governance, and optimization.
• Develop and maintain programmatic playbooks incorporating best practices for audience targeting, bidding strategies, creative optimization, and trading techniques that can scale across markets.
• Conduct detailed campaign and channel performance analysis, leveraging data to optimize strategies, refine targeting, and improve ROI. Develop and maintain comprehensive reporting frameworks to track KPIs (Impressions, Click-Rates, Conversion Rates, CPA etc.) and present actionable insights to leadership.
• Champion automation, attribution measurement (MMM/MTA), and scaled solutions by influencing prioritization in tech roadmaps and partnering with measurement and data science teams.
• Design and execute a rigorous experimentation roadmap across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and inventory sources to continuously improve channel performance.
• Help drive the evolution of using Amazon Advertising Self-Service DSP for Leo via product beta participation, ongoing client feedback loop, and close collaboration with cross functional Amazon teams (Product Management, Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science)
• Stay current with industry trends, privacy/signal loss developments, and Amazon best-practices to define and execute an innovation roadmap that delights customers and drives efficiencies.

- Experience in professional non-internship marketing
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience with A/B Testing or Multi-Variate Testing or both
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Hands-on experience with Amazon DSP and/or Google DV360, including campaign setup, audience creation, and optimization.
- Experience managing large-scale media budgets and delivering efficiency improvements on a scale.
- Experience in technology, media, or telecommunications; satellite internet; or subscription services.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Attraction, Influence & Marketing (AIM)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about connecting people to opportunity? Do you thrive using creative sourcing and marketing channels to deliver real hiring outcomes — at a pace and scale few organizations can match?

At Amazon, we are reinventing how to attract and hire exceptional talent at scale. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) organization is seeking a well-organized, data-driven, and self-motivated Marketing Manager to execute and scale Talent Marketing programs for India.

You are equal parts executor and analyst — comfortable building an integrated marketing plan with agency partners one day and presenting campaign results to leadership the next. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, take full ownership of your workstreams, and know how to coordinate across partner teams whose roadmaps don't report to you. You understand that recruitment marketing isn't just advertising — it's hiring infrastructure — and you're energized by delivering measurable, repeatable results at scale. This role requires operational rigor, creative problem-solving, and a bias for action on a team that works hard and has fun.

This role supports the Talent Marketing India leader in developing and executing India's sourcing and marketing strategy across all Amazon sites — profiling target candidates, identifying appropriate channel levers, and building top-of-funnel demand to efficiently attract hourly talent. You will develop and execute local and national community engagement strategies, operationalize plans against KPIs tied to growing the hourly talent pipeline, reducing reliance on paid advertising. Additionally, you will author candidate communications, hiring event content, onboarding collateral, offer templates, and other marketing materials.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders on data-driven candidate attraction initiatives, track market shifts in hourly candidate behavior, and contribute to market mapping and intelligence efforts. To succeed, you'll need to see the big picture while executing rapidly on the ground.

Key job responsibilities
• Work with internal and external agency teams to develop and execute integrated marketing programs tailored for local markets, messaging on the employee value proposition and branding at country and business line levels
• Use data to rigorously assess channel and media effectiveness, prioritize based on business requirements, and optimize to achieve marketing goals
• Maintain local staffing agency and marketing agencies including onboarding, project briefs, vendor management and payment processing
• Monitor channel analytics to measure effectiveness and forecast future spend and required activity by site/region
• Support multiple marketing programs end-to-end — from self-serve infrastructure to targeted activation for priority hiring domains
• Establish pre-pilot baselines in partnership with analytics teams, manage evaluation cycles, and present results to leadership
• Support tech integration requirements such as the transition from third-party tooling to Amazon-native infrastructure
• Serve as a reliable point of contact for assigned programs across analytics, PR, creative, and Central teams; contribute to cadenced reporting (WBR, MBR, HBR)
• Partner with analytics, performance marketing and other teams to validate attribution methodology, track baseline metrics, and translate data into actionable recommendations
• Maintain a thorough understanding of local employment trends and continually monitor competitor/industry developments
• Document processes, create playbooks, and maintain SOPs that enable programs to scale without proportional headcount growth

About the team
Amazon's Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) organization is a dynamic team of marketing professionals dedicated to attracting and engaging talent across Amazon's diverse business segments. AIM achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences, engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

jobs.title: Onsite Marketing lead, Amazon Pay
jobs.description:
Amazon Pay is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager who will own the end-to-end onsite marketing engine across lifecycle, GTMs, and channel operations. This person will be the single threaded owner of how we plan, execute, and optimize marketing across onsite assets (Gateway, Interstitials, Thank you page asset), lifecycle journeys to settle and upsell on the app, and strategic GTM launches for Amazon Pay products and Amazon sale events (HVEs/ARTs) as an SPOC. The role requires someone who can think strategically about share of voice planning while also getting into the weeds of journey orchestration, experiment design, and cross functional coordination with central homepage & events teams as well as internal category teams.

Key job responsibilities

1. Own monthly SOV (Share of Voice) planning across all onsite channels. Build and maintain the SOV planning mechanism and tenets that enable inventory allocation across GTMs, always on programs, and strategic priorities. Ensure every launch has a clear channel plan with impression targets, CTR guardrails, and cohort targeting logic.
2. Manage the strategic intake process for launches. Coordinate across product, category, and business teams to ensure every GTM request is triaged, planned, and executed with clear ownership and timelines.
3. Lead the onsite intercept strategy for new app launches and feature rollouts. Drive actions on how new products get surfaced to the right customers at the right time through onsite placements, coordinating with product, design, and engineering.
4. Define and run lifecycle marketing journeys across the full funnel: Acquire, Engage, Upsell. Set up multi stage automated journeys on the engagement platform including triggers, branching logic, channel selection, wait times, and exit criteria. Track stage wise drop offs weekly and action fixes.
5. Serve as the events leader for Stores led events (Prime Day, Great Indian Festival etc). Own the marketing GTM from teaser through sale, including channel allocation, creative briefing, performance tracking, and post event reporting.
6. Act as the team leader for a team of 3 marketing managers & merchandisers on onsite & events marketing operations. Represent onsite pod in business reporting including WBR/MBR connects, dashboards, and review cadences.

A day in the life
You start the morning by reviewing the AI powered dashboards and call-outs on channel wise performance across — Gateway CTRs, Interstitial impressions, Unified Thank-you-pages,etc. Review the newly launched GTM campaigns and lifecycle journey drop-offs from last week's automated flow. Something's under-performing; you dig into the cohort split, identify the segment, and Slack the creative team a revised brief before standup.

By 10am, you're in the leading the new GTM planning and execution by triaging next week's launches — a new UPI feature rollout needs onsite campaign , a recharges category team wants a prime only Share of voice allocation, a new Rupay credit card launch needs onsite intercepts and the Prime Day events plan needs your alignment and teaser assets need sign-off. You run the intake, assign slots, set timelines.

Post-lunch is lifecycle: you're reviewing the Acquire→Engage journey in MoEngage — adjusting branching logic on a trigger that's leaking users at step 3. You set up the A/B, define exit criteria, and move on.

You close the day prepping the WBR narrative — connecting this week's SOV utilization and funnel metrics to the business outcomes leadership cares about. Three Slack threads get resolved on the walk to the parking lot.

About the team
This role is part of Amazon Pay. Amazon Pay India is building the country's most comprehensive digital payments experience — UPI, bill payments, credit cards, buy-now pay later, travel, subscriptions, and shopping rewards — for millions of Amazon customers. We sit at the intersection of fintech and e-commerce, with a singular mission: make Amazon Pay the most preferred payments app for affluent Amazon shoppers. Our Central Marketing team operates like a high-conviction startup — small, senior, high-autonomy. We own brand, onsite, lifecycle, performance marketing, and events across a product portfolio spanning credit, UPI, merchant payments, and a standalone app launch. We're AI-native in how we work (gen-AI creative pipelines, ML-powered personalization, automated orchestration) and metrics-obsessed in how we measure. If you want to build playbooks that don't exist yet, at a scale that few Indian fintech teams can offer, this is the team.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience communicating results to stakeholders
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
- Experience with Salesforce and Tableau

jobs.title: Enterprise Growth Lead, Amazon Ads Marketing
jobs.description:
Amazon Ads helps businesses connect with customers through full-funnel advertising solutions that combine deep audience understanding with innovative technology. We develop marketing programs that provide actionable insights and opportunities for advertisers, partnering with enterprise brands, agencies, and technology platforms to drive mutually beneficial growth.
The Ads Regional Marketing team drives comprehension and accelerates adoption of Amazon Ads' full-funnel solutions among enterprise advertisers across international marketplaces. We are globally consistent yet locally relevant, aligning our marketing programs to regional buying cycles, customer behaviors, and product adoption patterns while reflecting the cultures and commercial environments of the markets we serve.
We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to own and deliver a Japan-first integrated marketing roadmap. You will define the audience strategy across all marketing activity in Japan, creating differentiated programs for enterprise advertisers, holding companies, and independent agencies that position Amazon Ads as a preferred partner within Japan's advertising landscape. You will drive measurable growth through always-on programs that integrate owned and industry events, digital content, partner marketing, executive engagements, industry partnerships, and paid media into a single, coordinated customer journey. This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence, reporting to the Head of Regional Marketing.
The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of the Japanese advertising landscape—including agency group structures, media buying norms, and advertiser planning cycles—and a track record of executing B2B marketing strategies aligned to enterprise sales cycles and Japan-specific planning windows. You understand how decisions are made across holding companies, their subsidiary agencies, and independent shops, and you translate that knowledge into programs that resonate with each cohort. This is a fast-moving role that demands strong ownership, sharp prioritization, and clear communication. Day-to-day activities will evolve as our business grows; by owning a cross-channel annual roadmap you can expect to deliver across both strategy and execution. Responsibilities span senior stakeholder management, channel investment allocation, and audience strategy, through to content development, thought leadership, and budget management. You thrive in ambiguity and operate with flexibility. You manage a demanding project pipeline autonomously, partner effectively across global and regional teams, and advocate confidently for Japan marketplace needs within a global organization.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the Japan integrated marketing roadmap, connecting events, digital and content marketing, partner marketing, executive engagement, industry partnerships, and paid media into a coherent, always-on customer journey aligned to Japan advertiser planning cycles and product adoption patterns
• Define the Japan audience strategy, determining how Amazon Ads priorities and engages enterprise advertisers, holding companies, and independent agencies with differentiated approaches that reflect their distinct decision-making structures and needs
• Develop Japan-specific thought leadership campaigns that articulate the Amazon Ads value proposition, leveraging research, insights, success stories, and industry partnerships relevant to the Japanese market
• Identify the right combination and sequencing of marketing touchpoints across the customer lifecycle to deepen engagement and accelerate commercial outcomes
• Own accountability for marketing's contributions to Japan business objectives. You build and maintain strong relationships with sales leadership, partner teams, industry leaders, and the broader Amazon Ads Marketing organization, representing marketing in key Japan-level business planning
• Establish clear goals and measurement mechanisms to understand marketing effectiveness; conduct structured reviews and contribute insights to operational planning narratives
• Own program budgets and finance reporting, ensuring investment aligns with strategic priorities

A day in the life
Lead regional enterprise marketing strategy and execution for Amazon Ads in Japan, driving advertiser engagement, market adoption, and business growth across enterprise advertisers, holding companies, and independent agencies. Drive B2B marketing events (e.g., Amazon Japan Upfront, unBoxed Tokyo) alongside branded content, trade media, integrated campaigns, and executive engagement programs as part of a coordinated, always-on customer journey. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, and executive stakeholders to align programs with regional business priorities and strengthen Amazon Ads' market position in Japan.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 7+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

jobs.title: Principal Partner Marketing Manager, Global Consulting Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a talented, self-directed Principal Partner Marketing leader to drive joint strategic planning, thought leadership, and demand generation with Global System Integrator (GSI) partners and Business Consulting and Advisory Partners (BCAP) globally.

This is a senior marketing leadership position responsible for developing complex, enterprise-level marketing strategies and enabling the execution of programs that have significant cross-organizational impact and require C-suite level influence with strategic partners.

The role demands deep business knowledge to drive organizational alignment and growth, to establish marketing best practices, and to influence investment priorities across multiple stakeholder groups.
The position requires exceptional judgment in handling ambiguous situations, building consensus across global AWS and partner teams. Successful candidates must have prior experience in marketing and business development, working at a top technology vendor, a global system integrator, or a business consulting and advisory partner, and must use this understanding to align our partners and AWS business objectives.

Key job responsibilities
• Define global Partner Marketing strategy in alignment with the field, enabling complex programs with broad cross-organizational impact and C-level influence
• Operate with complete autonomy on strategic initiatives, defining vision and strategy in undefined problem spaces
• Make strategic trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and long-term AWS and partner outcomes
• Represent complex strategic decisions to senior leadership (SVP level), articulating trade-offs and options with exceptional clarity
• Identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks
• Work directly with senior executives in our partners to build marketing strategy and joint-marketing plans that drive customer acquisition and revenue growth from AWS and partner services
• Develop deep knowledge of partner business objectives and investment priorities to inform and evolve strategy and execution effectiveness
• Enable and orchestrate comprehensive regional marketing programs, ensuring alignment between partners and joint field marketing teams
• Manage and optimize a global budget across partner marketing programs
• Be the voice of our partners through setting goals, strategy, resourcing, roles and responsibilities, reporting, and measurement
• Ensure strategies and plans proposed to partners fully account for the scope of AWS marketing capabilities and capacity available to support them
• Direct external vendor strategy to support program execution and achieve goals, including Account-Based Marketing initiatives
• Drive strategic and executional alignment across AWS and partner organizations, collaborating with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Partner Sales, Solution Architects, and senior AWS leadership
• Build mechanisms, scalable frameworks, and organizational standards that scale marketing best practices, improve repeatable outcomes, and deliver long-term value for AWS and our partners
• Champion and guide joint thought leadership content that positions AWS and partners as category leaders
• Develop future leaders and guide managers in team development

About the team
The Global Consulting Partner Marketing team serves as the strategic marketing catalyst for AWS's most impactful consulting partners. Our dedicated engagement model positions Partner Marketing Managers as strategic marketing advisors and leaders for their partners, setting direction, orchestrating alignment and resources across complex global stakeholder teams to enable partner-led program delivery, and being accountable for both AWS and our partners' success.

- Experience owning pipeline targets and using data to drive marketing investment decisions and measure business outcomes (e.g., pipeline, revenue conversion, deal progression)
- Experience managing and optimizing million dollar + marketing budgets across diverse funding mechanisms
- Experience building, orchestrating, and scaling cross-functional marketing programs across multiple geographies and partner organizations simultaneously

jobs.title: ANZ & APAC Digital Marketing Manager, Amazon MGM Studios
jobs.description:

This role is responsible for defining and executing high-impact digital and social campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and box office performance, while ensuring consistency with global positioning and flexibility for local market execution.

Strategy and Planning

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Amazon Supply Chain Services
jobs.description:
Amazon spent decades building one of the best supply chains in the world to run its own business, moving, storing, and delivering products fast and reliably. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) now opens that same network up to other businesses, so any company can use Amazon's multimodal ground and air freight, warehousing, distribution & fulfillment, and parcel shipping to run their own operations. Think of it like what AWS did for cloud computing, but for supply chain, and it is just getting started.

We are looking for a driven, results-oriented Senior Integrated Marketing Manager to join the Amazon Supply Chain Services team. You will have the opportunity to define and drive the integrated marketing strategy for current and future Amazon supply chain solutions. The successful candidate will be expected to think and act both strategically and tactically: from the creation of plans, to the brass tacks of execution. She or he will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail. This is a highly visible position that will interact at all levels of the organization.

The ideal candidate will be an experienced B2B marketer, who can think strategically and execute flawlessly. If you’re looking to join a dynamic, growing team in a high-impact role, bring your insight, imagination, and a healthy disregard for the impossible to this challenging and growing business. You bring strong analytical skills, strong organizational and project management skills, and you have a track record of successfully navigating matrixed organizations, influencing without direct authority. You have a high level of comfort navigating ambiguity, a passion for scaling learnings beyond your immediate team, and the ability to investigate complex challenges and effectively influence cross-functional stakeholders. You work backwards from the customer, apply innovative thinking, and dive deep to identify and mitigate gaps.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end campaign architecture. Define audience, channel mix, sequencing, and timing for integrated campaigns spanning performance marketing, field marketing, content marketing, events, and experimental tactics to activate customers.
• Align marketing to GTM motions. Partner with sales leadership as the single point of accountability for building campaign playbooks tuned to distinct motions ensuring marketing investment maps to active sales priorities.
• Build repeatable, durable playbooks. Author and scale standardized playbooks for new ASCS service launches and evergreen growth motions, avoiding reinventing campaign approaches and ensuring campaign quality every time.
• GTM orchestration. Maintain a campaign calendar that sequences tactics for compounding effect (e.g., event → content nurture → digital retargeting → sales handoff) and prevents duplication across channel teams.
• Define integrated measurement. Build a cross-channel KPI and reporting framework that evaluates performance holistically, and drive retrospectives that turn attribution data into concrete optimization.
• Manage marketing budget, budget tracking tools and build mechanisms with key stakeholder and channel owners to track investments and ROI.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills - particularly presenting to senior leadership audiences
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Interest in exploring how automation and AI can power workflows, dashboards, and campaigns

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the development and execution of cross-channel lifecycle strategies that drive conversion, activation, retention, and long-term loyalty. Own the end-to-end customer journey, identifying key moments and touchpoints to deliver timely, relevant, and brand-aligned communications, leveraging deep technical knowledge of data systems, and marketing automation platforms (Marketo/Pardot/Salesforce).

• Map out and maintain the entire lifecycle marketing roadmap, including email automation and cross-channel journeys, and build associated journey flows.

• Collaborate across a dynamic ecosystem of stakeholders to define, develop, and implement multi-channel communication strategies. Monitor performance, surface trends and identify opportunities to increase share of wallet with existing customers.

• Synthesize reporting and insights to make adjustments to audience strategy, cadence and frequency, across email and other owned channels.

• Develop and bar raise rich, high-quality content for email, banners etc. to maximize engagement.

• Create evergreen programs with continuous testing and optimization to iteratively improve reach, scale engagement (open rates, click through rates etc.), drive consideration and adoption across a number of audience segments.

• Communicate regularly with stakeholders regarding key test results and the status of major initiatives, providing recommendations on strategic shifts and prioritization.

• Collaborate with the integrated marketing, product marketing, events, and creative teams to ensure messaging aligns with brand strategy and campaign priorities. Stay tightly aligned with commercial goals and maintain flexibility to respond quickly to changing business needs.

A day in the life
During campaign and content development, you will work collaboratively with key stakeholders and partners such as Strategy, Integrated, Performance, Product, Field, Brand, and Segment Marketing POCs, as well as the Sales teams and agencies. This role sits within the AI & Startup Partner Marketing team, part of the AWS Partner Marketing organization working closely with the Data & AI Partner GTM team. The partners you work with are not traditional ISVs - they are category-defining companies at the frontier of foundation model research whose models power workloads across Amazon Bedrock and the broader AWS AI stack. Your job is to build the marketing engine that helps these partners succeed on AWS while helping AWS customers access their capabilities through joint messaging, campaigns, launches, and programs.

You will develop joint marketing plans (JMPs), orchestrate cross-functional activation across AWS field sales, product marketing, and partner development, and own pipeline and attribution metrics for your assigned partner portfolio. The right candidate combines deep marketing craft with enough AI/ML literacy to hold their own in technical product conversations, and enough commercial instinct to prioritize programs by revenue impact. This portfolio will evolve as the frontier AI landscape shifts - we need someone comfortable building structure in ambiguity while staying close to where the technology and customer demand is heading.

jobs.title: Talent Marketing Manager, Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM)
jobs.description:
We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale. Come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to own the marketing strategy for the Americas, driving activation management and integrated campaign planning across the region. This role is the single-threaded owner for how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are built and measured, and how the organization scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration. You serve as the accountable owner for onboarding new internal clients in the Americas into the standard activation management process.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.
As a marketing strategist, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and beyond. You force multiply through mechanisms, building systems that reduce manual effort and driving toward automated decisioning. You translate complex marketing performance data into executive-level strategy, owning the WBR narrative for senior leadership and influencing investment priorities across the AIM organization.

You shape organizational strategy and drive marketing impact at scale.

Your insights don't just inform decisions, they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps, align business managers and global risk teams on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign planning functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement.

Key job responsibilities
Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across Americas fulfillment sites, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for the Americas, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events (Peak, Prime, Hot Sale). Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate rolling 12-week labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive campaign management across the Americas, leading true collaboration with Creative, Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Talent Engagement, and Business stakeholders. Facilitate quarterly planning cycles, manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams, and bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Lead integrated campaign reviews with senior leadership, presenting data-backed recommendations.

Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the strategy for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order projection accuracy across the Americas portfolio. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Identify systemic opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and hold partner teams accountable for execution.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Own pacing management, ensuring ramp-down and pause decisions are executed with precision and that insights are fed back into program management to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own the governance framework for spend decisions and escalation thresholds.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes, from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Influence: Own the weekly WBR deep dive for senior leadership, translating activation performance, campaign results, and fill risk into clear, strategic narratives. Maintain alignment with business managers, global risk teams, and cross-functional partners. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases.

A day in the life
Your day begins with a review of overnight performance data, identifying anomalies, escalation triggers, and optimization opportunities. You finalize the weekly activation logic, making strategic override decisions and ensuring the log is structured to support automation development. Mid-morning, you walk down the hall to a cross-functional working session with Performance Marketing and Journey Orchestration, influencing channel investment decisions with data from the prior week's WBR. You grab a whiteboard with a Campaign Planner to work through a quarterly testing plan, thinking through risk signals and mitigation strategies for upcoming high-volume events. In the afternoon, you're reviewing the onboarding plan for a new internal client coming onto the activation process, ensuring intake requirements are met and the timeline is on track. You close the day finalizing the WBR narrative for senior leadership, sharpening the strategic framing and ensuring campaign performance is connected to hiring outcomes before it goes to Directors. This is an in-office role five days a week, and the pace, proximity, and real-time collaboration reflect that.

About the team
Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences, engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 7+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with A/B testing
- Experience in high-volume recruitment marketing, talent acquisition marketing, or employer branding
- Experience with marketing automation tools and campaign management platforms
- Experience managing campaigns in Canada, US, Mexico, and Brazil

jobs.description:
Amazon's Worldwide Brand Protection organization ensures that brands can protect their Intellectual Property, and customers can shop with confidence across Amazon's global stores. We do this through ML-powered detection systems that identify abusive actors at enrollment, identity verification pipelines that gate access to brand privileges, and automated enforcement mechanisms that detect catalog manipulation and coordinated abuse at scale.

We are seeking a motivated, data-driven Sr. Risk Manager to join the Brand Protection Policy & Governance team, which owns the development, evolution, and consistent application of Brand Protection's policy frameworks across Amazon's global stores. As the threat landscape shifts, this team creates and adapts policies that define enforcement actions, shape operational processes, and govern seller-facing communications. In this role, you will lead policy and governance initiatives—driving the evolution of existing enforcement policies, spearheading new strategic policy development, eliminating process defects along the way, and building the supporting scalable frameworks needed to operationalize them at global scale. Working across multiple organizations, you will ensure that every policy initiative is grounded in risk reduction and aligned to protect customers, strengthen brand trust, and set selling partners up for success.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, takes initiative, and thrives in environments where they must independently identify opportunities, shape direction, and move work forward. They bring strong business judgment, analytical thinking, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of succeeding in a customer-driven workplace under tight deadlines. They possess strong judgment—the ability to assess risk, identify and propose multiple solutions, and weigh strategic trade-offs to arrive at the right call in complex, ambiguous situations.

-Define and drive policy and governance strategy that enables scalable, fair, and comprehensive Brand Protection enforcement—including SOP and policy decisions that balance customer trust, seller fairness, and operational efficiency

jobs.title: Credit Risk Manager, Amazon Payments
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history with Amazon's Brazil team! We are seeking a hands-on and analytically strong Credit Risk Individual Contributor to support the execution of our credit initiatives in Brazil and help create access to affordable payment methods. You will own the development and optimization of credit policies, working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to manage and improve our digital credit products.

The ideal candidate possesses solid credit risk management experience, strong analytical skills, and a proven track record executing credit strategies end-to-end. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and monitor credit policies across the customer lifecycle (acquisition, activation, limit management, and maintenance), ensuring alignment with risk appetite and business goals.

- Analyze portfolio performance leveraging data-driven insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization across key metrics (approval rates, FPD, loss rates, Incremental profitability and vintage curves).

- Design and execute A/B tests and champion/challenger experiments to continuously improve underwriting rules, decision models, and segmentation strategies.

- Support collections and recovery strategy execution, including segmentation logic, collection rules, and performance tracking of internal and external collection efforts.

- Build and maintain risk dashboards and reporting cadences, translating complex data into actionable narratives for senior leadership and stakeholders.

- Partner with Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to embed risk controls into customer journeys, ensuring scalable and automated decision-making.

- Identify signs of macroeconomic deterioration or improvement that may impact portfolio performance and propose strategies with clear trade-off analysis.

- Support the development of credit risk frameworks, including risk appetite definition, governance documentation, and policy governance routines.

About the team
Brazil Payments is part of the International Emerging Stores Payments team and focuses on supporting the launch of new payment and financial products to our customers in Brazil.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Solid experience in credit risk, credit policy, or portfolio management in financial services, fintech, or banking.
Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of analytics & statistical tools such as SAS, PowerBI, SQL & ETL DW concepts
- Deep expertise in credit underwriting, collections strategy and fraud prevention across consumer lending products in Latin American markets, particularly Brazil.
- Proven track record designing and implementing credit risk frameworks that balanced growth targets with loss mitigation in high-growth environments.
- Proven ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable credit strategies
- Familiarity with machine learning models applied to credit scoring or segmentation
- Knowledge of Brazilian credit bureau data (Serasa, SPC, Boa Vista)

In this role, you'll be part of a team responsible for managing AWS' strategic relationships with a leading AI model provider. You'll build relationships with the partner's executives and its product, marketing, sales, and channel teams. You'll own the joint business plan and set the direction for how AWS and the partner win together. You'll drive revenue growth and customer adoption of the partner's models on AWS, and help get competitive deals over the line. This is a global role covering customers and markets across every region.

You bring a partner management background that lets you build trusted relationships at the executive level, and a sales background that makes you effective with enterprise customers and AWS field teams. You think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, and you can turn them into clear value propositions and plans people act on. You understand generative AI, frontier models, and how enterprises adopt them. You use data and AI tools to track the business, spot trends early, and keep leaders informed.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage a strategic global model provider partnership across Amazon Bedrock and AWS Marketplace, defining and executing joint partner plans, co-sell motions, and GTM programs.
- Own the partner development plan, including consumption, exit run rate, Marketplace revenue, and pipeline targets, aligned with AWS Generative AI strategy.
- Engage the partner's field sales and channel teams to create, accelerate, and close joint revenue opportunities on AWS.
- Own the deal escalation mechanism: remove blockers across sales, legal, finance, and funding teams, and report trends to leadership.
- Navigate AWS funding and incentive programs for competitive deals and advocate for mechanisms that scale.
- Lead internal stakeholders (solutions architects, service teams, marketing, legal) to execute the joint business plan and build field enablement.
- Build metrics and dashboards to track spend, attainment, and pipeline. Strong requirement and demonstrated experience using AI tools to automate reporting and analysis.
- Write and present business reviews for AWS and partner senior leadership.
- Manage complex contract negotiations and serve as liaison to AWS strategic deal, legal, and finance teams.

A day in the life
Your day centers on one of AWS's most strategic AI partnerships. Mornings might start with a call with the partner's sales leaders to review deals in flight, then a quick huddle with solutions architects on a customer who needs help getting to production. By afternoon, you could be getting a stalled deal moving again by bringing in finance and legal, or using AI tools to turn raw spend data into a dashboard leaders actually read. Some days you'll write the briefing for an executive meeting. On others, you'll help shape how AWS works with AI companies for years to come.

About the team
We're a small, close-knit team that manages AWS partnerships. Our mission is to make AWS the best place for customers to build with AI. You'll work side by side with partner managers, solutions architects, sales teams, and finance and legal partners, and also directly with the partner's own sales and leadership teams. Our customers are businesses of every size that want to use AI models securely and at scale. We clear the way for them by removing roadblocks, speeding up deals, and building programs that make adoption easier. The pace is fast, and we're still writing the playbook.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

You will safeguard Amazon Pharmacy's compliance posture by owning and managing the end-to-end relationship with accrediting bodies. jobs.description:

Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit aws.amazon.com.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

The Role
We are looking for an International Business Development Manager to join our International Business Development (IBD) team, based in Singapore, report to China & Hong Kong (CMHK) organization and focused on the Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ) region. Our mission is to accelerate CMHK customers’ global expansion — helping high-growth companies grow across borders in both directions. You will own the cross-border go-to-market bridge between customers expanding into and out of CMHK, connecting them with the right regional teams, partners, and programs to turn expansion ambitions into launched business.
This is a high-ownership, result-driven role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, works comfortably across cultures and time zones, and is energized by making others successful. You will act as a single-threaded owner for cross-border growth in APJ — spotting opportunities early, orchestrating the players who can capture them, and driving momentum from first introduction through to sustained growth.

Key job responsibilities
What You’ll Do
• Own cross-border go-to-market in APJ. Act as the single-threaded owner for cross-border growth in the region — driving strategy, execution, and outcomes end-to-end rather than waiting for boundaries to be drawn. Connect customers with the right teams. Orchestrate high-quality introductions between customers and the regional account, partner, and specialist teams best placed to serve them, accelerating pipeline through relationships and trust.
• Lead China–ASEAN / APJ collaboration. Own the region’s most active cross-border corridor, building and sustaining the relationships and cadences that move opportunities forward across markets.
• Accelerate pipeline and drive launched business. Identify, unblock, and progress cross-border opportunities — measured by influenced pipeline and launched revenue across both expansion motions. Orchestrate events and GTM activities. Plan and run the executive engagements, customer events, and go-to-market activities that create momentum and open doors across regions.
• Partner across a matrixed organization. Work hand-in-hand with program teams, regional sales leaders, and partners — succeeding by making others successful and strengthening ownership in the ambiguous spaces between teams.
• Make cross-border value visible. Define and communicate a clear service model — what you offer, when to engage you, and what you deliver — so your contribution compounds into recognized business impact.

A day in the life

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

About the Team
The International Business Development team drives a two-way, cross-border growth mandate. We help customers based in one market succeed as they expand into another — combining deep local relationships, cross-regional coordination, and go-to-market expertise that no single account team owns alone. The team operates across the two core motions that define cross-border growth:
• China2Global (C2G) Outbound expansion — supporting fast-growing customers as they enter APJ market, connecting them to the regional account teams and resources that accelerate their launch and scale.
• Global2China (G2C) — helping APJ customers land and grow in CMHK, building the local relationships and go-to-market motion that turn interest into launched business.
This APJ-based seat concentrates on the region’s highest-value cross-border flows, with a particular focus on collaboration between China and the broader ASEAN and APJ markets — the single heaviest cross-border corridor the team supports.

jobs.title: Category Growth Manager, Fashion & Fitness (Softlines)
jobs.description:

To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Category Manager to join our Softlines team. The Softlines business group is one of Amazon's five core retail businesses, along with Hardlines, Consumables, Electronics and Entertainment. Softlines encompasses a vast and growing range of businesses in the fashion industry (including Apparel, Shoes, Jewellery, Watches and Luggage), building on all the things consumers love about Amazon to deliver a unique and compelling range of products.

This role is multi-faceted in nature, working cross functionally with various teams including marketing, finance, supply chain, Amazon Ads, and our external supplier partners. As a Category Manager, you will be a passionate advocate for our customers and develop a category based on strong relationships with our supplier partners. You will be successful in the role by building long term, strategic relationships with our existing suppliers and also engaging with new brands to help drive incremental growth opportunities for them on Amazon.com.au. You will be an effective negotiator and act as a Subject Matter Expert in a particular field and play a role coaching and developing members of the team and peers across the business.

An Amazon Category Manager also complements their investments in relationships and people with a sharp, analytical mind: being comfortable with a suite of metrics across multiple KPIs is a must, likewise is holding an affinity with complex analysis and making data-driven decisions. Adding structure to processes, creating rigorous mechanisms and understanding operational flows will be part and parcel of your role.

We are looking for someone who:
- Enjoys a high degree of ownership: this will include owning the category P&L, ranging decisions and expansion, driving operational efficiencies and becoming your team’s Subject Matter Expert in various topics.
- Is a relationship-builder, developing trust and helping drive mutually beneficial outcomes for all stakeholders.
- Can problem solve both individually and as a team; working backwards from the customer.
- Can demonstrate strong organizational skills, effectively prioritizing tasks.
- Can create an inclusive environment; actively seek diversity of thought.
- Exhibits proficiency in using bespoke tools and systems, including an increasing use of AI.

- Dogs at Work: our popular program proven to lower stress and boost morale, running successfully across our Australian corporate offices
- Commuter benefits, helping you save on the cost of your daily commute

- Drive Category Strategy: Own end to end category performance, develop growth strategies, and make data-driven ranging decisions
- Demand Forecasting: Create forecasts of demand based on multiple sources, including local sales history, other locale data, external market insights, and vendor feedback to inform strategic decision-making
- Build Strategic Partnerships: Lead commercial negotiation and cultivate long term relationships with existing and potential supplier partners to create mutually beneficial growth opportunities
- Pricing & Promotion: Shape pricing strategies that balance profitability with customer value. Partner with marketing teams to plan and execute impactful promotional events.
- Analyse and Optimise: Dive deep into complex data to identify trends, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the customer experience
- Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with marketing, finance, supply chain, and advertising teams to achieve holistic business objectives
- Develop Team Capabilities: Act as a subject matter expert, coach colleagues, and contribute to team knowledge development

A day in the life
Your focus centers on driving growth and optimization within your assigned fashion or fitness category. You might start your day reviewing overnight sales data and customer feedback to identify emerging trends, then move into a strategic planning session with your supplier partners to discuss upcoming product launches. Mid-morning, you could be analyzing promotional performance metrics to refine pricing strategies, followed by a cross-functional meeting with our marketing and supply chain teams to align on inventory needs for an upcoming campaign. You'll also dedicate time to mentoring team members, sharing category insights, and collaborating with colleagues across the business to solve complex challenges. Your work balances analytical deep-dives with relationship-building conversations that create mutually beneficial outcomes for Amazon, our partners, and our customers.

About the team
We are a collaborative group of category specialists dedicated to making fashion and fitness accessible and discoverable for Australian customers. Our team values diverse perspectives and works together to understand what customers want, then partner with suppliers to deliver it. We're building something meaningful—expanding the range of quality products available while supporting our brand partners in reaching new audiences. You'll work closely with colleagues in marketing, finance, supply chain, and advertising, each bringing their expertise to solve problems from the customer's perspective. We're excited about the opportunity to grow this business thoughtfully and inclusively, and we're looking for someone who shares our commitment to customer-centricity and collaborative problem-solving.

jobs.description:
The Strategic Account Services (SAS) organization is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager to shape the future of the program. The Senior Customer Success Manager drives business growth for some of the most influential Sellers on the Amazon Store, ensuring Seller satisfaction by delivering an optimal level of service through strategic insights and relentlessly high operational standards. In this role, you will own building and executing strategic joint business plans with your Sellers; collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, traffic and conversion drivers, and operational improvement opportunities.

The ideal candidate for this role should possess client management skills with the keen ability to work backwards with Sellers to identify and prioritize the right inputs and outputs to deliver value and growth.

They will be able to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced work environment and actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives to multiply impact beyond their portfolios. Above all, they should demonstrate ownership and the ability to embrace and navigate ambiguity and complexity.

They are agile, inventive, and an advocate for their Sellers experience on the Amazon Store. If you are interested in growing Amazon’s leading brands, then we’re interested in you.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
Customer Success Managers drive Seller business growth through customized insights, recommendations, education on tools/products/services, and delivering a positive program experience.

Business Growth
- Identify and action improvements to business input metrics that drive growth and end customer experience. Develop and test solutions before scaling.
- Analyze data and trends to maximize long-term potential for your assigned Seller portfolio.

- Deliver timely, accurate, and professional operational support within specified SLAs.
- Drive optimal program and CSM satisfaction.
- Liaise with partner teams and coordinate cross-functionally to resolve Seller issues quickly and with high quality.

- Educate Sellers on driving incremental growth through tools, policies, products, and programs. Maintain in-depth knowledge to tie recommendations to Sellers' specific goals.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager II, Amazon SEND
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Manager II to help scale Amazon SEND, a cross-border logistics solution for FBA sellers worldwide. In this role, you will work backwards from customer problems and partner closely with carriers to elevate the seller experience on Amazon SEND.

You will sit at the core of supply chain innovation, where your ability to drive alignment across internal and external teams directly shapes both seller and carrier outcomes.

You will identify opportunities, lead strategic initiatives, and strengthen the value proposition of Amazon SEND. Success in this role demands expertise in cross-border logistics, strong stakeholder management, and a proven ability to drive progress across diverse teams. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who wants to deliver impact at scale, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive strategic initiatives to deliver step change improvement in key business results, use data analysis to surface trends and recommend supply chain improvements for cross-border logistics.
- Collaborate with external partners — including carriers and vendors — to negotiate solutions, close deals, and grow shipping volume across international lanes.
- Work with internal teams such as Operations, Procurement, Fulfillment Centers, Seller Support, Product and Tech to align on priorities and remove roadblocks.
- Monitor cross-border logistics market trends and proactively flag opportunities or risks that affect customer experience and business continuity.
- Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders, document findings for leadership, and create process improvements that support the team's goals.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing business metrics and carrier performance dashboards, then jump into calls with partnered carriers to discuss volume targets or resolve operational issues. Midday might find you working with Procurement on a new proposal or pulling together a market trend analysis for your manager. In the afternoon, you will document your findings, and collaborate with teammates to refine outreach strategies — all while picking up best team practices and sharpening your analytical skills.

About the team
Amazon SEND is a cross-border logistics solution integrated into Seller Central that enables FBA sellers to ship inventory from their home country to Amazon fulfillment centers in destination countries. The team's mission is to make cross-border shipping easy, reliable, and competitively priced for selling partners located anywhere in the world. We are in an exciting growth phase, actively scaling volume and expanding into new lanes. As part of this team, you will work closely with partnered carriers and collaborate across Amazon to help shape the future of global seller logistics.
