- 3+ years of business development, or account management with a proven ability to deliver results experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in managing global stakeholders
- Experience in team management and building (including coaching and mentoring)
- Experience with data analysis and using metrics to drive program improvements
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience driving innovation directly with Product Management and Engineering
- Master's degree
- 4+ years of supply chain management (e.g. logistics, inventory turn management, forecasting, operations) experience

AWS customers include some of the most innovative digital native companies in the world — from category-defining consumer platforms to high-growth ISVs — as well as the largest global enterprises.
We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager to lead a small, highly talented team of Senior Strategic Account Managers responsible for three of AWS’s most strategic Digital Native accounts. jobs.description:

Excel in identifying and communicating mutually beneficial customer and partner propositions and benefits? A creative marketer that can think big and make it happen? Then the Partner Growth Marketing team at Amazon could be the perfect fit for you, where we build dynamic future for Amazon subscriptions across the globe.

The Partner Growth Marketing team (Fuse) within Amazon’s Corporate Business Development group enables partners across multiple verticals to resell our subscription services including Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited, Kindle Unlimited, and more. The candidate must be able to work collaboratively and independently, building trust across internal teams as well as external partners. The focus will be on building, measuring and optimizing successful, results-oriented marketing programs in a fast-paced environment, often with speedy timelines, across new partner launches and on-going campaigns focused on growth marketing efforts that acquire new customers to our subscription services. This person must also have experience in creating centralized programs that can be leveraged on a global scale, both directly and by others. jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Manager III, RSR+ Supply Chain
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Supply Chain Manager to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will handle ambiguous initiatives independently, using domain expertise to define problems, determine goals, and design long-term solutions for our ultra-fast fulfillment network. You will work both tactically and strategically, driving innovation and solving complex problems in supply chain planning, forecasting, and network optimization.

Key job responsibilities
- Independently manage complex supply chain initiatives with considerable impact
- Design and deliver end-to-end solutions for complex supply chain challenges in our fast-paced fulfillment environment
- Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership, writing strategic narratives and communicating across diverse functions
- Develop and implement long-term supply chain strategies that balance speed, cost, and service performance
- Mitigate long-term risks and make strategic trade-offs between short and long-term needs
- Drive process improvements that impact long-term organizational goals across programs and potentially multiple countries
- Lead supply chain modeling and design projects from concept through implementation and scaling
- Partner with cross-functional teams including Operations, Finance, Product, Technology, and Science to optimize supply chain performance
- Manage forecasting, demand planning, and capacity planning to support rapid business growth
- Develop new processes and mechanisms for the organization while driving operational excellence
- Navigate and resolve contentious issues across stakeholder teams, building consensus and influencing without authority
- Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify root causes and implement scalable solutions
- Negotiate complex agreements and manage supplier relationships to reduce risk and optimize performance

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The SSD, RSR+, and Perishables Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations for Amazon's fastest, most complex fulfillment networks delivering fresh groceries and fast-moving general merchandise goods. We operate at the intersection of speed and complexity—balancing ultra-fast delivery commitments with the unique challenges of perishable inventory and high-velocity general merchandise.

The team is responsible for short-term capacity planning that ensures our facilities can handle daily volume fluctuations, inbound planning and design that optimizes how products flow into our network, forecasting that anticipates customer demand with precision, and in-stock management that keeps the right products available at the right time. This high-impact role owns strategic supply chain planning and design for a critical segment of Amazon's fastest-growing business. We're building the future of ultra-fast fulfillment.

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

jobs.title: Startups Portfolio Growth Manager, AWS Startups EMEA, Startup Investor Management - EMEA
jobs.description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Have you spent your career building strategic relationships — managing alliance partnerships, driving innovation programs, or connecting capabilities to emerging technology companies? Are you ready to use that expertise to help EMEA's most innovative startups access the enterprise ecosystem?

This role sits at the intersection of enterprise innovation and startups. You will connect AWS startup customers with enterprises, consulting firms, system integrators, corporate venture arms, and advisory practices — helping startups land their first enterprise engagements and helping partners access new technology. You will own the full lifecycle of these cross-functional partnerships, define business development strategy that complements product strategy, and translate partner and customer feedback into go-to-market actions. If you thrive on turning ambiguous opportunities into structured deals with measurable impact, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and grow relationships with enterprises, consulting firms, corporate venture capital arms, and system integrators, becoming their go-to contact for startup innovation on AWS and designing partnership frameworks that create mutual value for both startups and partners.
- Identify which startups in the AWS portfolio are market-ready and facilitate introductions, co-build opportunities, and joint go-to-market motions between startups and enterprise partners.
- Map the enterprise industries to uncover where innovation gaps exist, and position AWS startups to fill them by creating business reviews on ecosystem opportunities, partner health, and pipeline development.
- Coordinate with AWS Partner Network (APN), Global System Integrators, and key Independent Software Vendors to align startup positioning with broader partner strategies, and collaborate with corporate venture capital teams on co-investment opportunities.
- Own forecasting, planning, and reporting on the business impact of each partnership, tracking actuals against targets and contributing to strategic planning documents while mentoring and developing team members.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing deal pipeline metrics before joining a call with a startup or a CVC to negotiate terms on a complex agreement. By midday, you could be collaborating with product managers to translate partner feedback into actionable feature requests. In the afternoon, you may prepare a business review for senior leadership, synthesizing data on deal performance and strategic recommendations. Throughout, you balance hands-on deal execution with strategic thinking, working closely with colleagues across business, product, and engineering teams.

About the team
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world's largest companies. With nearly 20 years of experience gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups, the AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible — at any stage of growth and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to build on AWS.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in sales/business development, or experience in customer acquisition
- Knowledge of cloud computing technologies
- Business development or ecosystem roles connecting technology companies (or startups) to Enterprise companies
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience in sales/business development
- MBA
- Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications in on or more of the following industries: Healthcare & Life sciences, Retail/CPG/Luxury or ISV.
- Executive-level network within the above organizations
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, AWS Infra Supply Chain Automation
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges that impact cloud infrastructure at global scale? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team is seeking a Technical Program Manager III to drive critical programs that ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time. You'll tackle never-been-done-before problems involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly enable AWS's ability to scale and meet customer demand.

In this role, you'll leverage your program management expertise and technical depth to orchestrate complex supply chain initiatives across the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos). You'll work with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain. This is an opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while solving ambiguous problems that require both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team supply chain automation programs, defining scope, validating requirements, and driving execution with measurable success criteria
- Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to translate supply chain challenges into technical solutions, creating high-level designs and architectural approaches for the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos)
- Drive alignment across diverse global teams by managing priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs while proactively identifying and mitigating risks before they become blockers
- Establish program health metrics and operational excellence mechanisms, continuously monitoring progress and driving process improvements that enhance delivery efficiency
- Influence technical and business decisions by building consensus across stakeholders, communicating program status through written narratives and presentations, and escalating appropriately to resolve contentious issues

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing deployment metrics for a critical supply chain automation initiative, identifying a potential bottleneck in inventory forecasting. You organize a design review with partner engineering teams, asking probing questions to pressure-test assumptions and ensure the solution scales globally. After clarifying action items and owners, you draft a concise narrative for leadership addressing a cross-team dependency that needs resolution. You spend time mentoring a junior program manager on stakeholder management, then join a working session where you help engineering and operations teams navigate trade-offs between speed and technical debt for an upcoming launch.

About the team
The AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team builds the software systems that orchestrate AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain at global scale. Our mission is to ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time to support customer demand. We work on complex challenges involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly impact AWS's ability to scale.

Our team values innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive culture where perspectives from varied backgrounds drive better solutions, and we invest heavily in developing our engineers and leaders. As AWS continues its rapid growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while working on programs of critical importance to Amazon's success.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager, Amazon SEND
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Manager to help scale Amazon SEND, a cross-border logistics solution for FBA sellers worldwide. In this role, you will work backwards from customer problems and partner closely with carriers to elevate the seller experience on Amazon SEND.

You will sit at the core of supply chain innovation, where your ability to drive alignment across internal and external teams directly shapes both seller and carrier outcomes.

You will identify opportunities, lead process improvements, and strengthen the value proposition of Amazon SEND. Success in this role demands expertise in cross-border logistics, strong stakeholder management, and a proven ability to drive progress across diverse teams. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who wants to deliver impact at scale, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and track performance metrics that measure business results, using data analysis to surface trends and recommend supply chain improvements for cross-border logistics.
- Collaborate with external partners — including carriers and vendors — to negotiate solutions, close deals, and grow shipping volume across international lanes.
- Work with internal teams such as Operations, Procurement, Fulfillment Centers, Seller Support, and Product and Tech to align on priorities and remove roadblocks.
- Monitor cross-border logistics market trends and proactively flag opportunities or risks that affect customer experience and business continuity.
- Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders, document findings for leadership, and create process improvements that support the team's goals.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing business metrics and carrier performance dashboards, then jump into calls with partnered carriers to discuss volume targets or resolve operational issues. Midday might find you working with Procurement on a new proposal or pulling together a market trend analysis for your manager. In the afternoon, you will document your findings, update stakeholder reports, and collaborate with teammates to refine outreach strategies — all while picking up best practices and sharpening your analytical skills.

About the team
Amazon SEND is a cross-border logistics solution integrated into Seller Central that enables FBA sellers to ship inventory from their home country to Amazon fulfillment centers in destination countries. The team's mission is to make cross-border shipping easy, reliable, and competitively priced for selling partners located anywhere in the world. We are in an exciting growth phase, actively scaling volume and expanding into new lanes. As part of this team, you will work closely with partnered carriers and collaborate across Amazon to help shape the future of global seller logistics.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience with business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 1+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- 3+ years of stakeholder management experience
- Experience in international logistics, cross-border transportation and supply chain, or U.S. Customs rules and regulations

jobs.description:

This is a strategic, hands-on role requiring deep commercial acumen, full P&L ownership, and the ability to drive analysis that directly impacts business performance. A critical aspect is leading complex commercial negotiations with key vendors and strategic partners - structuring deals that drive mutual growth while balancing short-term targets with long-term partnership value. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, finance, supply chain teams, and brand partners to drive category growth. As an individual contributor, you'll deliver results through influence, mentor team members, and act as a Subject Matter Expert across the organisation.

A successful Senior Category Manager will:
- Own category outcomes end-to-end: taking full ownership of your category's P&L, setting strategic direction, driving ranging and investment decisions, and identifying operational efficiencies
- Lead complex negotiations: confidently navigating senior stakeholder relationships and structuring commercial deals that optimise terms, pricing, and promotional investment while building long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships
- Bring analytical depth and commercial rigour: diving deep in the data to uncover insights, build compelling business cases, and translate complex analysis into actionable category strategies
- Know your market: developing deep expertise in your category's competitive landscape, seasonality, and customer trends and using the knowledge to inform strategic decisions
- Be solutions-oriented at scale: proactively identifying challenges and opportunities across your portfolio, and always working backwards from the customer
- Technology & AI Adoption: Embrace AI and new technologies, diving into Amazon's tools and systems quickly and confidently

Amazon values diverse experiences and candidates with transferable skills are encouraged to apply. We are hiring across multiple business units and will match your profile to a category through the hiring process:
- Consumables (Grocery, Beauty, Household, Pet, Personal Care or Baby)
- Fashion (Luggage, Shoes, Watches or Clothing)
- Electronics (Audio, Consumer Electronics, TV or Camera)
- Home & Living (Toys, Kitchen, Sports, Lawn and Garden or Office)
- Entertainment (Physical Books, Video Games, Music, or Digital Products)

- Inclusive culture: Amazon celebrates diversity of background, experience, and thought as a key driver of innovation and our mission to be the most customer-centric company in the world

- Collaborate, Influence & Mentor: Partner with Merchandising, Operations, Procurement, Finance, and Marketing. Act as a brand ambassador externally and mentor team members internally.
- Embrace Technology & AI: Adopt new technologies and Amazon's tools quickly and confidently."

Your day will be dynamic and collaborative, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll lead commercial negotiations with key partners, dive deep into category performance data, and develop strategies that drive results. Expect to move between complex analytical work, cross-functional alignment, and senior stakeholder engagement.

We're seeking a CDR Network Plan Performance Manager to drive root cause analysis of build plan misses, identify systemic gaps in planning assumptions, and lead improvement initiatives that raise the bar on plan accuracy and execution reliability. The build plan determines what and how many server racks we can build each week given material and capacity constraints across a 13-week rolling horizon. You will be embedded in this end-to-end process — examining every input and assumption to ensure we are measuring what matters and improving where it counts. As the CDR planning function matures and additional planning elements are introduced (e.g., Landing Plan), the scope of this role will expand accordingly.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven problem solver with deep supply chain or operational planning experience, a relentless curiosity for understanding "why," and the ability to translate analytical findings into actionable process improvements at scale.

Key job responsibilities
Root Cause Analysis & Investigation: Conduct structured root cause analyses (RCAs) on build plan misses — investigating material availability, capacity constraints, vendor delivery, and other inputs that drive the 13-week build horizon. Investigate planning assumptions and inputs to determine where breakdowns occur — distinguishing between data quality issues, process gaps, constraint modeling errors, and execution failures. Document findings with clear causal chains and evidence to support corrective action recommendations.

Performance Measurement & Metrics: Develop and maintain performance metrics that track build plan adherence (racks planned vs. racks built per week), assumption accuracy, and supply chain input reliability. Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide visibility into performance trends, miss categories, and improvement trajectories. Analyze historical performance data to identify recurring patterns, seasonal effects, and systemic vulnerabilities.

Improvement Initiatives: Own and drive improvement initiatives end-to-end — from problem identification through solution design, implementation, and impact measurement. Partner with Build Plan, Landing Plan, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams to implement process changes that address identified root causes. Develop business cases for improvement investments and track ROI of completed initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

- Work across organizational boundaries to gather data, validate hypotheses, and drive alignment on corrective actions.

- Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership, translating complex analyses into clear narratives.

- Participate in planning forums and reviews, representing the performance perspective and advocating for data-driven decision making.

Process & Framework Development:

- Contribute to the development of performance management frameworks, RCA methodologies, and miss categorization taxonomies.

- Identify opportunities to automate performance tracking and anomaly detection across the build plan cycle.

jobs.description:
Are you energized by solving complex network design problems at scale? Amazon's Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) Supply Chain team is looking for a Senior Supply Chain Manager to lead site selection and launch planning for our Sub-Same Day (SSD) delivery network. In this role, you will conduct topology analysis, evaluate real estate options, and develop jurisdictional proposals and volume plans that shape where and how we expand. Your recommendations feed directly into financial modeling and capital approval decisions, making your work a critical input to one of Amazon's fastest-growing delivery programs.

This is a high-visibility opportunity at an inflection point: the SSD network is preparing for its largest expansion yet, and the team is investing in scalable, automated launch and expansion processes to support rapid growth in the years ahead. You will partner with Finance, Real Estate, Operations, S&OP, and Delivery Experience (DEX) teams to turn data into actionable plans that get new sites open on time and on budget.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct topology analysis using demand estimation and optimization tools to develop jurisdictional coverage proposals and volume plans for new and existing metro areas.
- Partner with Finance and Real Estate to translate site proposals into financial payback models that support the site selection and capital approval process.
- Collaborate with S&OP, launch, and DEX teams to align demand forecasts, capacity allocation, and launch timelines across the network.
- Identify and implement process improvements that scale and automate the jurisdictional planning and launch functions, reducing manual effort as annual launch volume grows.
- Manage trade-offs across competing priorities — building size, coverage boundaries, timeline, and cost — and present clear recommendations to leadership.

A day in the life
You will spend much of your time working in optimization and planning tools, estimating zip-code-level demand and mapping it against real estate options to build the strongest possible site proposal. From there, you will join cross-functional working sessions with planning and launch teams to align on timelines and capacity targets. When a live coverage gap surfaces, you may step in to help resolve it quickly, but most of your work is proactive and roadmap-driven. Expect a mix of heads-down analytical work and collaborative problem-solving with partners across the organization.

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

The IPS Procurement Category Management Org is responsible for the procurement of all third party provided services required for the operation of our Data Center infrastructure globally, including Colo and Edge facilities for externally delivered services not provided by the facility owner. The team is responsible for the identification, on boarding and performance management of suppliers as well as developing category strategies, conducting competitive tendering processes, supplier negotiations and the preparation of associated Work Orders.

The team is structured into three regions, each led by a regional manager, with each regional team composed of category managers with responsibility for the management of specific areas of spend within the region and a cohort of procurement specialists who support the category managers. The category management approach facilitates a strategic approach to procurement by facilitating in depth market analysis coupled with a cross functional approach to identify supplier and associated contracting options which are focused on meeting the particular needs of the business. Category management moves beyond traditional transactional based purchasing negotiations to provide a strategic approach to longer term, sustainable cost reductions, reducing risk and increasing resiliency in the supply base and facilitating innovation from within the supply base that the business can leverage.
While cost reduction will always be a key focus of the team, the principle cynosure of the team is the delivery of services that are keenly focused on increasing reliability and supporting enhanced availability through robust relationships which support continuity of operations. As service and quality levels can vary greatly, principally based on the skill set within a supplier local organization, the regional structure facilitates tailoring of category strategies to meet local market considerations and closely monitor supplier performance at the local level.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

•Manage a complex category within the Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) and Facility Management domains.

•Achieve cost savings through bidding and negotiations, drive collaboration to achieve long term value delivery.

•Obtain market intelligence, analyze category data and metrics to drive Procurement category strategies.

•Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns, across categories and regions, to influence customers’ priorities.

•Lead supplier selection process across multiple sub-categories, internal teams, and regions, and create longer-term supplier selection strategies for management.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about the supply market, new innovations and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about sustainability, diversity, in-country value and have experience developing category strategies to incorporate same.

•Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost.

•Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance.

•Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships.

•Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle.

•Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as SRM and management of contracts post-execution.

jobs.description:
Do you want to build the tools and processes that make supply chain planning faster and smarter? Amazon's Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning Products team is looking for a Supply Chain Manager III to define problems, design solutions, and drive productivity improvements across our outbound transportation network planning operations. As the team invests in using AI to automate manual planning processes and build more robust systems, this is a compelling time to join and shape how that transformation takes hold.

This is a highly collaborative, individual contributor role where you will work side by side with planners to understand their workflows, identify improvement areas, and write clear problem statements. From there, you will partner with technology teams to build tooling solutions and with operational partners to implement process changes. You will work with optimization models, capacity planning tools, and product management tools to turn undefined challenges into concrete products. If you thrive in ambiguity and want visibility with senior leadership, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Define problem statements by embedding with planners to understand planning workflows, then partner with technology teams to design and deliver tooling solutions — including optimization models and capacity planning tools — that improve productivity across the outbound transportation network.
- Analyze supply chain planning data to identify root causes behind performance gaps and propose scalable process or system improvements, with a focus on automating manual processes through AI-driven approaches.
- Lead weekly product update meetings with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders, and prepare monthly and quarterly business reviews to communicate progress, trade-offs, and recommendations.
- Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement technical improvements to reporting and planning mechanisms.
- Develop metrics and monitoring dashboards that enable stakeholders to track planning performance and make informed decisions.

A day in the life
Your work is almost entirely collaborative and roadmap-driven. You might start the morning reviewing capacity planning outputs or optimization model results to refine a problem statement, then meet with planners to validate your findings. After lunch, you could be in a working session with a tech team scoping requirements for a new AI-powered automation tool. Later in the week, you run a product update meeting with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders to share progress and align on priorities. You will also prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews, giving you regular visibility with senior leaders.

About the team
The GTS Planning Products team keeps Amazon's outbound transportation network planning processes current and pushes them forward. We are investing in AI and automation to replace manual workflows with robust, scalable systems. We build solutions for the broader planning organization and partner with carrier teams, tech teams, and operations to integrate these into our planning tools. This role offers growth in the product space — you will build expertise in optimization models, capacity planning, and the latest tooling trends while developing deep knowledge of network planning. Through business reviews and product launch communications, you will gain regular exposure to senior leadership and the chance to shape how Amazon plans transportation at scale.

A significant portion of your time will focus on coaching leadership teams and developing talent to ensure consistent delivery of excellence.

In your role, you'll maintain operational excellence by monitoring service levels, driving accountability, and managing critical escalations to maintain high performance standards. You'll partner with diverse stakeholders to create efficient, scalable solutions that achieve both people and business objectives while identifying and implementing innovative approaches to HR challenges, always with an eye on creating Earth's best place to work.

Crisis management and key decision validation will be crucial components as you address urgent issues impacting the workforce and business operations. jobs.title: Strategic Supply Chain Manager, Lawn & Garden + Tools Supply Chain Team
jobs.description:
Want to shape how millions of customers find the right Lawn & Garden and Tools products on the shelf, at the right time? Amazon is looking for a Supply Chain Manager II to own inventory sourcing strategies and end-to-end supply chain processes for one of our most highly seasonal retail categories. In this role, you will develop operational strategies for strategic vendor cohorts, use data and AI-powered tools to improve how we manage seasonal selection, and partner directly with retail vendors to reinvent their supply chain performance. You will balance tactical execution with strategic planning, designing inventory solutions that address competing priorities while identifying cost savings and reducing waste. Your work will have leadership visibility, and you will regularly present findings and recommendations to Category leaders. If you are a curious, analytical problem-solver who enjoys turning ambiguity into actionable plans, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Identify and deliver end-to-end supply chain improvement opportunities across large cohorts of Lawn & Garden vendors, developing inventory sourcing strategies that meet cost targets and customer availability goals.
- Track and own category metrics such as out-of-stock rate, lead time, and confirmation rate, and present insights and trends to Category Leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews.
- Define operational strategy for select vendors, making trade-offs between suppliers, cost structures, and service levels to optimize profitability and contribute to business growth planning.
- Collaborate with vendor management and product managers on initiatives to improve cost structure, profitability, and supply chain efficiency across the Lawn & Garden business.
- Build trusted relationships with retail vendors and partner on programs to improve inventory health, reduce costs, and deliver a great experience for Amazon customers.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing inventory health dashboards and flagging supply risks across your vendor cohort, then join a working session with Category Management to align on operational strategy for an upcoming seasonal peak. Mid-morning, you could be auditing recent inventory buys to ensure purchase orders are tracking to plan, or working with product managers to refine AI-powered workflows that surface out-of-stock trends. After lunch, you might hop on a call with a retail vendor to walk through their performance data and collaborate on lead-time reductions. Later, you could shift to preparing insights and risk mitigation plans for a Leadership review.

About the team
Our team owns supply chain strategy and sourcing execution for Amazon's Lawn & Garden and Tools business, a highly seasonal category where getting inventory timing right has an outsized impact on the customer experience. We work with some of Amazon's most strategic retail vendors, and our results carry high visibility with senior leadership. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Transformation Advisor), Independent Software Vendor (ISV)
jobs.description:
AWS Canada is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) team, a role at the intersection of technology strategy, business transformation, and customer partnership.

You will own the success of a portfolio of Canadian ISVs navigating multi-year cloud, SaaS, and AI transformation journeys. Your job is to ensure these companies don't just adopt AWS; they build competitive advantage on it. That means helping them migrate critical workloads, accelerate AI and agentic capability adoption, and translate their technology investments into measurable business outcomes.

In this role you are connecting ISV customers to the right AWS expertise, programs, and teams at the right time, and holding the thread across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Drive Customer Outcomes
- Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
- Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
- Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
- Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
- Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

Orchestrate Across AWS
- Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
- Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
- Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

Lead Strategic Engagements
- Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
- Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
- Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

Manage with Rigor
- Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
- Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
- Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

Raise the Bar Internally
- Challenge conventional thinking and take initiative on customer challenges, bringing new ideas, tools, and mechanisms to problems
- Bring the best of AWS and Amazon to customers, proactively solving problems by connecting them to emerging capabilities, programs, and expertise they may not know exist
- Contribute to repeatable mechanisms and internal enablement, sharing learnings from your customer engagements to help raise the bar for how AWS delivers customer success in Canada.

About the team
You don't need to build cloud infrastructure, but you need to understand it well enough to earn the trust of the engineers who do.

On any given day, you might help a VP/Director of Product at a Canadian SaaS company understand the business case for migrating their core platform to AWS, facilitate an alignment session between an ISV's engineering team and AWS Solutions Architecture, or work with your internal team to unblock a stalled migration that's at risk of missing its go-live milestone.

You'll be working with some of Canada's most innovative software companies at a pivotal moment, when AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, delivered, and monetized. If you thrive in environments where technical depth and clear communication are equally valued, this role is for you.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of IT and/or Management Consulting experience
- 4+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
Preferred qualifications:
- Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner , Worldwide Grocery Stores
jobs.description:
This role supports Whole Foods Market stores, within the Worldwide Grocery Stores organization.

Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. As an HRBP, you will serve as a leader of people and organizational strategy — accelerating business outcomes through diagnosis, development, and execution of integrated solutions.

You will build trusted relationships with leaders and act as the client face of TMS (Team Member Services), interfacing and liaising with Recruiting, Team Member / Team Leader Development, Compensation, Benefits, HRIS, and the Legal organization. You will coach, act as a change agent, and influence critical decisions around talent and organizational design to drive business results while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, government regulations, and statutory requirements.

This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness

Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

Create talent goals and cadence with the Leadership Team, building inclusive talent mechanisms into the organization's rhythm of business

Team Member Relations & Compliance

Consult with and advise organizational leaders and Team Members on TM relations and related issues within assigned client groups

Provide sound policy interpretations and practice decisions; ensure adherence to company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations (including FMLA, ADA, HIPAA, and Leaves of Absence)

Provide assigned client teams and leaders with training, coaching, and guidance to maintain compliance

Serve as a neutral, approachable TMS professional who recognizes and proactively resolves potential people and organizational issues — escalating as appropriate

A day in the life
This is an in-person role. You’ll be on-site in our stores four days per week, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders and Team Members you support — walking the floor and being a familiar, trusted face, not working from behind a desk or screen.
This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will partner with business leaders to develop HR solutions aligned with business objectives, support organizational design initiatives, drive talent strategies, and create mechanisms to assess organizational health. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.
The best HRBPs in our stores are the ones leaders and Team Members know by name — approachable in the aisle and the break room, not just in meetings. Strategy matters, but only when it’s grounded in real understanding of the people doing the work every day.

- 5+ years of HR work within an international, fast-paced, and customer-driven environment experience
- 2+ years of human resources or a mix of equivalent experience
- 2+ years of human resources or equivalent (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, distribution, shipping/logistics, healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing) experience
- Knowledge of local labor law
- Experience in HR within an international, fast-paced and customer-driven environment
- Experience in a call center, distribution center, or manufacturing environment
- Experience supporting hourly employee client group
- Experience with MS Office tools and HR Information Systems

- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting

- Experience supporting or leading employee-focused processes including onboarding, benefits, investigations, training or talent management
- • Willingness to work on-site four days per week, including time on the sales floor

- Experience managing and leading employees

- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising, or experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership

While we began by revolutionizing home WiFi, we aim to create comprehensive solutions that serve both wireless and wired connectivity needs for customers and businesses across the globe.Our cross-functional team, spanning hardware, software, and manufacturing, develops advanced Ethernet switching and gateway products, alongside state of the art security features, to complement our award-winning mesh WiFi systems. As an Amazon company, we combine the best of startup culture with the resources and stability of one of the world's leading technology companies. Our team builds products that customers love - from mesh routers to high-performance wired networking devices - and we're looking for you to join us in shaping the future of the connected home.

Do you have the business savvy and technical background necessary to help establish eero as a key technology provider to Internet Service Providers? If you have a passion for business development and strategy skills – and you enjoy innovation and building relationships – you may be right for the Business Development Manager role at eero.

We’re always looking to improve, and we also recognize there are many ways to lead and partner. We’re looking for a Delivers Results leader with diversity in thought who can add to our team’s skill set by bringing their unique industry knowledge and creativity to our organization. At Amazon, we live our professional lives by the Leadership Principals. When we hire, we look for those who are Amazonian rather than for someone who fits an exact resume mold. To us, diversity in thought and experience is a good thing. We are hiring for attitude and training for skill because we recognize success takes many paths.

In this role you will be responsible for growing the business by closing deals to create new partnerships and leveraging existing distribution partnerships, to enable distribution of our products and services. In many cases, you may be establishing a new relationship between eero and the an ISP, which requires strong sales and self-initiating skills. Within this role, you will be expected to lead the full sales cycle from initial prospecting to contract signature.

Key job responsibilities
- Opens new distribution channels for our products and services which means we are looking to hire someone with strong sales (hunting) background.
- Leads negotiations, working closely with legal, finance, and other cross functional teams. Operates in collaboration with eero’s business development leadership.
- Deal leader who represents our business interests and regularly interacts with senior members of an ISPs product, technology, and marketing teams.
- Ability to travel up to 35%

A day in the life
This a role that is anchored on a combination of driving operational excellence and strategic selling. The candidate will be an individual contributor with advanced ability to move fast, collaborating with product, marketing, finance, legal, and technology teams to drive deals to close.

About the team
eero's ISP Business Development team has responsibility to drive eero device and services revenue globally through various channels. Reporting the the company COO, the eero BD team is a high performing team who works to find creative ways to support customers, get deals done, and innovate.

jobs.title: APJ Customer Success Manager, Supply Chain, Applied AI Solutions Decisions GTM
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own customer success for our Amazon Connect Decisions across Asia-Pacific and Japan. As our customers in APJ scale, we need a single owner who makes sure the customers and partners we land actually succeed, realizing measurable business value, and renewing and growing over time. This role sits between deployment success prior to signature and post-sales success post-signature.

This is a regional, customer-facing role at the center of what happens after a deal is signed. You will work hand in hand with customers and our field and specialist teams across ANZ, ASEAN, India, Japan, and Korea to turn one-time launches into durable, expanding relationships. You will build the mechanisms — health scoring, adoption playbooks, renewal motions, and a voice-of-partner feedback loop — that raise the bar for how we deliver customer outcomes in the region. If you are energized by customer impact, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and motivated by building something new across a diverse set of markets, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the end-to-end deployment and post-launch journey for Amazon Connect Decisions in APJ. Day to day, that means driving adoption and value realization, keeping a close eye on customer health, stepping in early when accounts are at risk, and owning the renewal and retention motion that protects and grows recurring revenue. You will run quarterly business reviews and success reviews directly with partners, and you will be the person who translates what you learn on the ground into improvements our regional go-to-market team can act on.

Specifically, you will:

Drive activation and adoption of launched Connect Customer Decisions across APJ partners and their customers, and run structured onboarding and success plans for new feature launches.

Define and track value-realization milestones for each customer, making sure they reach first value and expansion milestones on time.

Own a regional customer health model that combines usage, sentiment, program, and delivery signals into a single view — and act on it, identifying at-risk accounts early and leading remediation with partners, specialist architects, and service teams.

Own the renewal and retention motion for partner-attached customers, running renewal forecasting, reducing churn, and surfacing expansion and cross-sell opportunities to our partner and field teams.

Coordinate success activities across ANZ, ASEAN, India, Japan, and Korea, adapting to local customer and market differences, and partner with global customer-success owners to adopt shared frameworks and share what works in APJ.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

jobs.title: Product Safety Compliance Manager, Amazon Private Brands-Safety, Sustainability and Compliance (SSC)
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we work to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you want to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Our vision for Private Brand Safety, Sustainability and Compliance (SSC) is to support Amazon's mission of offering the widest selection of safe and compliant products to our customers. We are looking for a smart, hard-working, and creative Product Safety Compliance Manager to join our Global Requirements Team, managing safety and compliance for our Consumables Private Brands (non-food) portfolio: cosmetics and personal care, detergents and cleaning products, formulated household goods, and OTC/drug products.

Key job responsibilities
1. Manage regulatory applicability for CPB consumables: review new and emerging regulations across cosmetics, detergents, formulated goods, and drugs/medical devices, assess impact on Amazon's Private Brands portfolio, and translate requirements into operational processes that close compliance gaps.
2. Lead product safety investigations and manage customer complaints and incidents, working with the audit team on post-market surveillance, corrective actions, and market action recommendations.
3. Respond to labelling queries and own labelling compliance across the portfolio, advising on claims, warnings, ingredient declarations, and market-specific labelling requirements.
4. Partner with business teams on product development questions, providing early compliance input on formulations, claims, and ingredients to keep launches on track.
5. Review product formulations, ingredient lists, Safety Data Sheets, and lab reports, and advise business teams on ingredient restrictions, permissible use levels, and compliance pathways.
6. Manage product notification and registration obligations (e.g. US FDA cosmetics listing under MoCRA, EU CPNP for cosmetics, OTC drug facility and product listings, detergent ingredient disclosure).
7. Provide subject-matter expertise and technical guidance to Legal on regulatory interpretation, upcoming rulemaking, and advocacy.
8. Build scalable, multi-jurisdictional approaches and apply requirements flexibly to support the development of country-specific, regional, and global products.
9. Develop guidance documents for internal teams on formulation, labelling, and packaging compliance.
10. Support vendor onboarding through SDS and formulation review and ingredient inventory management.

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing regulatory intelligence alerts for new or changing consumables regulations across the US and EU, and assessing whether they apply to Amazon's cosmetics, detergent, formulated-goods, and OTC/drug portfolio. You partner with Legal, Product Safety, Vendor Management, and Business teams to turn complex requirements into clear compliance guidance. On a given day you might investigate a customer safety complaint on a personal care product, answer a labelling query on ingredient declarations for a detergent, advise a business team on the compliance of a new formulation in development, review an SDS for a new vendor, or assess an EU Cosmetics Regulation restricted-substance update. You are the go-to consumables compliance expert, balancing technical depth with practical business judgement.

About the team
The Global Requirements Team implements the compliance requirements that enable safe and compliant products for our Private Brands business. This role drives implementation and continuous improvement of safety and compliance procedures for our consumables: cosmetics and personal care, detergents and cleaning products, formulated household goods, and OTC/drug products. You will manage escalations from senior stakeholders and build optimized, scalable processes while maintaining high standards for worldwide compliance.
Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of Product Safety & Compliance Law experience
- Experience working with cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Chemical Engineering, Toxicology, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.
- Working knowledge of US and EU consumables regulatory frameworks, including several of: US FDA cosmetics regulation and MoCRA, California Proposition 65, PFAS regulations, EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, EU Detergents Regulation, CLP (EC) No 1272/2008, and REACH.
- Experience reviewing formulations, ingredient lists, and Safety Data Sheets against ingredient restrictions and labelling requirements.
- Experience interpreting labelling and claims requirements for consumer products and advising business teams on compliant labelling.
- Experience conducting or supporting product safety investigations and managing customer complaints or product incidents.
Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with OTC/drug regulatory frameworks (e.g. US OTC monographs, drug facility and product listing).
- Experience with Canadian, Mexican, and Japanese consumables regulatory frameworks.
- Experience managing multi-jurisdictional compliance programs and harmonizing US federal and state requirements with EU frameworks.
- Experience with food contact material regulations (e.g. FDA 21 CFR, EU 1935/2004).

jobs.title: Sr Real Estate Development Manager
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Real Estate Development Manager to join the Real Estate Development Management (REDM) team within Data Centre Supply Solutions (DCSS) EMEA. Based in London, this role carries responsibility for managing the full lifecycle of data centre developments across EMEA — with assignments spanning the United Kingdom, Ireland, and additional regions as to meet business need.

The REDM function exists because data centre land acquisitions are not simple property transactions. Each development requires complex planning and zoning entitlements navigated through local regulatory frameworks, infrastructure obligations negotiated with statutory authorities, performance bonds managed over multi-year delivery programmes, sustained relationships with Authorities Having Jurisdiction, and coordination across a dozen internal stakeholder teams. Without a Single-Threaded Owner, accountability fragments, decisions drift, costs escalate, and programmes delay.

You will be that owner. You will exercise strategic and commercial judgement across complex, high-value development programmes. You will define and execute strategy with limited guidance, influence outcomes across organisations and geographies, and take end-to-end accountability for the developments assigned to you — from the first introduction of an opportunity through to close-out.

Travel: Regular travel across EMEA

About the Team

The REDM function sits within DCSS EMEA and serves as the Single-Threaded Owner for the development management of all Hybrid, Build-to-Suit (BTS), and Owned Land developments across the region. The team currently manages approximately 60 developments with an aggregated Capital Approval value exceeding $14 billion, spanning 9 regions across EMEA.

The team comprises in-country real estate development professionals positioned across key EMEA markets — including the UK, Germany, Spain, Italy, France, and Ireland — each bringing deep local expertise, regulatory knowledge, and established AHJ relationships in their respective jurisdictions. The function holds a broad and expanding mandate: Single-Threaded Ownership of all Hybrid and BTS development agreements, all Collateral Development Obligations (CDO) and Supporting Public Infrastructure (SPI) on land acquisitions, and all site development permitting from pre-acquisition through to Adoption/Taken-In-Charge (ATIC) and release of securities.

You will join a high-performing, internationally diverse team and work directly with counterparts in Business Development, Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, Construction, Legal, Finance, Environmental, Power, Water, and Public Policy.

The Role

Senior REDMs operate as the development owner — not as a support function, an advisor, or a coordinator. You will be the single point of authority and accountability for every development assigned to you, with the mandate to act on behalf of AWS and the judgement to know when to escalate.

The scope of the role spans three interconnected domains. In practice, you will be working across all three simultaneously:

Development Agreement Management

You will be the STO for Hybrid and BTS development agreements from pre-transaction through to close-out. In the pre-transaction phase, you will provide expert development management input to deal negotiations — shaping the commercial structure, specifications, cost arrangements, risk allocation, and change control provisions that will govern the development. Post-transaction, you will take ownership of delivering against the terms of the agreement: establishing the Development Business Plan, managing costs against approved budgets, managing the counterparty relationship, chairing progress meetings, preparing monthly development reports, and identifying and resolving adverse impacts before they crystallise into programme delay or cost overrun.

You own the budget and the delivery date. You are the only party authorised to instruct change. You exercise commercial judgement daily — on cost challenges, counterparty claims, specification queries, and programme risks — and you are accountable for the outcomes.

Land Development & Permitting

You will lead the entire site development permitting process for land acquisitions in your assigned regions — from the earliest point a land opportunity is introduced, through planning and zoning, CDO/SPI delivery, and onwards to ATIC of completed works and release of securities.

This is where the role demands local expertise. Site development permitting is deeply rooted in local regulation, planning law, and political stakeholder dynamics. It requires you to build and maintain sustained relationships with local planning authorities and government bodies; navigate zoning, planning, and building permit processes with confidence and authority; represent AWS directly before AHJs as the landowner — not through intermediaries; negotiate development obligations, planning agreements, and urban development contracts; and develop permitting and phasing strategies that protect the critical path to capacity delivery.

Your portfolio may include developments across multiple jurisdictions, each with its own regulatory framework. You will be expected to navigate these differences with the adaptability, cultural awareness, and local engagement that the role demands.

Stakeholder Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

The REDM sits at the centre of a complex stakeholder ecosystem. Externally, you will manage counterparties, AHJs, local elected officials, statutory undertakers, community stakeholders, and external consultants. Internally, you will coordinate across Business Development, Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, Construction, Legal, Environmental, Power, Water, and Public Policy to ensure strategic and consistent messaging on development goals and priorities.

You will take the central role in strategy and decision-making on all development matters. You will establish the collaboration model with Design Engineering — where DE defines what the Data Centre requires from the site, and you define how to secure those conditions through local processes. You will maintain Memoranda of Understanding with Pre-Construction on infrastructure categorisation and actively lead escalations through the organisation when alignment is not achieved at working level.

What Success Looks Like

Our incumbent Senior REDMs set the benchmark for this role. Across the team, successful performance is characterised by:

Owning a multi-site portfolio of developments worth hundreds of millions of dollars, managing each as an integrated programme with full commercial and programme accountability.

Building and leading the AHJ engagement strategy in-country — establishing direct, senior-level relationships with planning authorities, meeting regularly with council officers and elected representatives, and being recognised as the AWS voice in the room.

Identifying and surfacing material cost savings against approved investment decisions through rigorous analysis of development agreements and obligations.

Leading complex permitting processes end-to-end — including zoning modifications, full planning applications, environmental assessment processes, and planning obligation negotiations.

Establishing the REDM function from the ground up in a new country or region, becoming the coordination hub for the entire development portfolio in that geography.

Developing and owning urban development contracts, inter-administrative agreements, and territorial agreements with municipalities and regional governments.

Driving strategic permitting pathway decisions at critical gates — evaluating alternative routes, recommending approaches, and managing risk where the regulatory environment is uncertain or contested.

Protecting capacity delivery by identifying and mitigating development risks proactively — including regulatory challenge risk, AHJ capacity constraints, design misalignment, and third-party dependencies.

Contributing to the evolution of the REDM function through development of tools, mechanisms, and reporting frameworks that raise the standard across the team.

A day in the life
Infrastructure Services (AIS) AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, AWS

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, management, real estate, or another related field
- 10+ years of progressive experience in real estate development management, infrastructure programme delivery, or development-stage asset management.
- Demonstrable experience as a development manager or equivalent role with end-to-end accountability for programme delivery, cost control, and counterparty or contractor management on complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
- Experience engaging with planning authorities, local government bodies, and regulatory agencies in connection with building permits, zoning, and development consents.
- Experience negotiating and administering commercial development agreements (BTS, forward fund, development agreement, or equivalent structures) including provisions for work scope, cost control, change control, and risk allocation.
- Experience managing development cost plans and budgets at significant scale, with the judgement to challenge costs, exercise audit rights, and protect commercial interests.
- Willingness to travel regularly across EMEA and comply with the 5-day return-to-office policy in London.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience building and cultivating relationships with internal and external stakeholders
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of data centers or critical infrastructure or large-scale mechanical and electrical plants
- Master's degree in a relevant discipline (Real Estate, MBA, Construction Law, Urban Planning, or equivalent) and professional qualification: RICS (MRICS or FRICS), CIOB, RIBA, RTPI, or equivalent.
- Multi-country EMEA experience navigating diverse regulatory frameworks, planning regimes, and cultural contexts.
- Experience with UK and/or Irish planning processes, including planning obligation agreements, environmental assessment, and engagement with local and national planning authorities and Experience with GMP, fixed-price, and open-book development cost structures.
- Experience managing development obligations, urbanisation works, and performance bond or security management over multi-year delivery programmes.
- Fluency in one or more additional European languages (French, German, Italian, or Spanish).
