jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner , Worldwide Grocery Stores
jobs.description:
This role supports Whole Foods Market stores, within the Worldwide Grocery Stores organization.

Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. As an HRBP, you will serve as a leader of people and organizational strategy — accelerating business outcomes through diagnosis, development, and execution of integrated solutions.

You will build trusted relationships with leaders and act as the client face of TMS (Team Member Services), interfacing and liaising with Recruiting, Team Member / Team Leader Development, Compensation, Benefits, HRIS, and the Legal organization. You will coach, act as a change agent, and influence critical decisions around talent and organizational design to drive business results while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, government regulations, and statutory requirements.

This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness

Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

Create talent goals and cadence with the Leadership Team, building inclusive talent mechanisms into the organization's rhythm of business

Team Member Relations & Compliance

Consult with and advise organizational leaders and Team Members on TM relations and related issues within assigned client groups

Provide sound policy interpretations and practice decisions; ensure adherence to company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations (including FMLA, ADA, HIPAA, and Leaves of Absence)

Provide assigned client teams and leaders with training, coaching, and guidance to maintain compliance

Serve as a neutral, approachable TMS professional who recognizes and proactively resolves potential people and organizational issues — escalating as appropriate

A day in the life
This is an in-person role. You’ll be on-site in our stores four days per week, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders and Team Members you support — walking the floor and being a familiar, trusted face, not working from behind a desk or screen.
This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will partner with business leaders to develop HR solutions aligned with business objectives, support organizational design initiatives, drive talent strategies, and create mechanisms to assess organizational health. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.
The best HRBPs in our stores are the ones leaders and Team Members know by name — approachable in the aisle and the break room, not just in meetings. Strategy matters, but only when it’s grounded in real understanding of the people doing the work every day.

jobs.description:
The CM, Forecast and Planning serves as the manufacturing and financial backbone of the Global Manufacturing and Distribution Services organization. This role ensures every production investment is translated into measurable business outcomes. The CM, Forecast and Planning owns financial modeling, resource investment prioritization, and long-range operational planning, while establishing the standardized methodologies the organization uses to measure enablement and return on investment. This individual provides executive visibility into performance against innovation commitments and savings targets, ensuring leadership has real-time clarity on where the organization is delivering, where it is at risk, and where to allocate next.

Key job responsibilities
Financial Modeling & Forecasting: Build, maintain, and continuously refine financial models that project savings delivery, cost avoidance, and investment returns across all pillars within Global Manufacturing and Distribution Services.
Resource Investment Prioritization: Develop and manage frameworks for evaluating and prioritizing resource allocation (finances, time, materials) across competing initiatives, ensuring capital and headcount are directed toward the highest-value opportunities.
Long-Range Operational Planning: Lead annual and multi-year planning cycles, partnering with pillar leaders to build bottoms-up forecasts, set targets, and align operational roadmaps with organizational strategy.
Performance Measurement & Reporting: Establish standardized methodologies for tracking enablement, ROI, and cost reduction performance. Create and maintain executive dashboards and reporting cadences that provide leadership with consistent, actionable visibility.
Transformation Program Tracking: Monitor and report on the status of transformation initiatives across the organization, flagging schedule risks, budget variances, and dependency conflicts to leadership with recommended corrective actions.
Business Case Development: Partner with pillar leaders and sourcing managers to build business cases for new investments, headcount requests, and strategic initiatives, ensuring financial rigor and alignment with organizational priorities.
Variance Analysis & Risk Management: Conduct regular variance analysis against plan, identifying root causes for over/under-performance and developing mitigation strategies to protect savings commitments.
Executive Communication: Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly business reviews, savings readouts, and investment performance summaries for senior leadership (Director/VP level), translating complex financial data into clear narratives.
Process Standardization: Drive consistency in how financial performance is measured and communicated across all seven pillars, replacing ad-hoc reporting with scalable, repeatable processes.

If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.
****************************
AWS Canada est à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de la réussite client (CSM) pour se joindre à notre équipe Éditeurs de logiciels indépendants (ISV), un poste à l'intersection de la stratégie technologique, de la transformation des affaires et du partenariat client.

Vous serez responsable du succès d'un portefeuille d'ISV canadiens engagés dans des parcours de transformation pluriannuels en infonuagique, SaaS et intelligence artificielle. Votre rôle consiste à vous assurer que ces entreprises ne se contentent pas d'adopter AWS, mais qu'elles y bâtissent un avantage concurrentiel. Cela signifie les aider à migrer leurs charges de travail critiques, à accélérer l'adoption de l'IA et des capacités agentiques, et à traduire leurs investissements technologiques en résultats d'affaires mesurables.

Dans ce rôle, vous mettez en relation les clients ISV avec l'expertise, les programmes et les équipes AWS appropriés, au bon moment, tout en assurant la cohérence au sein d'environnements complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes.

Si vous excellez là où la profondeur technique et la stratégie d'affaires se croisent, et que vous souhaitez que votre travail ait un impact visible et durable sur la croissance des entreprises de logiciels les plus innovantes du Canada, ce poste est pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
Drive Customer Outcomes
- Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
- Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
- Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
- Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
- Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

Orchestrate Across AWS
- Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
- Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
- Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

Lead Strategic Engagements
- Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
- Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
- Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

Manage with Rigor
- Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
- Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
- Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

Raise the Bar Internally
- Challenge conventional thinking and take initiative on customer challenges, bringing new ideas, tools, and mechanisms to problems
- Bring the best of AWS and Amazon to customers, proactively solving problems by connecting them to emerging capabilities, programs, and expertise they may not know exist
- Contribute to repeatable mechanisms and internal enablement, sharing learnings from your customer engagements to help raise the bar for how AWS delivers customer success in Canada.
*****************************
Générer des résultats pour les clients
- Assumer la responsabilité du succès d'un portefeuille de comptes ISV, en travaillant à rebours des jalons stratégiques de chaque client pour définir et exécuter un parcours clair vers la réalisation de la valeur
- Diriger des séances d'alignement entre la feuille de route et les résultats, des séances d'information pour les dirigeants et des jalons de mise en service qui accélèrent le parcours infonuagique et d'IA de chaque client
- Aider les ISV à mettre en place la gouvernance, les modèles opérationnels et l'infrastructure de données nécessaires pour soutenir une transformation à long terme, et non simplement atteindre des objectifs à court terme
- Accompagner les clients dans l'adoption de l'IA générative et des capacités agentiques qui transforment la façon dont les logiciels sont conçus, livrés et monétisés

Orchestrer au sein d'AWS
- Servir de lien entre les clients ISV et les équipes AWS (ventes, architecture de solutions, soutien, services professionnels et équipes partenaires) afin d'assurer un engagement coordonné et de haute qualité
- Contribuer à la planification des comptes en traduisant les objectifs stratégiques en actions exécutables avec une responsabilité et des échéanciers clairs
- Identifier et éliminer les obstacles systémiques qui ralentissent la progression des clients, en procédant à des escalades avec précision et urgence lorsque nécessaire

Diriger des engagements stratégiques
- Diriger des engagements de niveau directeur, des ateliers de co-innovation et des séances de planification stratégique avec les équipes de direction en produit, ingénierie et technologie au sein des comptes ISV
- Aider à traduire des solutions complexes d'IA et d'infonuagique en analyses de rentabilité pour les parties prenantes de la haute direction, en comblant l'écart entre les équipes techniques et les décideurs exécutifs
- Accompagner les clients lors de points de décision critiques : séquencement de la migration des charges de travail, stratégie d'adoption de l'IA, évolution de l'architecture SaaS

Gérer avec rigueur

About the team

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager, BD, MKT
jobs.description:
Amazon Global Selling helps businesses launch globally, reach Amazon's customers, and build international brands. Since entering China in 2015, we have supported hundreds of thousands of Chinese sellers in selling across 19 Amazon overseas marketplaces, reaching hundreds of millions of active customers worldwide, including over 200 million Prime members.

The Business Development team under Amazon's Asia Global Selling Marketing organization is seeking a results-oriented Senior Customer Success Manager to own the Nurturing and Online Community program centrally. This role does not sit on the frontline - it sits above it. You will own the end-to-end prospects and leads hunting and nurturing process design, tooling, AI innovation, and online community operations that enable BD's field teams and Marketing's digital engine to convert prospects into qualified leads at scale. You are the bridge between field-sourced intelligence and scalable digital engagement, responsible for making the system work, not for working each prospect individually.

The ideal candidate combines deep customer obsession with strong program management capability and genuine curiosity about AI-enabled engagement at scale. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments, and you bring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution - designing scalable hunting and nurturing solutions from 0 to 1 while diving deep into conversion data to optimize every stage of the prospect-to-lead funnel. You must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to communicate complex analytical results clearly to diverse audiences.

Key job responsibilities

1. Own the end-to-end prospect hunting and nurturing process: design, optimize, and govern the full lifecycle from first-contact capture through lead qualification, ensuring consistent execution across all BD regions.
2. Drive AI-first nurturing innovation - partner with Online MKT and Lifecycle teams to deploy and continuously improve automated engagement flows (e.g., Maven, WeCom/SCRM automation), define human-escalation trigger logic, and raise Prospect-to-Lead conversion rates system-wide.
3. Own the company's online prospect community operations: establish taxonomy, segmentation, engagement strategy, and success metrics, transforming it from an unstructured contact pool into a scalable, measurable digital asset.
4. Build and maintain nurturing performance dashboards by channel, region, and prospect profile; identify funnel bottlenecks and design interventions that the field teams and automation programs execute.
5. Translate frontline intelligence from BD's field activities into scalable nurturing content, AI knowledge-base improvements, and refined scoring models that blend digital and offline signals.
6. Drive cross-functional alignment with Online MKT, Field MKT, Lifecycle, and BD regional teams on shared prospect pools, unified attribution, and bi-directional data flow.

About the team
Business Development team under the AGS Marketing organization.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience with CRM tools and systems that can be leveraged to drive customer engagement - including but not limited to Adobe, Salesforce, Unica, Marketo, Exact Target, Braze, etc.
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in SQL Server/MySQL
- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising, or experience in customer acquisition
- Experience creating processes and improving tools that have measurably improved productivity, quality, or advertiser experience

- Experience with online content, multimedia, analytics and impact measurements

jobs.title: AWS Support Business Development Manager, ANZ Enterprise Support, Enterprise Support, ANZ
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS Enterprise Support includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design build operate and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Enterprise Support and our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners AWS Sovereign Cloud AWS International Product and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You'll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

AWS Enterprise Support customers rely on us when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform and our Technical Account Managers (TAMs) and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises Public Sector companies as well as fast growing businesses and internet companies. Unlike most support organizations AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

As Premium Support BDM you will be part of the Enterprise Support organization. Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. Organizational Effectiveness

Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

Create talent goals and cadence with the Leadership Team, building inclusive talent mechanisms into the organization's rhythm of business

This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will partner with business leaders to develop HR solutions aligned with business objectives, support organizational design initiatives, drive talent strategies, and create mechanisms to assess organizational health. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive , North America, Fulfilled By Merchant Business Development
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a dynamic and motivated Senior Account Executive for our Selling Partner Services team (sell.amazon.com), supporting the North America Fulfilled by Merchant (FBM) organization. This role is chartered with building and managing a pipeline of high-value seller accounts and executing consultative sales and account management strategies that deliver results against bold growth goals.

You will own the full engagement lifecycle for strategic sellers who fulfill orders from their own warehouses, helping them adopt Amazon's automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment solutions. The core of the work is diagnostic and solutions-focused: analyzing a seller's shipping and delivery performance, identifying the gaps that slow their delivery promises, and guiding them to changes that shorten click-to-delivery times, protect their account health, and unlock incremental sales.

Success in this role means building trusted relationships with key decision-makers inside seller organizations, partnering with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams (product, tech, and program), and translating seller pain points into compelling, data-backed recommendations. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving space and act as a voice of the seller back into Amazon.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of successful B2B sales or account management experience, preferably in e-commerce, logistics, retail technology, supply chain, or SaaS. Demonstrated success exceeding targets through a consultative, data-driven approach is required, and experience selling nascent products or services into new markets is a strong plus. Candidates must have excellent communication and presentation skills, be comfortable working with data in Excel to build a narrative, thrive in ambiguity, and bring a genuine passion for continuous improvement through collaboration. A bachelor's degree is required.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive a portfolio of high-value seller accounts end to end, from identification and outreach through adoption and launch, consistently surpassing ambitious revenue and adoption targets.
- Influence senior decision-makers within seller organizations, establishing yourself as the strategic authority on fulfillment and delivery performance.
- Diagnose complex shipping and delivery gaps through rigorous data analysis, uncovering root causes that others miss.
- Architect and sell tailored solutions using automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment, tying every recommendation to measurable business impact such as faster delivery promises, stronger account health, and incremental sales.
- Lead cross-functional partners across product, tech, and program to break down barriers and accelerate results.
- Champion the voice of the seller, surfacing recurring pain points and opportunities to shape product and program roadmaps.
- Own pipeline accuracy and forecasting in Salesforce, using data to prioritize effort and report on results.
- Operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, and continuously refine your approach through experimentation and collaboration.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, and that's by design. You own your book of business, so where you invest your time is a strategic decision, not a checklist.

You might open the day inside a seller's shipping data, spotting a pattern in their delivery promises that's quietly costing them sales, then shaping that insight into a recommendation they can't ignore. By midday you're leading a consultative conversation with senior seller leadership, reframing how they think about fulfillment and earning their commitment to change.

In the afternoon you partner with a product team to escalate a pain point you've diagnosed across multiple accounts, influencing the roadmap with evidence, not opinion. Throughout, you're deciding where to go deep and where to move on.

You thrive in ambiguity, make judgment calls without a playbook, and are measured not by activity, but by the outcomes you drive and the trust you build.

About the team
We are the North America Strategic MFN (Merchant Fulfilled Network) team, part of Selling Partner Services. We partner with sellers who fulfill orders from their own warehouses, helping them use Amazon's automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment solutions to deliver faster, protect their account health, and grow their business.

We work in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where the playbook is still being written, which means the ideas you bring genuinely shape how the program evolves. We value diverse perspectives, learning through experimentation, and supporting each other. We take our work seriously, and we take care of each other while we do it.

If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/

About Us:

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role:

The Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) supports the ongoing success of creators across the Twitch Partner program and plays a vital role in bringing new creators into the ecosystem. This role spans Creator Recruitment, Account Management, and Community Engagement, requiring a balance of analytical thinking and relationship management skills.

The role will work from Madrid, Spain and report into the Director of Global Spanish Partnerships.

You Will:

Creator Recruitment
- Identify, evaluate, and reach out to high-potential creators who are new to Twitch or transitioning to livestreaming
- Guide creators through structured onboarding covering analytics, audience development, channel setup, and monetization fundamentals, support.
- Conduct stream reviews and support test-streaming to ensure smooth creator starts
- Maintain visibility in emerging creator communities across platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, etc.

Partner Touchpoints & Account Management
- Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of Twitch Partners
- Provide timely, high-quality support and guidance on Twitch products, policies, and best practices
- Maintain accurate documentation of creator interactions and portfolio data in Salesforce
- Collect and log partner feedback to inform product development and messaging
- Community Management & Events (15% of time)
- Support planning and execution of IRL events to deepen creator relationships
- Maintain active presence in Partner community spaces (e.g., Discord)
- Represent Twitch at creator community moments as a brand ambassador
- Document creator insights and event outcomes

Administrative & Strategic Tasks
- Generate and maintain reports on creator performance and engagement
- Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities within creator portfolio
- Participate in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
- Support development of scalable solutions for creator needs

Team Collaboration
- Work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and other teams
- Participate in regular team meetings and planning sessions
- Share insights and best practices with broader partnerships team
- Contribute to process improvements and team initiatives

Success Metrics
- Creator recruitment and onboarding targets
- Partner retention and satisfaction rates
- Response time and quality of support
- Event participation and outcomes
- Documentation quality and timeliness
- Cross-functional collaboration effectiveness

Perks
- Private Medical Insurance
- Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
- Pension Plan
- Maternity & Parental Leave
- Paid Time Off & Holidays
- Commuter Benefits
- Amazon Employee Discount

About the team
The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.
Basic qualifications:
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years of experience in client/partner management, content acquisition, or related fields
- Demonstrated experience in relationship management and business development
- Strong analytical and communication skills
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in digital media, gaming, or creator economy
- Knowledge of content creation platforms and livestreaming industry
- Experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)
- Project management experience
- Additional language skills relevant to the region

jobs.title: Global Supply Chain & Procurement Manager, AWS Infrastructure and Supply Chain - Energy Storage, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement (ISCaP) organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

We are seeking a Hardware Commodity Specialist to join a team that handles one of Amazon’s fastest growing commodities – Battery Backup Units (BBUs). In this role, the candidate will manage procurement and related operational supply chain activities in close collaboration with both internal and external cross functional teams. These are critical for AWS to achieve continuity of supply and cost goals.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of Seattle, WA, USA.

Key job responsibilities

The successful candidate must be a self-starter and have ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Candidates must have excellent analytical capabilities, supply chain experience. Candidate should be comfortable with diving deep into data sources to debug data related issues, and have strong writing skills.

The ideal candidate will not only raise the bar on delivering the right supply at the right time, but also is a person who actively participates with a strong curiosity to understand the business end-to-end, and has a track record of using data to influence decision makers.

In this role you will:

Understand forecasting, demand planning, material planning, and manufacturing processes to verify supply commitments

Work with internal and external stakeholders to forecast battery demand and manage supply positioning globally to support last mile operations

Own capacity planning with key OEMs and optimize supply chain network to best deliver for customers.

Work with various analytics and software development teams to drive operational excellence

Develop analytical tools and dashboards to track metrics, monitor SLAs, and report findings

Drive EOL management, collaborate with engineering, DC operations and finance to ensure cross-functional alignment on supply, product roadmap and budget requirements
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- 3+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- 3+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
- 3+ years of working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT. experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in online advertising or high-tech products/services
- Experience scaling a publisher monetization product or service
- Knowledge of battery industry / market

jobs.title: Procurement Manager, Data Centers, Data Center Sourcing & Procurement
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Amazon is seeking a motivated and data-driven category manager to support the Americas data center construction space. The candidate should have strong supply chain and procurement skills, engineering design, architecture, construction, analytical and financial acumen , and passion to dive-deep. Additionally, candidate must have proven skills in managing large-scale supply chain and procurement improvement projects.
As a Procurement Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for at least one services category and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to drive efficiencies, reduce risks, and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. You will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category.
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You will be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you will be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines, succeed in a fast-paced environment; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit.
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
· Proven experience driving large-scale process improvements resulting in measurable value
· High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
· Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
· Demonstrated ability to influence teams to adopt change utilizing smart technologies
· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where ambiguity exists and continuous innovation is desired
· Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
· Demonstrated analytical, financial and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
· Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; general manager / owner mentality
· Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the competitive landscape
· Ability to see ahead comprehensively and devise a strong plan of action, and ensure execution happens on time, every time
· Ability to get things done and produce conclusive, measurable results within time commitments
· Strong influencing skills

A day in the life

As a Procurement Manager on the Data Center Construction Procurement team, you will own the end-to-end commercial relationship with General Contractors (GCs) delivering AWS data centers. No two days look the same — you might be negotiating a Guaranteed Maximum Price in the morning, reviewing schedule recovery options with a project team at midday, and evaluating GC proposals for a new campus RFP by close of business.

Day to day you will:

Drive competitive sourcing events — develop RFP strategies, evaluate contractor qualifications, and lead award recommendations for some of the largest construction programs in the industry.
Negotiate and manage contracts — structure contract amendments, negotiate change orders, and hold GCs accountable to cost, schedule, and safety commitments.
Partner cross-functionally — work alongside Construction, Design, Legal, Finance, and Program Management to remove blockers, align on delivery milestones, and ensure data center capacity comes online on time.
Analyze cost and risk — benchmark GC pricing, identify cost-savings opportunities, and flag commercial risks before they become schedule impacts.
Influence at scale — develop procurement playbooks, contract standards, and lessons-learned that raise the bar across AWS's global data center portfolio.
You will support projects across multiple regions and have the opportunity to shape how AWS procures and delivers data center construction — locally and globally.

About AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — in other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support every data center and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that give our customers continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, construction professionals, security experts, and operations managers. You'll collaborate across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

jobs.title: Global Partner Manager, LCSA, Large Client Sales, Ads
jobs.description:
Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers and agencies. Our ad solutions, including video, display, device ads, audio and custom ads, leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage target audiences throughout their day. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a strong focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Amazon Ads is seeking an Account Executive to join our Acquisition team within our Large Customer Sales organization. This is an exciting opportunity to support our rapidly growing Streaming TV and Video business and will be focused on activating and growing net-new Advertisers. As an Account Executive working within a business development team, you will use your experience selling TV/Video and digital advertising solutions to advertisers and their Ad Agencies to successfully grow and scale advertising revenues. You will utilize your client-side and agency relationships within the advertising space, employ a consultative approach and have deep understanding of the TV and digital advertising landscape.

Successful candidates will be results-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, have the ability to quickly understand client objectives and tailor the positioning of Amazon Ads' branding solutions accordingly. Motivated to learn new technical skills, candidates pride themselves on operational excellence, including tracking inputs, sales progress and pipeline, as well as regularly reviewing their performance to improve their outreach, engagement, and deal rate. Strong candidates will be eager to learn and develop themselves, have experience in high-volume, transactional sales, and a hunger to uncover opportunities at scale and connect them with value-adding solutions.

Key job responsibilities
• The Account Executive generates advertising revenue via Ad agencies and advertisers directly, through objective led selling across video solutions and other brand-building advertising solutions.
• Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities, aligning them with our value-adding solutions
• Influence buying decisions to drive increased revenue with focus on new revenue streams.
• Establishes credible relationships with agencies and advertiser decision makers, in particular in the TV and Digital landscape.
• Map account strategies, aligning resources and uncovering which of our digital, audio, video and device products best serves an advertiser’s needs
Basic qualifications:
- Experience in building client and agency relationships
- Experience in Media Buying or Selling (Connected TV, TV, Video Products and Strategies)
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Thrive in fast paced dynamic environment, be adept at dealing with ambiguity and have good communication and presentation skills.
- Bachelor / Master’s degree or equivalent experience in the industry
Preferred qualifications:
- Relationships within the media industry across publishers, clients and agencies

jobs.title: Cloud Economics Senior Business Development Manager, AWS SCE Cloud Economics
jobs.description:
As a Cloud Economics Business Development Manager, you will quantify the cost and value benefits of running applications on AWS. You will build board-ready migration business cases, shape customers' IT financial models, and engage directly with C-level executives, Finance leaders, and IT architects to accelerate cloud adoption.

You will partner with AWS sales teams on strategic customer engagements, identify economic barriers to adoption, and develop strategies to overcome them. You will deepen your expertise in data center economics, legacy environment cost modeling, and consultative selling, while directly influencing how large enterprises in ASEAN think about their cloud investments.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a key member of the Cloud Economics team in APJC, helping to drive sales engagements with our customers in one of our most important markets
- Work with AWS Sales and Specialist AWS functions to help quantify the economics of running IT applications in the cloud versus a traditional data center environment
- Act as a central resource for the Sales team to help our customers create financial models for their current and future IT landscape
- Build case studies and reusable examples that scale Cloud Economics learnings across AWS
- Be a resource for market insights into how our customers view the economic benefit of using AWS relative to deploying applications on-premise or in traditional data centers
- Prepare and present business cases to senior leaders, explaining the value of migrating to AWS

About the team
The AWS Cloud Economics team helps customers identify and quantify value creation opportunities at each stage of their journey to the cloud. We engage directly and collaboratively with customers, partners and internal AWS teams to deliver cloud value advisory expertise, business value case development, and Cloud Financial Management best practices and methodologies. The Cloud Economics team can help answer the customer question: “What value can I expect to achieve by using AWS?”

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, AU Mass Vendor Recruitment (MVR)
jobs.description:
Amazon’s Retail team, located in Sydney, is looking for a Business Development Manager with a passion for identifying, onboarding, and launching new supplier opportunities. Working at the centre of the Amazon flywheel, you will be responsible for utilising data to identify the selection gaps that are most important to customers across multiple categories, initiating and developing strong relationships with suppliers who can provide this selection, and then account managing these suppliers to ensure a successful launch and ongoing growth.

The ideal candidate will have experience developing and growing supplier relationships with a proven track record of exceeding sales goals. While this role will be primarily external facing for new supplier recruitment, the Business Development Manager will also be required to work with cross-functional internal teams to identify opportunities and best practices within areas such as category, customer marketing, product set-up, supply chain, and advertising to devise the right onboarding and launch plans for new suppliers. To succeed in this environment, the ideal candidate will have a high degree of ownership, be eager to learn, and autonomously identify the right solutions for their suppliers.

Our retail team operates out of our fabulous CBD office conveniently located near many transportation options. As of 2025, Amazon has implemented a 5-day in office work model requiring full-time office presence.

Amazon offers employees in the retail team a competitive remuneration package, including participation in the company stock plan as applicable. We also look after our people with benefits, such as subsidised private health insurance, superannuation and paid parental leave options, amongst others.

Key job responsibilities
- Understand market trends across multiple categories to identify the most relevant selection for customers
- Own new supplier recruitment including end-to-end sales cycle from prospecting to account management post launch
- Own C-suite level negotiations that enable the onboarding of new suppliers
- Educate new suppliers on Amazon’s tools and systems to enable them to become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory, and performance
- Achieve business and financial objectives to drive growth of Amazon’s Retail business
- Identify opportunities to improve the Retail business for suppliers through scalable solutions and manage the roll-out of these solutions
- Work closely with category, marketing, supply, product, and other key internal Amazon stakeholders
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree, or 3+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of retail, operations, product or program management, or business management/consulting with negotiations and delivering results experience
- 3+ years of with Excel experience
- Experience with financial analysis and P&L ownership
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
- Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Supply Chain, Merch on Demand
jobs.description:
Merch on Demand is Amazon's print-on-demand business, enabling customers to purchase custom-printed products including apparel, drinkware, phone cases, jerseys, backpacks, PopSockets, and more; that are produced and fulfilled on demand within Amazon's fulfillment network. The Head of Merch on Demand Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for the end-to-end supply chain strategy and execution for this business. This leader sets the long-term vision for how Merch on Demand sources materials, develops and scales new print technologies, maintains best-in-class product quality, and delivers orders to customers faster and more cost-effectively.

Key job responsibilities
This role owns the global sourcing strategy for all raw materials, blanks, inks, and components used across the Merch on Demand product catalog. The leader drives R&D efforts to identify, test, and scale new print methods, substrates, and product formats that expand the Merch on Demand offering. They are responsible for quality assurance and quality control programs across the network, reducing defect rates and improving the end-to-end customer experience. The role owns production throughput and shipping speed performance, identifying and removing bottlenecks to deliver orders to customers faster. This includes defining the strategy for current and next-generation print technologies (Direct-To-Garment, Direct-Film-Transfer, sublimation, UV, etc.), ensuring the network operates on the most efficient and highest-quality methods available. The leader drives capacity planning and network design, including site selection, capacity expansion, and geographic optimization to support growth and improve delivery speed. They partner with technology teams to develop and deploy fulfillment systems, automation, and tooling that improve operational efficiency and scalability. Across all of these areas, this role drives supply chain innovation, building a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

A day in the life
• Review daily production metrics across the Merch on Demand network, including DPMO (defects per million opportunities), throughput per hour, SLA performance, and shipping speed to identify trends and areas requiring immediate action.
• Lead a weekly business review with sourcing, quality, production, and fulfillment technology teams to assess performance against goals and align on priorities.
• Evaluate a new blank supplier proposal, comparing cost, quality samples, and lead times against current vendors to determine whether to proceed with a pilot.
• Meet with the R&D team to review test results from a new print method trial, assess quality and cost implications, and decide whether to scale to additional sites.
• Partner with the network planning team to model capacity scenarios for an upcoming product launch, determining how to allocate volume across sites to meet demand while optimizing shipping speed and cost.
• Dive deep into a quality excursion at a specific site, reviewing defect data, root cause analysis, and corrective actions with the quality team.
• Join a working session with the fulfillment technology team to review the roadmap for automation investments, prioritizing projects based on expected throughput improvement and ROI.
• Conduct a monthly innovation review, where teams present new ideas and experiments across print methods, materials, packaging, and process improvements.
• Align with finance on variable cost performance and improvement plans, reviewing cost per unit trends and identifying levers to drive further savings.
• Meet with transportation and logistics partners to review shipping cost and speed performance, exploring opportunities to improve delivery promises through network placement or carrier strategy.

You are a leader, builder, and operator. You have experience leading or contributing to multiple simultaneous product development efforts and/or projects and initiatives. You’ll strive for simplicity and will demonstrate significant creativity.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Specialist, Observability & Security, AWS Specialist and Partner Organization
jobs.description:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

At AWS, Security has always been "job zero" - security is not just the top priority, it comes before everything else. At the same time, full-stack observability is critical for customers running modern applications at scale: the insights delivered by AWS's observability solutions help teams detect, investigate, and remediate problems faster, and, coupled with AI and ML, proactively predict and prevent them. These two disciplines are converging. Security observability, threat detection through telemetry, and AI-driven operations all require unified visibility across metrics, traces, logs, and security signals. In the era of GenAI, customers need solutions that bridge both domains to enable secure innovation, protect sensitive data, achieve operational excellence, and maintain compliance with evolving global regulations.

The Principal Customer Success Specialist, Observability & Security is an individual contributor role within the AWS Specialists & Partners (ASP) Customer Success Center of Excellence (CSCOE). This role serves as a senior technical advisor and thought leader who shapes the forward-looking strategy for customer post-sale journeys across both observability and security, encompassing adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term value realization. You will guide customers through the technical, operational, and organizational dimensions of implementing successful observability and security practices across their cloud environments, including AI and GenAI workloads.

In this role, you will personally engage and build deep relationships across relevant customer personas in our largest and most strategic enterprise accounts. You will be deeply technical across both observability and security solutions, spanning commercial, open-source, and AWS-native tooling, while effectively shaping customer journeys and raising the bar for the broader team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on enterprise experience with observability and security platforms and modern DevSecOps practices, and will be passionate about helping customers achieve operationally excellent, secure, compliant, and trustworthy environments.

This role is deeply cross-functional, engaging with AWS teams across Sales, Solutions Architecture, AWS Product teams, and Marketing, working at the CxO level at customers to maximize their observability and security investments. You will define customer success strategy, create playbooks and scalable frameworks that combine strategic thinking with operational excellence and technical depth. You will work closely with the Observability & Security Service and GTM teams, as well as Partners and Professional Services, to support and amplify service adoption plays through direct and partner-led engagements and by enabling the broader AWS Field to leverage best practices you establish.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Vision & Convergence Thought Leadership

- Define and communicate the strategic vision for how observability and security converge within the Customer Success practice, serving as the organization's subject-matter authority on this intersection

- Develop adoption frameworks that span the full maturity spectrum: from foundational monitoring and security posture assessment through advanced AIOps implementations, ML-powered anomaly detection, and automated security remediation workflows

- Author and maintain cross-domain playbooks that leverage the intersection of observability and security, such as using observability telemetry signals for security incident response and forensics or applying security context to intelligently prioritize operational alerts

- Lead the practice's approach to securing AI and ML workloads, incorporating observability-informed security practices and threat modeling specific to GenAI applications, data pipelines, and model inference environments
Strategic Customer Engagement

- Personally own a portfolio of the most complex, high-value enterprise accounts, operating as the primary senior technical advisor for customers navigating the convergence of observability and security

- Engage at the CxO level on strategically important accounts, providing executive advisory that connects observability and security investments directly to customer business objectives, risk posture, and competitive advantage

- Design and deliver customer success programs that address the full spectrum, from helping customers establish foundational security posture and observability baselines, to driving advanced multi-domain outcomes such as unified incident detection, automated remediation, and compliance-as-code

- Build and sustain strategic partnerships with AWS Service teams, Security GTM, Observability/CloudOps GTM, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, and AWS Partner teams to deliver coordinated, customer-centric outcomes across the full lifecycle
Adoption Program Development & Scaled Impact

- Create and maintain comprehensive best practices documentation, implementation guides, and training materials applicable across both observability and security service domains, ensuring materials reflect the latest AWS service capabilities and field-learned insights

- Define and own metrics frameworks to track the adoption effectiveness of programs you design, identifying leading indicators of customer health and lagging signals of adoption risk; iterate program design based on data-driven insights

- Develop and deliver scaled enablement programs including 1:Many webinars, technical persona circles, field enablement sessions, and digital-first content strategies that extend impact beyond high-touch engagement models

- Mentor and enable peers and junior team members through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and co-delivery on complex engagements
Customer Success Execution

- Define and implement customer health scoring models and dashboards that capture both observability and security maturity signals, providing a unified, actionable view of customer risk, health, and expansion opportunity

- Execute proactive risk identification, triage, and intervention processes that address adoption barriers, executive disengagement, or service underutilization before they escalate into churn or contraction risks

- Drive customer advocacy through structured success story documentation, executive case study development, and participation in AWS advocacy programs, amplifying proven outcomes across both domains to accelerate adoption in the broader customer base

- Consistently deliver and document measurable business value for customers, maintaining a strong proof-of-value motion that supports account retention, expansion conversations, and executive relationship health
Product Feedback & Influence

- Establish systematic processes for capturing customer feedback, pain points, and feature requests, and for communicating these insights to GTM teams, product organizations, and AWS service teams for both observability and security portfolios

- Analyze patterns and trends across your customer portfolio to identify systemic product gaps, adoption friction points, or unmet needs that represent high-impact product improvement opportunities

- Represent customer needs at the executive level with AWS service teams, leveraging data-backed insights to influence product roadmaps and prioritization across the AWS Observability and Security service portfolios

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Basic qualifications:

- 10+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles, including customer success, solutions architecture, technical account management, consulting, or equivalent, with demonstrated hands-on depth in observability, security, or both
- 5+ years of experience directly advising enterprise customers (Fortune 500 or equivalent) on cloud adoption, security posture, or observability strategy, with a track record of measurable customer outcomes
- Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale adoption programs for cloud services, including development and execution of adoption plays, health scoring models, and scaled enablement programs
- Proven track record of executive-level (CxO) engagement, including the ability to translate complex technical and operational challenges into strategic business recommendations that resonate with senior decision-makers
- Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across cross-functional teams (product, engineering, GTM, field sales) to drive customer-centric outcomes
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience writing technical articles, speaking at technology conferences, and contributing to open source
- AWS certification, such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, or a similar cloud certification, or CISSP-ISSAP / CISSP-ISSEP
- Experience that spans both observability and security domains, with demonstrated ability to advise customers and influence organizational strategy at the intersection of both disciplines
- Background building and scaling post-sale motions, including the design of engagement models, tiering frameworks, playbooks, and operational frameworks from the ground up

Amazon Customs & Trade (ACT) stands at a pivotal inflection point. After years of building world-class customs brokerage services, ACT is now expanding beyond serving internal Amazon customers to become a revenue-generating external business.

As the leader of ACT Business Development, you will scale the sales engine behind ACT's external revenue growth and diversification of new services. You will lead a team of established Account Executives, and the organization’s pricing, marketing, and other commercialization opportunities. Your immediate focus will be converting customers who need best-in-class customs brokerage services, and building and developing a team of experts.

This role requires senior leadership capability to run and scale a business development function in a resource-constrained, high-ambiguity environment. The role demands equal strategic thinking, ability to achieve growth targets, and cross-organizational influence. The role’s scope includes defining an external revenue plan, the pricing and marketing functions, commercialization of services, and direct leadership of a team of 6+ individuals. The role requires complex stakeholder management across multiple Amazon organizations, and the maturity to balance frugality with investment decisions that will shape ACT's external business trajectory.

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape a high-growth business within Amazon's logistics organization.

Drive New Business Acquisition

- Own the external revenue plan, delivering against goals that you will define and metricize across various lines of businesses and services

Strategic Partnership Development

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager, InfraOps Planning & Sourcing
jobs.description:
Every time someone streams a movie, runs a machine learning model, or spins up a server — that's powered by physical hardware in an AWS data center. When that hardware breaks, someone needs to make sure the right replacement part is already there, ready to go. That someone is you.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) Supply Chain manages the end-to-end supply chain for server racks, frontier outposts, networking, and power and cooling equipment across AWS data centers worldwide. We deliver capacity based on new technology — when and where it's needed — while maintaining a fair, equitable, safe, and sustainable approach to sourcing.

We're looking for a Supply Chain Manager who can think beyond day-to-day order management and take ownership of how we keep an entire region stocked, balanced, and ready. This isn't a "check the box and pass it along" role — you'll be the person who sees patterns across hundreds of sites, figures out why something keeps going wrong, and builds the fix.

Key job responsibilities
- Keep the region healthy. Monitor hardware availability across the Americas, identify root causes when things go wrong, and build action plans that fix problems at their source.

- Balance the network. Analyze inventory positions and demand trends across sites. When one location has too much and another too little, you drive the rebalancing.

- Own delivery performance. You'll track whether parts are arriving on time, dig into exceptions, and work with logistics partners to improve delivery windows and carrier compliance.

- Manage inventory accuracy. You'll ensure what's in the system matches what's on the shelf — monitoring storage locations, cycle counts, and material flows between warehouses and data centers.

- Bring new sites online. When we open a new data center, you'll own the spares readiness plan — making sure the right parts are in place before the first server goes live.

- Drive improvement projects. You'll lead initiatives that make our planning processes smarter, faster, and more automated. If you see something broken, you own fixing it.

- Communicate to leadership. Translate complex supply chain data into clear recommendations for senior leaders — influencing where we invest and how we prioritize.

A day in the life
You start by checking regional health — are parts flowing on time? Any stockouts building? From there, you might jump on a call with logistics to work a delivery issue, coordinate an inventory move between sites, or dig into a trend where the same component keeps running short. Some days you're managing an escalation; others you're leading a process improvement project. You'll also partner with engineering on automation ideas or mentor teammates on complex inventory problems. No two days look the same, but you're always making the system smarter.

About the team
Our mission is simple: make sure AWS data centers never run out of the parts they need to stay online. We're a tight-knit group of planners who each own a region and partner with logistics, operations, and procurement daily. Your customers are the data center technicians who rely on you to have the right part ready when hardware fails — and your success means millions of AWS customers experience zero disruption. We move fast, we're data-driven, and we give each other autonomy. If you like solving puzzles, building better systems, and seeing direct impact, you'll fit right in.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- 4+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization, including coaching of junior staff
- Experience measuring key operational metrics (e.g., order cycle time, ship estimate accuracy, on-time and complete shipment, inventory record defect rate)
Preferred qualifications:

- Experience in program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process

jobs.title: Business Dev Manager, Global Seller Supply Chain - PMO
jobs.description:
Amazon Global Selling helps individuals and businesses increase sales and reach new customers around the globe. The Global Selling team in China is responsible for recruiting local businesses to sell on Amazon's 21 overseas marketplaces and supporting their success and growth. Our vision is to be the first choice for all types of Chinese businesses going global.

We are seeking a motivated, results-driven Business Development Manager to join the Global Seller Supply Chain team, focusing on overseas warehouse service providers. The overseas warehouse segment has experienced rapid growth in recent years, serving both FBA inbound and MFN fulfillment use cases with strong seller demand. This is a great opportunity to build a new business area from the ground up, shaping how overseas warehousing becomes a core part of Amazon's logistics ecosystem. In this role, you will identify, vet, and manage overseas warehouse service providers, build industry and seller insights, and drive integration of solutions developed by global teams to deliver a seamless fulfillment experience for sellers.

Key job responsibilities
1. Develop deep understanding of the overseas warehouse industry landscape, including key players, competitive dynamics, and emerging trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations for product and business teams
2. Identify, evaluate, and onboard overseas warehouse service providers, establishing partnerships and clear collaboration frameworks aligned with Amazon's requirements
3. Understand seller and business needs through data analysis and direct engagement, and provide regular feedback to global teams to inform solution development and prioritization
4. Drive integration of Amazon logistics solutions with overseas warehouse service providers, ensuring smooth onboarding, technical readiness, and operational alignment
5. Track and manage service provider performance against defined metrics, driving continuous improvement and accountability
6. Deliver clear communications and business updates to senior leadership
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in business development, partner management, or logistics/supply chain roles
- Experience identifying, evaluating, and managing external service providers or partners
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize industry data into business insights
- Excellent oral and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working in multinational or foreign companies with exposure to global business environments
