jobs.title: Sr. Manager Tech Biz Dev, Creative Services and AI Solutions, Amazon Ads
jobs.description:
Lead strategic partnerships and drive transformative growth at Amazon Ads. As an AI Tech BD Sr. Manager, you will join the leadership team to focus on leading strategic deals, partnerships, and go-to-market strategies for the Creative X (CrX) and Retail Ad Service (RAS) organizations.

We’re building a new category of creative intelligence at Amazon Ads. Our team combines generative AI capabilities with advertiser-centric design to simplify complex creative workflows and deliver measurable impact across the full marketing funnel. We serve advertisers of all sizes—from emerging brands to global enterprises—helping them create, optimize, and scale creative content across Amazon's advertising surfaces.

Our vision is to make personalized, high-performing creative a foundational layer of how advertising works, not an add-on feature. We’re positioned at the intersection of Amazon’s richest commerce signals and the largest advertising surfaces on the internet.

Within Creative X and Retail Ad Service, you will serve as the primary advocate for our largest customers—agencies, advertisers, and global partners—ensuring they maximize the value of our generative AI solutions for creative production, personalization, and optimization, while also developing and executing high-impact partnerships with third-party retailers. You’ll collaborate with internal stakeholders across Sales, Partner Development, GTM, Creative Services, Product, and Product Marketing to drive usage, enhance the customer experience, and accelerate product development. Additionally, you’ll identify, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships with AI technology providers to bring new capabilities to our customers. This role demands a strategic mindset, deep expertise in AI-infused creative tools, and a passion for building long-term client relationships.

Key job responsibilities
Directly manage Tech BD members across both Creative X and Retail Ad Service to execute strategic partnerships and achieve business goals for each organization.

Own the executive relationships with strategically important customer and partner companies in the sector; institute regular mechanisms to cultivate trust and drive alignment with Amazon’s priorities. Provide executive sponsorship when needed for other BD efforts and act as the executive escalation management resource for Amazon leaders.

Build, orchestrate, and execute a GTM plan for forging and developing client relationships, driving adoption of both CrX and RAS solutions, as well as enabling product development based on customer requirements.

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, product/feature adoption, and ongoing success with CrX and RAS products.

End-to-end deal experience: structuring and negotiating complex partnership agreements such as advertising deals, complex digital media transactions, and strategic ad technology relationships.

Strong financial acumen with the ability to analyze income, balance sheet and cash flow statements. Can construct an operating P&L, model deals, and articulate cost/benefit analyses to key stakeholders.

Originate, execute, and manage partnerships to help accelerate product development and add new capabilities.

Partner with Account Executives and Partner Development Managers to drive customer engagement and identify growth opportunities.

Solicit voice-of-customer and synthesize feedback in digestible formats for use by internal partners in Product and Product Marketing.

Manage cross-functional stakeholder relationships, acting as the bridge between customers and internal constituents

A day in the life
Your day will blend strategic leadership with hands-on partnership management, driving high-impact deals and shaping the future of Amazon Ads. You’ll review customer feedback from recent campaigns, identify opportunities to enhance our generative AI solutions, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to align on a joint roadmap. You’ll negotiate multi-year partnership agreements with AI technology providers, balancing technical capabilities with business impact, and lead cross-functional sessions to refine go-to-market strategies for new Retail Ad Service features. Throughout the day, you’ll act as the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless onboarding, product adoption, and ongoing success while driving innovation through strategic insights and data-driven decisions.

About the team
We are the Creative X and Retail Ad Service (RAS) team at Amazon Ads—driving the adoption of generative AI solutions and externalizing Amazon’s advertising technology to third-party retailers. Our mission is to transform how advertisers create, personalize, and optimize campaigns through AI, while building strategic partnerships that accelerate product development and market growth.

You’ll work alongside sales, product, partner development, and engineering teams, ensuring our largest customers—agencies, advertisers, and retailers—maximize the value of Amazon’s AI-powered tools. We value innovation, collaboration, and a passion for solving complex problems in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 12+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- 10+ years of building and leading large teams and working in matrixed operating structures experience
- Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent
- Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent
- Experience negotiating VP-level contracts with channel partners and agencies
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
- Experience managing and developing high performance teams
Preferred qualifications:

- Master's degree or equivalent

jobs.description:

This person will have the exciting opportunity to deliver on a strategy to enable broad use of Amazon Services by Manufacturers and Exporters in India wishing to sell globally, and play a key role in influencing product selection on global Amazon marketplaces/websites. jobs.title: Sr. Business Development Manager, Storage (Data Foundations), WWSO Data APJC
jobs.description:
Are you a storage expert who can build and scale the go-to-market for one of AWS's highest-growth portfolios across Australia and New Zealand? Do you have the technical depth in cloud storage, data transfer, and migration, combined with business development instincts to drive our largest, most complex migration deals and build the motions that scale wins across the region? Do you love building strategic, data-driven businesses and helping customers get their data foundations ready for the AI era? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Data & AI team as a Sr. Business Development Manager for Storage, based in Sydney and focused on data foundations across ANZ.

This role builds and scales the AWS storage go-to-market across ANZ, owning the strategy and execution that helps customers modernise their data foundations to be ready for AI and agentic workloads. Storage is the foundation of every large migration and every AI workload from training data, model artifacts, inference pipelines, and the data lakes that power analytics. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it. You will be across all the top migration deals in ANZ ensuring storage is scoped, sized, and funded from day one, spanning S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, Backup, DataSync, Transfer Family, Snow Family, and Storage Gateway, and the networking and data transfer (DTO) that makes large migrations possible. You are accountable for the growth of the ANZ storage business. You will also be the voice of ANZ back to the service team, carrying customer needs to our storage service teams to help reshape service and roadmap strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- GTM for storage and data foundations across ANZ — strategy, messaging, positioning, and campaigns across all segments
- Be across all the top deals — ensure storage is scoped, sized, and funded from day one; own storage sizing, data transfer planning (DTO), and migration sequencing on the largest, most complex opportunities
- Drive storage pipeline and revenue — activate growth levers including workload placement, data migration, tiering optimisation, and AI-driven consumption
- Build scalable GTM motions — playbooks, ROI models, and partner enablement that multiply impact beyond one-to-one deals
- Drive the "storage as the foundation for AI" narrative
- Be the voice of ANZ to the storage service teams, feeding customer needs and competitive gaps back to product leadership

A day in the life
One morning you're modelling the data transfer economics for a large enterprise migration across Direct Connect and DataSync; midday you're in a CxO briefing positioning S3 as the data lake foundation for an AI initiative and making sure storage is funded in the deal. The afternoon you're building a partner-led storage assessment motion with an SI, reviewing migration pipeline with the ANZ area team, and feeding a feature gap back to the WW Storage service team. You operate across ANZ and every segment, building the strategy and executing it.

About the team
The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. We are technology specialists. This role sits on the APJ Data GTM team as the ANZ storage and data-foundations lead, working as an integrated unit with the Database and Analytics teams, account teams, Specialist SAs, and partner teams. Storage is one of the fastest-growing domains in our data portfolio driven by AI consumption, data lake expansion, and large migrations and it can never be an afterthought in a data or AI deal. We value individuals who combine deep technical knowledge with GTM business acumen: people who can size a multi-petabyte migration AND build the business case that funds it. If you thrive where you build the strategy and execute it, this is the role for you.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
- Deep technical knowledge of cloud storage services (object storage, block storage, file systems, backup, archival) and their application across enterprise workloads.
- Experience in data transfer and migration, understanding of network connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN), data transfer services, and DTO cost modelling for large-scale migrations.
- Track record of driving multi-million-dollar pipeline and influencing complex, multi-service deals involving storage as a core component.
- Experience working with large enterprise customers at CxO/VP level, articulating the business value of storage modernisation and data migration.
Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Experience with consumer brand experience design and an understanding of storytelling
- Experience across the full "large data deal" stack including storage + networking + data transfer + migration planning, able to model end-to-end data economics for customers
- Track record building scalable GTM motions, playbooks, ROI tools, partner enablement
- Experience working across APJ geo
- Familiarity with partner-led motions (SI engagement, MDF, co-sell)
- AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Storage or Networking Specialty) preferred

jobs.title: Senior Global Partner Business Development Manager, Partner Programs
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) customers are transforming and reinventing their businesses with AI and AWS partners are helping to dramatically accelerate that innovation, with more than 100k Partners in more than 150 countries. As AI reshapes how customers build, deploy, and scale on AWS, the partner ecosystem is evolving rapidly to meet new demands for specialized capabilities and cloud-native expertise.

The AWS Partner Organization is looking for a Partner Business Development Manager to drive the strategy and execution for market-leading Programs designed to differentiate highly skilled, trusted AWS Partners in this era of rapid technological transformation.

This role is responsible for end-to-end strategy and execution of our key differentiation program; AWS Specialization Program. This includes ownership of program governance, partner enablement, operational mechanisms, and cross-functional coordination to ensure the program is running effectively and delivering value to partners and customers in a rapidly evolving AI-driven landscape. This individual owns holding a high bar for program quality, managing competing internal priorities, and driving continuous improvement across the portfolio — including identifying how AI and automation can be leveraged to scale programs and improve the partner experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end program execution for AWS Specialization Programs — manage program governance, lead the launch roadmap, develop new benefits, and drive partner portfolio growth,

- Solve complex business challenges through programmatic solutions; partner with technical, marketing, systems, and field stakeholders on program design and requirements. Build strong relationships across partner development, field, and technical teams — define roadmap priorities, deliver actionable insights, and drive outcomes through others by equipping teams with the tools, data, and context to execute scalable solutions

- Define, track, and report on program metrics across weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews; own goal-setting, performance reporting, and stakeholder communications cadence

- Identify and drive operational excellence improvements based on business strategy, customer/partner behavior, and emerging technology trends

A day in the life
This role has a global responsibility and will work closely with delivery teams, specialist teams, partner development managers, solution architects, our partners, and our sales teams.

Shape the future: Define and evolve program strategy to stay ahead of market shifts — including how AI, cloud-native, and emerging technologies change what "specialized" means for partners.

Manage competing priorities: Balance requests from Specialization owners, field teams, and leadership while maintaining program quality and timelines.

Drive alignment globally: Work across regional teams, product, and engineering to ensure programs are consistent, scalable, and responsive to local market needs.

Measure and iterate: Define success metrics, track program outcomes, and continuously refine the strategic direction based on what drives real partner and customer impact.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. jobs.description:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for shaping how software, data, and AI-powered solutions are discovered, purchased, and deployed at scale? Do you have the technical depth, AWS Marketplace fluency, and partner ecosystem experience to influence product direction and drive feature adoption across a global community of sellers and buyers? Join the AWS Marketplace Business Development team to help define and launch the next generation of Marketplace capabilities.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are hiring a Sr. Technical Business Development Manager to serve as the connective tissue between our seller and buyer ecosystem — including ISVs, channel partners, and consulting partners — and the AWS Marketplace product and engineering teams. You will own the full lifecycle of feature development and adoption, from early-stage validation through launch and beyond, and serve as an external ambassador for Marketplace at partner conferences, industry events, and community forums.

This is not a traditional sales or business development role. You will operate with the rigor of a product manager and the external credibility of a seasoned partner advocate, driving alignment across engineering, product, field sales, legal, and tax teams to ensure that what we build resonates with the market and achieves measurable adoption.

Key job responsibilities
Feature Validation and Voice of the Customer
- Design and run structured feedback programs — including beta programs, pilot launches, and advisory councils — with ISVs, channel partners, consulting partners, and buyers to validate early-stage Marketplace feature concepts.

- Represent seller and buyer voice in product reviews and engineering discussions, synthesizing findings into clear recommendations for product and engineering leadership.

- Build scalable mechanisms to continuously collect and route partner and customer feedback to the right product and engineering teams.
Go-to-Market Launch Ownership
- Own go-to-market strategy and execution for Marketplace feature launches, including enablement materials, partner communications, and field readiness programs across software, services, data, and AI agent solutions.

- Track post-launch adoption metrics and develop remediation plans where adoption falls short; close the loop with product and engineering teams with structured findings.

- Leverage AI productivity tools to scale partner outreach, synthesize feedback signals, and accelerate the development of launch content and enablement materials.
Marketplace Evangelism and Community Engagement
- Represent AWS Marketplace at partner conferences, industry events, and community forums as a credible advocate for Marketplace capabilities across the full range of software, data, services, and AI agent offerings.

- Develop and deliver presentations, demos, and thought leadership content for audiences ranging from technical practitioners to C-suite executives.

- Build a network of engaged advocates and early adopters who can support beta programs and provide ongoing product feedback.
Partner and Field Engagement
- Build and manage senior-level relationships with ISVs, channel partners, consulting partners, and key buyers to drive feature adoption and surface new product opportunities.

- Collaborate with field sales, partner management, and alliance teams to co-develop go-to-market motions and accelerate Marketplace adoption within key accounts and segments.

- Identify and pursue business development opportunities that emerge from product launches, market trends, or gaps in the current Marketplace seller and buyer experience.

A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might spend your morning in a product review, presenting beta feedback from software vendors and consulting partners and recommending roadmap adjustments. By midday, you are briefing a partner executive on a feature launching next quarter — a new transaction model, an AI agent listing capability, or a channel program update. In the afternoon, you are on stage at a partner conference representing Marketplace to hundreds of vendors and service providers. You close the day tracking adoption signals and routing friction patterns back to the product team. This role rewards curiosity and comfort with ambiguity in equal measure.

About the team
AWS Marketplace is a curated digital catalog where companies find, buy, deploy, and manage third-party software, services, data, and AI agent solutions to run their businesses — serving everyone from fast-growing startups to the world's largest enterprises. The team you will join is focused on making sure that what Marketplace builds actually works for the people who use it. You will work alongside product managers, engineers, field sellers, and a broad partner ecosystem — acting as the voice of the market internally and the voice of Marketplace externally. Our mission is to make AWS Marketplace the preferred destination for discovering and deploying solutions at scale, and the preferred channel for software vendors, service providers, and data sellers to reach AWS customers.

jobs.description:
As the APJ DevOps and Observability Partner Category Lead, you will own and drive the end-to-end DevOps and Observability technology partner strategy across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region. The ideal candidate will have direct sales and/or ISV/Technology Partner experience, as well as deep familiarity with the Observability and DevOps technology landscape (infrastructure monitoring, log analytics, AIOps, cloud-native observability), cloud platform economics, and enterprise partner development. The candidate will have strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple customer personas and successfully align executive stakeholders with differing goals. Amazon's fast-scaling Worldwide Retail, Growth and Development (WWRGD) Grocery business is looking for a Senior Category Manager to join the team. In this role, you will drive category-level procurement strategy for the WWRGD Grocery business, with direct ownership of financial performance, supplier partnerships, and total cost of ownership. Your scope will span Grocery FFE, building systems, design and construction contractors, consultants, and materials.

As a Senior Category Manager (Program Manager III), you will be a high-impact individual contributor at the center of WWRGD's growth engine, executing multi-category programs that directly support Amazon's ambition to scale from ~560 to 1,700+ grocery locations. You will:

- Drive end-to-end category management across Grocery retail and industrial FFE, building systems, design consulting, and construction materials and services.
- Own supplier negotiations, business plans, and savings realization for assigned categories — managing for total cost of ownership, lead time, sustainability and supply chain resilience.
- Drive cross-functional alignment with key partners — building trust and shared ownership around category strategy and business outcomes.
- Work at the intersection of procurement and merchandising strategy, CapEx investment, and customer and associate experience.
Join a team navigating ambitious growth with a mission to scale and senior leadership visibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle for assigned procurement categories — from strategy execution through supplier performance and continuous improvement.
- Set category-level strategic direction that optimizes for long-term cost, quality, supply continuity, and customer outcomes.
- Conduct financial analysis of business opportunities; drive initiatives to meet and exceed financial goals, including CapEx investment and category P&L accountability.
- Initiate, structure, and negotiate partnerships with new and existing suppliers; develop business plans for new opportunities and execute project plans for pilots, launches, and long-term operations.
- Act as the business owner for assigned categories, accountable for identifying and driving realization of savings opportunities.
- Manage supplier relationships and performance; serve as the primary business contact for key suppliers.
- Build and streamline processes that simplify operations and drive continual improvement.
- Analyze industry trends and evolving technology to proactively identify supply base opportunities that reduce cost, minimize risk, protect continuity of supply, and support sustainability.
- Drive cross-functional alignment with key partners — building trust and shared ownership around category strategy and business outcomes.

A day in the life
On any given day, you might be modeling total cost of ownership for a new equipment specification, aligning with Design and Construction partners on a category sourcing timeline, or leading a supplier negotiation to secure lead time commitments ahead of a pipeline milestone.

You'll engage regularly across Indirect Procurement, Operational Excellence, Merchandising, and site-level buying teams — translating business requirements into procurement decisions that move with speed and confidence. The problems you'll solve range from supply disruption and cost pressure to building procurement mechanisms that scale across multiple retail formats and geographies.

About the team
Our mission is to deliver best-in-class category leadership across the WWRGD value chain, driving cost optimization, scalability, speed to market, and supplier excellence through innovative strategies, deep industry expertise and collaborative partnership. As WWRGD scales grocery development, our team ensures supply chain resilience through procurement capabilities that support ambitious growth targets while maintaining cost discipline and operational efficiency. jobs.title: Principal Talent Management, Amazon Talent & Compensation
jobs.description:
The Principal, Product Manager in Talent Management is a senior individual contributor who designs, leads, and scales enterprise-wide talent management strategies and programs. This role operates with significant autonomy in highly ambiguous environments, driving talent management initiatives across multiple business units or geographies. The Principal serves as a recognized subject-matter expert and trusted advisor to senior leaders (Director and VP level), shaping the talent agenda and influencing long-term workforce strategy.

Come Build How Amazon Grows Its Best People

Amazon doesn't just hire great talent — we obsess over how to develop, retain, and grow it. Our Talent Management team builds the programs, systems, and strategies that shape the employee experience for over 1.5 million people worldwide. This is where people science meets product thinking at a scale no other company can match.

We're looking for a Principal who thinks like a product leader and operates like a program owner. Someone who can take a complex, cross-functional challenge — spanning product, UX, engineering, and analytics — and turn it into a launched experience with clear strategy, measurable outcomes, and executive-level visibility. You'll own end-to-end product management and design for talent programs, writing docs, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and presenting to PXT leadership monthly. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write one.

Key job responsibilities
• Enterprise Talent Strategy: Design and own the end-to-end talent management strategy for the enterprise, including talent evaluation, high-potential identification and retention, performance management, and AI-enhanced talent experiences.

• Product Ownership & Delivery: Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for talent management programs. Write strategy docs, engage UX/Design/Analytics/Engineering partners, and drive cross-functional teams to ship at scale — without direct authority over those teams.

• Executive Communication: Present product launches and program updates to PXT LT and executives monthly. Translate complex technical and programmatic work into crisp narratives for senior leadership.

• Organizational Health & Insights: Leverage data and analytics to diagnose organizational health trends, identify talent risks, and develop proactive interventions. Translate complex talent data into actionable insights for senior leadership.

• Talent Evaluation & Calibration: Design talent evaluation and calibration processes, ensuring consistency, fairness, and alignment with role guidelines and leadership principles.

• Growth & Development: Architect and implement scalable growth & development programs that accelerate the growth of high-value talent and address capability gaps across the organization.

• AI Transformation: Drive experimentation and adoption of AI-powered talent experiences, partnering closely with engineering and technical teams to bring innovation from concept to production.

• Mechanisms & Scalability: Create scalable mechanisms, tools, and frameworks that raise the bar on talent management practices and can be adopted broadly across the company.

A day in the life
You'll own the full lifecycle of products and programs that have considerable impact across multiple Amazon organizations. That means defining the mission and vision, writing strategy documents, aligning with senior leaders, building go-to-market and change management plans, and driving execution across UX, Design, Analytics, and Program Management teams that don't report to you.

You'll develop KPI frameworks that give leadership real visibility into performance, and you'll use data to tell the story of what's working and where to push harder.

You'll be the connective tissue between product, design, technical, and business teams — identifying gaps before they become failures, sourcing and coordinating resources across organizations, and proactively mitigating risks that others haven't spotted yet. When a problem is ambiguous, you'll define it. When a path forward isn't clear, you'll build one.

About the team
The Compensation & Talent team is a newly formed organization within PXT that brings together talent evaluation, performance management, and compensation under one leader. Our mission is to accelerate and advance how Amazon identifies and rewards its people — uniting the full cycle of talent assessment and compensation into a streamlined, end-to-end experience. We own compensation product, tech, and program management, as well as talent management design, program, and policy work.

You'll operate at the intersection of people strategy and technology, working on initiatives that directly influence how Amazon identifies, develops, and retains talent at unprecedented scale. The stakeholders are senior, the problems are genuinely hard, and the work ships to an audience of hundreds of thousands.
Basic qualifications:
- 8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- 10+ years of progressive experience in talent management, organizational development, HR business partnership, or a related field
- Demonstrates experience designing and implementing enterprise-wide talent management programs (e.g., talent evaluation, performance management, growth & development)
- Experience advising and influencing senior leaders (Director level and above) on talent strategy and organizational health
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and voice of the customer to drive talent decisions and measure program effectiveness
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or advanced certification in a relevant discipline (e.g., MBA, M.S. in I/O Psychology, SHRM-SCP, or equivalent)
- Experience with performance management systems, competency frameworks, and assessment methodologies
- Demonstrated ability to manage through influence rather than authority, building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups

jobs.title: 2027 MBA Leadership Development Program (MLDP) Full-Time
jobs.description:
Build What's Next: From MBA to Enterprise Leader

What if your first role after business school gave you full P&L ownership, executive sponsorship, and a mandate to build, not just manage, across Amazon's largest consumer business? Amazon's MBA Leadership Development Program (MLDP) is a three-year accelerated leadership experience designed to develop the next generation of enterprise leaders within North America Stores.

This isn't a rotational program in the traditional sense. It's a builder's path - one that develops commercial judgment, product thinking, and cross-functional influence through progressively complex business ownership. You'll make decisions that impact hundreds of millions of customers, work directly with senior leaders, and help shape how Amazon Stores operates in an AI-first world.

THE MLDP EXPERIENCE
Amazon Stores is becoming an AI-first organization, and the leaders who will shape its future aren't just operators. They're builders. MLDP is an accelerated leadership pipeline that develops product-minded enterprise leaders who can run businesses while simultaneously reinventing how Amazon serves customers.

Over three years, you'll rotate through strategic leadership roles spanning:
- Business Ownership: Own a category P&L end-to-end - driving vendor strategy, negotiating multi-million-dollar deals, and making pricing, selection, and profitability decisions that directly impact the customer experience.
- Product: Define product roadmaps, launch customer-facing experiences, and develop the leadership influence required to drive outcomes without direct authority.
- Operations: Own buying strategies, optimize supply chain performance, and align cross-functional operations with Amazon's long-term objectives.

MLDP is more than rotations. It's Enterprise Challenges sponsored by VPs, executive mentorship, cohort-based development, and the opportunity to build AI-enabled capabilities and operating mechanisms that create lasting value across Amazon Stores. After your first year, you'll receive dedicated rotation support including career planning, interview preparation, networking, and insights from program alumni.

Key job responsibilities
MLDP seeks builders - leaders with product-minded curiosity, analytical judgment, learning agility, and a long-term orientation toward creating something better. You thrive in ambiguity, ask the right questions, influence across organizations, and see AI as a strategic advantage, not just a productivity tool. You want P&L accountability, founder-level ownership, and a clear path to enterprise leadership at scale.

About the team

- Start Date: July 19, 2027
- Location: Seattle, WA (participants must relocate to Seattle by program start; relocation assistance is provided)
- Placement: Team placement based on business needs. We are looking for candidates who want to own, build, and impact the customer experience rather than those tied to a specific role or team.
Join us in shaping the future of retail while developing into a next-generation business leader at one of the world's most customer-centric companies.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Sales Leader, Growth team
jobs.description:
The Demand Generation (DG) team focuses on identifying and acquiring new customers, accelerating the growth of existing customers, building and progressing high-quality pipeline toward customer outcomes, and developing a talent flywheel that contributes to scaling diverse early career professionals across the AWS Global Sales organisation.
As a Demand Generation leader, you will lead a team of Demand Generation Representatives (DGRs) in identifying, engaging, and acquiring new customers through various prospecting motions in partnership with a complex, cross-functional team of sales leaders, marketing professionals, technical specialists, and Partners. You will exercise ownership in support of strategic efforts to accelerate customer adoption of AWS services, penetrate new markets and verticals, while educating and building trust with internal stakeholders such as field and inside sellers and executive leaders to deliver results for the business. This role is a core part of the AWS Frontline Sales Management (FLM) community, contributing directly to the field sales leadership ecosystem where you will provide in-depth sales coaching and mentoring to your team of early career professionals to help them exceed quarterly KPIs and goals, build sales acumen and leadership skills, and ultimately guide them in their career growth within the AWS Global Sales organisation. You will shape how your team engages customers across the sales cycle, coaching team members to take ownership of customer outcomes rather than activity alone.

Key job responsibilities
● Lead, coach, and develop a team of Demand Generation Representatives responsible for identifying and acquiring new customers through effective outbound and inbound prospecting, scheduling customer meetings, and generating qualified opportunities for Field Sales progression.
● Manage team to performance KPIs and goals including outbound calls, meetings scheduled, opportunity creation ($ and # warm-hand off and closed-won), and marketing lead (MQL) follow-up.
● Be the trusted advisor and voice of Demand Generation within the FLM sales leadership team, engaging regional/segment sales leaders and cross-functional teams through monthly business reviews, QBRs, and cross-functional roundtables.
● Identify internal and external challenges and build scalable mechanisms that drive solutions and impact for your immediate team as well as your extended stakeholder organisation.
● Partner with Marketing, Partner Sales, Solution Architects, FLM peers, and Operations teams to align demand generation efforts with broader business objectives and drive customer outcomes end-to-end.
● Attract, hire, onboard, and retain top talent. Build a strong talent bench through deliberate succession planning, internal development pathways, and proactive pipelining of future candidates to ensure team continuity and readiness for growth.
● Leverage AI-powered tooling to drive team efficiency, enabling reps to focus on high-propensity customer engagement over manual administrative tasks.

About the team
The Demand Generation team sits within the Cloud Sales Center (CSC) and operates as the tip-of-the-spear for AWS customer acquisition and growth. DGRs perform customer outreach through calls, emails, and messages to generate qualified opportunities which are handed off to Cloud Sales Reps (CSRs) and Account Managers (AMs) to nurture and progress to revenue. The function develops early-career sales talent through a structured graduate and intern program, with clear progression paths to Senior DGR, CSR, and Account Manager roles.
DG Managers are frontline sales Managers (FLMs) responsible for team performance, talent development, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence. They work closely with APJ and Area Leadership to implement regional strategy, drive operational planning initiatives, and build mechanisms that scale across the organisation. As part of the broader FLM sales team, DG Managers participate in shared leadership development, cross-functional sales cadences, and contribute to the collective field sales strategy.
Basic qualifications:
- 7+ years of technology related sales, business development or equivalent experience
- Experience meeting revenue targets and quotas
- Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, and web-based meeting applications
- Experience hiring and growing top talent
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
- ● 3+ years of people management experience; managing teams of 5 or more
Preferred qualifications:
- ● Experience in B2B Cloud, SaaS, or enterprise technology sales environments
- ● Experience leading teams through sales cycle progression beyond initial qualification, including opportunity advancement and customer conversion
- ● Experience developing and executing multi-modal, targeted prospecting campaigns
- ● Familiarity with marketing-to-sales lead flow processes (MQL to SQL, SQL to SQO)
- ● Experience with sales engagement tools (e.g., Boost, Outreach) and prospecting platforms (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
- ● Experience with opportunity qualification frameworks (e.g., BANT, MEDDPICC)
- ● Familiarity with AI/ML-powered sales tools, signal-based prospecting, or agentic workflow platforms
- ● Track record of developing talent pipelines and progressing individual contributors into expanded sales roles

jobs.title: Principal Business Development Tech, APAC, Prime Video Ads
jobs.description:
Amazon Publisher Monetization（APM）は、Amazonが運営するストリーミングサービス（Prime Videoを含む）において、ブランドがオーディエンスにリーチするための広告ソリューションを開発・提供する組織です。Prime Video Adsは、映画・ドラマシリーズ・ライブスポーツ・オリジナル作品といったプレミアムかつブランドセーフなストリーミングTV広告枠を提供し、全世界で数億人の月間視聴者にリーチしています。広告事業が国内外で急速に拡大する中、アジア太平洋地域におけるストリーミングTV広告の未来を描く戦略リーダーチームの構築を進めています。

本ポジションでは、APAC地域（日本、オーストラリア/ニュージーランド、インド）におけるPrime Video Adsの広告事業成長戦略を一気通貫で担うPrincipalレベルのBusiness Development - Technologyリーダーを募集します。APAC地域の広告需要に対する戦略的ゼネラルマネージャーとして、新規広告主セグメント・新規市場への拡大を推進しながら、Prime Videoの収益成長を牽引します。新規ビジネス機会の発掘、既存広告チャネルのスケール拡大、複数年にわたる戦略策定の推進、そしてSales、Product、Finance、Marketingの各チームと連携したプロダクト戦略・プライシング・Go-to-Market戦略への提言が主な責務です。

Principalレベルのリーダーとして、APACの広告ポートフォリオ全体の戦略方針を策定し、ストリーミングTV広告市場のホワイトスペースや新興トレンドを特定し、シニアリーダーシップに対して投資フレームワークや長期的な需要戦略を提言していただきます。エグゼクティブレベルでのエージェンシー・ブランドとの折衝、プロダクトの商業化に関する議論、社内ビジネスレビューのいずれにおいても同等のレベルで活躍し、広告主の需要シグナルとAmazonの広告プロダクトエコシステムを繋ぐハブとして機能していただきます。

求める人材像としては、広告戦略、プロダクト商業化、クライアントリレーションシップマネジメントの交差領域に深い専門性を持つビジネスデベロップメントリーダーです。広告、メディア、またはストリーミング業界での10年以上の実務経験を有し、うちアジア太平洋地域での実績が相当程度あることを期待します。大規模な収益目標のオーナーシップを持ち、定量的なビジネス成果を創出してきた実績に加え、エージェンシーホールディングカンパニー、ブランド広告主、社内クロスファンクショナルチームなど、複雑なマルチステークホルダー環境を推進してきた経験を求めます。

Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM) is responsible for developing and delivering advertising solutions that enable brands to reach audiences across Amazon's owned and operated streaming properties, including Prime Video. Prime Video Ads offers premium, brand-safe streaming TV inventory across movies, series, live sports, and originals, reaching hundreds of millions of monthly viewers globally. As our advertising business continues to scale rapidly in new and existing international markets, we are building a team of strategic leaders who will shape the future of streaming TV advertising in the Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking a Principal Business Development - Technology leader to own the end-to-end advertising growth strategy for Prime Video Ads across APAC (Japan, Australia/New Zealand, and India). This individual will serve as the strategic general manager for the region's advertising demand, leading expansion into new advertiser segments and markets while driving revenue growth for Prime Video. They will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, scaling existing advertiser channels, leading multi-year strategic planning efforts, and influencing product, pricing, and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with Sales, Product, Finance, and Marketing teams.

As a principal-level leader, you will set the strategic direction for APAC's advertising portfolio, identify whitespace opportunities and emerging trends in the streaming TV advertising market, and influence senior leadership on investment frameworks and long-term demand strategy. You will operate with equal fluency across executive-level agency and brand engagements, product commercialization discussions, and internal business reviews, serving as the connective tissue between advertiser demand signals and Amazon's advertising product ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned business development leader with deep expertise at the intersection of advertising strategy, product commercialization, and client relationship management. They bring 10+ years of progressive experience in advertising, media, or streaming, with significant time spent in markets across the Asia-Pacific region. They have a demonstrated track record of owning revenue outcomes at scale, driving measurable business results, and navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments involving agency holding companies, brand advertisers, and cross-functional internal teams.

Key job responsibilities
- 日本、オーストラリア/ニュージーランド、インドにおけるPrime Video Adsの需要戦略を、2〜3年の計画視野で一気通貫でオーナーシップを持つ
- Sales、Product、Finance、Engineeringの各チームのステークホルダーと緊密に連携しながら、広告主の需要創出、プロダクト導入促進、収益の多角化に焦点を当てたビジネスプランを策定・実行する
- 新たな業種や顧客セグメントへの広告主基盤の拡大戦略を特定・実行し、ポートフォリオの集中リスクを低減しながら、持続可能な長期収益基盤を構築する
- 市場セグメンテーション、広告主インサイト、競合インテリジェンスに基づきビジネスゴールを定義し、導入状況をトラッキングしセールスの実行を最適化するための仕組みを構築する
- 新たな広告プロダクトの商業化をリードし、ProductチームおよびSalesチームと連携してプライシング、パッケージング、Go-to-Market戦略を策定する
- APAC地域全体において、エージェンシーホールディングカンパニーやブランド広告主とのエグゼクティブレベルのリレーションシップを構築・維持し、戦略プランニングの場においてPrime Video Adsのサブジェクトマターエキスパートとしての役割を担う
- 広告主からのフィードバック、競合動向、業界トレンドなどのシグナルを統合・分析し、Productロードマップの優先順位付けに反映するとともに、組織の投資判断に影響を与える
- Sales、Marketing、Product、Programの各チームと連携し、広告主のニーズへの対応、プロダクトの改善、成長を阻害する商業的・オペレーショナルな障壁の解消をクロスファンクショナルにリードする
- ビジネスレビュー、戦略プランニング資料、複数年フォーキャスト、セグメント別ディープダイブを作成し、シニアリーダーシップにプレゼンテーションを行う
- 広告主の獲得・維持、マルチプロダクト導入、収益の質を向上させるための主要ビジネスメトリクスを定義・分析する
- APAC地域の主要な業界イベントや戦略的な広告主エンゲージメントにおいて、Prime Video Adsを代表する

- Own end-to-end demand strategy for Prime Video Ads across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, and India, with a 2 to 3 year planning horizon
- Develop and execute business plans focused on advertiser demand generation, product adoption, and revenue diversification, working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Product, Finance, and Engineering teams
- Identify and implement strategies to expand the advertiser base into new verticals and customer segments, reducing portfolio concentration and building sustainable long-term revenue streams
- Define business goals based on market segmentation, advertiser insights, and competitive intelligence, then establish mechanisms to track adoption and optimize sales execution
- Lead product commercialization for new advertising capabilities, including defining pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies in partnership with Product and Sales teams
- Build and maintain executive-level relationships with agency holding companies and brand advertisers across the region, serving as the Prime Video Ads subject matter expert in strategic planning conversations
- Synthesize signals across advertiser feedback, competitive dynamics, and industry trends to inform Product roadmap priorities and influence organizational investment decisions
- Lead cross-functional collaboration to address advertiser needs, refine product offerings, and resolve commercial or operational barriers to growth in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Program teams
- Prepare and present business reviews, strategic planning documents, multi-year forecasts, and segment deep dives to senior leadership
- Define and analyze key business metrics to drive advertiser acquisition, retention, multi-product adoption, and revenue quality
- Represent Prime Video Ads at key industry events and in strategic advertiser engagements across the region

A day in the life
このポジションでは、APAC地域におけるPrime Video Adsの複数年にわたる成長戦略の策定と実行に注力します。日常業務としては、地域のビジネスヘルスメトリクスをレビューして差異や新たなトレンドを特定すること、エージェンシーやブランドのリーダーとの戦略的な対話を通じて市場ニーズを把握すること、そしてSalesチームやProductチームとクロスファンクショナルに連携して広告主の成長を阻害する障壁を解消することが含まれます。広告主のセグメンテーションデータや競合動向の分析に時間を費やし、その後、戦略的な提言、ロードマップの優先順位、収益パフォーマンスを伝えるリーダーシップレビュー向けの資料作成に取り組みます。新たな広告プロダクトの商業化をリードし、ProductチームやFinanceチームと連携してプライシングやパッケージング戦略を策定します。また、シニアセールスリーダーシップと直接連携し、地域の優先事項のアラインメントを図り、エージェンシーのプランニングサイクルにおいてPrime Video Adsが効果的にポジショニングされるようにします。本ポジションでは、複数のタイムゾーンや広告市場の成熟度が異なるマーケットを横断して活動することに抵抗がないことが求められます。

In this role, you will focus on developing and executing the multi-year growth strategy for Prime Video Ads across APAC. A typical day includes reviewing regional business health metrics to identify variances and emerging trends, engaging in strategic conversations with agency and brand leaders to understand market needs, and partnering cross-functionally with Sales and Product teams to resolve barriers to advertiser growth. You will spend time analyzing advertiser segmentation data and competitive dynamics, then shift to preparing materials for leadership reviews that communicate strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, and revenue performance. You will lead commercialization efforts for new advertising products, working with Product and Finance teams to define pricing and packaging strategies. You will also work directly with senior Sales leadership to align on regional priorities and ensure Prime Video Ads is positioned effectively in agency planning cycles. The role requires comfort operating across multiple time zones and markets with different levels of advertising maturity.

About the team
私たちは、Amazon Publisher Monetization内の戦略チームであり、Prime Videoの広告事業における将来の需要を形作ることに注力しています。私たちのBDT組織は、戦略インテリジェンスおよび需要形成のレイヤーとして機能し、新たなビジネス機会の特定、プロダクト導入の推進、そして複数年にわたる収益成長を実現するための商業戦略の構築を担っています。Sales、Product、Marketing、Finance、Engineeringと緊密に連携し、広告主と視聴者の双方に意義のある成果をもたらす広告ソリューションを市場に届けています。チームはAmericas、EMEA、APACをカバーしており、各リーダーがそれぞれの担当地域ポートフォリオにオーナーシップを持ちながら、グローバルイニシアチブにも貢献しています。

We are a strategic team within Amazon Publisher Monetization focused on shaping the future demand for Prime Video's advertising business. Our BDT organization operates as a strategic intelligence and demand-shaping layer that identifies emerging opportunities, drives product adoption, and builds the commercial strategies that unlock multi-year revenue growth. We partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to bring advertising solutions to market that deliver meaningful results for advertisers and viewers alike. The team covers Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with each leader owning a defined regional portfolio and contributing to global initiatives.
Basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Experience leading advertising revenue strategy or demand generation for a video streaming, OTT, or connected TV platform, with a demonstrated track record of scaling monetization in Japan market.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience as a founder or executive focused on related segments, or as a practice leader or business unit owner
- Experience selling to Fortune 1000 or Global 2000 organizations
- Experience in publisher-side ad monetization — including defining pricing models, packaging ad inventory, or driving product commercialization for video ad formats — in partnership with product, sales, and engineering teams.

jobs.title: Premium Support Business Development Manager, AWS Enterprise Support
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with a one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24/7/365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries. Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

As Premium Support BDM, you will be part of the Enterprise Support organization. You will support the Premium Support strategy and own driving the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst AWS customers while maintaining target margin performance and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Premium Support solutions (or why not, e.g., Enterprise Support or Unified Operations), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g., a differentiated offering value and return on investment vs. price) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects selling the Support value proposition in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and is comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.

Key job responsibilities
• Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support Services (Enterprise Support, Unified Operations, Migration Services, plus other new products launched throughout the year) • Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support Services adoption and identify levers for improvement • Identify, design, and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support Services adoption • Review and analyze Enterprise Support Services pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers • Quantify impact of Enterprise Support Services adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption • Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases, and value proofs for customers and partners • Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g., differentiated support offerings per customer segment. In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support-related training programs and material for the field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition • Work with stakeholders across Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise • Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team • Drive Enterprise Support Services deals end-to-end with Sales.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

jobs.description:
With global energy demand projected to rise 47% over the next 25 years, the Energy sector is simultaneously navigating a global expansion of existing and new energy sources, an AI driven transformation of subsurface, reservoir intelligence, real-time drilling operations, and agentic production optimization in Oil and Gas; and in Power and Utilities, an acceleration of grid modernization, decarbonization mandates, electrification of mobility, and growth in generation. These are transformational opportunities not seen in decades. At the same time, AWS is deploying billions in annual capital expenditure for power generation and delivery arrangements to support sustainable data center growth. AWS is co-investing in diverse supply like wind, solar, storage, and nuclear and creating more agile, responsive, and efficient energy workflows using AI and the cloud with leading Energy customers. This convergence creates an unprecedented opportunity—and an imperative—for AWS to lead at the intersection of AI, cloud technology, and energy infrastructure. Our mission is simple: to generate unprecedented value for Energy customers by reinventing their workflows with Agentic AI.

AWS is seeking a Director to lead the Business Development function for the Energy and Utilities Industry Business Unit. This leader is responsible for the industry Go-To-Market (GTM) that drives cloud and AI adoption across the Oil and Gas (O&G) and Power and Utilities (P&U) sectors, and for the integration of commercial relationships of companies delivering power to Amazon into a 360, strategic relationship. The Energy BD organization touches every facet of how AWS engages energy and utilities customers and the AWS strategic industry position. The BD team engages in account planning, demand generation, development of cloud and AI Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs), industry go-to-market strategy, solution development, partner ecosystem engagement, and field enablement for AWS Energy customers worldwide.

In this role, you will define and execute the multi-year strategy for how AWS engages the global Energy sector as a customer, partner, and infrastructure counterpart to drive cloud and AI growth. You will lead a globally distributed team of senior business development professionals who structure large, multi-party commercial agreements, manage CxO-level relationships, define the industry strategy, build the opportunity pipeline, enable regional and global account teams, and engage strategic ISV and systems integrator partners to accelerate cloud adoption across the sector. This role that demands credibility at the intersection of energy infrastructure, enterprise AI and cloud technology, and large-scale commercial deal-making.

You will serve as the managed gateway between Energy & Utilities account teams and AWS Infrastructure teams and other Amazon organizations, ensuring that requests and commercial discussions with power procurement teams are appropriately coordinated, triaged, and elevated. You will leverage and continuously expand a pan-Amazon network spanning Amazon Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Sustainability, Amazon Business, and other Amazon business units, bringing the full breadth of Amazon's assets and capabilities into strategic customer relationships. You will facilitate executive engagements between customer C-suites and senior Amazon leadership and represent AWS at the highest-profile energy industry forums.

- Identify, develop, and realize business opportunities to generate customer value and AWS AI/cloud revenue, building a business development pipeline in line with the AWS Energy industry strategic direction and multi-year revenue targets
- Structure and execute Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs) encompassing Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) and Cloud and AI deployments at scale with the world's largest energy companies
- Lead, develop, and grow a global team of senior business development professionals articulating how AWS can solve the hardest industry problems with Agentic AI and cloud, instilling a sense of urgency, coaching on multi-divisional deal structuring, CxO engagement, providing visible industry thought leadership, and fostering a culture of ownership and high performance
- Serve as the primary strategic advisor to energy industry executives at the CEO, CFO, CIO, CTO, and VP level, building trusted bilateral relationships that span both commercial infrastructure partnerships and enterprise cloud and AI adoption programs
- Manage the pan-Amazon relationship network to bring the full breadth of Amazon assets—Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Amazon Business, Sustainability, and others—into strategic customer engagements as inputs to SFA value propositions and commercial deal structures
- Define and size market segments; identify, qualify, and engage key customers and strategic industry partners and develop scalable partner engagement and co-sell motions
- Build and maintain named account/ white-space map across Energy and utilities, prioritized by propensity and strategic value
- Hand off qualified opportunities to Sales with clear documentation of the customer's business driver, stakeholders and urgency
- Coordinate regional and global field enablement initiatives, including account team training programs, infrastructure engagement playbooks, industry solution toolkits, and mechanisms that equip AWS field teams to engage confidently in energy infrastructure and cloud deals
- Work with Marketing to drive global campaigns highlighting customer success stories and strategic messaging.

- 15+ years leading global teams in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial leadership roles in the Oil and Gas sector
- 5+ years of working knowledge of cloud computing, AI/ML, or emerging technology paradigms and their application to energy industry challenges
- Strong knowledge and vision of AI and Agentic services applied to solving Energy industry problems

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager II, North America Transportation Services
jobs.description:
Own the analytical programs that improve how Amazon plans and moves packages across one of the world's largest transportation networks. In this role, you'll turn complex data into actionable planning solutions that directly reduce delivery costs and accelerate speed for hundreds of millions of customers. If you thrive at the intersection of supply chain strategy, data analysis, and cross-functional influence, this is your opportunity to drive visible, measurable impact at unprecedented scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Analyze delivery performance across the North American transportation network to identify improvement opportunities, then lead programs from business case development through implementation and impact measurement
- Develop and maintain automated reporting mechanisms and dashboards that enable operations partners to monitor planning health indicators and make data-driven decisions at scale
- Influence cross-functional leaders across operations, science, and technology teams through compelling data narratives to drive alignment on planning improvements without direct authority
- Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions that improve forecast accuracy and planning mechanism reliability
- Retrieve, synthesize, and act on complex datasets using SQL, Excel, and ETL tools to identify root causes of planning variance and recommend corrective actions

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing forecast and capacity inputs, identifying where network variability creates risk. By mid-morning, you're analyzing planning data to diagnose root causes of performance gaps across transportation nodes. After lunch, you facilitate a cross-functional discussion with operations and data science partners to align on a proposed planning mechanism improvement. You spend the afternoon building a business case for your initiative, using SQL to validate assumptions and quantify expected impact. Your day wraps with stakeholder updates, sharing progress on your improvement programs and removing blockers to keep delivery timelines on track.

About the team
The Plan Improvement, Network Flow, and Explainability (PINE) team stewards the Network Flow Plan across Amazon's outbound transportation network; spanning first-, middle-, and last-mile operations. We bridge technical innovation with operational execution to improve forecast accuracy, plan adherence, and network alignment. Our work transforms planning gaps into scalable solutions that directly enhance how Amazon delivers for customers. We value intellectual curiosity, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative problem-solving in a fast-paced environment where your contributions visibly improve the transportation experience for millions of customers daily.

jobs.title: Business Development, Mission Innovation, Public Sector (UK, Germany and International Organisations)
jobs.description:
Governments, defence organisations, healthcare and education providers are all facing seemingly impossible challenges - and the cloud and AI are how they'll solve them. AWS is looking for a Mission Innovation lead for the UK, Germany and International Organisations (UKGI) public sector team. Someone who can connect what is technically possible to the mission outcomes that matter most. Based in the UK, you'll create strategic customer relationships, win the trust of the most senior decision makers, and show them how the cloud and AI can bring clarity where strategy is still taking shape. Revenue growth and mission impact are treated as one goal, earned through disciplined customer engagement not through transactional selling.

This is a new role for UKGI, and success starts with customer obsession. You need to work backwards to understand constitutes mission success for our customers, and then build the path from that vision to execution so they can solve their hardest problems. Trust is earned daily through consistent, high-value engagement, and it is measured honestly: every critical relationship is assessed regularly for whether it advanced, held steady, went quiet, or cooled, with a deliberate plan to move each one forward.

The role also demands invention on behalf of the customer. You will build evidence-based adoption narratives for our customers, grounded in efficiencies, cost savings, and mission successes that were achieved with other customers, public sector or not. You will show customers that if they bring their silos together in the cloud, they can unlock new capability that seemed impossible before. Prototypes are built quickly, shown early, and refined through customer feedback, producing a growing set of proof points. Adoption narratives span all levels of sensitivity, adding service accreditation, hardening, and additional assurance requirements when needed.

Customers should experience AWS as a quiet enabler that has placed capacity, compute, silicon, infrastructure, and power in the right place for the mission. You help them unlock that and shape opportunities where none formally existed.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with our public sector customers to define mission success and apply our working backwards methodology to reach it.
- Build and iterate rapid prototypes that demonstrate value, capturing outcomes into a reusable set of proof points.
- Develop evidence-based adoption narratives, taking them from the commercial world and translating them for public sector at every level of sensitivity, adding security hardening as required.
- Map the decision makers who hold influence within key accounts, alongside understanding the formal and informal power structures that surround them.
- Identify and cultivate key influencers, enabling wider account teams to work through them to reach the decision makers for the whole public sector.
- Facilitate government-to-government and private-sector-to-government conversations, including cross-border engagement, that surface tradecraft and technical expertise in a way that is organic for the customer.
- Build and own a portfolio of strategic relationships, honestly grading the health and momentum of each account.
- Increase cloud utilisation of existing workloads by uncovering opportunities to improve data workflows, achieve cost efficiencies, and deploy new applications of generative and agentic AI.
- Contribute repeatable mechanisms that help account teams drive new workload migrations from on-premises environments and competitor platforms.
- Share thought leadership across the broader UKGI community, through white papers and on-stage presentations, on new and innovative ways to deliver mission outcomes.
- Support hackathons that accelerate external adoption of agentic AI and emerging technologies while extracting repeatable insights that sharpen account team strategy.

A day in the life
A typical week blends customer time with internal research and collaboration, though customer time always comes first. Mornings might open with a pipeline review that identifies the key touchpoints needed to keep priority accounts progressing. Midday could bring an executive briefing where you use a working prototype to turn an abstract mission requirement into something a decision maker can see and react to. Afternoons could shift to enablement, translating a hard-won migration pattern into a repeatable approach that other account teams can reuse. Travel is frequent, because presence with the customer is where trust is built and how momentum is sustained.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our public sector team is driven by a simple belief: the organisations that serve citizens deserve world-class technology and guidance to deliver on their missions. We dive deep to understand each customer's goals, bring clarity to complexity, and celebrate the diverse perspectives that make our solutions stronger. We're curious, customer obsessed, and proud of the difference our work can make.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development, Energy and Utilities
jobs.description:
With global energy demand projected to rise 47% over the next 25 years, the Energy sector is simultaneously navigating a global expansion of existing and new energy sources, an AI driven transformation of subsurface, reservoir intelligence, real-time drilling operations, and agentic production optimization in Oil and Gas; and in Power and Utilities, an acceleration of grid modernization, decarbonization mandates, electrification of mobility, and growth in generation. These are transformational opportunities not seen in decades. At the same time, AWS is deploying billions in annual capital expenditure for power generation and delivery arrangements to support sustainable data center growth. AWS is co-investing in diverse supply like wind, solar, storage, and nuclear and creating more agile, responsive, and efficient energy workflows using AI and the cloud with leading Energy customers. This convergence creates an unprecedented opportunity—and an imperative—for AWS to lead at the intersection of AI, cloud technology, and energy infrastructure. Our mission is simple: to generate unprecedented value for Energy customers by reinventing their workflows with Agentic AI.

AWS is seeking a Director to lead the Business Development function for the Energy and Utilities Industry Business Unit. This leader is responsible for the industry Go-To-Market (GTM) that drives cloud and AI adoption across the Oil and Gas (O&G) and Power and Utilities (P&U) sectors, and for the integration of commercial relationships of companies delivering power to Amazon into a 360, strategic relationship. The Energy BD organization touches every facet of how AWS engages energy and utilities customers and the AWS strategic industry position. The BD team engages in account planning, demand generation, development of cloud and AI Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs), industry go-to-market strategy, solution development, partner ecosystem engagement, and field enablement for AWS Energy customers worldwide.

In this role, you will define and execute the multi-year strategy for how AWS engages the global Energy sector as a customer, partner, and infrastructure counterpart to drive cloud and AI growth. You will lead a globally distributed team of senior business development professionals who structure large, multi-party commercial agreements, manage CxO-level relationships, define the industry strategy, build the opportunity pipeline, enable regional and global account teams, and engage strategic ISV and systems integrator partners to accelerate cloud adoption across the sector. This role that demands credibility at the intersection of energy infrastructure, enterprise AI and cloud technology, and large-scale commercial deal-making.

You will serve as the managed gateway between Energy & Utilities account teams and AWS Infrastructure teams and other Amazon organizations, ensuring that requests and commercial discussions with power procurement teams are appropriately coordinated, triaged, and elevated. You will leverage and continuously expand a pan-Amazon network spanning Amazon Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Sustainability, Amazon Business, and other Amazon business units, bringing the full breadth of Amazon's assets and capabilities into strategic customer relationships. You will facilitate executive engagements between customer C-suites and senior Amazon leadership and represent AWS at the highest-profile energy industry forums.

You will partner with AWS Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, AWS Infrastructure, and service team leadership to align commercial and technical priorities, influence AWS product and infrastructure investment direction, and build mechanisms that drive repeatable, scalable outcomes across the Strategic BD organization.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute a comprehensive strategic GTM plan for the global Power & Utilities sector, including industry solution prioritization, repeatable pipeline generation, market segmentation, and competitive positioning
- Identify, develop, and realize business opportunities to generate customer value and AWS AI/cloud revenue, building a business development pipeline in line with the AWS Energy industry strategic direction and multi-year revenue targets
- Structure and execute Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs) encompassing Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) and Cloud and AI deployments at scale with the world's largest energy companies
- Lead, develop, and grow a global team of senior business development professionals articulating how AWS can solve the hardest industry problems with Agentic AI and cloud, instilling a sense of urgency, coaching on multi-divisional deal structuring, CxO engagement, providing visible industry thought leadership, and fostering a culture of ownership and high performance
- Serve as the primary strategic advisor to energy industry executives at the CEO, CFO, CIO, CTO, and VP level, building trusted bilateral relationships that span both commercial infrastructure partnerships and enterprise cloud and AI adoption programs
- Manage the pan-Amazon relationship network to bring the full breadth of Amazon assets—Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Amazon Business, Sustainability, and others—into strategic customer engagements as inputs to SFA value propositions and commercial deal structures
- Define and size market segments; identify, qualify, and engage key customers and strategic industry partners and develop scalable partner engagement and co-sell motions
- Build and maintain named account/ white-space map across Energy and utilities, prioritized by propensity and strategic value
- Hand off qualified opportunities to Sales with clear documentation of the customer's business driver, stakeholders and urgency
- Coordinate regional and global field enablement initiatives, including account team training programs, infrastructure engagement playbooks, industry solution toolkits, and mechanisms that equip AWS field teams to engage confidently in energy infrastructure and cloud deals
- Work with Marketing to drive global campaigns highlighting customer success stories and strategic messaging.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or 16+ years of equivalent professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial leadership
- 15+ years leading global teams in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial leadership roles in the Oil and Gas sector
- 5+ years of working knowledge of cloud computing, AI/ML, or emerging technology paradigms and their application to energy industry challenges
- Strong knowledge and vision of AI and Agentic services applied to solving Energy industry problems
- Demonstrated experience structuring and executing large-scale commercial agreements ($500M+) with enterprise energy, utility, or infrastructure customers, including multi-party deal structures
Preferred qualifications:
- Advanced degree (MBA, or MS) in a technical, energy, or business discipline
- Deep familiarity with Power and Utilities sector challenges including grid interconnection dynamics, long-lead-time equipment procurement, data center power siting, decarbonization strategies, regulatory and permitting processes, and energy infrastructure supply chain constraints
- History of building and managing pan-enterprise or cross-business-unit relationships that bring the breadth of a large corporate organization to bear in strategic customer or partner engagements
- Deep understanding of cloud computing and AI solutions as applied to complex Energy processes

jobs.title: Senior Partner Manager, System Integrators
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Partner Development Manager (PDM) to own the strategic growth and field activation of a portfolio of System Integrators across the UK & Ireland. This is not a pipeline administration role you will be in the field with partners, driving joint go-to-market execution, co-developing solutions, and accelerating revenue through active co-sell motions.

As a PDM in the UKI Strategic Consulting Partners team, you will develop, enable, and deliver growth of a select number of system integrators. You will own the joint go-to-market strategies, be responsible for the partner's programme status, provide direct sales support to joint opportunities, identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities, and drive overall partner expansion aligned with AWS strategic priorities.

You will leverage comprehensive experience and deep expertise in enterprise IT transformation, strategy development, ERP, data centre exit strategies, and enterprise IT to drive AWS adoption through System Integrator partnerships.
