- Own end-to-end partner relationships across a managed portfolio of SIs, serving as the primary strategic advisor and activation lead

- Develop and execute Partner Business Plans that translate partner capabilities and market opportunities into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes

- Design and deliver Joint Go-To-Market (JGTM) strategies — including vertical solution positioning, demand generation campaigns, field alignment, and activation programmes — with the judgement to prioritise investments that drive the highest customer and business impact

- Build multi-quarter capability roadmaps for partners across priority workloads (Migration, Modernisation, GenAI, Industry Solutions) and drive execution against milestones

Field Activation & Co-Sell Execution

- Spend the majority of time in the field with partner sellers and AWS account teams — running GTM bootcamps, joint customer sessions, gather events, and co-sell deal support

- Drive proactive pipeline generation as a top priority — originating, qualifying, and advancing both Amazon-Originated (AO) and Partner-Originated (PO) opportunities through the ACE co-sell motion

- Coach partner sales teams on co-sell best practices, advancing their motion from reactive deal registration to proactive, seller-initiated pipeline creation at scale

- Own and drive complex IT transformations with partners, bringing AWS best practices and leading deal execution with System Integrators

- Work in partnership with System Integrator leadership to accelerate existing opportunities and identify new business development growth avenues for AWS services, effectively managing the deals pipeline and driving specific opportunities to close

Solution Development & GTM Enablement

- Enable partners to build and position industry-specific and workload-specific solutions addressing key customer needs (e.g., VMware displacement, GenAI adoption, cloud migration at scale)

- Create outcome-based vertical solution packages that GSI sellers can take directly to customers — moving beyond generic horizontal enablement to field-ready assets

- Support partners in achieving relevant AWS competencies, certifications, and programme milestones that unlock go-to-market resources and funding

- Manage partner funding and MDF investments with a high bar for ROI, ensuring alignment with joint business objectives

Executive Engagement & Relationship Management

- Build and maintain senior-level relationships with partner C-suite and practice leadership, orchestrating executive engagement, quarterly business reviews, and multi-year strategic planning

- Conduct regular pipeline and business reviews using data-driven frameworks, proactively raising findings and recommendations to leadership

We operate with a clear philosophy: PDMs are in the field activating partners — not behind a desk managing pipeline. Our team drives growth by ensuring partners are equipped, motivated, and actively co-selling with AWS account teams in front of customers.

We own the Engagement, Enablement, and Activation framework — a sequential mechanism that builds executive relationships, equips partner sellers with the knowledge and tools to position AWS, and then converts that capability into joint pipeline and revenue. If you thrive on strategic planning followed by hands-on execution in the field, this is the role for you.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Data Center Supply Solutions team is looking for a Real Estate Development Manager to drive our infrastructure strategy execution in India. As a Real Estate Development Manager with Amazon Web Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help build data centers, the physical backbone of Amazon Web Services. As the contract owner, you will interface with property developers and partners on technical, commercial and legal negotiations as well as ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and commitments. jobs.title: Sr. Partner Growth Manager, Prime Video, Device & AI Partnerships
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a talented, highly motivated, and experienced individual to join Prime Video's global Device & AI Partnerships (D&AIP) team as Senior Partner Growth Manager. This role is responsible for owning the end-to-end growth strategy for assigned third-party distribution partnerships — including partner performance and intelligence, partnership roadmap development, out-of-app (OOA) integration prioritization, and cross-functional orchestration across the Trio (Business Development, Technical Program Management, and Partner Growth Management). You will serve as the single point of accountability for ensuring partnership roadmaps are established, maintained, and aligned across stakeholders, and that growth initiatives are grounded in data and move forward with clarity and purpose.

As a Senior Partner Growth Manager, you will drive OOA UI integration opportunities (acquisition placements, engagement surfaces, search-based ingress points, out-of-the-box experiences), synthesize inputs from across the Trio to align on sequencing and priorities, and own the lifecycle of external business reviews and partner-facing engagements. You will also manage partner marketing initiatives — including always-on programs and premium campaigns — as one dimension of a broader growth mandate. Your goals will be to maximize output metrics (starts, acquisition, engagement, and hours), build scalable processes for roadmap planning and execution, and establish trusted, strategic relationships with OEM partners globally.

This position offers an unparalleled opportunity to leverage your strategic, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills inside one of the world's leading technology companies while experiencing the excitement of the streaming media industry. This is a highly visible role that interacts at all levels of the company and requires the ability to operate at both the strategic level (identifying bold growth opportunities, driving Trio alignment) and the tactical level (managing initiative execution, analyzing performance data, and solving problems).

Key job responsibilities
Other job responsibilities include the following:

- Own partner performance and intelligence: Maintain deep expertise across all partner output metrics (starts, PPAC, hours, app opens, OOA ingress performance) and serve as the single source of truth on partner health for the Trio and broader stakeholders — enabling data-grounded prioritization across all workstreams.

- Drive partnership roadmap and OOA integration priorities: Identify, evaluate, and advance out-of-app UI integration opportunities (new placements, OOBE, Account Linking, Autoplay, co-mingled Continue Watching, search-based placements) by synthesizing BD and TPM inputs to align on sequencing, timing, and partner appetite.

- Lead external partner engagements: Own the full lifecycle of business reviews — planning, content development, facilitation, and follow-through — and maintain ongoing partner communication that is data-rich, forward-looking, and drives clear next steps.

- Develop insight-driven, partner-facing narratives that articulate the mutual value of partnering with Prime Video, grounded in performance data and product opportunity.

- Orchestrate cross-functional alignment across the Trio: Ensure prioritization decisions are made, initiatives are resourced and sequenced, and ownership is clear — reducing ambiguity and keeping roadmap execution on track.

- Coordinate with Product teams (DPTX, GTM): Serve as the primary intake point for product roadmap pitches to partners, evaluating product-market fit and timing to determine what gets prioritized within the partnership roadmap.

- Manage partner marketing programs: Design and execute always-on and campaign-based marketing initiatives that leverage partner channels to drive awareness, acquisition, and engagement in coordination with internal marketing and regional stakeholders.

- Collaborate closely with Business Development to align on shared priorities during and outside deal cycles, ensuring roadmap coherence across all active workstreams.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross-functionally across several teams both technical and non-technical
- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or equivalent
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience managing external partner relationships and leading business reviews
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience identifying and aggregating trends, past performance metrics, and insights into effective narratives, with recommendations, to external senior leaders
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
- Experience owning partnership roadmaps and driving cross-functional alignment across business development, technical, and product teams
- Experience managing OEM, distributor, or platform partnerships in streaming media, devices, or digital services
- Familiarity with out-of-app distribution strategies (e.g., content discovery integrations, on-device placements, app store optimization)

jobs.description:
The AWS Infrastructure Partner Management (IPM) team performs a business control and vendor management function for colocation (colo) data center vendors where AWS has infrastructure deployments. The team manages AWS’s colo vendor business review program - to drive improvements to vendors’ service performance and is one of AWS’s System and Organizational Controls (SOC) compliance requirements. Through these activities, the function supports and empowers Operations, Safety, Security, and other key stakeholders to share expectations and work in close partnership to drive service improvement and resolve both contractual and relationship issues.

As a Infrastructure Partner Manager, you will work with teams across AWS to manage relationships with AWS’s colocation providers and drive service improvements across a global portfolio of infrastructure deployments. You will lead cross-organizational business reviews with our vendor partners, lead the development and implementation of infrastructure risk reduction and mitigation projects. You will drive projects and initiatives that deliver better experiences for internal customers and our vendor partners, and scale how the team manages its responsibilities. In this role, you will also act as a subject matter expert on AWS’s service relationships with these vendors and on their overall service performance.

- Lead development and implementation of infrastructure risk reduction and mitigation solutions
- Identify and drive targeted improvement initiatives to raise service performance with specific vendors.

- Empower internal customer teams like Operations and Security by facilitating issue resolution and ongoing performance improvement efforts with key infrastructure vendors

jobs.title: Principal Talent Management, Amazon Talent & Compensation
jobs.description:
The Principal, Product Manager in Talent Management is a senior individual contributor who designs, leads, and scales enterprise-wide talent management strategies and programs. This role operates with significant autonomy in highly ambiguous environments, driving talent management initiatives across multiple business units or geographies. The Principal serves as a recognized subject-matter expert and trusted advisor to senior leaders (Director and VP level), shaping the talent agenda and influencing long-term workforce strategy.

Come Build How Amazon Grows Its Best People

Amazon doesn't just hire great talent — we obsess over how to develop, retain, and grow it. Our Talent Management team builds the programs, systems, and strategies that shape the employee experience for over 1.5 million people worldwide. This is where people science meets product thinking at a scale no other company can match.

We're looking for a Principal who thinks like a product leader and operates like a program owner. Someone who can take a complex, cross-functional challenge — spanning product, UX, engineering, and analytics — and turn it into a launched experience with clear strategy, measurable outcomes, and executive-level visibility. You'll own end-to-end product management and design for talent programs, writing docs, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and presenting to PXT leadership monthly. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write one.

Key job responsibilities
• Enterprise Talent Strategy: Design and own the end-to-end talent management strategy for the enterprise, including talent evaluation, high-potential identification and retention, performance management, and AI-enhanced talent experiences.

• Product Ownership & Delivery: Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for talent management programs. Write strategy docs, engage UX/Design/Analytics/Engineering partners, and drive cross-functional teams to ship at scale — without direct authority over those teams.

• Executive Communication: Present product launches and program updates to PXT LT and executives monthly. Translate complex technical and programmatic work into crisp narratives for senior leadership.

• Organizational Health & Insights: Leverage data and analytics to diagnose organizational health trends, identify talent risks, and develop proactive interventions. Translate complex talent data into actionable insights for senior leadership.

• Talent Evaluation & Calibration: Design talent evaluation and calibration processes, ensuring consistency, fairness, and alignment with role guidelines and leadership principles.

• Growth & Development: Architect and implement scalable growth & development programs that accelerate the growth of high-value talent and address capability gaps across the organization.

• AI Transformation: Drive experimentation and adoption of AI-powered talent experiences, partnering closely with engineering and technical teams to bring innovation from concept to production.

• Mechanisms & Scalability: Create scalable mechanisms, tools, and frameworks that raise the bar on talent management practices and can be adopted broadly across the company.

A day in the life
You'll own the full lifecycle of products and programs that have considerable impact across multiple Amazon organizations. That means defining the mission and vision, writing strategy documents, aligning with senior leaders, building go-to-market and change management plans, and driving execution across UX, Design, Analytics, and Program Management teams that don't report to you.

You'll develop KPI frameworks that give leadership real visibility into performance, and you'll use data to tell the story of what's working and where to push harder.

You'll be the connective tissue between product, design, technical, and business teams — identifying gaps before they become failures, sourcing and coordinating resources across organizations, and proactively mitigating risks that others haven't spotted yet. When a problem is ambiguous, you'll define it. When a path forward isn't clear, you'll build one.

About the team
The Compensation & Talent team is a newly formed organization within PXT that brings together talent evaluation, performance management, and compensation under one leader. Our mission is to accelerate and advance how Amazon identifies and rewards its people — uniting the full cycle of talent assessment and compensation into a streamlined, end-to-end experience. We own compensation product, tech, and program management, as well as talent management design, program, and policy work.

You'll operate at the intersection of people strategy and technology, working on initiatives that directly influence how Amazon identifies, develops, and retains talent at unprecedented scale. The stakeholders are senior, the problems are genuinely hard, and the work ships to an audience of hundreds of thousands.
Basic qualifications:
- 8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- 10+ years of progressive experience in talent management, organizational development, HR business partnership, or a related field
- Demonstrates experience designing and implementing enterprise-wide talent management programs (e.g., talent evaluation, performance management, growth & development)
- Experience advising and influencing senior leaders (Director level and above) on talent strategy and organizational health
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and voice of the customer to drive talent decisions and measure program effectiveness
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or advanced certification in a relevant discipline (e.g., MBA, M.S. in I/O Psychology, SHRM-SCP, or equivalent)
- Experience with performance management systems, competency frameworks, and assessment methodologies
- Demonstrated ability to manage through influence rather than authority, building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups

jobs.description:
アマゾンジャパンでは、米国と欧州ですでに急速に成長しているビジネス「Merch on Demand」のサービスを2020年10月に開始しました。Merch on Demandでは、大手ブランド企業と提携し、最終的には日本のお客様が胸を躍らせるブランド商品の数々を提供していくビジネスです。エンターテインメント、ミュージック、ゲーム、さまざまな消費者製品等の複数の戦略的パートナーと連携しそれらのグラフィックコンテンツを活用して参ります。

このビジネスを展開するにあたり上記のパートナー開発及びマネージメントを担い、また製造サイドやテクニカルチームとの連携してビジネスの拡大を推進するる人材を募集しております。複雑な取引関係を管理しつつ良好な関係を育めるコミュニケーション能力の高い人材を募集しています。パートナー企業をリクルート＆サポートのみならず商品企画のロードマップ作成（マーケティング施策含む）にも関わり、このビジネスの成長を担っていただきます。

社内およびパートナー企業の両方の組織内のあらゆる階層の人たちと緊密な連携が主な責務となります。パートナー企業の製品制作の過程をサポートしそのビジネスの成功を後押しする役割がメインです。パートナー企業の選りすぐりのブランド製品のセレクションをAmazon.co.jp上にて増やしていくことにより、互いの成長につなげていきます。こうした多岐にわたる責任を果たすには、パートナーの戦略およびコンテンツに対する深い理解、そしてそのビジネスを促進するために互いがどう連携するべきか、について明確で説得力のあるビジョンを描く能力が求められます。
最後に、このポジションの方には、上記業務の導入、評価、最適化に関しても責任を持っていただくため、優れたデータ管理・分析及び業務改善能力も重要になります。このポジションの応募者として理想的なのは、コンテンツライセンス契約、強固な戦略的パートナーシップの構築及び市場への新しいアイデアの導入において成功実績のある方です。

Key job responsibilities
- 戦略立案に役立つ情報を提供（市場状況把握とその変化のモニタリング）
- 新しい製品のアイデアとその実行を推進するためのコンテンツパートナーとの連携
- パフォーマンスの分析とその改善促進
- ベストプラクティスの策定とその周知
- コンテンツ取得交渉
- ビジネスパートナー管理およびそのパフォーマンスの最適化

- Providing information that is useful for strategic planning (understanding the market situation and monitoring changes)
- Collaborating with content partners to promote new product ideas and their implementation
- Analyzing performance and promoting improvements
- Formulating best practices and promoting their adoption
- Negotiating content acquisition
- Managing business partners and optimizing their performance

About the team
＜ファッション事業部について＞
私たちの事業部は、アパレル、シューズ、バッグ、時計、ジュエリーのカテゴリーで様々なブランド・人気商品を取り扱っています。品揃え拡大のポテンシャルが大きく、更なる成長が期待される事業部です。Prime Try Before You BuyやMerch on DemandなどAmazonならではの便利なサービスを提供しています。私たちは、日本、アメリカ、中国、韓国、インドなど、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーで構成されており、個性豊かで楽しいチームです。業界の常識にとらわれない新しい発想で事業を成長させ、活躍している社員が多数です。新入社員には入社後すぐに活躍いただけるよう、バディ（業務ケア）とメンター（サポート）が付いて、オンボードをサポートしています。

＜About Amazon Fashion＞
Our business division consists of Apparel, Shoes, Bags, Watches and Jewelry and deals with various major brands and popular products. The potential for expanding assortment is large and there is high growth potential. In addition, services such as Prime Try Before You Buy and Merch on Demand allow customers to enjoy convenient services unique to Amazon. The team consists of members from a variety of industries, job experiences and regions including Japan, the United States, China, Korea, and India, and is a unique and fun team. There are many employees who are growing and thriving the businesses with completely new ideas that are not bound by the common sense of the fashion industry. In addition, new employees are equipped with buddies for operational care and mentors for support to help with on-boarding so that they can ramp up quickly.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 8+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
- Experience using sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

jobs.title: Manager, Business Development Team, Auto & Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead a team focused on increasing the reach of cloud computing across stakeholders in the industry, with a focus on Automotive and Manufacturing? Do you have the industry background, technical depth, and communication skills needed to help further establish Amazon Web Services as the leader in the industry?

AWS is looking for a Manager of Business Development who understands the business trends impacting the industry, and is passionate and capable of driving market development across the sector for AWS, leveraging the richness of the AWS cloud computing platform to position and drive the right technology solutions to enable the ecosystem and the changing industry needs.

Your responsibilities will include managing a team of business development employees engaging with key industry customers and strategic industry partners, attending and speaking at industry events, and facilitating the process to enable industry solutions, and help create new business opportunities for AWS. You will enable the AWS account management teams to drive their day-to-day interactions with key prospects. Your team will work closely with AWS Solutions Architects to develop and promote cloud patterns and solutions for the industry, including high performance computing (design engineering), partner based solutions, etc. You will work closely with the AWS product and services teams to help evolve AWS offerings for more rapid adoption by customers.
The ideal candidate will have both a business or consulting background, with experience working with Manufacturing and Automotive customers, enabling them to drive engagement and interact at the CxO/VP level, as well as a good understanding of technology. You should have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions, and work cross-organizationally to build consensus.

Key job responsibilities
Roles & Responsibilities:

Lead a team of Industry Specialists to drive overall AWS market and technical strategy for the Manufacturing and Automotive industry.
Define and execute on a strategic market development plan and ensure it is in line with the AWS strategic direction, in partnership with key internal stakeholders (e.g. account management teams, service teams, legal, support, etc.)
Define and size segments, identify and engage key customers, and identify and engage key partners including Independent Software Vendors and System Integrators.
Build business development pipeline by engaging with key prospects and partners.
Understand the technical requirements of our customers and work closely with the internal development teams to guide the direction of our product offerings for developers.
Present business reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks to expanding our reach in the industry.
Manage complex contract negotiations and liaise with the legal group.
Handle a high volume of engagements in the fast pace of the cloud computing market.
Basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of building and leading large teams and working in matrixed operating structures experience
- Knowledge of distribution networks and channel P&Ls
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent
- Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent
- Experience negotiating VP-level contracts with channel partners and agencies
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of managing and developing high performance teams experience

jobs.title: AWS Global Supply Chain Manager, Archive Storage Solutions
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services Supply Chain is seeking a supply chain professional to function as the end-to-end supply owner of our archive storage hardware platforms. In this role, you will build the supply strategy that ensures we can reliably deliver the capacity needed to enable the lowest cost and highest performance archive in the cloud. This role is predominately focused on the assurance of supply, but success also requires the ability to manage commercial aspects of a complex and multi-tiered supply chain.

You’ll join a diverse team of supply chain specialists, engineers (software, hardware and network), security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Our organization, AWS Infrastructure Services, owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The successful candidate must be a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, has high attention to detail, and a proven ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Candidates must have excellent analytical capabilities, program management experience, be comfortable diving deep into data, have strong writing skills, lead executive-level reviews, and effectively influence decisions at all levels of the company.

The ideal candidate will have familiarity with at-scale hardware supply mechanisms, preferably related to server, storage or networking platforms.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

• Deep dive all levels of the archive supply chain to ensure demand is supportable and supply is resilient.
• Detect risk and mitigate outcomes before they become supply interruptions.
• Serve as a key member of the AWS Infrastructure supply chain team by helping to define and deliver complex supply chain strategies.
• Design, develop and maintain scalable and reliable analytical tools, dashboards, and metrics that drive key decisions and resource prioritization.
• Understand the technical requirements of our partners and work closely with the internal technical teams to guide the direction of activities that will impact our supply chain.
• Produce written recommendations and insights for key stakeholders to help shape solution design.
• Handle multiple projects at once, deal with ambiguity and rapidly-changing priorities.

Our environment is fast-paced and requires someone who is hard-working, meticulous with high bias for action, who gets things done at an effective pace, gets results, and is comfortable working with tight deadlines and changing priorities.

A day in the life
Key Responsibilities / Daily Activities include:
• Material/inventory Planning
• Supply/Demand planning / forecasting
• Maintaining continuity of supply (COS)
• Communicating supply status, risks/mitigations to internal stakeholders and executive leadership
• Working with data and analytics (ability to view, edit, and extrapolate data in Excel or similar spreadsheet software)
• Working with suppliers/vendors, inventory warehousing teams
• Managing all tiers of the archive supply chain from components to full rack assembly.
• Capacity planning (expanding new manufacturing lines)
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- Experience in procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations
- Experience in strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
- Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
Preferred qualifications:
- 4+ years of program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process experience
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies

jobs.title: Sr Risk Manager, RISC (Program)
jobs.description:
The Regulatory Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies.

In this role you will be working directly with Testing, Inspection, and Certification providers (TICs) to scale product compliance across multiple categories and policies. This will include visiting TICs, developing test plans for product testing, and engaging in business development to expand the TIC network. This role will also be engaged in improving selling partner experience by coordinating with business teams and addressing selling partner pain points.

The candidate must be comfortable balancing strategic thinking with tactical, detailed execution while working independently, sorting through ambiguously defined problems, identifying and facing big challenges, and adjusting to sudden and frequent change. Think of this role as a non-technical “solution architect” where you will be given the autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective mechanisms to scale policy compliance.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary liaison with TICs
• Develop and optimize test plans across multiple product categories
• Identify and onboard new TIC partners to expand network capabilities
• Drive strategic growth initiatives with existing TIC partners
• Create and maintain documentation for TIC processes and procedures
• Maintain regular communication channels with TIC partners for day-to-day operations
• Coordinate with internal business teams to streamline selling partner experience
• Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and selling partner challenges
• Develop and track key performance metrics
• Prepare and present progress reports to leadership

About the team
Here at Selling Partner Services, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 14 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 10,000+ employees in chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our DEI Ambassador Program. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working with TICs on product testing
Preferred qualifications:
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

jobs.title: Principal, CTV Measurement, Amazon Ads Strategy & Business Development
jobs.description:
Advance the future of Connected TV (CTV) advertising measurement by developing innovative strategies that help advertisers unlock unprecedented insights and value. In this pivotal role, you'll bridge technology, partnerships, and strategic vision to evolve how brands understand and optimize their CTV advertising investments across Amazon's premium video properties and third-party publisher partnerships.

As Principal, CTV Measurement Strategy & Business Development, you will lead the development and execution of measurement strategies that enable advertisers to better quantify and maximize the value of premium CTV investments. You'll drive thought leadership across industry bodies, evaluate emerging measurement technologies and partnerships, and build business development frameworks that extend beyond any single initiative to deliver long-term organizational value. Expect to move seamlessly between executive strategy sessions, technical deep dives, and cross-functional collaboration.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic vision and collaborative execution. You'll work at the intersection of product innovation, partnership development, and go-to-market strategy to ensure Amazon Ads remains at the forefront of CTV measurement innovation. Work collaboratively with industry measurement providers and standards bodies to support advertiser choice and innovation across CTV.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop comprehensive measurement strategies for CTV advertising across Amazon's video properties and publisher partnerships
- Drive innovation in measurement solutions that address diverse advertiser needs
- Lead strategic business development initiatives with measurement providers and technology platforms
- Represent Amazon Ads in industry associations and standards bodies
- Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, and Analytics teams to translate market insights into actionable strategies
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 10+ years of professional experience in advertising technology, measurement, media, or related fields
- Proven track record of leading complex business development initiatives and strategic partnerships in the digital advertising or media ecosystem
- Deep expertise in video/CTV measurement methodologies, including panel-based measurement, census-based approaches, and emerging alternatives
- Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive consensus across multiple stakeholder groups
- Experience working with measurement providers, publishers, advertisers, or advertising technology platforms
- Strong analytical skills with ability to evaluate technical solutions and business models
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or above in business administration, economics, mathematics, engineering, statistics or related field
- Experience with advertising publishers and marketing/creative agencies
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- Active participation in industry organizations such as IAB, ARF, VAB, or similar bodies
- Track record of thought leadership through published research, speaking engagements, or industry working groups
- Experience with data clean room technologies, privacy-preserving measurement, and identity solutions
- Understanding of programmatic advertising, DSP/SSP technologies, and ad serving infrastructure

jobs.title: Sr. Business Development Manager - Tech, Devices Advertising, Devices Advertising, Amazon Publisher Monetization
jobs.description:
Drive the growth and adoption of Amazon’s device advertising solutions. As a Senior Tech Business Developer on our Publisher Monetization Device Advertising team, you’ll lead the launch and expansion of key advertising initiatives across new customer segments and markets. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring innovative advertising solutions to life, shaping go-to-market strategies, scaling existing channels, and delivering measurable revenue impact for Amazon Devices.

This role requires approximately 15% travel, primarily to meet with key partners and sales teams to align on strategic goals and drive adoption.

Key job responsibilities
Develop and execute a business plan focused on demand generation and adoption strategies, working closely with key stakeholders across business teams

Identify and implement innovative strategies to drive business growth, efficiency and scale within the device display advertising business

Define business goals based on market segmentation and customer insights

Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, program and engineering teams to address customer needs and achieve revenue targets

Lead the day-to-day health of the business, ensuring smooth execution and alignment with strategic objectives

Build and maintain relationships with senior leadership to drive business growth and optimization

Collaborate with product and engineering teams to refine and enhance products/services based on market feedback

Set forth mechanisms to track adoption goals, set efficient sales motions to achieve desired outcomes

Prepare and present monthly business reviews on roadmap updates, strategic business inputs, output metrics, adoption goals, and financial performance

Define and analyze key business metrics to drive customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth

A day in the life
As a Business Development Manager on our team, you'll focus on scaling our device display advertising business through strategic planning and cross-functional collaboration. Your day might include meeting with sales teams to align on adoption goals, analyzing market data to identify growth opportunities, or working with product and engineering partners to understand how new capabilities can address customer needs. You'll prepare business reviews that showcase roadmap progress and financial performance, while also building relationships with key partners and senior leadership. Your work spans multiple initiatives—from launching new ad capabilities to expanding into emerging markets—all while ensuring smooth day-to-day operations and strategic alignment across teams.

About the team

We’re rapidly expanding our shipping and delivery services to brands and merchants across the U.S., and we’re looking for entrepreneurial Business Development leaders who can help customers meet rising end-customer expectations in an increasingly competitive landscape.

You will leverage data and industry insights to teach customers something new about their business, tailor Amazon’s solutions to their unique goals, and guide them through complex decision cycles. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Tech, and Operations to translate customer needs into scalable solutions and help define the future of Amazon Shipping.

• Serve as the voice of the customer, translating market signals and customer feedback into clear inputs for Product, Tech, Operations, and other Amazon teams to improve features, performance, and scalability.

You excel in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments, influence senior stakeholders with clarity and confidence, and consistently drive deals toward measurable outcomes.

You quickly understand complex businesses, uncover the true drivers behind customer decisions, and translate those insights into clear recommendations. You build trust through expertise and preparation, communicate with precision, and operate with the ownership required to support a rapidly growing business.

jobs.description:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

- Partner with leaders to ensure equitable talent practices across selection, development, and advancement decisions. Champion initiatives that create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

- Drive adoption of HR technology solutions, AI, and self-service tools, ensuring effective utilization while maintaining focus on high-touch service delivery in critical moments. Identify opportunities to enhance user experience and process efficiency.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. You'll focus on driving organizational effectiveness and employee engagement, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and develop solutions that enhance workplace experience and deliver measurable results.

From coaching leadership teams on workforce and talent management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with business leaders to develop forward-looking strategies focused on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll build strong partnerships across all levels of the organization while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements.

Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through a combination of business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered, while driving long-term organizational success and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business landscape.

jobs.description:
Join our Fleet Strategy and Supply Chain team to manage operational relationships with one of our largest fleet management partners, overseeing approximately 20,000 vehicles across 8+ countries. As part of a new team focusing on supplier coordination, you'll serve as a critical bridge between Amazon and our supplier partners, using data-driven insights to optimize fleet operations, resolve complex challenges, and shape the future of our global commercial vehicle supply chain while managing over $1 billion in annual fleet spend.

Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate operations with fleet management partners by leading regular strategic meetings with partner leadership and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities and addressing conflicting directives across teams

- Monitor and improve fleet management partner performance by tracking key metrics, measuring performance against contractual standards, and collaborating on continuous improvement initiatives

- Maintain visibility across the supply chain by tracking vehicle movement through all stages of the fleet lifecycle, ensuring accurate data flow, and identifying bottlenecks or inefficiencies

- Develop and evolve fleet management strategies by collaborating on contract developments, identifying opportunities to expand into new regions and vehicle types, and shaping the future direction of the partnership

- Optimize internal processes and workflows by regularly assessing how teams interact with fleet management partners, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing changes that enhance efficiency and effectiveness

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on maintaining seamless coordination between Amazon and our fleet management partner across multiple countries and vehicle types. Your day might include reviewing fleet metrics from the past 24 hours to identify emerging issues, conducting deep-dive analyses into operational data to uncover root causes of performance gaps, and following up with internal and external partners to implement corrective action plans. You'll also prepare for monthly business reviews by compiling performance data, collaborate with leadership on strategic proposals for fleet expansion into new regions, and work to streamline processes that keep our supply chain running smoothly. Throughout it all, you'll balance the needs of both Amazon and our supplier partners, ensuring clear communication and alignment across all teams.

About the team
We are the operational engine of Amazon's global fleet strategy, partnering with original equipment manufacturers, fleet management companies, and internal teams to deliver the right fleet capacity at the right time and cost. Our team coordinates complex logistics across continents, manages billions of dollars in supplier relationships, and uses data to continuously improve how we operate. We're looking for someone who can thrive in this collaborative environment; someone who can represent Amazon's interests while building and maintaining strong partnerships with our suppliers. You'll work alongside colleagues who are passionate about solving supply chain challenges, and together, we're shaping how Amazon manages one of the world's largest commercial vehicle fleets. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a global scale while working with a team that values both analytical rigor and relationship-building.

- Bachelor's degree

- Experience creating and improving processes
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

jobs.title: Senior Fleet Partner Manager, Fleet Strategy and Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Join our Fleet Strategy and Supply Chain team to manage operational relationships with one of our largest fleet management partners, overseeing approximately 20,000 vehicles across 8+ countries. As part of a new team focusing on supplier coordination, you'll serve as a critical bridge between Amazon and our supplier partners, using data-driven insights to optimize fleet operations, resolve complex challenges, and shape the future of our global commercial vehicle supply chain while managing over $1 billion in annual fleet spend.

Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate operations with fleet management partners by leading regular strategic meetings with partner leadership and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities and addressing conflicting directives across teams

- Monitor and improve fleet management partner performance by tracking key metrics, measuring performance against contractual standards, and collaborating on continuous improvement initiatives

- Maintain visibility across the supply chain by tracking vehicle movement through all stages of the fleet lifecycle, ensuring accurate data flow, and identifying bottlenecks or inefficiencies

- Develop and evolve fleet management strategies by collaborating on contract developments, identifying opportunities to expand into new regions and vehicle types, and shaping the future direction of the partnership

- Optimize internal processes and workflows by regularly assessing how teams interact with fleet management partners, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing changes that enhance efficiency and effectiveness

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on maintaining seamless coordination between Amazon and our fleet management partner across multiple countries and vehicle types. Your day might include reviewing fleet metrics from the past 24 hours to identify emerging issues, conducting deep-dive analyses into operational data to uncover root causes of performance gaps, and following up with internal and external partners to implement corrective action plans. You'll also prepare for monthly business reviews by compiling performance data, collaborate with leadership on strategic proposals for fleet expansion into new regions, and work to streamline processes that keep our supply chain running smoothly. Throughout it all, you'll balance the needs of both Amazon and our supplier partners, ensuring clear communication and alignment across all teams.

About the team
We are the operational engine of Amazon's global fleet strategy, partnering with original equipment manufacturers, fleet management companies, and internal teams to deliver the right fleet capacity at the right time and cost. Our team coordinates complex logistics across continents, manages billions of dollars in supplier relationships, and uses data to continuously improve how we operate. We're looking for someone who can thrive in this collaborative environment—someone who can represent Amazon's interests while building and maintaining strong partnerships with our suppliers. You'll work alongside colleagues who are passionate about solving supply chain challenges, and together, we're shaping how Amazon manages one of the world's largest commercial vehicle fleets. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a global scale while working with a team that values both analytical rigor and relationship-building.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience managing complex and fast-moving issues
- Experience identifying and improving business processes
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience in vendor management

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager - Inspection, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience, Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)
jobs.description:
Designation: Senior Risk Manager - Inspection, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
Team: Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE), Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership
Location: Hyderabad, India (Work from Office)
Level: L6
Job Type: Full Time, Regular

OVERVIEW

Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership. This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazons risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes, with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable (AR) and Payroll.

You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with senior stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions.

This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction.

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits, inspections, and risk assessments across Finance Operations, with particular focus on Accounts Receivable and Payroll.

Conduct end to end assessments spanning process design, policy, organization structure, systems, technology, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.

Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identify control gaps, and quantify the potential impact of identified risks.

Identify emerging and material risks across Finance Operations and develop data driven recommendations to mitigate them.

Own the full lifecycle of high impact, cross functional risk and governance programs from problem definition through implementation, measurement, and closure.

Define program objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics, and establish mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of remediation.

Partner with Finance, Controllership, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Internal Audit to prioritize risks and drive sustainable remediation.

Influence senior stakeholders to adopt scalable, automated, and sustainable controls rather than manual or recurring interventions.

Evaluate policy and process exceptions, determine the associated risk, and recommend appropriate mitigation.

Perform deep dives into complex processes and data to identify root causes, systemic risks, control weaknesses, and process improvement opportunities.

Produce clear, data driven audit reports, risk assessments, executive narratives, and recommendations for senior leadership.

Support external regulatory, statutory, and internal audit requests, including evidence gathering, issue resolution, and remediation tracking.

Build and deliver training and awareness programs that raise the bar on controllership, risk management, policy adherence, and control ownership across Finance Operations.

Leverage data analytics, automation, and technology to improve risk identification, continuous monitoring, audit efficiency, and control effectiveness.

Establish mechanisms that prevent recurring risks and embed remediation into business processes and operating routines.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. You will own the questions that matter most to the health of Finance Operations.
2. Where are the material risks within complex Finance Operations processes?
3. Are existing controls appropriately designed to mitigate those risks, and are they operating effectively in practice?
4. What breaks when a process spans multiple systems, teams, or geographies?
5. Are recurring issues being resolved at the root cause, or simply remediated repeatedly?
6. How can technology, automation, and data detect and prevent risks earlier?
7. What mechanisms can make risk management scalable as Finance Operations grows?
8. You will turn these questions into actionable insights, sustainable mechanisms, and measurable risk reduction.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

A typical day might start with leading a risk assessment of a complex Accounts Receivable or Payroll process, analyzing operational and financial data to identify control weaknesses, reviewing findings with process owners, and working with Technology and Finance teams to design an automated control.

You may also prepare an executive level risk narrative, challenge a remediation plan, review policy exceptions, facilitate a cross functional risk review, or support a statutory auditor request.

The role moves fluidly between deep process analysis and senior level stakeholder influence. Some days will be highly analytical, while others will require aligning multiple teams on a risk response and executing against it.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team strengthens the risk, governance, control, and operational mechanisms that enable Finance Operations to scale.

FORGE partners across Finance Operations and the broader Amazon organization to identify risks, strengthen controls, improve governance, and drive sustainable process transformation.

We combine risk expertise, operational understanding, data, technology, and durable mechanisms to build a Finance Operations environment that is resilient, scalable, and ready for the future.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Risk Management, or a related field.

10 or more years of experience in risk management, internal audit, controllership, finance operations, compliance, or a related field.

Experience leading complex audits, risk assessments, control assessments, or large scale process improvement programs.

Experience with Accounts Receivable, Order to Cash, O2C, OTC, Payroll, Hire to Retire, H2R, Finance Operations, or Controllership processes.

Experience identifying control gaps, assessing risk, developing recommendations, and driving remediation.

Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to work across complex data and processes.

Experience influencing cross functional stakeholders and operating effectively in a matrixed environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Masters degree, MBA, or a professional certification such as CA, CPA, CMA, CIA, or CISA.

Experience with global Finance Operations or multinational organizations.

Experience with finance, process, or controllership transformation initiatives.

Experience designing or implementing automated and technology enabled controls.

Experience applying data analytics, automation, or continuous monitoring techniques to risk identification and audit.

Experience supporting regulatory, statutory, or external audit engagements.

Strong track record creating executive level presentations, risk narratives, and data driven recommendations.

Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.

Experience leading large, cross functional programs from strategy through execution.

Knowledge of financial systems, ERP environments, and integration between finance and operational systems.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex risk clearly to senior leadership.

AMAZON LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

The successful candidate will demonstrate strength across Amazons Leadership Principles, particularly Ownership, Dive Deep, Deliver Results, Earn Trust, Invent and Simplify, Think Big, Have Backbone, Disagree and Commit, and Customer Obsession.

This role is ideal for a risk professional who can dive deep into complex problems, challenge existing mechanisms, influence without authority, and turn risk insights into scalable business solutions.

Successful candidates should have strong audit and risk management capabilities, excellent problem solving skills, and a deep understanding of Finance Operations processes, systems, and controls.

jobs.title: Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Amazon Intermodal
jobs.description:
Amazon's Intermodal (AZIM) team is looking for a strategic, analytically-minded leader to join as a Senior Supply Chain Manager focused on intermodal network optimization. This is a high-impact role responsible for driving cost efficiency, operational performance, and strategic supply decisions across Amazon's intermodal network — spanning drayage operations, rail partnerships, equipment utilization, and mode optimization.

The ideal candidate combines deep analytical capability with the ability to set strategic direction, is comfortable influencing cross-functional partners and holding external providers accountable, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where data-driven decisions directly impact network cost and service reliability. This role requires someone who can both identify the "so what" from complex data and drive initiatives from concept through execution.

Key job responsibilities
Network Cost & Supply Optimization
-Develop and drive supply mix strategies that optimize cost, service, and capacity across Amazon's intermodal network
-Identify and execute initiatives to improve network efficiency — including drayage optimization, mode selection, carrier mix, and equipment utilization
-Build business cases for strategic investments and operational changes with quantified financial impact

Performance Management & Partner Accountability
-Monitor key performance indicators including transit time, on-time delivery, dwell, equipment ratios, and cost-per-unit metrics
-Own escalation and resolution processes for service failures, compliance gaps, and contractual disputes with external partners

Data-Driven Strategy & Insights
-Conduct deep-dive analyses on network performance data — including lane-level metrics, cost drivers, capacity utilization, and operational bottlenecks
-Translate analytical findings into strategic recommendations that influence network design, sourcing decisions, and operational improvements

Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence
-Partner with Product, Tech, and Finance to translate operational insights into product requirements, success metrics, and automation priorities
-Collaborate with Strategic Sourcing on contract strategy, providing data-driven inputs to support negotiation positions

Executive Communication & Reporting
-Develop and present weekly/monthly performance reviews and strategic recommendations to senior leadership
-Author whitepapers and strategy documents that articulate network optimization opportunities, financial impact, and recommended actions

A day in the life
Analyze network cost and performance dashboards to identify emerging trends, cost anomalies, or service degradation requiring action

Conduct deep dives on lane-level supply mix decisions — evaluating drayage vs. OTR trade-offs, carrier allocation, and capacity constraints

Lead performance review discussions with transportation partners to address service gaps and agree on corrective action plans

Partner with Product and Tech teams on roadmap priorities — translating operational pain points into product requirements

Develop strategy documents and business cases for network optimization initiatives, quantifying savings and implementation paths

Collaborate with Operations teams on execution challenges related to ramp congestion, equipment positioning, and carrier coordination

About the team
Amazon Intermodal (AZIM) is Amazon's internal intermodal transportation program, managing the movement of freight across the nation's Class 1 railroad network. The team oversees rail strategy, carrier relationships, operational execution, and financial performance for one of Amazon's most cost-efficient long-haul transportation modes. We partner closely with Strategic Sourcing, Drayage Operations, Security, and Finance to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-effective intermodal service at scale.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

jobs.title: Senior Creative Account Director, Brand Innovation Lab AU
jobs.description:
Amazon Ads' Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) is a global creative team that develops custom advertising solutions for brands. We combine Amazon's unique first-party insights, owned channels, and emerging technology to create breakthrough campaigns that go beyond standard ad products. The AU BIL team partners with advertisers to concept and deliver bespoke, experiences - from digital ideas, events, partnerships with Prime Video and mcuh muc more across the Amazon canvas for brands.

The Senior Solutions Manager will partner with internal teams to lead key accounts, and scope, pitch and execute one-of-a-kind campaigns for some of the world’s most valuable brands. Through excellence in strategic thinking, relationship management and project management this role will raise the creative bar for brands and their customers.

The Senior Solutions Manager helps the team navigate never-been-done-before situations and build lasting relationships with clients by partnering to address business and marketing challenges.

The Senior Solutions Manager will also work closely with creative and technical peers within the Brand Innovation Lab and other partner teams (e.g., Alexa, AWS, Prime Video, Twitch).

The Senior Solutions Manager will comfortable working with data and AI to find insights and write briefs that bring out the best in our creative team.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, agile leader with experience partnering with Creative, Technical and Sales teams to deliver bar-raising results for advertisers. A person who isn't afraid to wear many hats and get scrappy to find solutions in a small team with a start-up mentality that thrives in change.

Key job responsibilities
Build relationships with Advertising clients as a partner in addressing their business and marketing challenges, helping them navigate the Amazon Canvas and unlock customer centric innovation.

Work with Sales Leads and Directors to help them understand where their business can benefit from Brand Innovation Lab, while identifying opportunities for BIL to innovate to help drive incremental revenue.

Learn about new opportunities within and outside Amazon to inspire and push the Creative team to take full advantage of Amazon channels and products.

Play a frontline role in leading the development of pitches and proposals to Advertising clients.

Manage the intake vs. available resourcing process, striking the balance of saying “yes” to finding alternative solutions.

Utilize the team’s Salesforce and Asana systems ensuring data quality and output.

Foster internal relationships both on an individual level and on behalf of Brand Innovation Lab.

You'll partner with Art Directors, design technologists, program managers and producers to create innovative work by hacking the Amazon canvas (Alexa, Twitch, Prime Video, etc). You'll work on projects that benefit the end customer while pushing the creative envelope. And with new tech rolling out all the time, there's always an opportunity to create something innovative on behalf of our clients.

Some days you'll be helping set strategy for a key project, others you'll be project managing a complex never-been-done-before project removing ambiguity and laying a path for the team to succeed.

You'll be leading pitches to senior stakeholders and evangelising the role of creativity in driving business outcomes and improved customer experiences.
You'll be able to wear many hats to get the best creative outcome from project managing, strategy to digital and video production.

The Brand Innovation Lab team is the internal group within Amazon that creates one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers, like Pepsi, Lego, McDonald's, Samsung, and Mars.

Using all of the different platforms within the Amazon canvas (Custom landing pages on Amazon.com.au, Alexa, Twitch, Prime Video, etc.), we create campaigns that reach millions of Amazon customers across our digital channels and out in the real-world.

In Australia we're a small and scrappy team that is still building the future of Brand Innovation Lab in Australia.

jobs.title: Risk Manager-II, Controllership
jobs.description:
Amazon's Transportation Controllership team is an operations finance team that ensures accurate payment and revenue integrity across Amazon's worldwide logistics cost. This is achieved through strengthening internal and external controls by working closely with multiple internal stakeholders such as Operations, Procurement, Technology groups, and external stakeholders such as carriers. The team audits billions in annual transportation cost payables and focuses on ensuring payment accuracy and reporting integrity.

The Controllership team recently expanded its scope to Revenue Controllership, to evaluate risks across Amazon's revenue-generating businesses, including Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). Controllership conducts comprehensive controls assessments across key process areas including onboarding, invoice completeness, pricing, rates & margins, claims, and collections.

We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will execute transactional controls for last mile and revenue-side payments, conduct risk assessments, and drive compliance across assigned control areas. This role will support end-to-end Controllership by identifying control gaps, performing detailed testing, and working with business and technology teams to implement remediation actions. This is an individual contributor role.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute and monitor transactional controls across assigned payment and revenue streams, ensuring compliance with established policies and procedures.
• Conduct risk assessments and controls testing for revenue-generating businesses, focusing on process areas such as pricing, rates, margins, onboarding, and invoice completeness.
• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and control documentation for assigned audit areas.
• Perform root-cause analysis on control failures and exceptions, and recommend remediation actions.
• Challenge assumptions of why a process or mechanism failed, ask the questions to get to the root cause of the problem and work for a solve.
• Support the development and enhancement of the revenue controls playbook by documenting findings and best practices.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Procurement, and Technology teams to understand process flows and identify control gaps.
• Prepare and present audit findings, risk reports, and status updates to senior team members and stakeholders.
• Track and report on key risk metrics, escalating issues as appropriate.
Drive process improvements within the Controllership function by leveraging data analysis and lean methodologies.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience establishing successful partnerships with internal and external teams to execute tactical initiatives or equivalent
- Experience with data and analysis tools including Microsoft Excel and SQL
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (esp. MS Excel, Word) at an advanced level
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment, or experience in accounts receivable or account payable
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight
- • Experience conducting risk assessments or controls testing in a logistics, supply chain, or transportation finance environment
- • Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

jobs.description:
The Supplier Risk Manager is a senior-level role within Global Supplier Management (GSM), part of the Global Procurement Organization (GPO). This role owns the end-to-end design, development, and operationalization of supplier risk programs and policies protecting Amazon's global supply chain across ~$45B in annual spend.
You will architect comprehensive risk programs and establish the governance frameworks, analytics infrastructure, and resource models that enable scalable execution. The ideal candidate is a builder who thrives in ambiguity, defines both the “what” and the “how,” and drives cross-functional alignment at enterprise scale.

Key job responsibilities
Program Architecture & Execution
• Design and implement scalable supplier risk programs spanning financial, operational, reputational, safety, regulatory, tier-n, geopolitical, sustainability, and single/sole source risk domains
• Develop risk scoring methodologies, segmentation frameworks, and tiered monitoring approaches aligned to supplier criticality and spend exposure
• Build early warning systems to proactively identify emerging supplier risks before business impact occurs
• Consolidate siloed risk management activities into a unified, governed program portfolio with defined escalation pathways, response protocols, and supplier remediation frameworks
• Define program success metrics, reporting cadences, and escalation protocols
• Identify and secure resource support structures — team capacity, partner ownership, technology tools, or vendor support — that enable programs to operate at scale

Policy Development & Governance
• Author and maintain supplier risk management policies, standards, and procedures enabling consistent execution across all regions
• Establish governance mechanisms to ensure policy compliance and drive continuous improvement
• Partner with Legal, Compliance, GPO partners, and Finance to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and corporate standards
• Own policy lifecycle management including periodic reviews, updates, and stakeholder communication

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
• Collaborate with Category Managers, Supplier Performance Managers, and regional teams to embed risk considerations into sourcing decisions, business consequence decisions, and supplier lifecycle management
• Present risk posture, program performance, and policy recommendations to senior leadership
• Influence cross-functional partners without direct authority to adopt risk management practices and tools
• Champion a risk-aware culture across GSM and the broader GPO

Analytics & Continuous Improvement
• Lead design of data models and risk scoring methodologies integrating financial health assessments, background/suitability screening, ESG indicators, geopolitical signals, safety records, quality metrics, capacity, delivery, and other performance metrics
• Leverage data and analytics to identify risk trends, concentration risks, and portfolio vulnerabilities
• Drive automation and tooling improvements to increase program scalability and reduce manual effort
• Benchmark internal practices against industry standards and implement leading-edge approaches

A day in the life
• Global scope supporting all regions
• High degree of autonomy with expectation to define both strategy and execution
• Cross-functional collaboration with Category Management, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Security, Sustainability, and Operations teams
• Hybrid work environment; travel up to 50%
