jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Der/Die Senior HR Business Partner:in ist verantwortlich für operative Exzellenz und organisatorische Gesundheit durch PXT-Führung an den zugewiesenen Standorten. Als erfahrene HR-Führungskraft agierst du als Individual Contributor und arbeitest direkt mit Field Leaders, Standortleitungsteams und General Managers zusammen. Du bringst dabei die Seniorität und Glaubwürdigkeit mit, die für strategische Diskussionen zu komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen erforderlich sind. Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten und verantwortest Feedback-Mechanismen, Anerkennungsprogramme sowie Umgebungsstandards, die Vertrauen, Engagement und Leistung nachhaltig prägen. Diese Rolle erfordert die Balance zwischen taktischer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick – unter Nutzung von Technologie und menschlichem Urteilsvermögen, um qualitativ hochwertige Mitarbeitererlebnisse zu schaffen und gleichzeitig eine proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung voranzutreiben.
Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten und mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner Region (Campus) betreuen, mit regelmäßiger Mobilität zwischen den zugewiesenen Standorten.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement
Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation durch Voice of the Associate-Programme, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks mit zeitnaher Lösung von Anliegen und Stärkung der Beziehungen zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften. Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die die Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit messbar steigern. Schaffung eines inklusiven Umfelds, in dem sich Mitarbeitende sicher fühlen, ihre Meinung zu äußern und authentisch aufzutreten – durch die Etablierung von Employee Resource Groups und die Sicherstellung gerechter Talentpraktiken. Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche, um Vertrauen auf allen Ebenen aufzubauen und Anliegen frühzeitig zu erkennen, bevor sie eskalieren.

Operational Excellence & Site Standards
Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen durch regelmäßige Standortbegehungen und Etablierung von Routinen zur Einhaltung der Standards gemäß den Amazon-Vorgaben. Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams zur konsequenten Umsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards und -programmen. Leitung strategischer Community-Initiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations. Proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung durch die Einrichtung von Frühwarnsystemen, Nutzung von Datenerkenntnissen und fundierte Entscheidungen, die den Richtliniengeist mit den Geschäftsanforderungen in Einklang bringen. Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse nach strengen Standards sowie Durchführung von Inspektionen und Audits zur Sicherstellung der Compliance. Effektive Koordination mit Shared Services und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zur Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Serviceerbringung.

Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology
Führende Nutzung von Analysen und KI-Tools zur Aufdeckung verborgener Muster, Antizipation aufkommender Risiken und Förderung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung. Umwandlung von Erkenntnissen in überzeugende Narrative, die Senior Stakeholder beeinflussen und messbare Verbesserungen im Mitarbeitererlebnis und in der Unternehmensleistung vorantreiben. Strategische Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen und Self-Service-Tools für Effizienz und Exzellenz – unter Nutzung von Automatisierung bei gleichzeitiger Beibehaltung eines persönlichen Service für sensible Anliegen, die menschliches Urteilsvermögen und Empathie erfordern.

Strategic PXT Leadership
Regelmäßige Partnerschaft mit Standortleitungen und General Managers zur Balance zwischen operativen Anforderungen und Amazons Werten sowie Personalstrategie – mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen. Hinterfragen des Status quo und Förderung von Innovationen in HR-Praktiken bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen Umsetzung. Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektivem Personalmanagement, einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und komplexen Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen. Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Unterstützung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen. Festlegung klarer Ziele für die Kulturtransformation und Umsetzung umfassender Strategien zur systematischen Stärkung der Organisationsgesundheit, Talentkompetenzen und Führungseffektivität.

PXT Leadership & Organizational Health
Mitwirkung bei PXT-Personalentscheidungen, Ressourcenallokation und Dienstplanung zur Sicherstellung angemessener Abdeckung und Kompetenz. Beteiligung an Nachfolgeplanung und Beförderungsentscheidungen sowie Identifikation von High-Potential-Talenten und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Durchführung von Talentbewertungen für PXT-Teammitglieder mit Beiträgen zu Leistung, Potenzial und Entwicklungsbedarf. Unterstützung der Entwicklungsplanung und Beitrag zum Aufbau von Nachfolgekapazitäten für kritische Positionen. Beiträge zum Performance Management des PXT-Teams sowie Förderung einer positiven Teamkultur und Anerkennungspraktiken.

A day in the life
Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet strategisches Denken mit praxisnaher Umsetzung auf Standortebene. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verbessern. Vom Coaching von Senior Leaders bei komplexen Personalherausforderungen bis hin zur Förderung von HR-Prozessexzellenz arbeitest du eng mit Field Leaders und General Managers an zukunftsorientierten Strategien zusammen. Du pflegst eine starke Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche durch Standortbegehungen, Mitarbeiter-Feedback-Runden und strategische Initiativen und navigierst dabei komplexe organisatorische Herausforderungen mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen. Darüber hinaus trägst du zur organisatorischen Gesundheit des PXT-Teams durch Talentbewertungen, Nachfolgeplanung und Performance Management bei. Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten, in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und eine Unternehmenskultur zu schaffen, in der sich Mitarbeitende wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

About the team
Unsere HR-Abteilung bei Amazon spielt bei der Betreuung unserer Mitarbeitenden eine wesentliche Rolle. Oberste Priorität des sogenannten People Experience und Technology Solutions Team (PXT-Team) ist es, unseren Kolleg:innen ein großartiges Amazon-Erlebnis anzubieten und uns dabei zu helfen, eines der innovativsten, kundenorientiertesten und agilsten Unternehmen der Welt zu bleiben.
Wir arbeiten proaktiv und wenden einen holistischen Ansatz für das People Management an. „Customer Obsession“ – Die oberste Priorität haben immer unsere Kund:innen. Unser Team konzentriert sich darauf, Fragen in Bezug auf das Engagement der Mitarbeitenden zu lösen und dafür zu sorgen, dass nichts unser makelloses Mitarbeiter- und Kundenerlebnis beeinträchtigt. Unsere Aufgabe besteht darin, auf den allerhöchsten Standards zu bestehen und den Fortschritt in allen Strategie- und Zielbereichen von Amazon zu fördern.

- Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation
- Fließende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch
- Umfangreiche Erfahrung in einer HR-Führungsrolle oder eine Kombination aus gleichwertigen Erfahrungen (z. B. Operations, Kundenservice, Einzelhandel, Distribution, Versand/Logistik, Gesundheitswesen, Gastronomie/Hotellerie oder Produktion)
- Erfahrung im Einsatz von Daten und fundiertem Urteilsvermögen zur Unterstützung von Geschäftsentscheidungen
- Erfahrung in der Unterstützung und/oder Leitung mitarbeiterorientierter Prozesse wie Onboarding, Benefits, Ermittlungen, Schulungen und/oder Talentmanagement
Preferred qualifications:

Amazon is seeking an experienced Compensation Specialist to join our team. This role will support the implementation and ongoing management of complex compensation programs, including our Provider Incentive Plans, while serving as a strategic partner to business leaders across the organization.

About the Role
As a Compensation Specialist for One Medical you will manage complex compensation problems and influence key stakeholders to champion Amazon's compensation model. You will work independently on large-size projects and programs, providing strategic compensation solutions while building trusted relationships with business leaders. This role requires both tactical execution and strategic thinking to support organizational goals.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Compensation Management
1. Manage complex compensation problems and influence key stakeholders on One Medical and Amazon's compensation philosophy and strategy
2. Navigate ambiguity across multiple internal business initiatives, soliciting input from business and cross-functional teams
3. Anticipate business needs and create forward-looking compensation solutions, highlighting potential risks and barriers
4. Make trade-offs between short and long-term needs to achieve optimal outcomes

Stakeholder Partnership & Leadership
1. Build trusted relationships with senior and executive-level leadership through delivering results across various engagements
2. Manage and set stakeholder expectations by understanding their challenges and demonstrating flexibility and ownership
3. Lead Business and Steering Committee reviews and advocate for compensation program design and delivery
4. Educate others effectively on topics related to variable pay, Healthcare and assigned client groups

Program Design & Implementation
1. Lead implementation of complex incentive programs, including provider dashboard development, plan documentation, payroll readiness, controllership, standard operating procedures and continuous improvement
2. Create new frameworks and establish new and equitable business practices across multiple variable pay programs, such as incentive pay, merit incentives and professional development
3. Identify, define, and improve processes, automation, and tools that scale for client groups
4. Develop and deliver white papers (QBRs, policy and process documentation) to stakeholders
5. Drive scalable solutions and apply best practices to transaction processes
6. Draw insights from data to identify root causes, trends, and validate compensation assumptions for the variable pay plans

Cross-Functional Collaboration
1. Partner with teams including , HRIS (Workday) Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Legal, Employee Relations, Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, and Technology on multi-workstream initiatives
2. Coordinate across a vast range of stakeholders and manage complex milestones in multi-functional efforts
3. Respond appropriately to urgent or ad-hoc requests, identifying correct teams to involve and escalating as needed

jobs.title: HR Business Partner, PXT
jobs.description:
The Amazon HR team is passionate about business partnering in its truest sense. You will play a critical role in delivering the HR plan at our location fulfillment centre. You will work closely with the operations team providing pragmatic, commercial and employee-focussed advice and support to a client group. You will utilise your excellent communication, coaching and influencing skills to drive employee engagement and manage change, ensuring that we retain motivated teams of employees who can deliver an excellent service to our customers.

As an HR Business Partner, you will enjoy a varied role and a wide range of interactions across all levels on a daily basis. You will get exposure to many different aspects of the business and have the opportunity to work on national HR projects. Whatever you will focus on, it will all be aimed at delivering the highest quality service to our internal and external customers.

Key job responsibilities
Recruitment and Selection: All Amazon leaders are challenged to Hire and Develop the Best – it’s one of our leadership principles. You’ll support this by liaising with hiring managers and the talent acquisition team to ensure that vacancies are filled in a timely manner with high calibre candidates. You’ll work with the operations team to ensure that there is a robust succession plan in place and that we are developing our leaders and getting them ready for the next challenge. You will also support the site’s resourcing plan, taking responsibility as necessary for seasonal temporary recruitment through our agency partners, making sure that we select employees who want to exceed customer expectations.

Employee Relations & Engagement: Employee engagement is at the heart of everything we do. We need to care about our employees so they can care about our customers. jobs.title: HR Business Partner, EU PXT
jobs.description:

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die Mitarbeitende spürbar wertschätzen

- Schaffung eines Umfelds, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden sicher, gehört und einbezogen fühlen

- Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche — frühzeitige Anzeichen von Desengagement erkennen und aktiv darauf reagieren

Operational Excellence & Standortstandards

- Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams, um Sicherheitsprogramme an deinen Standorten konsequent umzusetzen

- Leitung von Community-Initiativen an deinen Standorten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Netzwerk sowie den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations

Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung & Technologie

- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um aufkommende Trends zu erkennen, Herausforderungen frühzeitig zu antizipieren und proaktive Lösungen umzusetzen

- Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen, KI-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen — bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung eines persönlichen Service in entscheidenden Momenten

Strategische PXT-Führung

- Partnerschaft mit der Standortleitung, um operative Anforderungen mit Amazons Werten und Personalstrategie in Einklang zu bringen

- Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektiven Personalmanagement-Praktiken — einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen

- Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Begleitung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen

- Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse unter Aufbau von Vertrauen und Einfluss durch fundiertes unternehmerisches Denken

A day in the life
Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen — und genau das macht diese Rolle so spannend. Dein Arbeitsalltag ist eine dynamische Mischung aus strategischem Denken und praktischer Problemlösung. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen, die Bedürfnisse deiner Standorte zu antizipieren und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis wirklich verbessern.

Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, organisatorische Dynamiken zu navigieren, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten und in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Durch unternehmerisches Denken, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und starke Partnerschaften trägst du dazu bei, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

Amazon's mission is to be the earth's most customer-centric company. We are looking for a smart and ambitious risk management professional to join Amazon's Global Retirement & Investments team in London, UK. As a Global Retirement Risk Manager, you will collaborate and partner with a team of retirement professionals, working extensively with Amazon's legal, tax, benefits, compensation, HR shared services, technology and operational teams to identify, assess, mitigate and monitor risks across the organization's global retirement programs and ensure compliance obligations are met.

This hands-on individual contributor role requires a subject matter expert who will partner with internal stakeholders and external consultants/vendors to execute on all retirement benefit matters and regulatory requirements for our International retirement programs.
The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive risk management strategies and frameworks for program and project management to support our international retirement plans, define risk governance structures with internal stakeholders and external partners, document risk assessment processes and control requirements; implement business-level risk monitoring mechanisms; develop and execute on program/business level risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies, and manage risk reporting metrics and dashboards. They will also have responsibility for plan design, governance and fiduciary oversight; improving the employee experience and have oversight of investment fund management, across multiple EU countries.

Qualified candidates need to have prior pension/retirement program management experience with a strong focus on risk assessment and mitigation, and the ability to utilize data to make recommendations for improvements that will benefit our employees. The ideal candidate must have strong critical thinking skills, superior attention to detail with sound judgement, highly organized, analytical, excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, and have a strong passion for customer service, the employee experience, and risk management excellence.

Experience with AI-powered analytics tools and automation platforms for risk monitoring, predictive modeling, and dashboard development; familiarity with generative AI applications for data analysis, reporting automation, and risk modeling is highly desirable.

- Risk Strategy & Framework: Develop and implement comprehensive risk management solutions that identify, assess, and mitigate pension-related risks while supporting strategic initiatives, optimizing employee experience, and scaling for future growth.
- Risk Assessment & Monitoring: Review international retirement plans to identify operational, financial, regulatory, and reputational risks, ensuring operations meet risk tolerance thresholds and regulatory obligations.
- Risk Mitigation: Develop and implement corrective action plans to resolve vulnerabilities and address emerging risk scenarios, including proactive identification of compliance gaps, operational risks, and fiduciary threats.
- Project & Escalation Management: Execute risk assessments for retirement/savings projects, audits, and compliance reviews, communicating findings and mitigation strategies. Respond to and resolve escalations while maintaining appropriate risk controls.
- Risk Intelligence & Reporting: Research risk scenarios, maintain country-specific risk inventories with impact assessments, and develop automated dashboards using AI tools. Become proficient in Amazon systems and risk management tools.
- Regulatory Monitoring & Governance: Track regulatory changes affecting international pension programs and develop risk-adjusted compliance strategies. Lead or participate in RFI/RFPs, ensuring risk considerations are embedded in vendor selection and management.

HRBPは、担当するFCで働く従業員をカスタマーと考え、FCのリーダーの人事戦略パートナーとして、ビジネス成長に欠かせない組織・人材面の意思決定をサポートする上での重要な役割を担います。
組織開発、人材育成・配置、キャリア形成の機会、組織文化の醸成など、短期・中長期にわたるさまざまなHRソリューションを人事部門の他チームやメンバーと連携・協働しながら提供します。
また、勤務地は埼玉県坂戸市ですが、影響範囲は勤務するFCに留まらず、様々なプロジェクトを通じて他拠点にも貢献する機会があります。

Key job responsibilities
このポジションでは、採用、評価、配置、退職といった一連の人事管理と、FCで働く従業員の勤怠や労務環境を管理する労務管理について、ハンズオンなアプローチで責任を持って業務遂行して頂きます。
具体的には、人事データを分析し、FCの組織における問題点を特定し、タレントマネジメントを行うことで、組織横断的に戦略的な人事配置や人材開発を行なったり、パフォーマンスや言動に問題ある社員対応を行なう等、あらゆる人事課題の問題解決までの方向性を提案、道筋を立ててマネージャーと連携することもあります。
これらの業務を遂行するため、高いコミュニケーション能力とハンズオンのアプローチが必要です。また、論理的かつ分析能力に優れ、労働法、組織開発、報酬・福利厚生等における幅広い知識を持っている必要があります。
FCの従業員構成は、製造業・物流業・小売業等と類似しており、年俸制の社員に加え、時間給パートタイマーや、派遣社員・請負労働者を含みます。
上記業界での経験は、目まぐるしく変化するビジネス環境に適応することに役立ちます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

A day in the life
【HRBPとして働くやりがいとチャレンジ】
事業成長スピードが速い会社の人事として、ビジネス感覚（スピード感）を鍛えることが出来ます。
ヒトをどのように活かしていくのかHR専門性をもって働くことが期待され、責任ある業務がアサインされ、やりがいを感じます。
大きなHR組織でピープルマネジメントするチャンス、グローバル企業ならではの仕事としては、HQから新しい施策を日本国内に導入する機会等、多岐に渡ります。

我々はHRBPのDiversity拡大にも取り組んでいます。HRジェネラリストだけでなく、特定エリアのスペシャリストで、HRBPになることを目指している方も歓迎します。（例: HRコンサルタントやHRのアウトソーシング業務に携わっている方など）。
このようなバックグラウンドの方々には、培ったスキルを発揮し、私たちのHR Operationをより高いレベルに引き上げていただくことを期待しています。

【勤務形態】

jobs.title: HR Business Partner, PXT
jobs.description:
Creating a culture where all our people feel encouraged and supported is what makes Amazon a great place to work. As an HR Business Partner, you’ll drive a positive employee experience through your detailed grasp of HR programmes, processes, and tools, offering credible and clear HR advice to Amazon’s managers. From resolving complex HR queries with colleagues to perfecting new policies and programmes, you’ll be making a real difference in how Amazon operates.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and deliver projects and drive progress towards business goals
- Engage and coordinate with key stakeholders on data collection and policy implementation
- Resolve high-level employee issues, including grievances, appeals and complex disciplinary issues
- Coach and develop HR colleagues and stakeholders across the business
- Where relevant, co-ordinate with work councils and unions to drive positive employee relations
- Analyse internal dashboards to create reports on key metrics for leadership at your site

A day in the life
HR Business Partners get involved in a wide range of different projects and work with a mix of diverse stakeholders, all with one goal: to make Amazon a great place to work. You’ll be based in an Amazon fulfilment centre, delivery station or sortation centre and will frequently use data to inform key decisions.

From one day to the next, you could be taking the lead on a range of different projects or supporting senior stakeholders with developing strategies and carrying out regular talent reviews. You’ll be taking a fresh look at our working culture and thinking of new ways to optimise them.

You’ll also be supporting new colleagues to develop and learn new skills, so as well as shaping our working culture, you’ll be helping our colleagues grow. There will be plenty of opportunities for you to progress and shape your career at Amazon.

About the team
At Amazon, our HR department plays a vital role in looking after our people. Known as the People Experience and Technology Solutions (PXT) team, our priority is making the Amazon experience brilliant for our people, helping us remain one of the world’s most innovative, customer-centric and nimble businesses.

We operate proactively and take a holistic approach to people management. Our team is ‘Customer Obsessed’ and focuses on solving employee engagement issues quickly, ensuring nothing impacts our seamless employee and customer experience. Ultimately, it’s our job to insist on the highest standards and drive progress across Amazon’s strategy and goals.
Basic qualifications:
- Knowledge of local labor law
- Experience in HR within an international, fast-paced and customer-driven environment
- Experience in a call center, distribution center, or manufacturing environment
- Experience supporting hourly employee client group
- Experience with MS Office tools and HR Information Systems
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in Human Resources Management
- Experience in human resources with companies supporting 250-500 or more associates
- Experience managing and leading employees

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice ( https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page ) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Partenaire RH - HRBP , EU PXT
jobs.description:
Amazon a à cœur de créer une culture où tous nos employé·es se sentent valorisés et soutenus. Notre objectif : faire d’Amazon un endroit où il fait bon travailler. En tant que partenaire RH, vous contribuerez à la création d’une expérience positive pour les employé·es grâce à votre connaissance approfondie des programmes, des processus et des outils RH. Vous accompagnerez les responsables d’Amazon dans la mise en œuvre de leur politique RH et dans la gestion des salarié·es. En collaborant avec vos collègues pour résoudre des questions RH complexes ou pour mettre au point de nouvelles politiques et de nouveaux programmes, vous aurez un impact concret sur le fonctionnement d’Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Mener à bien vos propres projets pour aider l’entreprise à atteindre ses objectifs
Dialoguer et collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes à la collecte de données et à la mise en œuvre des politiques
Résoudre les problèmes majeurs des employé·es, y compris les plaintes, les recours et les questions disciplinaires complexes
Encadrer et former les collègues des RH et les parties prenantes dans l’ensemble de l’entreprise
Le cas échéant, assurer la coordination avec les comités d’entreprise et les syndicats afin de favoriser des relations positives avec les employé·es
Analyser les tableaux de bord internes afin de créer des rapports sur les principaux indicateurs à l’intention des dirigeants de votre site

A day in the life
Les partenaires RH prennent part à un large éventail de projets et collaborent avec différentes parties prenantes dans un seul objectif : faire d’Amazon un endroit où il fait bon travailler. Vous serez basé·e dans l’un de nos centres de traitement des commandes, de livraison ou de tri et vous prendrez des décisions à partir de données concrètes.
Aucun jour ne ressemblera à un autre. Vous pourriez, le lundi, diriger une série projets et, le lendemain, aider la direction à élaborer des stratégies et à réaliser des évaluations routinières des talents. Vous porterez un regard neuf sur notre culture de travail et réfléchirez à de nouvelles solutions pour l’optimiser.
Vous aiderez les nouvelles recrues à acquérir de nouvelles compétences, progresser et évoluer et vous contribuerez également à façonner notre culture de travail. Vous aurez de nombreuses occasions d’évoluer et de faire progresser votre carrière chez Amazon.

About the team
Le service RH joue un rôle essentiel dans le fonctionnement de l’entreprise et la gestion des collaborateurs·trices. jobs.description:

Part of the Amazon One Medical People Experience Team, the HR Operations team is seeking a highly motivated Disability & Leave Specialist to join our team. Reporting to the Manager, HR Operations, the Disability & Leave Specialist will interface with employees and our outsourced leave & disability vendor to answer questions, serve as the internal point of contact, and escalation resource throughout an employee's leave of absence. - Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner, EU PXT
jobs.description:
Amazon schafft eine Unternehmenskultur, in der sich alle Menschen ermutigt und unterstützt fühlen. Das macht uns zu einem großartigen Arbeitsplatz. Als HR Business Partner:in förderst du aktiv ein positives Mitarbeitererlebnis. Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, das Amazon-Management zu unterstützen, indem du dank deiner umfassenden Kenntnisse der Personalprogramme und -prozesse glaubwürdige und klare Personalberatung bietest. Indem du mit Kollegen zusammenarbeitest, um komplexe Personalfragen zu lösen und neue Richtlinien und Programme zu optimieren, wirst du einen erheblichen Einfluss auf den Betriebsabläufen bei Amazonhaben.

Key job responsibilities
- Du bist ein integraler Bestandteil des Entscheidungsprozesses in Bezug auf Einstellungen, Vertragsverlängerungen und die Beendigung des Arbeitsverhältnisses innerhalb des Unternehmens

jobs.title: Manager, People Programs & Workforce Transformation, GO-AI
jobs.description:
The Manager, People Programs & Workforce Transformation will lead the end-to-end talent lifecycle for GO-AI's associate workforce; spanning engagement, performance management, workforce mobility, instructional design, AI upskilling, internal communications, and leadership development. You will own the systems that determine how talent is assessed, certified, moved between programs, and prepared for an AI-augmented future. You will design the certification frameworks that feed automated workforce allocation tools, build the career architecture for roles evolving from manual annotation toward AI quality oversight, and ensure the high-volume hiring pipeline delivers associates who meet readiness standards from day one.
As GO-AI evolves from a labor-led service to a tech-enabled operation, this role is the engine of workforce transformation, ensuring associates are skilled for emerging AI-augmented work, leaders are developed at every level, and talent mobility systems connect workforce supply to program demand with minimal friction.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and evolve the talent programs portfolio across four sub-verticals: Talent Development, Instructional Design, Internal Communications, and Data Insights, ensuring they operate as a unified system serving all Ops pillars
• Own the high-volume hiring pipeline for annotation associates, including assessment design, intake criteria, onboarding velocity targets, and quality-of-hire measurement
• Build and deliver the AI workforce readiness strategy, including upskilling curriculum, digital learning paths, and proficiency certification for associates and leaders operating in AI-augmented workflows
• Define career architecture for evolving roles, establishing progression criteria, skill taxonomies, and readiness assessments at each transition point
• Design and maintain competency certification frameworks that define the skill assessments and certification gates governing cross-pillar workforce movement
• Drive leadership development programs, ensuring structured learning pathways exist at each career transition and measuring leadership effectiveness as a standard metric
• Own retention and engagement levers including employee sentiment platforms, recognition programs, and communications that connect associates across India and Costa Rica to organizational direction
• Lead and develop a geographically distributed team across India and Costa Rica, spanning program managers, instructional designers, communications specialists, and data insights analyst

About the team
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of team management experience
- 6+ years of learning & development, talent management, or program management experience
- Experience managing complex curriculum portfolios or learning solution lifecycles for large learner populations (1,000+)
- Experience designing competency or certification frameworks at scale
- Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or expert workforce environments
- Experience with workforce mobility, internal talent marketplace, or skills-based talent systems that feed automated workforce allocation decisions
- Experience with high-volume associate hiring pipelines including assessment design and onboarding program ownership
- Experience deploying AI-enabled learning tools (LLM-based training, adaptive learning platforms, AI-powered content generation)
- Experience driving cultural engagement and retention programs

AWS Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) is seeking a Risk Specialist to join our team within Risk Management Excellence (RMX). In this role, you will serve as a key operator within the TPRM program, responsible for monitoring, assessing, and reporting on risks associated with AWS’s critical third-party ecosystem.

You will manage ongoing risk surveillance through the Sentinel platform, produce executive-level risk intelligence reports, support regulatory audits, lead financial viability assessments, and coordinate incident response documentation. This is a highly cross-functional role that partners with AWS service teams, legal, compliance, supply chain, and external vendors to ensure third-party risks are identified, measured, and mitigated.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong analytical skills, an eye for process improvement, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving cloud infrastructure environment.

Key job responsibilities
You will monitor third-party risk alerts and escalate issues as they arise, ensuring risks are identified and addressed quickly. You will own the monthly risk report from draft through executive distribution, and track key metrics that measure program health. You will produce on-demand risk profiles for internal stakeholders using financial intelligence platforms and AI-assisted tooling. You will lead financial viability assessments for critical vendors—collecting due diligence reviews, distributing risk surveys, and scoring financial health—while partnering with engineering to automate data collection. You will serve as the team’s point of contact for regulatory and customer audits, and document third-party incidents in coordination with security operations. You will also drive vendor reassessments, process risk nominations for new and existing third parties, and participate in launch reviews for new AWS services. Throughout, you will look for ways to streamline operations through automation, tooling improvements, and well-maintained runbooks.

A day in the life
You start the day triaging Sentinel alerts and actioning third-party risk indicators—executing overrides, updating logs, and filing tickets. Midday, you shift to project work: pulling financial health data for a viability assessment, drafting a risk summary for a stakeholder request, or coordinating audit evidence with a program manager. You may join a cross-functional call with Legal or Supply Chain on an open incident. Afternoons are for reporting and improvement—updating reassessment trackers, compiling the flash report, or partnering with engineering on an automation that saves the team hours each week.

The Risk Management Excellence (RMX) team within AWS FGBS serves as the central hub for enterprise risk management across AWS. We partner with Legal, Compliance, Security, Finance, and business teams to ensure coordinated risk management at scale. The team is collaborative, intellectually curious, and committed to operational excellence. jobs.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Risk Manager to own and mature the risk, controls, and compliance framework within Amazon Leo's Global Service Compliance (GSC) organization, with a focus on Network and Security compliance obligations. Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are seeking a Sr. Risk Manager to own and mature the risk and controls framework within our regulatory security and network compliance portfolio. This leader will identify, assess, and mitigate security and compliance risks across regulated product and service lines by designing scalable control environments, driving continuous risk monitoring, and ensuring adherence to applicable regulatory obligations. This individual will assess complex, competing priorities across security and network controls, regulatory obligations, and business timelines; making informed trade-offs that balance compliance rigor with operational agility. The role requires deep expertise in building risk-based control structures within highly regulated environments, partnering with security engineering, legal, and compliance teams to embed proactive risk management into operational processes. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in regulatory frameworks, control design and testing, and the ability to translate complex risk landscapes into actionable mitigation strategies and executive-ready reporting. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic about technology, enjoys being continually challenged, and demonstrates sound judgment even in ambiguous situations.

Key job responsibilities
* Creating and implementing a compliance control framework and owning the end-to-end internal control lifecycle for Network and Security compliance domains.
* Determine appropriate testing cadence for controls, executing testing, completing quality reviews, and preparing performance reports to clearly communicate results to leadership.
* Developing and continuously improving strategies to identify ineffective controls and create solutions that are scalable and right-sized.
* Engage with internal teams and external stakeholders to proactively define and implement mitigations.
* Use high judgement to provide recommendations to the organization to solve ambiguous, complex business problems.
* Evaluate competing demands across internal control workstreams, regulatory timelines, and business objectives. Frame trade-offs clearly for leadership, recommend risk acceptance or mitigation paths, and document residual risk decisions with appropriate escalation.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
Leo Global Service Compliance (GSC) manages the implementation and execution of compliance obligations that exist because Leo operates as a communications service provider. These compliance obligations are derived from various sources including license conditions, license commitments, and statutory obligations that may be borne out of regulation, orders, and extra-judicial actions and cover a wide variety of subject matter areas including (but not limited to) consumer protection, privacy, network sovereignty and security, law enforcement requests, regulatory fees, network performance and availability, and marketing/advertising.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience leading enterprise-level governance, risk and compliance (GRC) programs.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.

Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
- Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
- Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
- Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
- Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.

Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.

About the team
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.

This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Tax Governance Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Tax Governance Risk Manager to join the TAC team and help build and run the governance function for Amazon's worldwide tax compliance programmes. This is a small, high-impact team where everyone contributes to shaping how governance works, not just executing it.

Your primary focus will be operational: making the Holistic Tax Governance Framework work in practice across 100+ tax regulations. You will run governance cadences, maintain control inventories, track risk indicators, produce audit-ready documentation, and hold teams accountable. You will also work closely with product and technology teams to ensure governance requirements are embedded in product design and that changes to tax products do not introduce compliance gaps.

You will work within Amazon's Three Lines of Defence (3LoD) model, ensuring 1st Line controls are documented, tested, and effective while coordinating with 2nd and 3rd Line partners on assurance activities.

Key job responsibilities
Governance Execution
- Provide programmatic support and maintain effective tracking mechanisms for various governance mechanisms across various Tax programs (weekly, monthly, quarterly), ensuring they stay on schedule and produce the required outputs.
- Maintain the control inventory across worldwide tax programmes. Ensure controls are documented, have clear owners, and link to regulatory requirements.
- Track completion of Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and escalate when teams miss deadlines or fall below the required standard.
- Monitor governance actions and remediation plans to deadline. Chase overdue items.
- Contribute to integrating bad actor detection and prevention into the governance lifecycle.

Product Governance
- Work with product and technology teams to ensure governance requirements are reflected in product design, business requirement documents (BRDs), and implementation plans.
- Review product changes and new tax programme launches from a governance perspective, ensuring compliance checkpoints are embedded from the outset.
- Track governance-related product risks and open items, coordinating with programme managers to drive resolution.

Control Monitoring and Risk Tracking
- Review and challenge Monitoring Control Indicators (MCIs), identify adverse trends, and flag them for review.
- Support periodic control testing: prepare test plans, gather evidence, document results, follow up on remediation.
- Review and track issue register items to ensure timely closure and ensuring deviations are promptly escalated through established protocols.

Reporting and Audit Readiness
- Produce governance reports, dashboards, and status updates for governance forums and senior leadership reviews.
- Maintain audit-ready documentation with complete, version-controlled evidence trails.
- Track key governance metrics: RCSA completion rates, control effectiveness, issue closure velocity, regulatory submission accuracy.
- Support audit preparation and response, coordinating with Internal Audit and external regulators as needed.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Coordinate across Tax, Legal, Policy, Product, Technology, and Fraud Prevention teams to collect governance inputs and ensure deadlines are met.
- Act as the operational point of contact for governance queries from partner teams.
- Work across time zones with teams in the US, EU, Japan, and India.

A day in the life
Morning: you review the governance tracker. Two RCSAs are overdue. You send reminders and note the escalation path. Mid-morning: you join a working session with the Monitoring team to review MCI trends for a high-risk programme. One indicator is moving in the wrong direction. You document the finding and draft the agenda item for the next Quarterly Governance Review.
Afternoon: you review a BRD for a new tax regulation launch with the product team, checking that governance checkpoints and control requirements are baked in. You then update the control inventory, map the new controls, assign owners, and schedule the initial RCSA. Before close, you pull together the weekly governance status report and flag two items that need senior attention.
The rhythm is consistent: track, monitor, chase, document, escalate, report.

Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.

No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.

jobs.description:
Every day, millions of products flow through Amazon's fulfillment network — and not all of them belong there. The Inventory Trust team stands at the front-line of protecting customers, brands, and Amazon's reputation by identifying and eliminating fraudulent, counterfeit, and non-compliant inventory before it reaches a customer's doorstep.

Scale & Impact: You'll drive disposition decisions on millions of units, manage escalation pathways involving legal holds and regulatory compliance, and set thresholds that determine how quickly Amazon neutralizes the impact of bad actors.
Ambiguity & Innovation: The problems you'll solve are large and complex. You'll design new processes, define clearance strategies, and build cross-functional mechanisms that didn't exist before.
Visibility: You'll communicate directly with senior leadership, influence enforcement policy through data, and partner with Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Engineering teams across multiple organizations.

This role focuses on the programmatic and operational execution of inventory clearance — identifying bad actors, driving inventory through evaluation and disposition workflows, and scaling mechanisms to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Lead end-to-end programmatic clearance of bad actor and risky inventory across global marketplaces, driving disposition decisions on millions of units to protect customers and Amazon's fulfillment network

Own cross-functional coordination with Legal, Compliance, Enforcement, and Operations teams to resolve complex inventory holds (e.g., regulatory freezes, legal seizures, non-responsive blocked accounts)

Identify process gaps and drive operational innovation — creating new mechanisms where playbooks don't exist and scaling solutions that reduce manual intervention over time

jobs.title: Risk Manager II, TSI SCI & Res-Q
jobs.description:
Millions of Selling Partners trust Amazon's marketplace to grow their businesses, and hundreds of millions of customers depend on us every day. Behind that trust is a network of systems, tools, and workflows designed to detect and resolve fraud and abuse at scale — and our team builds them.
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will drive end-to-end program execution for risk reduction initiatives across TSI SCI and Res-Q. In this role, you will own cross-functional program delivery — building roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving process automation to eliminate defects and improve operational efficiency at scale.
You will partner with engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams to define program scope, manage trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll own root cause and preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects, drive process automation initiatives that reduce manual investigation effort, and ensure programs are delivered on time, at quality, and with measurable impact.
This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon protects seller and customer trust by combining structured program management with process automation expertise that fundamentally improves how our organization operates.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end program management for risk reduction initiatives — defining scope, building roadmaps, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams.
• Drive cross-functional alignment across Risk Managers, Operations, Science, Legal, and Policy stakeholders to define program scope, prioritize features, and manage trade-offs — with defect elimination and operational efficiency as the primary lens.
• Identify, design, and implement process automation opportunities that reduce manual investigation effort, eliminate repetitive workflows, and improve investigator productivity — partnering with engineering teams to translate operational pain points into automation solutions.
• Own root cause / preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects — when defect pattern analysis reveals recurring failure modes, document root cause findings, define preventive actions with measurable closure criteria, and track implementation through to validated defect elimination.
• Build and manage program roadmaps for automation and process improvement launches, tracking dependencies, identifying risks, and driving escalation management across multi-team initiatives.
• Conduct defect pattern analysis to identify systemic abuse trends, process gaps, and opportunities for automation coverage expansion — translating findings into prioritized program requirements.
• Lead escalation triage for program-impacted workflows — rapidly diagnosing whether issues stem from process gaps, system failures, or policy misalignment, and routing to the appropriate team with clear severity assessment and remediation path.
• Define and instrument success metrics to measure program impact, automation coverage, defect escape rates, process cycle time reduction, and seller experience improvement.
• Drive process improvement initiatives using structured methodologies (DMAIC, Kaizen, or equivalent) mapping current-state workflows, identifying waste and bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
• Manage stakeholder communication and program governance - preparing and presenting program updates, launch readiness reviews, and impact assessments to senior leadership, quantifying the value of risk reduction investments.
• Own change management for new process launches and automation deployments — ensuring smooth adoption across operations teams through documentation, training, and feedback loops.
• Conduct deep dives into escalation data, process metrics, and system gaps to identify launch blockers and ensure seamless program implementation.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing program dashboards and defect metrics — checking milestone progress, flagging blockers, and identifying where process automation can reduce manual effort. You'll meet with investigators and Risk Managers to understand which workflows are creating friction and translate those insights into program requirements.
You'll drive sprint planning and stakeholder alignment meetings — prioritizing initiatives by defect elimination impact and operational efficiency gains. You'll analyze escalation data to spot systemic issues that process automation should solve, and work with operations leaders to validate that deployed solutions are actually reducing investigation workload.
Your week includes cross-functional program reviews with Science, Legal, Operations and Policy, launch readiness assessments, RC/PA deep dives on systemic defects, process mapping workshops for automation opportunities, and presenting program progress at WBRs and MBRs.

About the team
The Res-Q team operates as the central command for abuse-related escalations, conducting investigations and driving systemic improvements across Amazon's global stores. Through our various intake channels, we handle the most complex and sensitive cases that require expert judgment and cross-functional coordination.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 2+ years of experience in risk management, trust & safety, fraud prevention, or marketplace integrity domains
- Experience driving process automation or process improvement initiatives that delivered measurable operational efficiency gains
- Experience managing programs across technical and non-technical teams with competing priorities
- Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision making
- Experience with defect analysis, root cause investigation, and structured problem-solving methodologies
- Experience writing program requirements, process documentation, and stakeholder communications
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with interdependencies

- Experience defining and tracking program metrics, and driving data-informed prioritization
- Experience launching automation solutions that directly reduced operational defect rates or manual investigation workload

jobs.description:
MULTIPLE POSITIONS AVAILABLE

Employer: AMAZON.COM SERVICES LLC
Offered Position: Risk Manager II
Job Location: Austin, Texas
Job Number: AMZ10108334

Position Responsibilities:

Identify, design, develop, implement and execute new and existing processes, policies, goals, and solutions to reduce potential risks. Create schedules, identify and communicate risks to stakeholders, define risk mitigation strategies, and facilitate appropriate engineering solutions. Develop system requirements to streamline and simplify tools used to manage and enhance operational productivity, accuracy, and effectiveness for customers. Evaluate effectiveness of current or future systems. Collaborate with other departments to integrate with business systems and processes. Maintain metrics, reports, and process documentation to monitor and analyze delivery performance and key controls. Manage cross-functional teams and/or third party-vendors for implementation of project/program requirements.

Position involves security and regulatory compliance risks, specifically: information security control risks (gaps in controls protecting customer data), data localization risks (non-compliance with data residency requirements across jurisdictions), payment, healthcare and privacy security risks (e.g. vulnerabilities in digital payment systems), and regulatory non-compliance risks (failure to meet requirements of financial regulators and security standards) within cloud-based technology environments. This is accomplished by leading security compliance assessment engagements across regulatory standards for in scope global Amazon businesses across US, EU, APAC and MENA regions; analyzing regulatory requirements and mapping them to security controls within compliance platforms; conducting control testing and evaluating security artifacts; performing threat modeling and application security reviews; executing security assurance reviews; developing Generative AI and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to automate compliance mapping; building automated security control monitoring using deterministic and non-deterministic testing.

The scope of managing cross-functional teams and third party vendors involves individual contributor-level authority to independently lead compliance engagements, define new security controls and test procedures, evaluate control effectiveness, identify and escalate compliance risks, and recommend remediation strategies to engineering and leadership teams. Exercises independent judgment to assess regulatory requirements, determine control applicability, prioritize risks by severity, and approve or reject assessment findings before submission to external audit facing teams. Defining engagement scope, timelines, and deliverables for security compliance projects; coordinating with payment security, enterprise controls, application security, and engineering teams; overseeing assessment progress across multiple regulatory regimes; conducting cross-functional reviews to resolve control testing queries; managing third-party vendor assessments for data center security controls and evaluating control applicability between the organization and third-party providers; tracking milestones and reporting status. For vendors, evaluates vendor security controls against regulatory requirements and escalates contractual decisions to senior management. Processes include Security Control Monitoring Automation (SCMA), Application Security Review (ASR) certification, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of compliance workflows. Systems include ServiceNow, Amazon Control Framework (ACF), NightWolf, Avocato, Data Classification Engine (DACE), AWS GuardDuty, and Party Rock. Products supported include digital payment and e-KYC services assessed under PCI DSS, RBI, UIDAI, CBUAE, and NESA regulatory frameworks.

jobs.title: Risk Manager II-IE, Inventory Evaluations
jobs.description:
Inventory Trust team (SPIV) works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. Our mission is to safeguard our store from bad inventory and bad actors concealing their identities. To accomplish this mission, we withhold funds from bad actors, deny our fulfillment network to bad actors as a means to scale their abuse and ensure that counterfeit/illegal inventory is destroyed, prevent Seller credit abuse, identify and disrupt bad actor “spare accounts”, and generate insights to help SPS understand where bad actors are prioritizing their efforts.
If we successfully achieve our vision, then Bad Actors will stop committing misconduct on Amazon. While we obsess over customers, we specialize in obsessing over bad actors to identify their friction points and multiply them exponentially in ways that don’t impact good sellers. Our vision is to ensure Bad Actors never receive a dollar from selling on Amazon and abusing our policies. This is done with minimal friction for good sellers, clearly communicated policies, and accurate calculations.
We are looking for an experienced Risk Manager II to own complex projects, take high judgement decisions and manage escalations associated with our program’s expansion. In addition to making the right decisions, the candidate will need to be able to use SQL knowledge and use data as evidence to convince/influence key stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
• Innovating and designing new or improved processes to support the business needs.
• Conducting detailed process analysis including time and motion studies, and safety/ergonomic, process complexity, cost and impact analysis.
• Maintain a strong understanding of best in class risk and control principles, and regulatory expectations – embed governance processes to perform recurring gap analysis against those expectations, and drive remediation where necessary.
• Identify and develop appropriate data sources and elements which contribute to risk-based assessments.
• Experience working in or supporting a fast-paced operations environment.
• Perform operational deep dives on compliance-related processes and systems. Understand business processes, regulations and controls, work with partners to identify root cause of issues.
• Take leading role in drafting and presenting deep-dive documents, including responses to senior executives and Correction of Errors (COE) reports.
• Analyze existing policy and process gaps, and develop solutions to close them.

jobs.description:
The Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity (TSI) org is committed to our vision that bad actors cannot operate in our store while selling partners start and grow their business without fear of disruption, such that customers and selling partners across the globe trust us, and have confidence in the integrity of Amazon’s store.

As part of TSI org, the Inventory Trust (IT) team is
responsible for detecting and preventing inventory from bad actors reaching our customers. We build proactive detection mechanisms, risk models, and intelligence-driven processes to identify bad actors before they impact customers.

Leading cross-functional root cause analysis, the position handles EEs from virtually every business unit, working to maintain store trust and prevent business disruption. The role's success depends on coordinating comprehensive responses across multiple teams - including Policy, Legal, Operations, Product, and Business units - to effectively combat emerging fraud patterns.

2. Scope and Impact: EEs represent one of the most intricate areas of risk management, requiring expert judgment to identify subtle abuse patterns and sophisticated fraud schemes. The manager ensures quality, while addressing emerging threats company-wide. Their strategic decisions directly impact Seller, Customer, and Brand Experience metrics, influencing Amazon's global risk management strategy.

Team & People Management: They lead both EEs and broader REs-Q strategy, providing hands-on mentorship to develop risk managers' technical and analytical capabilities through individualized career development plans. jobs.title: Risk Manager I, Relay Product Excellence
jobs.description:
As a Risk Manager of the Driver Identity Verification team, you will be responsible for providing the overall management for a team of employees and direct leadership to the investigation team, overseeing and developing employee performance and process improvement activities. This team conducts risk reviews on drivers with investigatory resources and tools to validate identity. The group has responsibility for taking appropriate actions on or accounts to protect Amazon from risk of account takeover and to prevent /mitigate fraud. The team aims and works towards zero fraud, zero account takeovers, zero false positives, and zero scams of any kind. The team seeks the best possible trade-off between customer experience and risk related losses, and when they have to make difficult choices, they will err towards the customer experience.

You will be responsible for building and maintaining SOP’s, implementing, managing and reporting through Metrics, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators through Strategic Leadership and Vision, Daily Operational Management and Continuous Process improvements. You will be responsible for building operational cadences and review mechanisms to enable the team to achieve performance standards. You will have a strong voice in the forecasting accuracy of investigations, the necessary staffing requirements to achieve SLAs, and in ensuring all coaching, training needs are met. You will be a functional Operations owner, who works closely with the global program owners to design and deploy business strategies for enhanced Customer experience, including SLAs, First Contact Resolution, feedback on policies and decision quality and overall tools enhancements.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage a team of investigators
• Provide data analysis & conduct investigations (as needed)
• Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
• Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends
• Identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon’s transportation operations
• Understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data
• Knowledge to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams
• Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed
• Written and verbal communication experience, as you will be required to create a narrative outlining your weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum
• The right individual will have solid business judgment, effectively communicate team goals, and drive a fast-paced organization to deliver results with a focused and pragmatic approach to the business
• Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvements
• Develop employees and their skill sets to expand the team capabilities
• Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality, maintain clear metrics on our investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality
• Possess superior analytical abilities and judgment. Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity, experimentation and innovation, and drive projects with urgency in this fast-paced environment
• The manager's success will be measured by their ability to drive operational efficiencies across all processing areas whilst improving internal and external customer experience
.Person should be willing to work in rotational shifts

About the team
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. The Middle Mile Transportation Technology organization, builds complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both time & cost of getting the packages delivered. Our services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers, owner operators and drivers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers. That said, this remains a fast growing business and our technical journey has only started. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, unique delivery models for products ranging from Amazon Fresh groceries, ultra-fast Prime Now deliveries of big-screen TV’s, increasingly complex transportation network, and growing number of shipments worldwide, we see a brand new opportunity to fundamentally change the way people get the stuff they need, and make a big impact by cutting billions of dollars of transportation costs from the ecosystem. Our mission is to build the most efficient and optimal transportation solution on the planet, using our technology and engineering muscle as our biggest advantage. We aim to leverage latest technologies in big data, machine learning, optimization techniques, and operate high volume, low latency, and high availability services.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience with MS Office, MS Excel, and data retrieval languages
- • Min 2 years of experience working on identity verification/ fraud detection processes • Prior experience in manufacturing, transportation, customer service, and/or distribution environments • Min 5 years of overall experience out of which over 3 years of experience in leading an operational organization in a global environment, responsible for an overall team of 15+ employees • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or equivalent • Should be flexible to adapt to a 24 x 7 operating environment • Ability to pull data from databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) • Well-versed with written and verbal communication skills both remotely and face to face • Evidence of success in operational management, operational enhancement and operational change • Coaching and leadership skills including evidence of successful succession planning models. • 3 years+ people and performance management experience
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in Lean and Six Sigma
- Data management & data quality control experience with experience pulling and analyzing large sets of data
- Knowledge using data to drive root cause elimination and process improvement
- Knowledge in data and experience spotting the trends and fixing gaps
- Experience in building Quick Suite dashboard

jobs.title: Manager, Risk Management , Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV)
jobs.description:
Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity (TSI) is responsible for creating a trustworthy shopping experience across Amazon stores worldwide by protecting customers, brands, selling partners, vendors and Amazon from fraud, counterfeit, and abuse as well as providing world‐class support and building loyalty with Amazon’s millions of selling partners. The Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) team protects Amazon’s WW stores store by creating projects and programs focused on the detection of abuse at its earliest point and identifying the root causes, vulnerabilities or exploits to systematically address to prevent future abuse. Our growth requires highly skilled candidates who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, a tenacity to get things done, thrive in an environment of ambiguity and change, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems. We value individual expression, respect different opinions, and work together to create a culture where each of us is able to contribute fully. The combination of our unique backgrounds and perspectives strengthens our ability to achieve Amazon's mission of being Earth's most customer-centric company.

We catch bad actors and stop online fraud; It’s fun! It’s hard! It matters! We are passionate about protecting our selling partners and customers from bad actors and want a candidate that shares that passion. We are looking for an experienced Manager with background in risk, digital fraud, compliance, and/or cyber investigations. You will manage the core investigative function to provide feedback to partner teams by identifying and interpreting risk across Amazon’s global stores. You will set the vision, direction and execution of key deliverables in the risk management space, developing business cases and requirements, and prioritizing competing opportunities. You will work with a wide range of global cross-functional teams and senior leaders to build feedback loops to drive scalable improvement across the broader organization. You will align your team to high impact business areas and executing to high expectations in a fast-paced and highly visible delivery area. The ideal candidate should have a blend of strong individual investigation skills along with experience managing a high performing risk team. You should be passionate about using and understanding data to discover bad actor trends and help us ensure that customers make great purchase decisions and our selling partners using Amazon are successful listing and selling their products. Your decisions and deliverables will help proactively mitigate risk and empower partner teams in making high confidence decisions that are fundamental to protecting Amazon customers, selling partners, and will help maintain the overall health of Amazon's WW stores.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a high performing risk team by prioritizing high impact investigative leads that drive down business impact metrics
- Work within a sprint process to properly prioritize work and deliver results consistently
- Own end to end investigation flywheel to intake high quality leads from multiple sources to identify abuse and share detailed investigation briefs with partner teams to drive scalable detection and solutions
- Manage a strong risk team with a broad knowledge of abuse/fraud to conduct deep dives to derive insights about tactics used to conduct abuse on our WW stores
- Use high-level judgment to inform our most complex enforcement decisions and understand downstream impact and tradeoffs
- Develop goals, KPIs and metrics to track investigation health, progress, and impact. Effectively communicate challenges/roadblocks, progress and success to business and senior leadership.
- Provide feedback to partner teams and intake sources to improve the quality of leads and investigation outputs
- Break down problems into understandable and manageable pieces, ruthlessly prioritizing, and delivering results in an ambiguous environment

About the team
Our work is to solve hard puzzles and identify what hasn’t already been discovered - typically with data and always with a lot persistence and curiosity. If you like the sound of that, come join us.
Basic qualifications:
- 7+ years of conducting workplace risk investigations experience
- Experience in conducting workplace risk investigations
- Experience leveraging technology to drive process improvements
- Experience managing direct reports
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Preferred qualifications:

- Lead deal engagement, negotiation and closing of real estate sites; this includes build to suit negotiations and land acquisition.
- Cultivate developer relationships

- Partner with developers and the local jurisdiction and participate in any local meetings and hearings relating to these projects
- Work cross-functionally with other internal and external teams, including Design Engineering, Legal, Economic Development, Public Policy, Construction and Capacity Planning, to inform a regional real estate strategy
- Build and lead teams of vendors and consultants to evaluate site feasibility

What if your first role after business school put you at the intersection of commerce, product, and AI - with the ownership to build something that didn't exist before? Join Amazon's MBA Leadership Development Program (MLDP), starting with a transformative summer internship where you'll solve real business problems with measurable customer impact.

MLDP Overview
Amazon Stores is becoming an AI-first organization - and the leaders who will shape its future aren't just operators. They're builders. MLDP is an accelerated leadership pipeline that develops product-minded enterprise leaders capable of running businesses while simultaneously reinventing how Amazon serves hundreds of millions of customers.

Your journey begins with a 12-week summer internship, where you'll own a strategic business challenge, work alongside senior leaders, and present your findings in a formal business review. Successful interns transition into the full-time, three-year MLDP - a structured development experience designed to build the commercial judgment, product thinking, and cross-functional influence that define Amazon's next generation of enterprise leaders.

Through rotational experiences spanning business ownership, product, and operations, you'll progressively take on greater scope and complexity. MLDP is more than rotations - it's Enterprise Challenges sponsored by senior leaders, executive mentorship, cohort-based development, and the opportunity to build AI-enabled capabilities and operating mechanisms that create lasting value across Amazon Stores.

As an MLDP intern, you'll:
- Own a strategic business problem with real P&L impact and present your solution to senior leadership
- Apply data, customer insights, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities others haven't seen
- Collaborate across functions to develop innovative, scalable business solutions
- Build relationships with executive leaders, current MLDP participants, and program alumni
- Experience Amazon's builder culture firsthand where curiosity, ownership, and invention are rewarded

- Rotational experiences across business ownership, product, and operations - building enterprise leadership breadth
- Enterprise Challenges that put you at the center of Amazon Stores' high-priority business problems
- Executive sponsorship and structured leadership development designed to accelerate your trajectory
