Join us in shaping the future of retail while developing into a next-generation business leader at one of the world's most customer-centric companies.

MLDP seeks builders - leaders with product-minded curiosity, analytical judgment, learning agility, and a long-term orientation toward creating something better. jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst, Customer Operations Strategy, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Financial Analyst to build and run the financial controllership mechanisms for our global Customer Operations organization. This role is critical to ensuring Leo has accurate, timely, and reliable financial reporting as we scale from early launch toward full commercial operations.

As a member of our Global Customer Operations (GCOPS) Finance team, you will own the month-end close process for customer operations cost lines, build reporting infrastructure that provides leadership with clear visibility into financial performance, and develop the automated mechanisms that will scale with the business. You will be the person who ensures the numbers are right – and that the organization knows what's driving them.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who thrives on building processes from scratch, has a passion for financial accuracy, and wants to see their work directly influence executive decision-making at a business on the cusp of transformational scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the month-end financial close for customer operations – including vendor invoice processing, accrual calculations, disbursement reconciliation, and journal entry coordination with Accounting

- Build, maintain, and continuously improve the financial reporting infrastructure – weekly and monthly business review finance sections, variance analysis, automated bridging tools, and executive dashboards

- Develop and operate the self-invoicing mechanism for outsourced customer service partners, ensuring accuracy targets are met (>98%) and exceptions are resolved promptly

- Create automated financial controls and audit mechanisms – PO tracking, invoice matching, spend vs. forecast monitoring, and anomaly detection across customer operations cost lines

- Produce variance analysis and cost bridges that explain month-over-month and plan-vs-actual movements in plain language for senior leadership

- Support annual and long-range planning cycles by preparing data inputs, validating cost loads, and building supporting analytics for rate card development

- Partner with FinTech and engineering teams to build scalable financial tools – including automated bridging platforms and variable headcount calculator mechanisms

- Identify process improvement opportunities and drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve data quality across the financial close and reporting cycle

A day in the life
You might start your morning reconciling vendor invoices against accrual estimates, flagging variances for investigation. Mid-morning, you're finalizing the weekly business review finance deck – pulling actuals, computing bridges, and drafting narrative bullets. After lunch, you join a working session with the FinTech team to validate the latest automated bridging tool against your manual calculations. Later, you design the invoicing workflow for a new outsourcing partner. Before wrapping up, you pull together the data package for the upcoming planning cycle – validating rate card inputs and flagging assumptions that need updating.

About the team
You'll join the Global Customer Operations (GCOPS) Finance team within Amazon Leo – one of two finance teams led by this manager, alongside the Commercial Strategy & Planning (CS&P) team. Together, the teams span field services, customer support, cost of payments, bad debt, and multi-year strategic planning across the world, with members in Bellevue/Seattle and London. - 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Partnership & Account Manager, DACH Retail, Amazon Devices
jobs.description:
At Amazon Devices & Services, we imagine the future, and then create it. Join brilliant minds to build new categories of technology that become part of everyone's everyday life. Together, we create connected experiences and transform lives, communities, and the world with our work.

The Devices team for the DACH region is looking for a Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager. As a Sr. Account Manager, you will be the face of Amazon Devices to several of Europe's largest consumer electronics retailers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. You will shape how Amazon Devices, including Echo, Fire TV, Kindle and many more, reach customers in physical stores, and you will be accountable for the sales, the plan and the relationship behind them. Picture a customer in a consumer electronics store in Munich, Vienna or Zurich. They pick up a Kindle, ask an adviser how Alexa works, and walk out with an Echo for the kitchen. That moment is made by the partnerships you will own.

You will work with partners that are as ambitious as we are, in a category where customers increasingly expect their devices to work well together. You will decide where to focus, back those decisions with data, and bring colleagues from across Amazon along with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the partnerships. Act as the single point of accountability for Amazon Devices at our largest DACH retail partners. Build trusted relationships across multiple teams, including commercial, marketing, supply chain and distributors, up to senior leadership, in each of the three countries.
- Lead the field team and vendors. Manage the field team and the external vendors who support us in delivering for customers in stores. Set clear priorities, hold a high bar, and make sure their work drives sales for the partner and for Amazon.
- Set the strategy and the plan. Develop and deliver the annual joint business plans with the partners. They cover sales targets, assortment, pricing and promotions, marketing, and in-store execution, and they balance long-term growth against short-term results.
- Own the financials. Be accountable for the sales, margin and investment plan across the DACH retail partners. Set and forecast the sales targets, manage the promotional, marketing and trade budgets, and track return on that investment. Make clear trade-offs between growth and profitability, and take responsibility for delivering the plan and for explaining any gap to it.
- Negotiate. Lead commercial negotiations and agree terms that work for the partner and for Amazon, with a clear view of what each term means for sales, margin and long-term value.
- Grow the partner base. Build the case for, and bring on, new retail partners in the region, including in Switzerland. Own the business case, the commercial terms, the onboarding and the launch plan for each, so that new partners reach the customer quickly and profitably.
- Launch with impact. Coordinate go-to-market for new products and major events. This includes shaping launch timelines around retail channel requirements and making sure the plan is carried out well across stores and online.
- Drive performance with data. Review sales, inventory, forecasts, margin and promotional performance with the partner on a regular rhythm. Spot opportunities and risks early, and agree clear actions with the partner and Amazon’s internal teams.
- Run business reviews. Prepare and lead regular business reviews with the partners, and write the plans, forecasts and narratives behind them for Amazon's senior leaders. Use the reviews to move long-term initiatives forward and to deepen the collaboration.
- Represent Amazon, and represent the partner at Amazon. Present our devices and our plans to senior audiences with strong product knowledge. Bring the partner's priorities, and its customers' feedback, back to our product, marketing and supply chain teams.
- Test, learn and share. Pilot new in-store and online merchandising and marketing ideas with the partner. Scale what works, share lessons with Retail colleagues in other EU markets, and mentor colleagues who are earlier in their careers.
- Innovate and simplify, with AI. We are using AI to change how we work: automating recurring reporting and analysis, simplifying planning, and cutting the manual steps between a good idea and its execution. You will try new approaches, keep the ones that work, and help the team do the same. The aim is for more of your time to go to the partner and to long-term strategy, and less to routine tasks.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU End-to-End Network Planning
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who is excited to join a tech company that is constantly improving and re-imagining the logistics industry. Our candidate should be passionate about using data to solve big, complex, and ambiguous problems across end-to-end network design - spanning Inbound, Sortable, Non-Sort, Middle Mile, and Last Mile segments.
The ideal candidate should be eager to continuously learn and improve their skills, with a keen eye for the details that make all the difference. You will partner with network planning teams to drive financial governance, support multi-billion euro CapEx planning, and shape the topology decisions that define how we serve customers faster.
Do you want to contribute to shaping the future of logistics and the new standard of shopping? If so, come and join the Network Planning Finance team.

Key job responsibilities
- Independently identifies and drives cost-out opportunities across multiple network segments (Inbound, Sortable, Non-Sort, Middle Mile, Last Mile) by connecting operational performance metrics to financial outcomes, defining the analytical framework where one may not exist

- Navigates complex, ambiguous CapEx and network cost structures with limited or incomplete data, exercising senior judgement to size opportunities, quantify trade-offs, and recommend action to leadership with confidence

- Leads root cause analysis on systemic issues spanning multiple sites or topology decisions, uncovering underlying drivers and designing scalable measurement frameworks that raise the bar on network efficiency

- Serves as a trusted strategic partner to senior Network Planning leaders, proactively influencing decisions on investment, capacity placement, and network cost strategy rather than responding to requests

- Owns the end-to-end relationship with data source providers and technology teams, driving automation roadmaps, defining data quality standards, and ensuring decision-grade data is available at pace to support network design cycles

- Identifies and champions process improvements across the wider finance organization, codifying best practices, raising the analytical standard for peers and junior analysts

A day in the life
You will be at the heart of how Amazon's logistics network evolves. On any given day, you might be building the financial business case for a new site launch, modelling what happens to cost and service when a topology change is proposed, or presenting capacity investment trade-offs to Senior Leadership.
You will partner closely with Network Planning, Operations, and Technology teams to translate complex planning decisions into clear financial recommendations. One morning you could be quantifying the cost impact of adding a new node to the network; by the afternoon, you may be automating a reporting pipeline using AI tools to free up time for deeper analysis.
No two days look the same, but the thread that ties them together is this: you will use data, judgement, and financial rigor to help the business make better, faster decisions about where to invest, what to build, and how to design the network of the future.

About the team
As part of the End-to-end Network Design Finance team, you will join a team that is passionate about numbers, data, and how to use them to generate insights and improve our business. We support and influence the organization by providing a holistic and financial perspective, we are the trusted business advisors. We collaborate with our partners to ensure leaders have the most up to date and reliable information, and work with them to make sure we are making the best possible decisions.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field, or experience in relevant finance roles
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
- Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to inform business decisions with proven business impact (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
- Experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)
- Knowledge of of financial reporting tools (Cognos, Redshift)
- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)

We combine Amazon’s global technology capabilities with local expertise to create and improve experiences for customers in Japan. - Partner with engineers, product managers, and senior technical leaders to drive decisions about system architecture, interfaces, data flows, integrations, and implementation strategy.
- Build and maintain an integrated program plan covering the critical path, cross-team dependencies, decisions, resources, risks, and release readiness.

- Resolve disagreements and priority conflicts across teams. When escalation is required, present clear options, their consequences, and a recommended path.
- Establish durable mechanisms that improve accountability, decision speed, and delivery predictability across participating teams.

A day in the life
You will work with engineering, product, business, operations, and specialist teams to turn an ambiguous customer need into an executable technical program. You will also work with Payroll Tech stakeholders to build scalable process improvements and transformation mechanisms that raise the compliance bar and protect Amazon's employees and the business.

This role offers a unique blend of regulatory depth, cross-border complexity, and technology-driven innovation — ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex compliance challenges at scale. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of payroll operations, human resource, benefits and employment tax and legal. You will work across countries, and across functions to ensure that every employee is paid accurately and in full compliance with local laws.

• Proactively monitor payroll compliance and regulatory updates at a regional level, communicate their impact on business and payroll operations and update policies accordingly.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Finance Transformation and Analytics - North America Customer Fullfillment
jobs.description:
Finance is all about the numbers... unless you work in NACF Finance; here it is knowing the numbers and so much more. Amazon operates the most complex retail fulfillment network in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses every year. North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance provides the cost controllership, return-on-investment analysis, and financial insight that keep the economics of that network healthy. We translate operational KPIs into financial impact so our stakeholders have the most reliable, up-to-date information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.
This is a perfect role for a finance expert with highly advanced data skills, or a data expert with strong ability and genuine interest in finance. You know how to turn large, messy datasets into advanced analysis, automation, and metrics that move the business. You view problems as treasures, you dive deep to find the root cause, and you are comfortable when your ideas and mechanisms are tested daily. You will sit at the center of a Hub-and-Spoke analytics team whose mission is to own the outcome of the NACF finance analytics function, not simply to produce more dashboards.

Key job responsibilities
1. Serve as an expert in both Finance and Data, bridging the gap between finance and data teams. Build deep understanding of the key cost-of-fulfillment drivers across the NACF network along with the related finance, accounting, and controllership systems and data.
2. Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models and analyze complex business problems with limited guidance.
3. Own the efficiency of financial reporting for a business area, identify and resolve complex data-integrity issues with stakeholders, and build data-analysis processes that are scalable and auditable.
4. Collect, analyze, and manage quantitative data and create meaningful metrics and tools that drive cost reduction and process improvement.
5. Write systems queries to gather finance data and perform data mining and analysis using Excel, SQL (required), and Python.
6. Lead root-cause analysis that uncovers core issues in the data, then partner with Operations to improve their competitive position and profitability.
7. Enable finance stakeholders to navigate data-driven solutions and datasets so they can confidently self-service their needs.
8. Apply AI to raise your own productivity and to automate financial workflows: use large language models and agentic development tools (for example AWS Kiro, Claude Code, and similar) to build analyses, tooling, and automation faster than traditional methods allow.
9. Identify, lead, and execute opportunities to improve, automate, standardize, or simplify finance tools and processes across teams and organizations.
10. Work with data-source providers and tech teams to ensure key decision data is accurate, automated, and timely.
11. Communicate data clearly and concisely, in writing and verbally, adjusting your style to the audience to make complex finance issues understandable. Draw conclusions, make recommendations, and challenge partner assumptions when necessary.

A day in the life
No two days in NACF Finance look alike. You will work in a fast-paced, high-energy, and ever-changing environment alongside Operations, Product, Tech, and Procurement partners. One day you may be building a cost model for a network initiative, the next automating a reporting process with an AI-assisted toolchain, the next root-causing a data defect that is distorting a leadership metric. You move with purpose and speed, think like an owner, and treat every day as Day One.

About the team
NACF Finance Transformation & Analytics is a centralized, Hub-and-Spoke analytics team that supports the full North American Customer Fulfillment network. The team is the front door for finance analytics: rationalizing the reporting landscape into one source of truth, delivering advanced analytics and deep-dive root-causing, and building AI-first automation that lets finance spend less time assembling data and more time answering the hard questions. You will partner with Senior Leaders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Procurement, Accounting, and Technology as a trusted financial advocate and business partner.

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 4+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

jobs.description:
Drive the Financial Strategy Behind One of Amazon's Most Transformative Businesses

Amazon's Alexa organization is redefining how hundreds of millions of customers interact with technology — and we need a Senior Financial Analyst on our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team who wants to be at the center of it. This isn't a back-office finance role. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution — owning the financial planning, forecasting, and analytical frameworks that guide how Alexa invests, grows, and scales. From building the models that shape OP cycles to delivering variance analyses that change the conversation in leadership reviews, your work will have direct, measurable impact on one of the fastest-growing businesses in Amazon's portfolio.

What You'll Do
Own the Planning Cycle End-to-End — Lead the financial planning and forecasting processes (OP1, OP2, monthly/quarterly guidance) for your business area, building high-fidelity models that translate strategic ambitions into actionable financial plans with robust checks and balances.

Deliver Actionable Variance & Performance Analysis — Go beyond reporting the numbers. Conduct deep-dive variance analyses (actuals vs. plan, month-over-month, year-over-year), identify the why behind the trends, and surface insights that drive corrective action and inform forward-looking decisions.

Partner as a Strategic Finance Advisor — Work directly with business leaders and senior executives as a trusted thought partner — not just a number provider. Translate financial data into strategic narratives that influence investment priorities, resource allocation, and long-range planning.

Build & Maintain Scalable Financial Models — Design and own sophisticated P&L, revenue, and cost models that support scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and business case development. Your models will be the foundation for decisions worth millions.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment — Collaborate with product, engineering, marketing, and operations teams to ensure financial perspectives are embedded in business decisions. Own the bridge between operational metrics and financial outcomes.

Elevate the FP&A Function — Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and improve existing planning and reporting processes. Bring a continuous improvement mindset to how the team operates — think mechanisms, not just deliverables.

What Makes This Role Special
Strategic Seat at the Table — FP&A at Alexa isn't a support function; it's a strategic partner. You'll have regular visibility with VPs and Directors, and your analyses will directly shape how the business allocates capital and prioritizes investments.
Impact at Scale — Alexa touches hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. The financial frameworks you build will influence how Amazon invests in AI, voice technology, and the next generation of ambient computing.

Intellectual Depth — This is a business that thrives in ambiguity. You'll tackle complex, undefined problems — from emerging revenue streams to evolving cost structures — where the right financial lens can unlock entirely new ways of thinking.

Growth Trajectory — The Alexa business is evolving rapidly, creating abundant opportunities for expanded scope, increased ownership, and career acceleration within Amazon Finance.

What We're Looking For
A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and sees undefined problems as opportunities, not obstacles

Strong FP&A fundamentals — you're fluent in planning cycles, P&L management, variance analysis, and financial modeling
Exceptional Excel/financial modeling skills with a keen attention to detail and a commitment to high-fidelity outputs

Experience building scalable processes and mechanisms, not just one-off analyses
Intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for understanding what drives business performance at a unit-economic level

We are looking for a driven and analytical Senior Financial Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment to support Imports — the end-to-end inbound freight that moves Amazon's import volume from China to European fulfilment centres by both ocean and air.
EU Imports spans the full freight journey — origin handling in China, port-to-port, and destination delivery — across an end-to-end annual cost base of approximately $380M. The role turns carrier cost, invoice, rate-card and volume data into the rates and cost models that drive the monthly close and forward guidance, and is central to understanding and improving the economics of the business. The current emphasis is on ocean and destination economics, alongside origin cost work in China.
The role will require learning quickly to understand the big picture of how Global Logistics fits into Amazon's overall supply chain, gaining proficiency in our data to capture the right details, and communicating clearly to effectively partner with business leaders and influence decisions. It requires high judgement and the ability to drive both strategic and tactical goals.
This role partners closely with a broad range of finance and business leaders — Operations executional teams, Procurement, Controllership, long-term planning teams, and FP&A. A typical day provides the opportunity to own high-impact projects that drive cost out of the business, build accurate and insightful reporting, and develop influential frameworks that drive key decision-making for an evolving business. You'll track performance metrics, analyse data and build financial models to identify where we can drive better efficiency and productivity, and show how different scenarios impact our business financially — vital for stakeholders making decisions.
This role will support the EU Financial Automation launch between 2026 and 2027, performing tech system reconciliation and financial validation across upstream data sources (XBTMS, Virtual Manifest), the Griffin manifest platform, and downstream Finance reporting (TFS / USL). The Sr. Financial Analyst will partner with the Product team on new GL program and new carrier onboarding to financial automation, ensuring finance requirements are built into the launch bar from Day 1. The role will be the Finance owner for EU-region FA launch readiness — defining the financial reporting bar, leading exception triage on data accuracy / completeness / timeliness, and driving cross-functional decisions with GLS Finance, Controllership, IVT, Hydra, and Product partners. As the program scales, the role will own the EU manifest data pipeline and the metrics mechanism that gives Finance visibility into automation health at the transactional level — enabling Finance to move from manual processing to systematic controllership.

Key job responsibilities

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Finance teams are the strategy drivers to any organization. This role gives you the opportunity to be a part of making business decisions at scale, in a multinational company that still retains is Day One Customer Obsessed start up culture. By being involved in performance metrics, data analysis and financial models, you’ll identify where we can drive better efficiency and productivity to continue reducing costs for our customers while continuously improving our products’ selection.

During your internship you will tackle real-world business challenges, while developing your analytical expertise. As an intern, you will own projects that directly impact our business operations honing your financial acumen and quantitative skills. This hands-on experience will provide you with valuable exposure to corporate finance, data analysis, empower you to build Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions working together with like-minded customer obsessed finance professions. You will be part of strategic decision-making learning from your peers and leaders. You will gain practical insights into financial planning, analysis, and reporting while contributing to initiatives that drive business growth and enhance customer value. This opportunity is ideal for driven individuals looking to launch their careers in finance or broader business. Where is better to learn about innovating at scale than a company that has multinational resources but remains startup at its heart.

• Develop financial reports, forecasts, and KPI dashboards to support strategic decision-making
• Perform financial assessments that inform business solutions and enhance customer value
• Implement process automation and data quality improvements
• Collaborate with stakeholders across teams while building your professional network

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, WW DSP Finance
jobs.description:
Amazon's Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program is the backbone of last-mile delivery - thousands of independent small businesses that hire drivers, operate Amazon-branded vans and deliver millions of packages every day across North America, Europe and the rest of the world. Within WW DSP's multi-billion-dollar cost base, the largest and most control-sensitive flow is what Amazon pays its DSPs - fixed, variable, incentive and exception payments, all governed by rate cards set by the DSP Pricing team.

The Senior Financial Analyst will serve as the dedicated Finance partner to the WW DSP Payments and Pricing teams within the WW DSP Finance Central Team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager, and will own two interconnected mandates. On payments, the role owns end-to-end DSP payment controllership across North America (Monthly fixed payments, plus weekly variable, FMP, Walker, incentive, dispute and exception payments) together with the GRC controls and Internal Audit action items that sit on top of them - evolving DSP Finance from transactional approver to SME mechanism owner under the risk-tiered DSP Payments Controls Framework, and scaling that model to WW parity across EU and ROW. On pricing, the role establishes Finance as the governance and analytical partner to the Pricing team - building the rate card audit framework, embedding Finance checkpoints before rate changes are implemented, shaping PRICE tool controllership design, and bridging Pricing and Payments so disconnects are caught before they become payment defects.

Both mandates run on an AI-first operating model: extending AI-driven validation agents from weekly variable payments to every recurring control and into EU and ROW, so Finance time shifts from manual approval to exception management, root-cause resolution and strategic partnership. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a Finance professional who combines strong controllership instincts and sound judgement on high-dollar decisions with the ability to influence Payments Product, Payment Ops, Pricing, Trans CS and Internal Audit stakeholders - and who operates with equal confidence at the transaction level and in front of senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end payments controllership for WW DSP - approving weekly variable (NA and EU), FMP, Walker, incentive, dispute and exception payments under the risk-tiered DSP Payments Controls Framework, operating as total process owner and governance auditor, and running the 15-20% governance audit of Payment Ops checks and quarterly Finance attestation.
- Own the payments controls, audit and governance agenda - GRC Rate Validation as quarterly control owner, Fixed and Variable Payments Internal Audit action items, payment policy formalization (FMP, Variable, Bulk Upload), and authoring the WW RMP Approval Threshold Framework with per-country thresholds and tech build partnership.
- Serve as the dedicated Finance partner to the Pricing workstream - building the NA rate card audit framework and extending it WW, establishing Finance review checkpoints in the pricing change process, engaging with the PRICE tool on controllership design, building rate card effectiveness reporting and planning-cycle scenario modelling, and managing the FMP payment cycle end-to-end from VPA run through rate card approval to execution.
- Drive WW parity in payments and pricing controllership - consolidating all payment lines across NA and EU under DSP Finance, approving EU weekly variable payments across nine countries, closing EU bulk-payment controllership gaps with maker-checker controls and SOPs, laying the EU / ROW pricing governance groundwork, and owning the parity roadmap with milestones per geography.
- Lead AI-first automation, reporting and cost-out for the payments and pricing space - extending Orcha/AI validation agents to every recurring control, training Payment Ops on agent-driven checks, contributing Finance inputs to VPA 2.0, Shield anomaly detection and the Dispute Reduction Framework, publishing the weekly payments controllership flash and Payments MBR metrics, and identifying validated cost avoidance and savings for the DSP Cost-Out MBR.

A day in the life
- Reviews the week's variable payment runs and pending FMP, Walker and exception payments - validating against rate cards and agent-driven checks, approving what passes, and working high-dollar disputes through the tiered framework with root-cause evidence
- Partners cross-functionally with Pricing, Payment Ops, Trans CS and CO India - auditing rate-in-system against approved rates, ensuring Finance checkpoints are met before rate changes land, and tracing payment defects back to their upstream pricing or process cause
- Owns controllership narratives for leadership - translating exception trends, audit findings and automation progress into the weekly payments flash, bi-weekly leadership updates, GRC evidence packages and Internal Audit responses
- Advances WW parity and automation - onboarding the next EU or ROW payment line into the DSP Finance validation framework, extending an Orcha validation agent to a new control, and documenting the SOP so the process scales without adding manual effort

About the team
Our team is committed to delivering accurate, timely financial insights that help Amazon make smarter decisions. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and a culture where every team member is encouraged to ask questions and challenge assumptions. As we look ahead, we are focused on expanding our analytical capabilities and building scalable tools that drive efficiency. If you are curious, resourceful, and excited about growing your career in finance at one of the world's most innovative companies, we would love to hear from you.

- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Global Prime Finance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Finance Manager to own the rhythm of business (RoB) for the WW Prime Benefits, Pricing, And Constructs Finance (BPCF) team. This role is the operational backbone of the team, responsible for ensuring that the financial scorecards, reporting packages, and planning documents that senior leadership relies on are accurate, timely, and insightful. You will own the end-to-end publication of the BPC Page 0 (our key financial scorecard by locale at country and consolidated WW level), prepare financial packages for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews, support OP planning documents, and maintain the tracking systems that keep the team grounded in data. This is a high-visibility role: your outputs will be reviewed by Directors and VPs across Global Prime Finance and WW Prime leadership. You will work directly with a Senior Finance Manager and collaborate across a team of Finance Managers, each owning distinct sub-domains of the Prime BPC business.

Key job responsibilities
Reporting & Page 0 Ownership
- Own the end-to-end publication of the Benefits, Pricing & Constructs Page 0 at country and WW consolidated level on a monthly, quarterly, and annual cadence.
- Prepare and publish financial packages for Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), and Monthly Finance Reviews (MFR), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and narrative clarity.
- Support OP1/OP2 document preparation, including initiative sizing inputs and financial summaries.
- Maintain and improve reporting templates, data pipelines, and publication workflows to reduce manual effort and increase reliability.
Planning & Goals Tracking
- Track and report incremental Prime member balance across geographies, identifying trends, variances, and risks to plan.
- Own goals tracking and reporting for the BPC Finance team, including progress against OP targets and key initiative milestones.
- Publish DSI (Daily Sales Intelligence) runs on a regular cadence, ensuring the team and stakeholders have current performance data.
- Proactively flag variances and emerging trends to the Senior Finance Manager, with root-cause hypotheses and proposed next steps.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Coordinate with country finance teams across 26 geographies to collect, validate, and consolidate data inputs for Page 0 and business reviews.
- Partner with Finance Managers on the BPC team to integrate sub-domain data (Benefits, Pricing, Constructs, Savings & Rewards) into consolidated reporting.
- Work with Business Intelligence Engineering (BIE) teams to improve data quality, automate data pipelines, and resolve data discrepancies.
- Serve as the primary BIE liaison for the BPC Finance team: own the relationship with BIE to drive data quality improvements, prioritize pipeline fixes, unblock data access requests, and reduce the manual reconciliation burden on senior Finance Managers.
Analytical & Insight Development (Growth Scope)

- Conduct variance analysis and root-cause deep-dives on Page 0 metrics, member balance trends, and benefit cost movements, escalating findings with hypotheses and recommended actions.
- Support ad hoc financial analyses for senior leadership, including opportunity sizing, benefit cost trending, and scenario modeling for business reviews.
- Build and maintain Benefits Usage Index (BUI) tracking and trend analysis to support WW Prime leadership decision-making.

BIE Partnership & Data Infrastructure

This role supports accounting function related to reconciliation, close process and accounting. As Amazon has been growing at over 30% Year-over-Year, this position will also help drive process changes and improvements to support the growing needs of the Company. This role will include leasing/finance reporting and asset addition to sub-ledger responsibilities on a large portfolio of technology assets.

Responsible for ensuring the successful completion of close activities, ranging from data entry and ledger entry to deliverables review
Prepares and reviews complex account reconciliations, financial analyses, and deliverables
Acts independently to lead and complete projects with complex objectives
Understands the relevant accounting principles and can communicate the application of GAAP to peers and business partners.
Works independently to identify and execute projects and process improvements to enhance efficiency
The successful candidate will report into a Finance Manager. This will include working with central accounting, finance operation and Global financial teams to ensure we have a controlled accounting process to do month end accounting and reporting activities in a manner fitting with our "Customer Obsession", “Deliver Results” and “Insist on Highest Standard” philosophy.

The Financial Analyst responsibilities include month end activities and ensure proper review of account balances for Amazon, preparation and review of monthly/quarterly/annually reconciliations and balance sheet analysis.

This position will support the management in all aspects of financial accounting, reporting systems, procedures and policies. On the audit front, Financial Analyst will manage department’s response to internal and external audit requirements and will ensure compliance with SOX requirements for all geographies/activities handled by Shared Services.
This position will also play an important role in promoting systems/process development within department to ensure ongoing efficiency and control improvements. The successful candidate will have a strong desire in innovating processes and exceed expectations in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, primarily driving innovation on behalf of our customers.
Performing month end activities that include closing of sub ledgers, general ledger account reconciliations, reporting and balance sheet account analysis.
Ensure appropriate financial policies, procedures, and internal controls are in place, documented, and operating as intended.

· Provide response to internal and external audit requirements and ensure compliance with Sox requirements for all geographies/activities.

Drive process improvements required to enhance controls and quality of reconciliations and related processes. Build and monitor performance metrics, with principal focus on ensuring timely delivery of month end reports, reconciliations and other deliverables.
Maintain monthly communications and metrics reporting with Director and VP level business partners in finance operations, central accounting and FOAA. Actively participate in strategic initiatives and special projects when assigned or required.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses
- Experience using data to influence business decisions
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- CA with 5-6 Yrs of accounting experience
- Knowledge of standard software including Excel, Access, Oracle,Essbase/Smartview
- Experience in Month end closing of Books of accounts/working on various sub-ledgers/Accounting Knowledge/Balance Sheet Reconciliation.
Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
- Experience in problem solving and delivering results
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, APAC Production Finance
jobs.description:
Amazon MGM Studios is shaping the future of entertainment globally, and our Japan Local Originals slate continues to grow rapidly. We are seeking a Production Finance Manager to support the financial operations of Local Original productions in Japan.
This is an opportunity to join one of the most innovative businesses at Amazon, directly supporting a high-performing content team. The successful candidate will support Production Finance operations across multiple show productions at various stages of the production lifecycle, working closely with production accounting teams, production service companies, and internal stakeholders to ensure financial accuracy, compliance, and controllership. This role requires someone who is highly analytical, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can work with large sets of data while exercising sound judgment on difficult projects and issues.
This role will be based in Tokyo, Japan.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.
Amazon MGM Studiosは、エンターテインメントの未来をグローバルに形成しており、日本のローカルオリジナル作品のラインナップは急速に拡大しています。私たちは、日本のローカルオリジナル制作の財務業務をサポートするプロダクション・ファイナンス・アソシエイトを募集しています。
このポジションは、Amazonにおける最もイノベーティブなビジネスの一つに参加し、優秀なコンテンツチームを直接支援できる機会です。採用された方は、制作ライフサイクルのさまざまなステージにある複数の番組制作にわたりプロダクション・ファイナンス業務をサポートし、制作経理チーム、制作サービス会社、および社内ステークホルダーと緊密に連携しながら、財務の正確性、コンプライアンス、内部統制の確保に取り組んでいただきます。このロールには、高い分析力、スピード感のある環境でのパフォーマンス発揮、大規模なデータ処理能力、および困難なプロジェクトや課題に対する適切な判断力が求められます。
この職種は、日本・東京を勤務地とします。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
Production Finance Operations
• Support Production Finance operations across multiple show productions in various phases (development, pre-production, production, and post-production).
• Collect, review, and validate monthly financial reporting (cost reports, General Ledger, Trial Balance, etc.) for multiple productions on a timely basis.
• Track and quantify financial performance of shows against budget and projected cash flow needs, identifying data inaccuracies to maintain data integrity.
• Manage weekly cash flow and funding schedules for assigned projects in multiple currencies, ensuring cash flow tracks reasonably with projected spend and adjusting funding schedules to adequately support production activities while avoiding excess funding.
• Comprehend and articulate details and root causes relating to production and funding variances.

Budget Management and Cost Tracking
• Support the Production Finance team in scrutinizing production budgets and ensuring accurate cost control and forecasting throughout the production lifecycle.
• Gather data to accurately populate standard financial and operational reports (e.g., MBR reports, month-end reports) and deliver valuable insights across multiple productions.
• Collect and communicate up-to-date information from financial reports (e.g., cost reports) to internal stakeholders.

Compliance and Controllership
• Understand policies, procedures, and control risks and effectively reinforce the fiduciary responsibilities of production accounting teams within existing Finance and Accounting Guidelines.
• Onboard local production accounting teams during pre-production to ensure compliance with Studio finance and accounting guidelines.
• Work closely with Senior Production Finance Executives to ensure compliance of the close-out of released wholly-owned and co-production titles.
• Track production tax incentive estimates and workflows to ensure up-to-date financial information is provided to the team.
Process Improvement and Collaboration
• Identify gaps in the flow of information between internal and external stakeholders and propose solutions to standardize workflows for the team.
• Initiate change and improve reports and processes with automation or further insights, with support of the team.
• Independently address process, policy, and procedure questions or issues that arise during day-to-day accounting operations of assigned shows.
• Collaborate with internal and external partners to develop efficient SOPs for difficult tasks.

プロダクション・ファイナンス業務
• 開発、プリプロダクション、本制作、ポストプロダクションなど、各フェーズにある複数の番組制作にわたり、プロダクション・ファイナンス業務をサポートする。
• 複数の制作案件のコストレポート、総勘定元帳、試算表等の月次財務報告を期限通りに収集・精査・検証する。
• 予算および予測キャッシュフローに対する番組の財務パフォーマンスを追跡・定量化し、データの不正確さを特定してデータの整合性を維持する。
• 複数通貨での担当プロジェクトの週次キャッシュフローおよびファンディングスケジュールを管理し、キャッシュフローが予測支出と合理的に一致していることを確認するとともに、制作活動を十分にサポートしつつ過剰なファンディングを避けるようスケジュールを調整する。
• 制作上の差異およびファンディングの差異に関する詳細と根本原因を把握し、明確に説明する。

予算管理とコスト追跡
• プロダクション・ファイナンスチームをサポートし、制作ライフサイクル全体を通じて制作予算の精査、正確なコスト管理および予測を確保する。
• 標準的な財務・業務報告書（MBRレポート、月次報告書など）に正確に記入するためのデータを収集し、複数の制作案件にわたって有益なインサイトを提供する。
• 財務報告書（コストレポートなど）から最新情報を収集し、社内ステークホルダーに共有する。
コンプライアンスと内部統制
• 方針、手続き、統制リスクを理解し、既存の財務・会計ガイドラインの範囲内で制作経理チームの受託者責任を効果的に強化する。
• プリプロダクション期間中に現地制作経理チームのオンボーディングを行い、スタジオの財務・会計ガイドラインへの準拠を確保する。
• 制作物のデジタルファイル管理体制のコンプライアンスを確保し、完了時にすべてのファイルが納品されるようにする。
• シニア・プロダクション・ファイナンス・エグゼクティブと緊密に連携し、自社制作およびコプロダクションタイトルのクローズアウト処理のコンプライアンスを確保する。
• 制作税制優遇措置の見積もりとワークフローを追跡し、最新の財務情報をチームに提供する。

プロセス改善と協業
• 社内外のステークホルダー間の情報フローのギャップを特定し、チームのワークフローを標準化するための解決策を提案する。
• チームのサポートのもと、自動化やさらなるインサイトの活用によってレポートやプロセスの変革・改善を推進する。
• 担当番組の日常的な経理業務において生じるプロセス、方針、手続きに関する疑問や課題に独自に対応する。
• 社内外のパートナーと協力し、複雑なタスクに対応する効率的な標準作業手順（SOP）を構築する。
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal education).
- 6+ years of progressive industry experience in production accounting or in a studio production finance role.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and communicate insights effectively.
- Proficiency in financial software and tools (e.g., Excel).
- Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Business-level proficiency in Japanese and English (written and verbal).
- 財務、会計、または関連分野の学士号（同等の実務経験での代替可）。
- 制作経理またはスタジオのプロダクション・ファイナンス職での6年以上の実務経験。
- 財務データを解釈し、インサイトを効果的に伝達できる高い分析力。
- 財務ソフトウェアおよびツール（Excelなど）の習熟度。
- 優れた組織力とコミュニケーション能力。プレッシャーの下でも複数の優先事項を効果的に管理できること。
- 日本語と英語のビジネスレベルの読み書きおよび会話能力。
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with budgeting and financial analysis for large-scale productions in the Japanese entertainment industry.
- Experience managing multi-currency cash flows and production funding.
- Knowledge of relevant Japanese financial regulations and entertainment industry standards.
- Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau).
- Experience working with production service companies and 3P auditors.
- Familiarity with Amazon Studios production finance guidelines and processes.
- 日本のエンターテインメント業界における大規模制作の予算策定および財務分析の経験。
- 複数通貨のキャッシュフロー管理と制作資金調達の管理経験。

jobs.title: Partner Manager Amazon Mentor, New Seller Recruitment
jobs.description:
The Amazon Mentor Program is part of the LATAM New Seller Recruitment team. The program incentivizes third-party partners (3PPs) — such as integrators, consultants, and influencers — to refer, launch, and grow Sellers on Amazon, allowing us to scale our capabilities to onboard new Sellers. The partners (a.k.a. Mentors) are trained to prospect leads, pitch Sellers, provide launch assistance (e.g., catalog and listing), and offer post-launch engagement for up to 4 months (e.g., Ads, FBA, DBA). The program was launched in Brazil in Apr'22 and has leveraged seller experience through partners. One challenge of the team is to educate other 3P teams on how to use their initiatives through Mentors. The program has 100+ partners acting as Seller's Mentors, with the high performers managed by a Partner Manager.

Therefore, the Partner Manager core activities include: identify, prospect, recruit, and manage high-potential Mentors for the program. Within this scope, we expect the person to lead strategic projects to improve partner experience and foster the adoption of key 3P programs such as FBA and Ads. The Partner Manager manages a portfolio of 15–20 companies from the e-commerce sector, such as SaaS companies, integrators, consultancies, and e-commerce influencers. The main inputs/outputs to be managed by the Partner Manager on a day-to-day work can be broken down into: (1) partner inputs, driving the number of active Mentors and Sellers launched by them, and (2) Seller inputs, managing Seller conversion from RegStart-to-launch, FBA adoption, Ads adoption, and GMS.

The person must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity to adapt the strategy based on the partner profile, building quarterly strategies that can change with market trends, and diving deep into partner acquisition mechanisms to support them. As there is no similar program to be used as benchmark, there is not a clear SOP ready and the Partner Manager needs to search for external benchmarks and draw inspiration from other programs. Additionally, the Partner Manager faces challenges such as managing a diverse set of partner profiles with varying levels of maturity, aligning partner incentives with Amazon's seller success goals, driving brand owner acquisition through mentors (currently at ~4% penetration), and ensuring partners remain engaged beyond the initial onboarding phase. We expect the person to have bias for action to explore new segments of partners and test different onboarding and engagement strategies to retain key Mentors. The account management routines involve: providing data-driven insights and advice to optimize the partners' success at Amazon, organizing in-person events at the office with stakeholders, and coordinating internal Seller improvement initiatives in the Mentor pipeline with program leaders.
Basic qualifications:
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools

jobs.description:
Amazon's Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team is seeking an innovative and experienced Sr Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation to lead the technical strategy, standards, and optimization of mechanical and Building Management Systems (BMS)/Controls across our global corporate office portfolio. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for a mechanical or controls engineering specialist. You will own the mechanical and building automation backbone (HVAC, central plant, BMS/BAS, sequences of operation, fault detection) for the global GREF portfolio, while partnering across the broader MEP disciplines.

The ideal candidate combines deep, demonstrable expertise in mechanical systems and building controls with strong leadership and strategic thinking. You are fluent in the language of open-protocol building automation — BACnet, Modbus, Niagara/Tridium — and you can read a sequence of operations, interrogate a controls submittal, and diagnose why a system is not performing. You will develop and execute global engineering initiatives that enhance workplace environments, improve operational efficiency, and advance sustainability goals, navigating complex stakeholder relationships and making data-driven decisions that balance innovation with cost-effectiveness at a global scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Standards & specifications — Develop and maintain global controls/BMS and mechanical design standards, guidelines, and specifications — including sequences of operation, points lists, and naming/tagging conventions — for new construction and retrofits.
- Automation architecture — Define open-protocol BMS architecture (BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus, Niagara/FOX, MQTT), network topology, and integration; partner with InfoSec and IT on OT network security and data governance.
- Operations & maintenance — Lead operational guidelines and SOPs for mechanical systems, controls, and equipment.
- Performance & FDD — Establish fault detection & diagnostics, trending, and analytics to drive optimization and energy efficiency across the portfolio.
- Technical leadership — Provide SME support to regional teams on complex mechanical and controls issues, including commissioning, Test and Balance (TAB), and root-cause failure analysis.
- Lifecycle & modernization — Develop strategies for equipment lifecycle management, preventive maintenance, and system modernization.
- Sustainability — Advance corporate environmental goals through mechanical and BMS initiatives.
- Technology & innovation — Evaluate and recommend new building systems, controls, and smart-building technologies.
- Metrics & vendors — Set KPIs and track portfolio improvements; partner with procurement on equipment/controls-vendor standards, qualification, and performance.
- Strategy & growth — Support due diligence for acquisitions and renovations, deliver technical training, and shape long-term strategy and capital planning.

About the team
The GREF Global Engineering team drives continuous improvement for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems across Amazon's corporate office portfolio worldwide. We set design and construction standards, develop operations and maintenance guidelines, and shape long-term MEP strategy — balancing innovation, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness at global scale. Our team thrives on diverse expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and data-driven decision-making to deliver resilient, high-performing workplaces. We're looking for technical leaders who challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to complex building system challenges.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 6+ years of experience in building systems engineering
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes
- Professional Engineering (PE) license
- Certifications such as LEED, PMP, CEM, and/or HBDP.
- Deep hands-on experience with BMS/BAS platforms and open protocols — Tridium/Niagara (FOX), BACnet, Modbus — including programming, commissioning, and integration.
- Experience with fault detection & diagnostics (FDD) and building analytics platforms (e.g., SkySpark) and using building data to drive optimization.
- Experience with OT network architecture and building-systems cybersecurity/InfoSec coordination.
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of commercial office buildings.
- Experience managing engineering programs for large, global real estate portfolios.
- International project experience.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Learning and Development to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of enterprise-wide leadership development, onboarding, and compliance programs that shape how this growing workforce builds capability and performs at its best.

In this role, you will own the leadership development architecture for AHS, the enterprise onboarding and compliance program strategy, and the measurement framework that demonstrates learning impact across all business lines. You will lead a team of program managers, learning designers, and measurement specialists to build scalable development experiences. This is a compelling time to join: as AHS grows rapidly following acquisition, we need a leader who can accelerate leadership development and help integrate our workforce into Amazon's ways of working.

Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Leadership Development
• Own the end-to-end leadership development architecture for AHS — frameworks, programs, and tools for leaders at all levels, from frontline managers to senior clinical and operational leaders
• Partner with Amazon central L&D and other business-line L&D organizations to identify, adapt, and implement existing leadership programs for AHS before investing in net-new development
• Define program vision, success metrics, and multi-year roadmap aligned with AHS business priorities and culture goals
• Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, participant feedback, and industry best practices
Enterprise Learning Products
• Own the full lifecycle of enterprise learning products (leadership, onboarding, compliance, culture): strategy, design, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration
• Build enterprise products that business-line portfolio teams localize and adopt, ensuring consistent quality while enabling business-specific customization
• Oversee onboarding and compliance program strategy in partnership with the team's Sr. Program Manager
• Scale programs to meet the needs of AHS's growth across pharmacy expansion and One Medical integration while maintaining quality and impact
Stakeholder Management & Influence
• Partner with AHS senior leadership to align program content and delivery with business needs and secure sponsorship for enterprise initiatives
• Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and PXT teams to ensure integrated talent solutions
• Build relationships with Amazon L&D peers across the company to source best practices and proven program models
• Present program results and recommendations to senior leadership audiences
Measurement & Impact
• Establish and track key performance indicators for program effectiveness and business impact
• Oversee the team's Assessment & Measurement function, which serves all AHS L&D portfolios — set standards, drive consistency, and demonstrate ROI
• Use data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in leadership and workforce development across AHS
Team Leadership
• Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of program managers, learning designers, and measurement specialists
• Set clear goals, provide coaching, and create development opportunities for team members
• Manage team capacity across competing priorities: leadership development, onboarding, compliance, and enterprise requests

- Experience with program and project management in a matrixed organization, including managing details, keeping multiple tasks/projects on track, and influencing others

jobs.title: Operations Manager/Operations Manager:in  - Enns, DAP1, AMZL
jobs.description:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

Key job responsibilities
Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life

You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

- A degree
- Relevant experience in people and stakeholder management
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and intermediate proficiency in the local language
- Relevant experience in using data or anecdotal evidence to influence business decisions
- Relevant experience in key areas of production and supply chains

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.

- Experience in a similar logistical working environment

jobs.description:
Application deadline: Oct 17, 2026

Amazon Customs & Trade (ACT) manages US import customs clearance across multiple U.S. ports of entry for both internal and external Amazon customers. The Sr. Compliance Specialist is the primary resolution support owner for cargo detained by CBP, FDA, CPSC, EPA, and other Partner Government Agencies (PGAs) — managing each case from first notice through final resolution. You will work across a broad stakeholder set: importers of record (IORs), U.S. government agencies, examination facilities, carriers, and Amazon internal teams spanning Operations, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Origin, and Product/Tech.
ACT is scaling to meet growing import volume and increasing case complexity. This role will evolve alongside the business — we are looking for someone who can adapt, take ownership across shifting priorities, and contribute beyond their immediate caseload. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential; cases routinely carry same-day response requirements with seizure, penalty, or mounting demurrage as direct financial consequence of inaction.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage an active caseload of CBP exam holds, PGA detentions, and other enforcement actions across assigned U.S. ports — from intake through resolution (release, re-export, destruction, or formal response)
• Track and respond to CBP CF-28 and CF-29 notices within statutory deadlines; escalate approaching deadlines and elect appropriate disposition paths, including re-export, manipulation/destruction, and UFLPA exclusion proceedings
• Serve as the primary government-facing customs broker point of contact — building working relationships with CBP officers, FDA district staff, CPSC analysts, EPA inspectors, and other PGA personnel
• Coordinate logistics for cargo returns, CES pickup, drayage, and destruction with carriers, exam facilities, and Amazon's logistics network teams
• Partner cross-functionally with CTU operations, finance, controllership, and billing on entry corrections, fee approvals, invoice reconciliation, and systemic filing issues
• Draft formal agency responses, triage enforcement communications by urgency, and escalate seizure and penalty actions same business day per team SLAs
• Contribute to weekly business reviews and operational reporting — port-level case status, dwell aging, hold/exam rates, and constraint callouts for leadership
• Collaborate with product, tech, and I&I teams on automation and AI initiatives to improve exam resolution workflows and scale operational capacity
Basic qualifications:
- 1+ years of logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration experience
- Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e.g., UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc.)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis

jobs.description:
Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Managers with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we’re changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

We have ambitious plans to expand our specialist fulfilment centres and delivery stations across the UK and Europe. While those of us who work in delivery stations will do some night shifts, most of us work during the day. Our team is made up of people across operations, supply chain, business intelligence and programme management, and everyone plays a crucial role in growing this part of the business.

jobs.title: Prod Compliance Specialist I, Global Product Verification (GPV)
jobs.description:
The Product Compliance Specialist I is expected to own and improve product verification workflows such as Bin Checks, Test Buys, Metrology, ML model labelling and behaviors — to detect counterfeit, used-sold-as-new, damaged, wrong item and expired products in Amazon’s fulfillment network. This role is expected to write and maintain SOPs, perform root cause analysis, handle escalations, train the team, and work closely with stakeholders to improve product quality outcomes. The specialist is also expected to support upstream and downstream detection systems to integrate into the workflow seamlessly.

Key job responsibilities
• expected to operate independently in ambiguous situations, exercise sound judgment, and influence decisions independently
• expected to identify policy changes that affect GPV verification workflows, update SOPs accordingly, and train the team on changes
• expected to analyze data to identify trends, anomalies, risk signals, and opportunities for proactive intervention
• expected to perform root cause analysis to resolve product quality incidents within their scope of work
• expected to draft and maintain workflows, work instructions, and SOPs for the team that align with team strategies
• expected to create and use reports (e.g., quality trends, regional metrics) from multiple data sources to improve process metrics
• expected to mentor and support team members by sharing investigation methodologies and best practices

About the team
The Global Product Verification (GPV) team is Amazon's premier product authentication and verification team, protecting marketplace integrity through comprehensive product verification systems. We specialize in seller verification, strategic product procurement, and implementing comprehensive authentication standards. By focusing on PQ metrics, we tackle critical challenges including counterfeit prevention, expiration compliance, and product condition accuracy. Through collaborative partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, we ensure Amazon remains the most trusted destination for authentic products worldwide.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- 3+ years of quality assurance engineering experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
- Experience working with large datasets, determining trends/patterns which can be used for value decisions
Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent, or Associate's degree
- 2+ years of fraud/risk investigations experience
- 3+ years of implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts, or 2+ years of fraud identification and detection, investigation and analysis for root causing and providing suitable preventive mechanisms experience

The ideal candidate combines technical grounding in the built environment with strong program coordination skills, operates effectively in ambiguous environments, and brings cross-regional curiosity that enables benchmarking to raise the quality of EU standards.

Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to support the end-to-end delivery of EU AMZL design initiatives, ensuring programs are executed with precision and pace
- Contribute to the development and documentation of building design standards for EU AMZL and sub-programs, working within established frameworks
- Support cross-regional and cross-program initiatives to ensure EU design standards are globally informed and transferable across Amazon's logistics network
- Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, bringing structure and clarity to complex, multi-stakeholder environments
- Qualify, track, and drive design change proposals through the standards governance process, aligning stakeholders and monitoring outcomes until changes are adopted
- Produce clear, data-driven documentation and communications in English, and present findings to senior stakeholders
- Conduct cross-regional benchmarking by leveraging curiosity about other markets and cultures to identify transferable design and cost efficiencies
- Travel across the EU up to 30% of the time to support program delivery, site reviews, and stakeholder engagement

You connect with engineering, construction, and operations partners across time zones to move proposals forward and keep delivery on track. Operating across multiple regions — including North America, Europe, and International (covering markets such as LATAM and India) — GBDE works at the intersection of design, engineering, and program delivery, translating strategic direction into standards that scale across hundreds of facilities globally.
