jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Operations Finance
jobs.description:
As a member of our Customer Fulfilment (CF) Finance team, you will help leaders turn data into insight so we can keep delivering an excellent experience for our customers and find new ways to support them. We are trusted business advisors: we bring a holistic financial perspective and partner with the business to make the best possible decisions.
This role gives you a front-row seat to how those decisions are made, and the opportunity to own meaningful analysis, influence outcomes, and grow.

About the Team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. From a team of booksellers, CF has scaled into a sophisticated global network that handles millions of orders every day. Our Fulfilment Centres are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced operations — often called the “First Mile” because it is where most Amazon packages begin their journey.
As CF Finance, we work closely with our Operations partners to ensure leaders have reliable, up-to-date information to take the right decisions. We value the different perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets our people bring — they make us stronger.

Key job responsibilities
• Build reports and financial models that inform forecasting, planning and problem-solving, and share your analysis to support strategic decisions.
• Dive deep to understand what is driving performance, identify root causes behind variances, and propose actionable recommendations.
• Own recurring financial and operational reporting, ensuring accuracy and providing clear, timely commentary to stakeholders.
• Build trusted relationships with business partners, use narratives, data and analysis to influence decisions, and challenge assumptions where the data tells a different story.
• Lead or contribute to projects that scale processes, strengthen controllership, or add value.
• Simplify and improve: automate processes, reduce defects, and make your deliverables easier for everyone to use.
• Communicate findings clearly and concisely — both verbally and in writing — including to non-finance partners and senior leaders, even as topics grow more complex.
• Contribute to the team by building and maintaining tools, SOPs and documentation, sharing knowledge with others, and supporting the onboarding and development of colleagues.

A day in the life
You use data to build reports and financial models that answer difficult business questions. You dive into cost drivers and productivity metrics, and when performance moves away from plan, you look for the story behind the numbers. You sit side by side with your Operations partners, translating data into clear, actionable insight and aligning on the right path forward.

You work independently on your own analysis while partnering closely with colleagues across the business. You will be based in one of our corporate offices and may visit our sites from time to time to ground your analysis in real operational context. No two weeks look exactly the same, and that variety is part of what makes the role rewarding.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience in quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance)
- Experience working with data to drive business decisions, including advanced proficiency in Excel
- Experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving, or experience in financial modeling
Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field, or Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python), or experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
- Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience giving skills and communicating complex concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences across different functions
- Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Amazon EU Logistics Central Operations Finance
jobs.description:
Amazon Logistics is transforming its last-mile delivery network at pace, opening new delivery stations, expanding faster delivery options for customers, and handling steadily growing volumes across Europe. As the network has scaled and centralised, Central Operations has become the team that runs the day-to-day execution decisions behind last-mile delivery across Europe, from how delivery stations manage their capacity and volume to how routes, fleet, and delivery-partner costs are managed on the road. Finance partners closely alongside it, turning operational performance into the insights that guide where the network invests next.

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who is excited to partner with operations and influence how a fast-growing network manages its productivity. You will own the financial partnership for a Central Operations area, connecting operational performance to the cost base across delivery stations in Europe, sizing the opportunities that matter, quantifying the trade-offs, and proactively guiding business owners toward the decisions that improve performance, so that in a network this size, where even small movements in productivity translate into meaningful results, the analysis you bring genuinely shapes how the business acts.

With the reporting automated and much of the recurring analysis now taking care of itself, the value you bring is in reading the numbers better than anyone else, spotting where cost is drifting before it reaches the plan, and partnering with the business to act on it. You will draw on the team's own AI and automation tools to spend your time exactly there, on the analysis and the partnership that move performance, on a team that keeps setting itself a higher standard and will look to you to help shape what comes next.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the financial partnership for a Central Operations area, connecting operational performance metrics to financial outcomes and identifying where cost is running ahead of plan.
• Bring the analysis to business owners, sizing the opportunity, quantifying the trade-off, and influencing decisions, making thoughtful judgement calls in ambiguous environments where data may be difficult to procure.
• Lead root cause analysis on variances spanning multiple sites or countries, separating controllable drivers from structural ones and designing scalable measurement that improves network efficiency.
• Drive cost-out and efficiency opportunities within your area, contributing to the cross-functional programs that reduce cost and defects across the network.
• Own the financial and operational planning for your area, producing a challenging yet solid plan and testing business assumptions where needed.
• Communicate variance drivers and the actions to close them to Country Finance leads and senior stakeholders, turning analysis into decisions.
• Partner with data and technology teams to automate recurring analysis, and support the adoption of the team's AI and automation tools across the wider finance community.

A day in the life
You will be at the center of how the network builds its performance, so on any given day you might be working with a business owner to understand why an area is performing the way it is and where the next level of productivity will come from, pressure-testing a capacity or productivity plan together to make sure it reaches for the right ambition, or turning what the numbers are telling you into a clear recommendation that moves a decision forward.

Some of the questions you will help answer:

• Where is the network losing efficiency, and which lever wins it back fastest?
• Is a given variance controllable, or is it driven by network design and service mix?
• How do we shape a capacity or productivity plan so it lands the best balance of cost and service?

No two days look the same, but the thread that ties them together is that you will use data, judgement, and financial rigour to help the network deliver better, faster, and more cost-effectively, working alongside the business to get there.

We partner across countries and delivery stations to strengthen the productivity plan, protect the cost base, and shape where the network invests next, and we are the trusted business advisors to Central Operations leadership, working with our partners to make sure they have the most reliable information and make the best possible decisions.

ファイナンシャルアナリストは、経営企画・財務部の一員として担当ビジネス部門と一体となってビジネス戦略や事業計画を策定・実行のサポートをし、経営者の視点からビジネスの成長と財務の健全性をサポートします。予実分析や経営指標のトラッキングのみならず、大量のデータに基づく分析や自ら現場へ赴き何が起きているか実際に把握し、ビジネス部門とアマゾンビジネスの拡大・成長をサポートする提案を行います。さらに、新規サービスの立ち上げや重要な変更に対する、ビジネス部門へのコンサルティング業務も行い、日々起こるビジネスの変化をダイレクトに経験することができます。

Amazonの財務部門は、世界最大級のeコマース企業およびテクノロジーカンパニーの財務戦略を支える重要な組織です。Amazon内の多岐にわたる事業部門の健全な成長を財務面からサポートしています。

Amazon の財務部門はただ数字を扱う部署ではなく、世界をリードするテクノロジー企業で革新的なプロジェクトに携わりながらプロフェッショナルとしての成長を実現できるチームとなっております。

＜職種概要＞

データ駆動型の意思決定をリードし、ビジネスの成長機会の特定や、運営効率の向上に貢献していただきます。具体的には、複雑な財務モデリング、予算策定、収益予測、原価計算、投資収益率（ROI）分析などを実施します。最新の分析ツールやテクノロジーを活用し、大規模なデータセットから実用的な示唆を導き出すことが期待されます。

また、事業部門のリーダーやステークホルダーと緊密に連携し、経営判断に必要な財務分析や提言を行い、事業戦略の策定から実行までを財務面からサポートします。

Amazonの企業文化である「Day 1」の精神に基づき、常に顧客中心主義を念頭に置きながら、革新的なアイデアを追求することが求められます。財務部門では、単なる数字の管理だけでなく、ビジネスパートナーとして事業の成長を積極的に支援する姿勢が重視されます。

キャリア開発の面では、グローバルに展開する様々なプロジェクトに参画する機会があり、財務のプロフェッショナルとしての成長を加速させることができます。社内の異なる事業部門や地域での経験を積むことも可能です。

＜選考プロセス＞
書類→オンラインアセスメント→一次面接（Excel Test）→最終面接

履歴書（英語・日本語可）：必ず以下の項目が含まれることをご確認ください。以下の内容が含まれていない場合は、次のステップへのご案内ができない場合があります。

② 最も大きな失敗と、そこから学び行動を変えたこと 　③ データや事実に基づいて自分の考え・判断を変えた経験

以下の事項をご確認の上、ご応募ください。

jobs.title: Financial Analyst Intern 2027
jobs.description:
Un univers d'opportunités vous attend chez Amazon.

Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle s'accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi d'une manière que vous n'auriez jamais imaginée. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonner la manière dont elles vivent, travaillent et interagissent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact.

Vous travaillerez avec des outils de classe mondiale, des plateformes internationales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez vite, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent. Avec d'innombrables opportunités à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez rapidement, mettrez en pratique vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences que vous ne soupçonniez pas. C'est un environnement conçu pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact de leur travail dans le monde. Prêt à commencer l'aventure ?

Qu'est-ce que ça vous apporte ?

Un stage chez Amazon, c'est de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous concevrez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui souhaitent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact.

Les équipes financières sont les moteurs stratégiques de toute organisation. Ce rôle vous donne l'opportunité de participer aux décisions commerciales à grande échelle, dans une entreprise multinationale qui conserve sa culture de start-up centrée sur le client (Day One Customer Obsessed). En vous impliquant dans les indicateurs de performance, l'analyse de données et les modèles financiers, vous identifierez où nous pouvons améliorer l'efficacité et la productivité pour continuer à réduire les coûts pour nos clients tout en améliorant continuellement la sélection de nos produits.

Key job responsibilities
Durant votre stage, vous relèverez des défis commerciaux concrets tout en développant votre expertise analytique. En tant que stagiaire, vous serez responsable de projets qui impactent directement nos opérations commerciales, affinant vos compétences financières et quantitatives. Cette expérience pratique vous apportera une exposition précieuse à la finance d'entreprise, à l'analyse de données, et vous permettra de développer des solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) en collaboration avec des professionnels de la finance partageant la même obsession du client. Vous participerez à la prise de décisions stratégiques en apprenant de vos pairs et de vos leaders. Vous acquerrez une expérience pratique en planification financière, analyse et reporting tout en contribuant à des initiatives qui stimulent la croissance de l'entreprise et augmentent la valeur pour le client. Cette opportunité est idéale pour les personnes motivées souhaitant lancer leur carrière dans la finance ou le commerce en général. Où mieux apprendre à innover à grande échelle que
dans une entreprise disposant de ressources multinationales mais gardant l'esprit d'une start-
up?

Responsabilités clés:
• Analyser les données et tendances financières pour optimiser les coûts et l'efficacité opérationnelle
• Développer des rapports financiers, des prévisions et des tableaux de bord KPI pour soutenir la prise de décision stratégique
• Réaliser des évaluations financières qui éclairent les solutions commerciales et améliorent la valeur client
• Mettre en œuvre l'automatisation des processus et l'amélioration de la qualité des données
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes au sein des équipes tout en développant votre réseau professionnel

A day in the life
Votre stage rémunéré de 6 mois comprend:

• Mentorat : nous nous soucions de vos aspirations professionnelles et nous efforçons d'attribuer des projets selon vos intérêts. Vous pouvez apprendre et être curieux avec un accès illimité aux formations virtuelles sur la gestion de projet, la marque personnelle, les compétences en communication et bien plus encore.
• Avantages supplémentaires pour les Amazoniens tels que : remise exclusive Amazon.fr ; réduction sur l'abonnement en salle de sport ; tests bêta sur les nouveaux produits Amazon ; soutien gratuit en santé mentale, juridique et financier pour vous et votre famille.
• Impliquez-vous : nous avons plus de 13 groupes d'affinité Amazon que vous pouvez rejoindre et devenir allié d'une cause qui vous tient à cœur (développement durable, diversité, LGBTQ+, handicaps mentaux et/ou physiques, initiatives communautaires locales, etc.)
• Prenez en main votre carrière : car quand vous réussissez, nous gagnons tous. Un stage réussi pourrait mener à un poste à temps plein (diplômé) après la fin de vos études universitaires.

About the team
• Communauté de stagiaires : Rejoignez un réseau de stagiaires où vous créerez des liens durables à travers des projets collaboratifs et des événements sociaux. Engagez-vous avec des personnes partageant les mêmes idées dans des groupes d'intérêt spécialisés, du développement durable à l'innovation, élargissant votre réseau professionnel et votre perspective.
• Communauté Amazon : Immergez-vous dans la culture d'entreprise diversifiée d'Amazon, collaborant avec des professionnels de différents rôles et niveaux d'expérience pour acquérir des perspectives et des opportunités de mentorat inestimables.
• Support : Bénéficiez d'un support complet du programme, incluant un mentorat dédié, des heures de bureau régulières, et une assistance IT et RH, vous assurant d'avoir les ressources nécessaires pour réussir.
• Sessions d'apprentissage : Accélérez votre développement professionnel grâce à des sessions de formation exclusives, l'accès aux plateformes d'apprentissage d'Amazon, et l'interaction directe avec des experts du secteur, vous préparant au succès professionnel futur.
• Opportunités : Excellez dans votre stage pour débloquer des opportunités potentielles de postes diplômés à temps plein ou des programmes de stage prolongés. Profitez d'une rémunération compétitive, d'une aide à la relocalisation et d'avantages sociaux complets tout en travaillant dur, en vous amusant et en faisant l'histoire. Chaque journée sera remplie de développement de nouvelles compétences et de croissance personnelle.

Intéressé(e)? La soumission de votre candidature prend moins de 10 minutes et les lettres de motivation ne sont pas requises. Vous devrez simplement joindre votre CV et répondre à un questionnaire. Les candidats sélectionnés seront invités à une évaluation en ligne. En cas de succès, vous participerez à deux séries d'entretiens virtuels, qui se déroulent le même jour. Les entretiens consistent en des questions comportementales et une étude de cas, centrées sur nos Principes de Leadership. Le processus de recrutement complet prend généralement 3 à 4 semaines. Notez que le processus de sélection et les délais sont sujets à changement et varient selon le rôle et l'emplacement.

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst, WW Operations Sustainability Finance
jobs.description:
WW Operations Finance is looking for a Sr. Financial Analyst to join the Carbon Planning & Analysis team, supporting North America region (NA). CP&A is the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity (CI) data integrity, reporting, and planning across WW Ops' ~45MM tCO2 annual footprint, directly supporting the WW Ops S-team carbon intensity goal and Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment of net zero by 2040. This role will maintain and improve the data structures underpinning NA carbon reporting and planning, partner cross-functionally and cross-country with regional sustainability and BI teams, and deep-dive data quality challenges as they arise. The role sits at the intersection of Sustainability, Finance, and Operations - a rare combination that gives the analyst exposure to carbon science, financial planning rigor, and operational decarbonization levers all in one seat, and offers a strong foundation for building differentiated expertise in their career. The analyst will operate with growing autonomy over time as regional carbon data fluency builds.

Key job responsibilities
- Support NA carbon month-end close (MEC), ensuring carbon ledger (GCD) aligned data quality and timely resolution of carbonation and data quality issues.
- Maintain and continuously improve carbon reporting and planning data structures within data cluster and Carbon Reporting Deck.
- Partner cross-functionally with regional sustainability, BI, and BU Finance teams to consolidate data requests, validate submissions, and resolve discrepancies.
- Support carbon planning cycles (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), ensuring carbon drivers (LMPP, 3P cost, WHT LoH, fleet electrification) are captured accurately and tie to the broader financial plan.
- Deep-dive data quality and reporting challenges, identify root causes, and propose process or automation improvements.
- Contribute to CP&A's transition toward an AI-native reporting and planning model - supporting GenAI-powered variance commentary, automated data quality checks, and other tools that reduce manual reconciliation work.
- Assist in preparing variance commentary and metrics tables for leadership reporting (Kingpin, WWS reviews), under the guidance of a senior team member.
- Escalate data quality, timeline, or stakeholder risks promptly, partnering with the senior team member on resolution.
- Build subject-matter expertise in carbon data systems and regional carbon drivers to grow scope over time.

A day in the life
Your day starts with a check of data submission status and the latest carbon ledger (GCD) snapshot, flagging any late, missing, or anomalous data before it becomes a downstream reporting issue. For this you will use AI tool you have built. You'll join a call with an NA sustainability or BI counterpart to align on a carbon driver discrepancy or walk through a data request - always leading with data lineage and methodology clarity, since regional teams often hold their own numbers. Back at your desk, you update Carbon Reporting Deck tabs for your regions, validate CI calculations, and dig into any variances that don't tie to plan. You sync with your senior team member to review findings, prioritize open items, and decide what needs escalation versus what you can resolve independently. Depending on the point in the month, your afternoon might involve supporting a planning cycle deliverable (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), pulling together inputs for a leadership review, or scoping a process improvement to reduce manual reconciliation work.

About the team
Carbon Planning & Analysis sits within WW Operations Finance and was built from scratch in 2024 to bridge carbon science and financial planning across Amazon's largest and most complex emissions source. The team serves as the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity reporting, planning, and data integrity across NA, EU, and ROW - covering 10+ business units and over 45MM tCO2 of annual operations-wide emissions. CP&A owns the monthly carbon month-end close, the Carbon Reporting Deck (WW Ops' single source of truth for CI), and multi-year carbon planning (OP1/3YF, OP2), directly informing decisions at the VP and S-team level in support of the Climate Pledge's net zero by 2040 commitment. It's a small, high-visibility team that combines rigorous financial modeling with deep carbon domain expertise, and is actively building out AI-native automation for data quality checks and variance commentary.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 3+ years of finance, tax or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data, identifying patterns that support business strategy experience, and forecasting
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, NACF
jobs.description:
Amazon’s North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, supporting operational and functional leaders. Amazon operates the most complex retail networks in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses annually. Come be part of this tremendous organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence where you will focus on the inputs, think like an owner and where every day is Day One.

The NACFinance team vision is to provide cost controllership, projects return on investment (ROI), and financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across supply chain. Our team supports various North America teams through translating operational KPIs into financial impact to ensure our stakeholders have the most up to date and reliable information to make the best possible decision for Amazon. The ability to learn and be curious while working through a high degree of complex ambiguity in order to think big while inventing and simplifying for process improvement is mission critical.

Key job responsibilities
Key Business Support:
• End-to-end ownership of the financial planning cycles which include forecast modeling, bridging, network partnership and presentations to senior leadership.
• Perform projects financial validations to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights.
• Collect, analyze and manage quantitative data and create meaningful reports to lead business improvement and defect cost reduction strategy.
• Perform root cause analysis to uncover core issues using data, then assisting the operation stakeholders to improve and create new measures for sites productivity.
• Invent and simply processes to drive efficiency and cost improvement over finance processes related to defect costs.
• Thinking big to deliver scalable solutions to better understand end-to-end cost and identify new improvement opportunities.

Controllership:
• Intuitively utilize active listening skills to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner, adjusting your style based on audience, to articulate complex finance issues.
• Create effective business partnership with senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and provide guidance for cost strategy and goals.
• Have backbone and challenge business partner plans and assumptions when needed.

Team Leadership:
Take part in developing and mentoring activities, and leverage diverse perspectives.

A day in the life
The Defect Cost Controllership (DCC) team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings and end-to-end (e2e) defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment (NACF). The primary time spend is focused on workstreams to identify opportunities that lead to cost reduction, process improvement, and financial controllership. The team is also responsible for project financial validations, return-on-investment, and tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, developing and leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables

About the team
The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment, and collaborates with Customer Service, Transportation and Delivery teams for an end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. The endless opportunity to invent on behalf of our customers ensures the work is always fun.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
Preferred qualifications:
- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst, Amazon Business Finance
jobs.description:
Entering the business to business (B2B) market is one of Amazon’s most exciting growth opportunities and since launching in 2015, Amazon Business (AB) already has more than 6 million customers WW. We are growing fast, and require talented finance professionals to help us scale.

Amazon Business (AB) Finance is hiring a Sr. Financial Analyst to support the WW Amazon Business Product & Technology organization. This team encompasses engineering, product management, UX/design, and technical program management across all AB verticals, building the core platform that powers B2B commerce globally. You will serve as a finance business partner to senior technology leadership, owning headcount and operating expense (HC/OpEx) planning, investment analysis, and financial reporting for one of Amazon's fastest-growing technology organizations.

This role requires a Builder who can develop scalable financial models, deliver actionable insights to VP-level leadership, and drive operational rigor in resource allocation. You will partner closely with engineering and product leaders to evaluate technology investment tradeoffs, analyze cost structures across a global workforce, and ensure financial resources are deployed against the highest-impact priorities.

AB Finance offers a rich learning experience and an opportunity to develop professionally. We are a young business, and you will be challenged to weigh in on decisions that have long-term strategic impact and to produce insightful analytics that help us accelerate growth. You will work closely with business partners and get exposure to senior leaders, and become a subject matter expert. We are looking for individuals who can engage business partners to drive results and who welcome the challenge of building structure and supporting high growth.

Key job responsibilities
Own HC and OpEx forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting for the WW AB Product & Technology organization, spanning engineering, product, UX, and TPM teams across multiple geographies.

Build and maintain financial models to evaluate technology investment tradeoffs, headcount scenarios, and resource allocation across charters and programs.

Partner directly with senior technology leadership to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, providing analytical insights that inform hiring decisions, contractor spend, and program funding.

Deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR/QBR) with clear, data-driven narratives that explain cost trends, forecast risks, and opportunities to VP-level audiences.

Drive process improvements in financial planning cycles, developing scalable mechanisms for tracking technology costs, workforce productivity, and ROI on engineering investments.

Solve complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, business insights, and recommendations that drive improvements and influence leaders.

Influence business decisions with effective verbal and written communication, data-driven analysis and modeling, and presentation of options and alternatives.

- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience

- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

jobs.description:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills:
• Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
• Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
• Strong attention to details.
• Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
• Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
• Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
• Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

- Experience with Excel

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor, ATS
jobs.description:
Las operaciones son la esencia de todo lo que hacemos en Amazon. Los artículos se procesan y envían a tiempo a nuestros clientes gracias a la eficacia de las operaciones. Ser supervisor/a de operaciones te da la oportunidad de ver cómo funcionan sus distintas etapas y de intervenir para que todo vaya sobre ruedas.

Serás la primera persona de contacto para los miembros del equipo durante su turno y les ayudarás a seguir los procesos establecidos por tus superiores. Se trata de un puesto muy práctico, que te aportará experiencia en el uso de las herramientas y los sistemas que garantizan el éxito de nuestras operaciones.

Key job responsibilities
- Medir y supervisar los flujos de trabajo, controlar la productividad en el centro y proporcionar información clave sobre los turnos a los/las responsables de primera línea para garantizar la excelencia operativa.
- Brindar apoyo y formar al personal para que pueda prestar un gran servicio y supervisarlo en sus tareas diarias.
- Apoyar al/a la responsable de área con proyectos destinados a mejorar procesos, crear un entorno de trabajo seguro y aumentar la motivación de los trabajadores.
- Colaborar con otros departamentos en la búsqueda de soluciones a problemas comunes o garantizar el rendimiento en áreas clave.
- Identificar formas de optimizar la seguridad, la calidad y la productividad mediante el análisis de datos.

A day in the life
Como supervisor/a de operaciones tu sitio estará en uno de nuestros centros operativos. Ayudarás a tu responsable de turno/área a ejecutar el plan establecido para cada turno. Para ello, desempeñarás un papel fundamental en las reuniones de equipo celebradas antes de cada turno y supervisarás los procedimientos para asegurarte de que todo el mundo sigue las normas de seguridad, los procesos de calidad y el plan de prioridades de cada día.
Si detectas algún problema, se lo comunicarás a tu superior, pero a veces serás la persona más veterana del turno y el encargado de dar a los demás las instrucciones necesarias para que realicen sus tareas. En otras ocasiones, ayudarás a tu responsable de área a organizar los turnos para garantizar una cobertura de personal suficiente durante las horas punta.

About the team
Amazon Transportation, o ATS, se encarga de la mediafase del proceso de entrega, en colaboración con empresas externas de distribución. Recurrimos al pensamiento creativo y la puesta en marcha de iniciativas de mejora continua para hacer llegar millones de productos a manos de nuestros clientes. Nuestro objetivo consiste en dar a los clientes una experiencia de entrega lo más fluida posible y lanzar soluciones de ámbito internacional para el reparto en nuestros servicios más recientes, como Amazon Fresh, Prime Now y Amazon Restaurants.
Nuestra actividad tiene dos facetas. El personal que trabaja en los centros logísticos procesa millones de productos para enviarlos a los equipos de reparto. Nuestro equipo se centra en las personas y las apoya, sobre todo porque muchas de ellas trabajan en horarios de noche. Las operaciones son el núcleo principal de nuestra actividad, de ahí que trabajemos por turnos las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana en casi todos nuestros centros.
En paralelo, nuestro personal sobre el terreno trabaja con Amazon Flex, una red de contratistas de reparto. Cada año que pasa elevamos el listón de la experiencia que ofrecemos al cliente incluyendo en nuestra cartera nuevos y, sobre todo, innovadores servicios de entrega. Buscamos nuevas maneras de superar los retos logísticos del sector y de reducir nuestra huella de carbono, gracias a una cartera de vehículos de última generación (que incluye vehículos eléctricos) y a la tecnología que nos ayuda a lograrlo.

- Nivel avanzado de español, tanto oral como escrito (nivel C1 CEFR).
- Experiencia en el empleo del análisis de datos y métricas relacionadas para identificar problemas.
- Experiencia en el manejo de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) en un entorno laboral.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experiencia en la gestión de socios empresariales, lo que incluye establecer y mantener relaciones profesionales.
- Experiencia en un entorno operativo, como la logística, el comercio minorista, la hostelería o la atención al cliente.
- Nivel intermedio alto de inglés

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Advanced proficiency in local language in both written and verbal communication (C1 Common European Framework of Reference, CEFR)
- Relevant experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems
Preferred qualifications:
- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- Experience of stakeholder management including building and maintaining professional relationships
- Experience in an operational environment, such as logistics, retail, hospitality, or customer service

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Ein effektiv ablaufender Betrieb trägt dazu bei, dass Artikel bearbeitet und rechtzeitig an unsere Kund:innen versendet werden. Als Operations Supervisor erlebst Du, wie alle unterschiedlichen Teile des Betriebs funktionieren und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf bei.
Du fungierst als erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für Teammitglieder während ihrer Schicht und hilfst ihnen beim Befolgen der Prozesse, die Deine Manager:innen eingeführt haben. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung und benutzt analytische Systeme, die zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beitragen.

Key job responsibilities
- Messung und Überwachung von Arbeitsflüssen, Verfolgen der Leistung am Standort und Bereitstellung wichtiger Schichtinformationen an die Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:innen im Betrieb, um für schichtübergreifende Operational Excellence zu sorgen
- Unterstützung und Schulung von Mitarbeitenden, damit diese großartige Leistungen erbringen können, und Beaufsichtigung ihrer täglichen Aufgaben
- Unterstützung des/der Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei Projekten zur Prozessverbesserung, Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds und Erhöhung des Mitarbeiterengagements
- Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um Lösungen für häufige Probleme zu finden oder Bedürfnisse in wichtigen Leistungsbereichen zu erfüllen
- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu finden

A day in the life
Als Operations Supervisor arbeitest Du an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Du unterstützt Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Durchführung des Schichtplans. Du hilft bei der Vorbereitung von Schichtbesprechungen mit Deinem Team und überwachst Verfahren und Abläufe. Damit stellst du sicher, dass Sicherheitsregeln, Qualitätssicherungsprozesse und die Prioritäten für den Tag befolgt werden.
Probleme, die Du bemerkst, eskalierst Du an Deine:n Manager:in. Gelegentlich agierst Du auch selbst als Schichtleiter:in und bietest Deinen Mitarbeitenden die notwendige Anleitung, um ihre Aufgaben zu erledigen. Bei Bedarf unterstützt Du Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Schichtplanung und sorgst dafür, dass zu Stoßzeiten genügend Teammitglieder eingeteilt sind.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.
Basic qualifications:
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenanalytik und deren Anwendung zur Problemerkennung
- Erfahrung mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld
Preferred qualifications:
- Erfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement, einschließlich Aufbau und Pflege professioneller Beziehungen
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem Betriebsumfeld, beispielsweise in Logistik, Einzelhandel, Gastgewerbe oder im Kundenservice
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse

- Collaborate with the Area Managers and Operations Managers in tracking, analyzing, and reporting metrics
- Support the Area Managers and Operations Managers in identifying and understanding factors contributing to the achievement or shortfall of objectives
- Monitor and report on associate hours and schedules
- Address and resolve process-related issues within the area as needed
- Ensure timely and accurate reporting of equipment defects

- Experience in logistics

Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.
Basic qualifications:
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenanalytik und deren Anwendung zur Problemerkennung
- Erfahrung mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld
Preferred qualifications:
- Erfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement, einschließlich Aufbau und Pflege professioneller Beziehungen
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem Betriebsumfeld, beispielsweise in Logistik, Einzelhandel, Gastgewerbe oder im Kundenservice
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse

jobs.description:
We’re seeking for an experienced Operations Supervisor/Process Assistant to join the team of our Fulfillment Center at Morebank.

The Process Assistant will support the Area Manager, and will hold responsibilities specific to your process path which may include receive, stow, pick, pack or ship.

Key job responsibilities:
- Support and work in Inbound and other departments as required
- Helping support daily management of department duties, including allocating labor, leading meetings, assigning job duties
- Providing coverage for Area Managers
- Providing policy follow-up, attendance tracking (duties do not extend to discipline)
- Tracking and reporting of ATS/labor hours
- Assisting the floor as an associate resource, training associates and verifying SOP compliance
- Ensuring successful area performance, through tracking, reporting and feedback of associate performance
- Participating in Operational Excellence initiatives in some capacity
- Fully understanding workflow and daily production goals
- Assisting in keeping work area clean and organised
- Identifying and addressing safety hazards within the work area
- Coaching associates to work safely at all times
- Referring all job injuries immediately to area manager
Basic qualifications:
- Experience in team leadership
- Experience managing inventory in warehousing, retail or distribution setting
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Availability to work 38 hours+/week, and overtime as required
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in management directly
- Experience in performance metrics, process improvement, and Lean methodologies
- Comfortable in lifting up to 16 kilos, stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach, all with or without reasonable accommodation
